topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 日常生活中的 AI
topics.description: 发现日常生活中的 AI：手机的人脸解锁、视频推荐、拼写自动纠正、能感应到人的自动门；那些好像“知道”事情的技术
evidence: Identify at least five examples of AI in their daily life
Explain that these technologies use patterns and data, not magic or real thinking
Describe one way AI makes their life easier and one time it might not work perfectly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能说出几样自己每天都会用到的东西——比如自动纠正或人脸解锁——并说明这些就是 AI 的例子？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 日常生活中的计算机
topics.description: 识别日常生活中的计算机——不只是笔记本电脑，还有手机、平板、智能音箱、红绿灯、洗衣机；是什么让一样东西成为计算机
evidence: Point out at least five everyday objects that contain computers
Explain what all computers have in common (they follow instructions and process information)
Sort a set of objects into 'contains a computer' and 'does not contain a computer'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能在家里四处看看，指出至少五样里面装有计算机的东西，包括那些看起来不像传统计算机的？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 现实世界中的机器人
topics.description: 机器人到底是什么——不是科幻片里的样子；工厂里的机器人、扫地机器人、手术中的机械臂；机器人会按照人给的指令行动
evidence: Describe what a robot is (a machine that follows instructions to do a task)
Name at least three real robots and what they do
Explain that robots are not alive and do not have feelings — they follow instructions people wrote
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一台扫地机器人，能不能解释它和人打扫有什么不同——它是按指令行动，而不是自己思考？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 智能设备与非智能设备
topics.description: 把物品分成“智能”（能感知并做出反应）和“不智能”（只是待在那里）；烤面包机与智能音箱的对比；初步认识有些机器能感知世界并做出反应
evidence: Sort a set of objects into 'smart' (responds to input) and 'not smart' (does the same thing every time)
Explain what makes a smart speaker different from a regular radio
Give an example of a machine that senses something and responds (automatic door, motion-sensor light)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能解释普通电灯开关和走进房间就自动亮起的开关有什么区别？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 分步指令
topics.description: 日常任务的分步指令（做三明治、刷牙）；如果指令有错或缺失，事情就会出错；计算机会严格按指令执行
evidence: Write or describe step-by-step instructions for a simple everyday task
Predict what goes wrong if a step is missing or in the wrong order
Explain that a computer follows instructions exactly — it cannot guess what you meant
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要写一份做果酱三明治的指令，精确到连机器人都能照着做，能不能把每一个步骤都写进去？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 语音助手及其工作原理
topics.description: 当你对 Alexa、Siri 或 Google Assistant 说话时会发生什么；它们会听、试着理解、查找答案；有时会弄错；它们是工具，不是活的
evidence: Describe the steps that happen when you ask a voice assistant a question (it listens, processes words, finds an answer, speaks back)
Give an example of a time a voice assistant might get something wrong
Explain that a voice assistant is a computer program, not a person — it doesn't understand or feel
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 问了 Alexa 或 Siri 一个问题却得到错误答案，能不能解释语音助手为什么有时会出错？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 电脑游戏中的 AI
topics.description: 电脑游戏角色如何“决定”要做什么；简单的基于规则的 AI 与会学习的 AI；NPC、难度调整；AI 作为国际象棋或棋盘游戏中的对手
evidence: Explain how a computer opponent in a game decides its moves
Describe the difference between a game character that follows fixed rules and one that learns from the player
Give an example of AI making a game more fun (adjusting difficulty, generating levels)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 和电脑玩电子游戏时，能不能解释游戏里的角色是如何“决定”要做什么的？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 的错误与局限
topics.description: 机器会犯错；它们只知道被展示过的东西；糟糕的训练数据会导致糟糕的结果；AI 不是魔法——只是对数据做数学运算；展示边缘情况和失败案例
evidence: Give an example of AI making a mistake (voice assistant mishearing, auto-correct error, wrong recommendation)
Explain that AI mistakes happen because of gaps or errors in training data
Describe why AI is not magic — it follows mathematical rules applied to data
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 AI 把一张松饼的图片错认成吉娃娃，{{name}} 能不能解释为什么会出现这种错误？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 计算机的数据与信息
topics.description: 什么是数据：计算机使用的信息——数字、文字、图片、声音；计算机知道的一切都来自人们给它的数据
evidence: Define data as information stored in a computer (numbers, text, images, sounds)
Give at least three examples of data they create every day (photos, messages, search queries)
Explain that a computer only knows what it has been given — it has no knowledge of its own
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释“数据”是什么意思，并举例说明他们每次使用手机或电脑时会创造哪些数据吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人类与机器
topics.description: 比较人类与机器的能力：创造力、共情、常识 vs 速度、记忆、重复；图灵测试（简化版）；是什么让人类独一无二
evidence: Name at least three things humans are better at than computers (creativity, empathy, common sense)
Name at least three things computers are better at than humans (speed, memory, repetitive tasks)
Describe the Turing Test in simple terms (can a computer fool a person into thinking it's human?)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释人类在哪些方面仍然比计算机更强，以及计算机能做什么人类做不到的事吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 机器学习基础
topics.description: 机器学习在概念层面如何运作：给计算机看很多例子，它找出规律，然后对新事物做出预测；用 Teachable Machine 或类似工具动手体验
evidence: Describe the three steps of machine learning in simple terms (give examples, find patterns, make predictions)
Train a simple model using a tool like Teachable Machine and describe what happened
Explain why showing more and better examples makes the model more accurate
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述如何教计算机识别某样东西——给它看大量例子，直到它发现规律吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 规律与分类
topics.description: 人类很擅长发现规律；计算机也能学会发现规律，但需要大量例子；分类与归类活动是机器学习的基础
evidence: Sort a set of items into categories and explain the rules they used
Explain that computers learn patterns by looking at many examples
Describe why a computer needs more examples than a human to learn the same pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看猫和狗的图片，他们能解释计算机如何学会区分它们吗——以及为什么计算机需要的图片比人多得多？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 推荐系统与信息茧房
topics.description: 推荐系统如何运作：YouTube、Netflix 和购物网站会追踪你点击的内容并找出规律；信息茧房；有用建议与操纵之间的区别
evidence: Explain how YouTube or Netflix decides what to suggest next
Describe what a 'filter bubble' is (only seeing things similar to what you already like)
Give one benefit and one risk of recommendation systems
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能理解为什么 YouTube 总是推荐和他们看过的相似的视频，并能解释推荐系统是如何运作的吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 与决策公平
topics.description: AI 是否应该对人们做出重要决定：工作、贷款、司法；当 AI 做出不公平决定时谁来负责；算法公平入门
evidence: Give an example of an important decision that AI might help make (hiring, medical diagnosis, loan approval)
Explain why letting AI make decisions about people can be risky if the system is biased
Suggest who should be responsible if an AI system makes an unfair decision
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 得知一个计算机程序在决定谁获得面试机会，他们能解释为什么这可能不公平，以及应该由谁负责吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 与环境
topics.description: AI 训练需要大量能源和水；数据中心及其环境成本；但 AI 也能帮忙——预测天气、监测森林砍伐、优化能源；权衡取舍
evidence: Explain that training AI models uses a lot of electricity and water
Give at least two examples of AI being used to help the environment
Describe the trade-off between AI's environmental cost and its environmental benefits
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释 AI 运行需要大量能源，但也可以用来帮助保护环境，并讨论这种权衡是否值得吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 与工作的未来
topics.description: AI 如何改变工作世界：一些工作消失，新工作出现，许多工作发生变化；AI（目前）做不了的工作；在 AI 时代哪些技能重要
evidence: Name at least two jobs that AI is changing or replacing and two new jobs AI has created
Explain why creativity, empathy, and problem-solving are skills that matter more in an AI world
Describe how AI might change a specific job they know about (teacher, doctor, farmer) without replacing it
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释 AI 未来可能如何改变人们的工作方式，以及哪些人类技能仍然重要吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 数据收集与隐私
topics.description: AI 系统会收集你的哪些数据；谁拥有这些数据、为什么重要；cookie、追踪、一直在听的智能音箱；你的数据很有价值
evidence: Name at least three types of personal data that AI systems collect
Explain why personal data is valuable to companies
Describe one step they can take to protect their privacy online
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否明白应用和网站会收集他们在网上的行为信息，并能解释为什么这很重要？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 系统中的偏见
topics.description: 如果训练数据有偏见，AI 就会有偏见；例如：人脸识别对某些肤色效果更好、翻译默认性别；偏见从何而来，我们能否修正
evidence: Explain what bias in AI means using a real-world example
Describe how biased training data leads to biased AI results
Suggest one way to reduce bias in an AI system (use more diverse data, test with different groups)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否解释为什么一个主要用浅肤色人脸照片训练的 AI，对深肤色的人可能效果没那么好？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 深度伪造与 AI 生成内容
topics.description: 深度伪造、AI 生成的图像和文字；如何识别它们、为什么重要；核实来源的重要性；网上的东西不都是真的
evidence: Explain what a deepfake is and give an example of AI-generated content
Describe at least two clues that might reveal an image or text was AI-generated
Explain why it matters that AI can create realistic fake content
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在网上看到一张惊艳的照片，他们会想到去质疑它可能是 AI 生成的，而不是相机拍的吗？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 设计公平的 AI 规则
topics.description: 把设计思维用到 AI 伦理上：如果你来设计一个 AI 系统，你会给它定什么规则？它应该帮助谁？它不应该被允许做什么？
evidence: Propose at least three rules for a hypothetical AI system they are designing
Explain why AI designers need to think about who might be harmed, not just who benefits
Describe one real example of AI being used responsibly and one where it was not
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要为学校设计一个 AI 助手，他们能否想出规则来确保它对每个人都公平、有帮助？

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: AI 的未来
topics.description: AI 在 10 年后可能做什么；我们希望它做什么、担心什么；孩子是未来 AI 的设计者和决策者；充满希望、赋能的视角
evidence: Describe at least two ways AI might be used in the future that don't exist yet
Explain one thing they would want AI to do and one thing they would want it not to do
Describe why it matters that young people understand AI — because they will shape how it is used
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否有深度地聊一聊他们希望 AI 未来做什么、又担心什么？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 为理解而读
topics.description: 理解阅读是为了获取意义，而不只是把字念对——一段能拼读出来却没被读懂的文本，等于没读
evidence: Simple View of Reading (Gough & Tunmer)
reading comprehension research on comprehension-decoding separation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 能正确朗读一段内容，却说不出它讲了什么，他们是否认识到阅读意味着理解——而不只是念出字词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 监控理解过程
topics.description: 注意拼读字词和真正理解之间的区别——意识到自己读了字词却没抓住意思，并采取行动
evidence: comprehension monitoring research
Metacognitive Monitoring in Reading Comprehension (MDPI 2024)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读完一段话或听完一段讲解后，是否能察觉自己其实没太听懂——而不是装作听懂了继续往下走？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作者的用词选择
topics.description: 认识作者在词语、结构、语气和视角上的刻意选择，如何对作为读者的你产生特定效果
evidence: authorial awareness research
Understanding Author's Purpose (Firkins)
collaborative multilayered text interpretation in 5-8 year olds
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读一本书或一篇文章时，是否会注意到并说出作者为什么这样写——以及这对作为读者的他们有什么影响？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 推断与明确含义
topics.description: 区分文本明确说了什么，以及你自己推断、假设或读进去的内容——分清两者是诚实理解的基础
evidence: inference vs literal comprehension development research
online inference making and comprehension monitoring (PMC 2021)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 读完一个故事或一篇文章后，他们能告诉你哪些部分是文本里实际读到的，哪些部分是他们自己推出来或假设的吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 知道自己不知道什么
topics.description: 留意自己的词汇缺口——注意到那些一知半解的单词，区分有把握和不确定的知识，并发展出解决不确定性的策略
evidence: Noticing Unfamiliar Words Assessment research (grade 2+)
word consciousness and vocabulary metacognition research
Building Word Knowledge e-Book (PMC 2019)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 遇到一个一知半解的单词——能猜出意思但不太确定——他们会注意到这个缺口并采取行动吗，比如查一查或问一问？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 回顾自己的写作
topics.description: 评估自己的写作是否达到了想要给读者的效果——不只是检查对错，还要问它是否真的奏效
evidence: writing self-evaluation research grades 3-5
metacognitive awareness of writing (Frontiers 2025)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 写完东西之后——一个故事、一封信、一篇议论文——他们会思考它是否能对读者产生想要的效果，而不只是拼写对不对吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 反思自己的语言使用
topics.description: 反思自己作为语言使用者的表现——你的阅读、写作和说话如何随受众、目的和情境而变化，以及你想在哪些方面进一步发展
evidence: metalinguistic awareness development
register and audience awareness research
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 会注意到自己在不同情境下沟通方式的不同吗——比如写学校作业和给朋友发消息，或在辩论中发言和在家聊天——他们能解释这些差异为什么重要吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 组句
topics.description: 理解词语组合起来构成句子——句子表达一个完整的意思；在口语和书面表达中说出并扩展完整的句子
evidence: Distinguish between complete sentences and fragments
Compose a complete sentence with a subject and verb
Expand a simple sentence by adding detail
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 说出类似“The dog”这样的话，他们能告诉你这不是一个完整的句子——并加上词语让它变成类似“The dog ran fast”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词与词之间的空格
topics.description: 书写时用空格分隔单词；理解空格在书面文字中标记词与词的边界
evidence: Leave clear finger-spaces between words when writing
Count the number of words in a written sentence by identifying spaces
Correct writing that has missing spaces between words
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在写一条短消息，他们能在每个词之间留出空格——让读者能看出一个词在哪里结束、下一个词在哪里开始吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 基础名词与动词
topics.description: 在口语和书面表达中恰当使用常见名词（人、地点、事物）和动词（动作词）
evidence: Use common nouns accurately in sentences (e.g. 'dog', 'school', 'book')
Use action verbs appropriately (e.g. 'run', 'eat', 'play')
Identify nouns and verbs in simple sentences when prompted
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 谈论或书写日常事物时——比如“the dog runs”或“Mum cooks dinner”——他们能正确使用表示事物（名词）和动作（动词）的词，而不混淆吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人名、星期与 I 的大写
topics.description: 专有名词（人名、地名）、星期几以及人称代词“I”使用大写字母
evidence: Capitalise names of people and places consistently in writing
Write the pronoun 'I' as a capital letter
Capitalise days of the week (e.g. 'Monday')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在写朋友的名字或一个城镇的名字，他们会自动用大写字母开头吗——在说到自己时，会把“I”写成大写吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法词汇：字母、单词、句子
topics.description: 在讨论阅读和写作时使用基本的语法术语：字母、大写字母、单词、单数、复数、句子、标点、句号、问号、感叹号
evidence: Name punctuation marks correctly when pointed out in text
Use terms like 'capital letter' and 'full stop' when editing writing
Explain what a 'sentence' is using the correct term
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你指着书里的句号或问号，{{name}} 能说出它叫什么、有什么用吗？他们能分清单词和句子的区别吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用“and”连接词语
topics.description: 使用连词“and”连接词语和分句，组成更长的句子
evidence: Combine two simple sentences using 'and' (e.g. 'I like cats and dogs')
Join two related clauses with 'and' (e.g. 'We went to the park and we played')
Use 'and' in lists of items within a sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 跟你讲他这一天的事时，他能不能把两个想法用“and”连起来写出来——比如“I had lunch and then we played outside”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 方位介词
topics.description: 理解并使用最常见的表示位置和方向的介词（如 to、from、in、out、on、off、for、by、with）
evidence: Use prepositions correctly in sentences (e.g. 'on the table', 'under the bed')
Follow instructions involving prepositions (e.g. 'Put the book on the shelf')
Describe positions using prepositional phrases
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 描述某个东西在哪里——比如杯子在桌上的什么位置——他能不能正确使用“on”“under”“next to”或“by”这样的小词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 疑问词
topics.description: 理解并使用疑问词（who、what、where、when、why、how）来提问和回答问题
evidence: Ask questions using appropriate question words
Answer who, what, where, when questions about familiar topics
Recognise that question words signal a question is being asked
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想知道某件事——比如你把他的鞋放哪儿了，或者天为什么是蓝的——他能不能用正确的疑问词开头提问，比如“where”或“why”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 规则复数名词
topics.description: 通过加 -s 或 -es，在口语和书面表达中构成并使用规则复数名词；理解复数表示多于一个
evidence: Say and write correct plural forms (e.g. 'one cat, two cats'; 'one wish, two wishes')
Choose -s or -es correctly based on the ending sound
Explain that plural nouns name more than one
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你指着一张只有一只猫的图片，再指着好几只猫的图片，{{name}} 能不能说出表示“多于一个”的正确单词——并写对词尾，比如“cats”或“boxes”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子的开头和结尾
topics.description: 句子以大写字母开头，以恰当的标点结尾（句号、问号或感叹号）；能识别并说出句末标点的名称
evidence: Write sentences beginning with a capital letter
Choose and use the correct end punctuation for statements, questions, and exclamations
Identify and name full stops, question marks, and exclamation marks when reading
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写“the cat sat on the mat”这样的句子时，他会不会记得开头用大写字母、结尾用句号——不用别人提醒？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 撇号：缩写与所有格
topics.description: 在写作中使用撇号表示缩写（标记省略的字母）和单数所有格，并能区分这两种用法
evidence: Use apostrophes correctly in both 'don't' and 'Sam's bag' within the same piece of writing
Explain the difference between apostrophe for contraction and apostrophe for possession
Correct misplaced or missing apostrophes in a set of sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写“don't”或“it's”这样的词时，他能不能把撇号放在正确的位置——他也能写出“the dog's bowl”这样的表达，说明碗是狗的吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 列表中的逗号
topics.description: 在句子中用逗号分隔列表中的各项（如“I bought apples, bananas, and oranges”）
evidence: Write a sentence containing a list of 3+ items separated by commas: 'I bought apples, bananas, and oranges'
Identify where commas should go in an unpunctuated list sentence
Explain that commas separate items in a list so the reader knows each item
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 写一个列举三样或更多东西的句子——比如他去野餐要带的东西——他会不会在列表的每一项之间加逗号？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 限定词与冠词
topics.description: 在名词前正确使用限定词（冠词 a/an/the 和指示词 this/that/these/those）
evidence: Use 'a' before consonant sounds and 'an' before vowel sounds correctly: 'a ball', 'an apple'
Distinguish 'this/these' (near) from 'that/those' (far) when pointing to objects
Select the correct article (a/an/the) to complete a sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写到近处的东西和远处的东西时，会用对词吗——手里的书说“this book”，房间那头的书说“that book”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 扩展名词短语
topics.description: 使用扩展名词短语进行描述和限定，在名词前添加形容词和其他修饰语（如“the blue butterfly”“the old, creaky door”）
evidence: Expand 'the cat' into 'the fluffy black cat' by adding adjectives
Use noun phrases with two or more modifiers in independent writing
Choose precise adjectives to make a noun phrase more vivid: e.g., 'a tiny, shivering kitten'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在写作中描述某样东西——比如宠物或玩具——会加上额外的描述词吗，比如写“the small, fluffy rabbit”而不只是“the rabbit”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 四种句子类型
topics.description: 理解并使用四种句子类型——陈述句、疑问句、感叹句和祈使句——认识语法结构如何体现句子功能
evidence: Write or identify a statement, question, exclamation, and command from a set of sentences
Match each sentence type to its correct end punctuation mark
Transform a statement into a question or command on request
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能分辨疑问句（“Are you hungry?”）和祈使句（“Eat your dinner!”）的区别吗——并且能用正确的句末标点写出每种句子？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：名词、动词和时态
topics.description: 在讨论中使用并理解二年级语法术语：名词、名词短语、陈述句、疑问句、感叹句、祈使句、复合词、后缀、形容词、副词、动词、时态（过去/现在）、撇号、逗号
evidence: Use the term 'noun phrase' when discussing expanded noun phrases in own writing
Identify adjectives, adverbs, and verbs in sentences using correct terminology
Explain what 'tense' means and give an example of past and present tense
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你请 {{name}} 从阅读书里的一句话中找出名词、动词或形容词，他们能找到并说出它在句子中的作用吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 过去时、现在时与进行时
topics.description: 正确、一致地使用动词表达过去时和现在时，包括进行时形式（如 she is drumming、he was shouting），理解时态如何表示时间
evidence: Write a passage consistently in past tense without switching to present
Use progressive forms correctly: 'was running', 'is jumping' to show ongoing actions
Identify verbs in a sentence and change them from past to present tense or vice versa
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写昨天发生的事和现在正在发生的事时，会改变动词吗——比如过去写“she jumped”，现在写“she is jumping”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 代词
topics.description: 正确使用人称代词、物主代词和不定代词（如 I/me/my、they/them/their、anyone/everything），用代词替换名词以避免重复
evidence: Replace a repeated noun with a pronoun: 'The dog was happy. He wagged his tail.'
Use I/me correctly in subject and object position in a sentence
Choose the correct possessive pronoun (my/his/her/their) to match the noun it replaces
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 复述故事或描述朋友做了什么时，会正确使用“he”“she”“they”或“his”这样的词吗——而不是每次都重复那个人的名字？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主谓一致
topics.description: 在句子中使用单数和复数名词并搭配相应的动词，保持主谓一致（如“He hops”与“We hop”）
evidence: Write 'The dog runs' (singular) and 'The dogs run' (plural) with correct verb agreement
Correct subject-verb agreement errors in sentences: fix 'The children plays' to 'The children play'
Choose the correct verb form to match a singular or plural subject in a gap-fill exercise
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 写了“she hop”或“we hops”，能发现错误吗——能改成“she hops”和“we hop”，让主语和动词一致吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 从句
topics.description: 使用从属连词（when、if、that、because）和并列连词（or、and、but）连接分句，构成并列句和复合句
evidence: Write 'I stayed inside because it was raining' using a subordinating conjunction
Use 'but' and 'or' to join ideas: 'I wanted to play but it was raining'
Use 'when' and 'if' clauses in writing: 'If it stops raining, we can go outside'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写故事或留言时，能用“because”“but”“when”或“if”这样的词把两个想法连起来吗——而不是把每个想法都写成单独的一句短句？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 形容词与副词
topics.description: 正确使用形容词和副词，根据修饰的是名词还是动词/形容词来选择（如“She ran quickly”与“She is quick”）
evidence: Choose the correct form: 'The dog is (slow/slowly)' vs 'The dog walks (slow/slowly)'
Identify whether a word is modifying a noun (adjective) or a verb (adverb) in a given sentence
Expand sentences by adding both an adjective and an adverb: 'The tall boy ran quickly'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 写出“she ran quick”而不是“she ran quickly”，他们能发现这里需要用副词来描述跑步——并自己改正吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 选择 A 或 An
topics.description: 正确使用不定冠词的形式——以辅音音素开头的词前用“a”，以元音音素开头的词前用“an”（如 a rock、an open box、an hour、a unicorn）
evidence: Choose 'a' or 'an' correctly before nouns beginning with consonant or vowel sounds (e.g., 'a ball', 'an egg', 'an umbrella')
Apply the rule to tricky words where spelling and sound differ (e.g., 'an hour' because /h/ is silent, 'a uniform' because /juː/ starts with a consonant sound)
Correct errors in a/an usage in given sentences (e.g., change 'a orange' to 'an orange')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写作时，他们能自动在以辅音音素开头的词前选“a”、在元音音素前选“an”吗——比如“a cat”但“an apple”或“an hour”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 表达时间、地点和原因
topics.description: 使用连词（when、before、after、while、so、because）、副词（then、next、soon、therefore）和介词（before、after、during、in、because of）在句子内部和句子之间表达时间、地点和原因
evidence: Use time conjunctions to connect clauses (e.g., 'We went inside because it was raining', 'After the bell rang, we lined up')
Use adverbs of time and cause within sentences (e.g., 'First, she opened the door. Then, she stepped outside. Therefore, she got wet.')
Use prepositions of time and cause in phrases (e.g., 'during the lesson', 'before lunch', 'because of the rain')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写故事时，他们会用“after”“while”或“soon”这样的时间词来表现事情发生的先后顺序——而不是每句话都用“then”开头吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：从句与连词
topics.description: 在讨论阅读和写作时，能准确使用并理解三年级语法术语：介词、连词、词族、前缀、从句、从属从句、直接引语、辅音字母、元音字母、引号/对话标记
evidence: Use the terms 'clause' and 'subordinate clause' to identify parts of a multi-clause sentence (e.g., point to the subordinate clause in 'I stayed inside because it rained')
Use the terms 'conjunction', 'preposition', and 'prefix' correctly when explaining word/sentence choices in own writing
Distinguish between consonant letters and vowel letters and use the terms 'direct speech' and 'inverted commas' when discussing punctuation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 在他们书里的一句话中找出“从属从句”或“介词”，他们能指出来并解释它的意思吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 不规则动词过去式
topics.description: 正确构成并使用常见不规则动词的过去式（如 sat、hid、told、went、came、ran），认识到这些词不遵循规则的 -ed 变化模式
evidence: Supply the correct past tense of common irregular verbs: go→went, see→saw, run→ran, tell→told
Correct over-regularised forms in writing (e.g. change 'goed' to 'went', 'hided' to 'hid')
Write a short recount using at least five irregular past-tense verbs accurately
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用不规则动词写过去发生的事——比如“run”或“sit”——他们会写“ran”和“sat”，而不是“runned”和“sitted”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 不规则复数名词
topics.description: 除规则复数外，能构成并使用不规则复数名词（如 children、teeth、mice、geese），认识到有些名词的复数形式不规则，不遵循 -s/-es 模式
evidence: Form and use irregular plural nouns correctly (e.g. child→children, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice, goose→geese)
Identify collective nouns that name a group (e.g. 'a flock of birds', 'a group of children', 'a pack of wolves')
Correct over-regularised plurals in writing (e.g. change 'mouses' to 'mice', 'foots' to 'feet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你指着一张画有好几只老鼠或一群孩子的图片，{{name}} 能写出正确的复数吗——知道是“mice”不是“mouses”，是“children”不是“childs”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用代词让表达更清晰
topics.description: 为清晰和连贯选择代词，避免歧义和重复；正确使用反身代词（如 myself、ourselves、himself）
evidence: Replace repeated nouns with pronouns to improve cohesion: rewrite 'Sam picked up Sam's bag' as 'Sam picked up his bag'
Use reflexive pronouns correctly in sentences (e.g. 'I made it myself', 'They helped themselves')
Identify and fix ambiguous pronoun references (e.g. 'Tom told Jack he was late' — who was late?)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写一段关于两个人的文字——比如故事里的两个角色——他们能清楚地使用“he”“she”和“they”，让你始终知道说的是谁吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 直接引语的标点
topics.description: 使用引号（对话标记）为直接引语加标点，理解直接引语记录的是原话，必须用标点符号括起来
evidence: Place inverted commas around the spoken words in a sentence (e.g., "Let's go!" shouted Tom.)
Write a sentence containing direct speech with correct punctuation including a reporting clause (e.g., Mum said, "Time for bed.")
Identify direct speech in a text and explain what the inverted commas show
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写下故事中某个角色说的话时，他们会把原话放在引号里——比如“Come here,” she called——并在里面使用正确的标点吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 现在完成时
topics.description: 使用动词的现在完成时形式，并与一般过去时对比，理解现在完成时表示动作已完成但时间不明确，或与现在仍有联系（如“He has gone out”与“He went out”的区别）
evidence: Form the present perfect using 'has/have' + past participle (e.g., 'She has eaten', 'They have finished')
Choose between simple past and present perfect to match the intended meaning (e.g., 'I ate lunch' vs 'I have eaten lunch')
Identify the present perfect form in a text and explain why the author used it instead of simple past
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释“I ate breakfast”（一般过去时）和“I have eaten breakfast”（现在完成时）的区别吗——知道一个表示已完成的动作，另一个把过去和现在联系起来？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 抽象名词
topics.description: 理解并使用抽象名词来命名无法通过感官感知的想法、品质和状态
evidence: Sort words like 'freedom', 'table', 'courage', 'pencil', 'childhood' into abstract and concrete noun categories
Complete sentences using appropriate abstract nouns: 'Her _____ (brave → bravery) inspired the whole team'
Write three sentences each containing a different abstract noun (e.g. 'honesty', 'friendship', 'happiness')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用“kindness”“freedom”或“happiness”这样的抽象词写一个句子吗——知道这些是名词，即使你摸不到也看不到？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子中的一致性
topics.description: 确保句子内部和句子之间主语与动词一致、代词与先行词一致
evidence: Correct 'The group of children were laughing' to 'The group of children was laughing' and explain the singular subject
Choose the correct pronoun in 'Each student must bring ____ (his or her / their) book' and explain the antecedent link
Identify and fix three agreement errors in a short paragraph, explaining each correction
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 写了“Each of the players have their own locker”，他们能发现错误并改成“has their own locker”吗——确保动词与主语一致？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比较级与最高级
topics.description: 构成并使用形容词和副词的比较级和最高级，正确选择使用
evidence: Form comparatives and superlatives for 'big' (bigger/biggest), 'beautiful' (more/most beautiful), and 'good' (better/best)
Choose the correct form in 'She runs _____ (faster/more fast) than her brother' and explain the rule
Write sentences using both a comparative adverb ('more carefully') and a superlative adjective ('tallest') correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在比较三样东西——比如他们读过的三本书——他们能正确地说一本是“good”，另一本是“better”，最好的是“the best”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 扩展名词短语（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 用修饰性形容词、名词和介词短语扩展名词短语，增加细节
evidence: Expand 'the teacher' to 'the strict maths teacher with curly hair' using adjective, noun, and preposition phrase
Write a sentence containing a noun phrase with at least three modifiers, e.g. 'the old stone bridge over the river'
Identify the head noun and its modifiers in 'the tiny grey kitten under the table'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在写作中描述某样东西时，他们会构建丰富的描述吗——比如“the tall man with the grey coat”而不只是“the man”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 前置状语与逗号
topics.description: 使用前置状语来变化句子开头，并用逗号标点
evidence: Write a sentence beginning with a time adverbial, e.g. 'Later that day, the children ran home'
Rewrite 'The fox crept through the garden at midnight' with the adverbial fronted and a comma placed correctly
Identify and correct a missing comma after a fronted adverbial in 'Before breakfast she packed her bag'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写故事或报告时，他们有时会用“After lunch,”或“Quietly, the fox moved closer,”这样的短语开头——并在开头短语后加逗号吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：代词与限定词
topics.description: 了解并使用四年级语法术语，包括限定词、代词、物主代词和状语
evidence: Label the determiner, pronoun, and adverbial in 'She quickly opened her present on the table'
Explain the difference between a possessive pronoun ('mine', 'theirs') and other pronouns ('I', 'they')
Use the terms 'determiner' and 'adverbial' accurately when discussing a classmate's writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 在句子中找出一个“限定词”或“物主代词”，他们能指出来并解释它的作用吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 名词的复数与所有格
topics.description: 区分名词的复数后缀 -s 和所有格后缀 -'s
evidence: Sort words like 'dogs', 'dog's', and 'dogs'' into plural, singular possessive, and plural possessive categories
Explain why 'the cats bowl' is incorrect and supply the correct form ('the cat's bowl' or 'the cats' bowl') for a given meaning
Write two sentences using the same noun — one as a plural and one as a possessive
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能区分“the girls' coats”（属于许多女孩）和“the girls are coming”（只是复数）吗——并正确写出每个句子而不混淆撇号？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 一般过去时、一般现在时和一般将来时
topics.description: 在写作中正确、一致地使用一般过去时、一般现在时和一般将来时
evidence: Rewrite 'I walk to school' in past tense ('I walked') and future tense ('I will walk')
Identify and correct inconsistent tense in 'Yesterday she walks to the shop and bought milk'
Write a three-sentence paragraph maintaining consistent future tense throughout
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写昨天发生的事、现在正在发生的事和明天将要发生的事时，他们能根据时间正确变化动词吗——比如“I walked”“I walk”和“I will walk”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 标准英语动词
topics.description: 使用标准英语的动词屈折形式，替代非标准的方言形式
evidence: Correct 'we was playing' to 'we were playing' and explain why the standard form is needed in writing
Choose the standard form in pairs such as 'I did / I done', 'she has / she have', 'they were / they was'
Rewrite a short passage replacing three non-standard verb forms with their Standard English equivalents
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在对话中有时说“we was”或“they done it”，他们在作业中是否知道要写成“we were”和“they did it”——使用标准书面英语？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子中的形容词顺序
topics.description: 按照英语的常规顺序排列句子中的形容词（观点—大小—年龄—形状—颜色—来源—材料—用途），使描述听起来自然
evidence: Arrange multiple adjectives before a noun in conventional order, e.g. 'a lovely little old rectangular green French silver whittling knife' simplified to classroom examples like 'a small red bag' not 'a red small bag'
Identify when adjective order sounds unnatural and rearrange to match English conventions, e.g. correct 'the wooden big table' to 'the big wooden table'
Apply the size-before-colour-before-material pattern in descriptive writing, e.g. 'a tall grey stone castle' rather than 'a stone grey tall castle'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 把几个描述词放在一起时——比如“a tiny old wooden box”——顺序听起来自然吗，还是会把形容词顺序弄混，听起来很奇怪？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用括号和破折号表示插入语
topics.description: 使用括号、破折号和逗号表示插入语——即插入句子中的补充信息，去掉后不改变句子的核心意思
evidence: Insert a parenthetical phrase using paired brackets, e.g. 'The oldest building (built in 1642) stands in the town square'
Use paired dashes to add an aside or extra detail within a sentence, e.g. 'My brother — who is older than me — lives in London'
Choose between brackets, dashes, and commas for parenthesis based on how much emphasis the aside should receive, recognising that dashes give most prominence and brackets give least
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在句子中加入一点额外细节时——比如“The teacher, who is very strict, gave us homework”——他们能否正确使用括号、破折号或逗号把这段补充内容括起来？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 段落内部的衔接
topics.description: 在段落中使用衔接手段——包括代词、状语（then、after that、firstly）和同义词——把句子连接起来，形成连贯的思路
evidence: Replace repeated nouns with pronouns or synonyms to maintain cohesion without ambiguity, e.g. 'The explorer found a cave. She examined it carefully'
Use adverbials of sequence (firstly, then, next, finally) and cause (therefore, as a result, consequently) to connect ideas within a paragraph
Identify where cohesion breaks down in a paragraph and insert appropriate linking devices to improve the flow
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写一段话时，句子之间是否衔接流畅——使用“however”“after this”或“in contrast”等词连接想法，而不是每句话都以“And then”开头？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 连接词前的逗号
topics.description: 在并列句中连接两个独立分句时，在并列连词（and、but、or、so、yet）前使用逗号
evidence: Place a comma before the coordinating conjunction in a compound sentence, e.g. 'I wanted to go outside, but it was raining'
Distinguish compound sentences (two independent clauses) from simple sentences with compound predicates, e.g. 'She sang and danced' needs no comma but 'She sang a song, and he played the piano' does
Edit writing to insert missing commas before coordinating conjunctions in compound sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用“but”或“so”等词连接两个完整的意思时——比如“I wanted to go, but it was raining”——他们会在连接词前加逗号吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用逗号避免歧义
topics.description: 在缺少逗号可能导致误读的句子中，使用逗号澄清意思、避免歧义
evidence: Insert a comma to prevent ambiguity, e.g. 'Let's eat, Grandma' vs 'Let's eat Grandma' or 'Most of the time, travellers worry about their bags'
Identify sentences where a missing comma changes the meaning and explain the two possible readings
Use commas after introductory elements (adverbial phrases, subordinate clauses) to prevent misreading of the main clause
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么“Let's eat, Grandma”和“Let's eat Grandma”意思完全不同吗——并能在自己的写作中使用这类逗号来避免混淆？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 把词转换成动词
topics.description: 通过添加后缀 -ate、-ise（-ize）和 -ify 把名词和形容词转换成动词，理解词性变化如何影响句子构建
evidence: Add -ate, -ise, or -ify to nouns or adjectives to form verbs, e.g. pollen → pollinate, advert → advertise, simple → simplify
Choose the correct verb-forming suffix for a given root and use the resulting verb in a sentence, e.g. 'They needed to classify the animals' from 'class'
Identify the word-class change when a suffix converts a noun or adjective into a verb and explain how this affects the sentence structure
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把“active”或“sharp”这样的词加上后缀变成动词吗——知道“activate”和“sharpen”是动词形式？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 扩展名词短语（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 构成并使用介词短语（介词 + 名词短语），在句子中补充时间、地点或方向等细节，并认识它们如何充当形容词短语或副词短语
evidence: Identify the preposition and noun phrase within a prepositional phrase, e.g. in 'under the old bridge', 'under' is the preposition and 'the old bridge' is the noun phrase
Add prepositional phrases to expand sentences with detail about where, when, or how, e.g. 'The cat slept' → 'The cat slept on the warm windowsill throughout the afternoon'
Distinguish prepositional phrases functioning as adjectives (modifying nouns: 'the house on the hill') from those functioning as adverbs (modifying verbs: 'she ran across the field')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写路线指引或描述一个地方时——比如“behind the old tree”或“near the top of the hill”——他们能自然地用介词短语来说明某物在哪里或什么时候发生吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修正句子片段与连写句
topics.description: 识别并改正句子片段（缺少主语或谓语的不完整句子）和连写句（两个或更多独立分句没有正确标点或连词就连接在一起）
evidence: Identify a sentence fragment by checking whether it has both a subject and a predicate, e.g. recognise 'Running through the park' as a fragment and correct to 'The dog was running through the park'

Identify a run-on sentence where two independent clauses are fused without punctuation or a conjunction, e.g. 'I like cats I also like dogs' and correct using a full stop, comma + conjunction, or semicolon
Edit a paragraph to fix fragments and run-ons, choosing the most effective correction strategy for each error
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 的作文里有像“Running down the street.”这样的句子，或者两个想法没有任何标点就挤在一起，他们能发现哪里不对并改正吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：情态动词与分句
topics.description: 在讨论阅读和写作时，准确了解并使用五年级语法术语：情态动词、关系代词、关系分句、插入语、括号、破折号、衔接、歧义
evidence: Label a relative clause in a sentence and identify the relative pronoun that introduces it, using correct terminology
Explain why a pair of brackets or dashes creates a parenthesis and describe its function using the term 'parenthesis'
Use the terms 'modal verb', 'cohesion', and 'ambiguity' when discussing how a writer has achieved particular effects in a text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 什么是“情态动词”或“关系分句”，他们能给你清楚的解释，并在句子里指出一个例子吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用状语连接段落
topics.description: 使用时间状语（later、meanwhile、after a while）、地点状语（nearby、far away、beyond the wall）和顺序状语（secondly、finally、in addition）把段落之间的想法连接起来，引导读者读懂多段文本
evidence: Begin a new paragraph with an adverbial of time to signal a shift in time or sequence, e.g. 'Meanwhile, back at the castle...' or 'Several hours later, the storm finally passed'
Use adverbials of place to move the reader to a new location between paragraphs, e.g. 'Beyond the forest, the land was flat and dry'
Use numbering or addition adverbials to structure non-fiction across paragraphs, e.g. 'The first reason... The second reason... In addition...'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写多段的故事或报告时，他们会用连接短语——比如“Meanwhile, far away…”或“By the following morning…”——引导读者顺畅地从一段过渡到下一段吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 情态动词与可能性
topics.description: 理解并使用情态动词（can、may、must、might、shall、will、could、should、would）和情态副词（perhaps、surely、certainly），表达不同程度的可能性、必要性和许可
evidence: Select a modal verb to express certainty, probability, or possibility in a sentence, e.g. 'It will rain' vs 'It might rain' vs 'It could rain'
Replace a modal verb with a modal adverb to achieve a similar effect, e.g. 'He might come' → 'Perhaps he will come'
Distinguish between modals expressing permission (may, can), obligation (must, should), and possibility (might, could) in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 写作时，{{name}} 会在“must”“might”“could”“should”这类词之间做选择，来表明某事是确定的、可能的，还是只是一个想法——而不是把每个动作都当成确定发生的吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 进行时态
topics.description: 构成并使用进行时态——过去进行时（was walking）、现在进行时（am walking）和将来进行时（will be walking）——表达不同时间里正在发生的动作
evidence: Write sentences using past progressive to describe an action that was ongoing at a particular time, e.g. 'She was reading when the phone rang'
Distinguish present progressive from simple present, e.g. 'I am eating lunch' (right now) vs 'I eat lunch at noon' (habitual)
Form the future progressive using 'will be' + present participle to describe an action that will be ongoing, e.g. 'Tomorrow at 3pm I will be travelling'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想描述过去某段时间里正在发生的动作——比如“I was reading when the phone rang”——他们能把动词写成正确的过去进行时形式吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 关系分句
topics.description: 构成并使用以关系代词（who、whose、whom、which、that）和关系副词（where、when、why）开头的关系分句，补充细节、限定名词，并构成复杂句
evidence: Combine a main clause with a relative clause using 'who' or 'which' to add information about a noun, e.g. 'The dog, which had a red collar, barked loudly'
Choose the correct relative pronoun (who for people, which for things, where for places, when for times) and identify the noun it refers back to
Recognise that a relative clause beginning with 'that' can often replace 'who' or 'which' in defining clauses, e.g. 'The book that I read' vs 'The book which I read'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写作要给名词补充细节时——比如描述一个“who loves football”的朋友，或一个“where we always go on holiday”的地方——他们会用关系分句把这些细节放进同一个句子里吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 动词前缀与词义
topics.description: 使用动词前缀（dis-、de-、mis-、over-、re-）改变动词词义，理解每个前缀如何改变词根动词所表达的动作
evidence: Add verb prefixes to change meaning, e.g. dis- (disagree, disappear), de- (decompose, defrost), mis- (misunderstand, misbehave), over- (overlook, overreact), re- (redo, reconsider)
Select the appropriate verb prefix to express a specific meaning shift such as negation (dis-/mis-), reversal (de-/un-), repetition (re-), or excess (over-)
Distinguish verb prefixes from noun/adjective prefixes and explain how adding a prefix to a verb changes the action described
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 一个像“appear”这样的动词，让他们用前缀改变词义，他们能说出“disappear”“reappear”或“misrepresent”这样的词，并解释前缀的作用吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主动语态与被动语态
topics.description: 使用被动语态把焦点从施动者转移到动作或受动者上，理解被动结构如何影响正式、客观写作中的信息呈现
evidence: Convert active sentences to passive voice and explain the change in emphasis
Identify passive constructions in news reports and scientific writing
Choose between active and passive voice based on purpose and audience
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 想写某件事却不想说明是谁做的——比如在科学报告中——他们能不能把句子换个说法，用“实验被进行了”而不是“我们进行了实验”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 项目符号的标点
topics.description: 一致地为项目符号加标点，清晰地列出信息，在各条目中运用大写规则、句末标点和平行结构的规范
evidence: Create bullet point lists with consistent capitalisation and punctuation throughout
Use full stops for bullet points that are complete sentences and no punctuation for fragments
Maintain parallel grammatical structure across all items in a bulleted list
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用项目符号列出信息时——比如在学校作业中——所有条目的标点方式是否一致，大写规则是否统一，句末标点是否前后一致？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 选择时态以准确表达含义
topics.description: 运用动词时态表达不同的时间、顺序、状态和条件，有意识地选择时态，以准确表达动作和事件发生的时间与性质
evidence: Write a paragraph using multiple tenses to show the sequence of past, present, and future events
Choose between simple, progressive, and perfect tenses to express duration or completion
Explain why a specific tense is appropriate for expressing a condition or hypothetical situation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写一个在往事和当下想法之间来回切换的故事时，他们能不能有意识地、准确地转换动词时态——让读者始终清楚每件事发生在什么时候？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 列表中的冒号与分号
topics.description: 用冒号引出列表，用分号分隔列表中的各项，尤其是当列表项本身含有逗号或是复杂短语时
evidence: Introduce a list with a colon after an independent clause such as 'You will need the following items:'
Use semi-colons to separate list items that contain commas such as locations with city and country
Punctuate complex lists in formal writing maintaining clarity and consistency
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 列出一串本身较长或含有逗号的内容时——比如带用量的配料清单——他们会不会用冒号引出列表，并用分号分隔各项？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 引导成分后的逗号
topics.description: 用逗号把引导成分与句子其余部分隔开，包括引导词、引导短语和引导从句
evidence: Place commas after introductory adverbs such as 'However' or 'Therefore' at the start of sentences
Use commas after introductory prepositional phrases like 'In the morning' or 'After the game'
Punctuate introductory dependent clauses correctly such as 'When the bell rang, we left'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用短语或从句开头时——比如“尽管下雨，”或“如果你仔细看，”——他们会不会在这个开头部分之后、主句开始之前加上逗号？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: yes、no 和称呼语旁的逗号
topics.description: 用逗号把 yes 和 no 隔开，把附加疑问句隔开，并在句中表示直接称呼
evidence: Write sentences using commas with yes and no at the beginning such as 'Yes, I understand'
Punctuate tag questions correctly such as 'It's cold today, isn't it?'
Use commas to set off names in direct address such as 'Sarah, please pass the salt'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写对话或写信、用名字称呼某人时——比如“是的，妈妈，我确实整理了房间”——他们能不能在名字以及“yes”或“no”这类词旁边正确使用逗号？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 连词、介词与感叹词
topics.description: 解释连词、介词和感叹词在一般情况和具体句子中的作用，理解每一类词如何贡献意义
evidence: Identify conjunctions, prepositions, and interjections in sentences and explain their function
Explain how removing a preposition or conjunction changes the meaning of a sentence
Use interjections appropriately to convey emotion in dialogue or informal writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}}“although”或“ouch!”在句子中起什么作用，他们能不能解释一个是连接观点的连词，另一个是表达感受的感叹词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 时态一致
topics.description: 识别并纠正句子内部以及句子和段落之间不恰当的时态转换，保持时态一致，除非表达需要转换
evidence: Identify and correct unnecessary tense shifts in a given paragraph
Edit own writing to ensure consistent tense use throughout a narrative
Explain when a tense shift is appropriate such as when describing a flashback
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你把 {{name}} 写的一段话读回去，发现它中途意外地从过去时切换到了现在时，他们能不能发现这个转换并改正，让时态保持一致？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 关联连词
topics.description: 在句子中正确使用关联连词，搭配 either/or、neither/nor、both/and、not only/but also、whether/or 等词对
evidence: Write sentences using each pair of correlative conjunctions correctly
Ensure parallel structure when using correlative conjunctions in complex sentences
Identify and correct errors in correlative conjunction usage in given sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 想表达两件事同样成立时——比如“both cats and dogs make good pets”（猫和狗都是好宠物）——他们是否知道要把“both…and”搭配使用，而不是只单独用“and”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：语态与标点
topics.description: 准确理解并使用六年级语法术语：主语、宾语、主动语态、被动语态、同义词、反义词、省略号、连字符、冒号、分号、项目符号
evidence: Define and give examples of subject and object in sentences
Explain the difference between active and passive voice using correct terminology
Use terms such as ellipsis, colon, and semi-colon accurately when discussing punctuation choices
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 找出句子中的“主语”和“宾语”，或者解释“分号”或“省略号”的作用，他们能给出自信而准确的回答吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 带前缀词语中的连字符
topics.description: 在复合修饰语和带前缀的词语中使用连字符以避免歧义，区分因连字符位置不同而改变的含义
evidence: Distinguish between 'man eating shark' and 'man-eating shark' by adding or removing hyphens
Use hyphens with prefixes to clarify meaning such as 'recover' versus 're-cover'
Apply hyphens correctly in compound adjectives before nouns such as 'well-known author'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么“a man-eating shark”（吃人的鲨鱼）和“a man eating shark”（一个正在吃鲨鱼的人）意思完全不同——并在自己的写作中正确使用连字符来避免这类混淆吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 段落衔接
topics.description: 使用更多种类的衔接手段在段落之间连接观点，包括词语重复、状语等语法连接以及省略，以形成连贯的长篇文本
evidence: Use adverbials such as 'on the other hand' and 'as a consequence' to connect paragraphs
Apply ellipsis to avoid repetition while maintaining clarity across sentences
Create cohesion by repeating key words or using synonyms to link ideas between paragraphs
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写出跨越多个段落的长篇作品时，各部分是否感觉相互关联——通过重复关键词、连接短语，以及有意使用偶尔的省略来把整篇文本串联起来？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 从句的标点
topics.description: 使用分号、冒号和破折号标记独立从句之间的边界，根据从句之间的关系选择合适的标点
evidence: Join two related independent clauses using a semi-colon in place of a conjunction
Use a colon to introduce an explanation or elaboration of the first clause
Replace commas with dashes to create stronger pauses between clauses for emphasis
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写两个密切相关的句子时，他们能用分号或冒号把它们连接起来——比如“It was late; the streets were empty”（天晚了；街上空无一人）——而不是总是用句号或“and”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作品标题的标点
topics.description: 使用下划线、引号或斜体标示作品标题，遵循书籍、故事、诗歌、歌曲和文章等不同类型作品的惯例
evidence: Use italics or underlining for titles of books, films, and albums
Use quotation marks for titles of short works such as poems, songs, and articles
Apply title formatting conventions consistently in a piece of writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在写作中提到书名或电影名时，他们是否知道要加引号或用斜体——比如写成 *Charlotte's Web* 或“Charlotte's Web”——而不是直接写成普通文本？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 虚拟语气
topics.description: 在正式写作和口语中使用虚拟语气形式来表达愿望、要求、建议或假设情境（如“If I were you”“I suggest that he go”“Were they to arrive”）
evidence: Write sentences using 'If I were' to express hypothetical conditions
Transform informal sentences into formal equivalents using subjunctive forms such as 'I recommend that she attend'
Identify subjunctive mood in formal texts such as legal documents or formal letters
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写正式信件或议论文时，他们能使用“If I were in charge…”或“The school suggests that every pupil attend…”这样的短语，让表达更正式、更准确吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 变化句式
topics.description: 为表达意义、吸引读者兴趣和调整风格而扩展、合并和精简句子，运用嵌入从句、使用同位语和变化句长等技巧
evidence: Combine two simple sentences into one complex sentence using subordination
Expand a simple sentence by adding descriptive phrases and clauses
Reduce wordy sentences by removing redundant words while preserving meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 修改自己的写作时，他们能把一个很长的句子拆开，或者把三个短促的句子合并成一个——并选择最适合读者阅读的版本吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 让表达更清晰的进阶标点
topics.description: 自信、准确地使用标点来增强表达效果和清晰度——包括用分号连接相关分句，用冒号引出列表或解释，用破折号和括号补充插入信息，用省略号表示省略或制造悬念，以及用逗号分隔并列形容词和非限制性成分
evidence: Use a semicolon to link two closely related independent clauses without a conjunction
Set off a nonrestrictive clause with commas and explain why the commas are needed
Use a colon to introduce an explanation or elaboration, and a dash for a dramatic aside
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写一篇复杂的作品——比如一篇议论文或一个细节丰富的故事——他们能否自信、准确地使用分号、冒号、破折号和省略号等进阶标点来塑造含义和风格？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 为效果而用的语法
topics.description: 分析所读文本中语法特征的有效性和影响力——理解作者如何有意识地做出语法选择（句子长度、被动语态、前置状语、列举）来对读者产生特定效果
evidence: Explain how an author's use of short, simple sentences creates tension or urgency in a passage
Analyse why an author uses a list of three (tricolon) in a persuasive text and evaluate its impact
Identify a grammatical choice in a text (e.g., present tense for immediacy) and explain the effect on the reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到一篇他们欣赏的作品时，能否指出作者做出的具体语法选择——比如用很短的句子制造紧张感，或用三项列举营造节奏——并解释这些选择为什么有效？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文学与语言术语
topics.description: 在讨论阅读、写作和口语时，准确、自信地使用语言学和文学术语——包括词类、句子类型、分句类型、文学手法和篇章层面特征的术语
evidence: Use terms like 'subordinate clause', 'relative pronoun', 'metaphor', 'alliteration' accurately in discussion
Explain the difference between a simile and a metaphor using correct terminology
Use metalanguage (e.g., 'the author employs enjambment to...') confidently when writing about texts
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 和老师讨论一本书或一篇作品时，他们是否会使用精确的语言——比如“作者在这里用了一个并列复合句”或“那是一个非限制性关系从句”——而不是只说“这段写得不错”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 短语与分句
topics.description: 理解并分析短语（名词短语、动词短语、形容词短语、副词短语、介词短语）和分句（主句、从句、关系从句）在一般情况和具体句子中的功能，包括识别并纠正错位修饰语和悬垂修饰语
evidence: Identify a prepositional phrase acting as an adverbial and explain its role in the sentence
Distinguish between a main clause and a subordinate clause and explain their relationship
Spot a dangling modifier in a sentence and rewrite it to remove the ambiguity
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到“Walking home from school, the rain soaked her backpack”这样的句子，感觉语法上有点不对劲，他们能否找出悬垂修饰语并说明如何正确改写？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 标准英语
topics.description: 了解并理解口语与书面语之间的差异——包括正式程度、语域、语法和词汇方面的差异——以及标准英语与其他英语变体之间的差异，在写作和口语中自信地使用标准英语
evidence: Explain three differences between how we speak informally and how we write formally (e.g., contractions, slang, sentence completeness)
Identify features of Standard English and explain why it is used in formal contexts
Rewrite an informal spoken passage (e.g., a text message) in formal written Standard English
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否理解和朋友说话的方式与在学校写作时应该用的方式不同——并且能否在正式场合调整自己的语言，使用标准的语法和词汇？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子类型
topics.description: 选择并构造简单句、并列句、复合句和并列复合句，以标示观点之间的不同关系，有意识地变换句式来服务于含义、趣味和风格
evidence: Combine short sentences into a complex sentence using a subordinating conjunction for effect
Rewrite a passage of monotonous simple sentences using a mix of sentence types for variety and flow
Identify the sentence type (simple, compound, complex, compound-complex) of given examples and explain the effect of each
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 为效果而写作时——比如在故事中营造紧张感或组织论证——他们是否会刻意变换句子类型，把简短有力的句子和较长、较复杂的句子混着用？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 动词的语态与语气
topics.description: 理解并有意识地使用主动语态和被动语态，识别动词的语气（陈述语气、祈使语气、虚拟语气、条件语气）及其效果——根据目的和读者选择合适的语态和语气
evidence: Rewrite an active sentence in the passive voice and explain when the passive is more appropriate
Identify the subjunctive mood in a formal text (e.g., 'If I were...', 'It is essential that he be...')
Explain why a scientific report typically uses passive voice while a personal narrative uses active
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写正式报告或分析时，能否有意识地在主动语态和被动语态之间做选择——比如在科学报告中用被动语态来显得客观、不带个人色彩？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 坐姿与握笔
topics.description: 在桌前坐姿端正，舒适且正确地握笔；按正确方向书写小写字母，起笔和收笔位置正确
evidence: Hold a pencil with a comfortable tripod or near-tripod grip
Write all 26 lowercase letters with correct starting points and direction
Maintain consistent letter size on lined paper
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 坐下来写字时，他们握笔是否舒适，每个字母是否写得正确——从正确的位置起笔、朝正确的方向运笔？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 书写大写字母
topics.description: 正确书写大写字母；清晰工整地写出许多大写和小写字母
evidence: Write all 26 capital letters with correct formation
Distinguish between uppercase and lowercase forms in own writing
Use appropriate sizing so capitals are taller than lowercase letters
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把所有大写字母写得清楚工整，让别人读起来很容易分辨每个字母是什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 字母书写家族
topics.description: 理解哪些字母因书写方式相似而属于同一书写家族，并按组练习这些字母
evidence: Group letters by similar strokes (e.g. c, a, d, g, o family — all start with a curve)
Explain why certain letters are practised together
Form letters within the same family consistently using the shared movement pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否明白有些字母的写法相似——比如“c”“a”“d”和“g”都以同样的弧线起笔——并把同一家族的字母放在一起练习？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 书写数字 0-9
topics.description: 正确、工整地书写数字 0-9
evidence: Write all digits 0-9 clearly with correct starting points
Form digits the appropriate size relative to letter height
Write numbers legibly so they can be read by others
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写 3、5、7 这样的数字时，写法是否正确、清楚易读——没有写反，也没有朝奇怪的方向写？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 连写字母
topics.description: 开始用斜线和横线笔画连写字母，了解哪些字母组合最好不连写，并让字母之间大小比例正确
evidence: Join 'in', 'un', 'it' with a diagonal stroke connecting the letters
Leave letters like 'b' unjoined when followed by certain letters, explaining why
Write with consistent letter sizing on lined paper, ascenders and descenders in proportion
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写字时是否开始把字母连起来，让书写更流畅，而不是每个字母都完全分开？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 拼读声音来读单词
topics.description: 运用自然拼读知识，拼读含有已学字形—音素对应关系的不熟悉单词；对全部 40 多个音素的字形快速作出反应
evidence: Sound out and blend unfamiliar phonically regular words (e.g. /sh/-/o/-/p/ → 'shop')
Read words containing taught GPCs without excessive sounding out
Distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying differing letter sounds (e.g. 'big' vs 'bag')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 遇到没见过的单词时，能不能一个音一个音地读出来，再把各部分拼在一起读出整个词——哪怕需要想一会儿？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 辅音双字母组合
topics.description: 读和拼写含有辅音双字母组合及较少见辅音拼写的单词（ch、sh、th、ck、tch、ng、ph、wh，以及用 k 表示 /k/）
evidence: Read words with consonant digraphs (e.g. 'shop', 'chip', 'that')
Identify the sound made by ph (/f/) and wh (/w/) in words
Spell words ending in -ck (e.g. 'duck') and -tch (e.g. 'match')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到“shop”“chip”“ring”或“photo”这样的单词时，能不能看出两个字母合起来发一个音，并正确读出整个单词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认识所有字母
topics.description: 认读并说出字母表中所有大写和小写字母的名称；按顺序说出字母，并用字母名称区分不同的拼写
evidence: Name all 26 letters in both cases when shown in random order
Recite the alphabet from A to Z
Use letter names to explain spelling choices (e.g. 'Is it c or k in cat?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能指着任何一个字母——大写或小写——说出它的名称吗？能按顺序从 A 到 Z 说出字母表吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 首音与韵脚
topics.description: 拼合与切分单音节单词的首音和韵脚；分离并读出 CVC 单词中的单个音素（首音、中音、尾音）；添加或替换音素组成新词
evidence: Blend onset and rime to say a word (e.g. /c/ + /at/ → 'cat')
Identify the first, middle, or last sound in a CVC word
Change one sound to make a new word (e.g. change /c/ in 'cat' to /b/ → 'bat')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你慢慢说出音素“/d/ /o/ /g/”，{{name}} 能把它们拼在一起说出“dog”吗？如果你说“cat”，他们能说出三个分开的音素 /k/ /a/ /t/ 吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 押韵词
topics.description: 能识别并说出押韵词；跟着故事和诗歌中可预测的短语和韵脚一起念；学会欣赏并背诵诗歌
evidence: Identify which words rhyme from a set (e.g. cat, bat, dog)
Generate a word that rhymes with a given target
Join in with repeated refrains and rhyming patterns during shared reading
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当你给 {{name}} 读押韵的书时，孩子会跟着一起念、猜出押韵的词吗？能不能自己给像“cat”这样简单的词想出押韵词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 单个字母的发音
topics.description: 知道每个辅音的主要发音，以及五个主要元音的长短音；看到单个字母能快速反应出读音
evidence: Say the most common sound for each consonant when shown the letter
Distinguish short vowel sounds in CVC words (e.g. /a/ in 'cat' vs /e/ in 'bed')
Associate long and short vowel sounds with common single-letter spellings
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看到字母时，能马上说出它的发音吗？比如“s”发 /s/，“a”可以发短音 /a/（像“apple”里那样），也可以发长音 /ā/（像“cake”里那样）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认识印刷文字
topics.description: 能理解印刷文字是有意义的，阅读方向是从左到右、从上到下，书里的内容是一页一页组织的
evidence: Track words with a finger moving left to right across the page
Turn pages in the correct sequence when handling a book
Point to where reading starts on a page
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看绘本里的一页时，知道要从左上角开始，从左往右读，再往下读到下一行吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 元音双字母组合
topics.description: 能读会拼含有常见元音双字母组合的词（ai、ay、ee、ea、oa、oe、oo、oi、oy），包括同一个双字母组合可以表示多个音的情况
evidence: Read words with vowel digraphs (e.g. 'tree', 'boat', 'rain', 'coin')
Distinguish between different sounds for the same digraph (e.g. 'oo' in 'book' vs 'moon')
Spell words using common vowel digraph patterns
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读到“rain”“boat”或“moon”这样的词时，能认出那个发特殊音的元音组合，并把整个词读对吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 复合词
topics.description: 能通过找出组成一个词的两个部分来识别和拼写复合词
evidence: Identify the two words in a compound (e.g. 'sunshine' = 'sun' + 'shine')
Spell compound words by combining known words
Create compound words from given word pairs
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看到“sunshine”或“football”这样的词时，能找出藏在里面的两个小词吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 双元音与复杂元音
topics.description: 能读会拼含有双元音和复杂元音组合的词（ow、ou、ew、ue、ie、aw、au），以及以 -y 作元音结尾的词
evidence: Read words with variable vowel sounds (e.g. 'ow' in 'cow' vs 'snow')
Decode words with diphthongs (e.g. 'cloud', 'blue', 'pie')
Read words ending in -y pronounced as /ee/ or /igh/ (e.g. 'happy', 'my')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能读“town”“cloud”“flew”“claw”或“pie”这样的词吗？能认出其中特殊的元音组合，并读出正确的音吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: R 控制的元音发音
topics.description: 能读会拼含有 r 控制元音的词（ar、er、ir、ur、or、ore），以及“r”改变元音发音的元音-r 组合
evidence: Read words with r-controlled vowels (e.g. 'car', 'bird', 'fork', 'her')
Recognise that 'r' changes the vowel sound (e.g. 'cat' vs 'cart')
Spell words with common r-controlled patterns
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读到“car”“bird”“nurse”或“fork”这样的词时，能意识到元音后面的“r”改变了它的发音，并把词读对吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 缩略形式的阅读
topics.description: 能读并理解带撇号的缩略形式，知道撇号代表省略的字母
evidence: Read common contractions in text (e.g. 'I'm', 'we'll', 'don't')
Match contractions to their expanded forms (e.g. 'I'm' = 'I am')
Explain that the apostrophe shows where letters are missing
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 明白“can't”就是“cannot”、“it's”就是“it is”吗？知道撇号代表省略掉的那个或那些字母吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 流利朗读
topics.description: 准确朗读与自然拼读能力相匹配的书籍，并逐步提升流利度；反复朗读熟悉的文本，建立自信、提高速度并读出感情
evidence: Read a phonically appropriate text with 90%+ accuracy
Reread familiar texts with improved pace and expression
Read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 朗读与其水平相符的书时，能不能顺畅地读出大部分单词——听起来不像在逐个拼读，而更像在讲故事？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 整体认读高频词
topics.description: 自动整体认读常见的高频词和例外词，包括拼写规律不规则的单词
evidence: Read common exception words instantly without sounding out (e.g. 'the', 'said', 'was', 'you')
Note unusual correspondences between spelling and sound in exception words
Recognise at least 20-30 high-frequency words in connected text
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能一眼认出像“said”“was”“they”“come”和“because”这样的日常单词，而不需要每次都拼读出来？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认读屈折词尾
topics.description: 认读含有已学字母-音素对应关系并带常见屈折词尾（-s、-es、-ing、-ed、-er、-est）和前缀 un- 的单词；认读符合已学规律的多音节单词
evidence: Read suffixed words fluently (e.g. 'jumping', 'wanted', 'faster')
Identify the root word when a suffix is added
Read words with prefix un- (e.g. 'unhappy', 'undo')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到带有不同词尾的熟悉单词——比如“jumped”“running”“biggest”或“unhappy”——能不能找出词根并正确读出整个单词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 分离双字母组合与魔法 E
topics.description: 认读和拼写含有分离双字母组合（a-e、e-e、i-e、o-e、u-e）的单词，即词尾的“e”使前面的元音发长音
evidence: Read words with split digraphs (e.g. 'cake', 'bike', 'home', 'cube')
Compare minimal pairs showing the effect of the split digraph (e.g. 'cap' vs 'cape')
Spell words with split digraphs correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知不知道“cake”“bike”或“home”这类单词末尾的“e”会改变中间的元音发音——让它读字母本身的名称，而不是短音？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 音节
topics.description: 数出、拼合和切分口语单词中的音节；把书面单词划分成音节，辅助阅读和拼写
evidence: Clap out syllables in spoken words (e.g. 'butterfly' = 3 claps)
Blend syllables to form words (e.g. 'rain' + 'bow' → 'rainbow')
Segment a word into its syllable parts orally
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能拍手数出单词中的音节——比如“pen-cil”拍两下、“com-pu-ter”拍三下——并把一个口语单词拆分成几个部分？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 三字母组合
topics.description: 认读和拼写含有三字母组合的单词——即三个字母组成一个音素的字母组合（igh、air、ear、are）
evidence: Read words with trigraphs (e.g. 'night', 'chair', 'near')
Distinguish between different sounds for 'ear' (e.g. 'hear' vs 'bear')
Identify the single phoneme represented by three letters in a word
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能认出像“night”中的“igh”、“chair”中的“air”和“hear”中的“ear”这样的三字母组合——知道这三个字母合在一起只发一个音？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 已知音的其他拼写方式
topics.description: 识别已知音素的其他字母-音素对应关系（如 /dʒ/ 写作 ge/dge/g，/s/ 写作 c，/n/ 写作 kn/gn，/r/ 写作 wr，/ʒ/ 写作 s），认读熟悉发音采用较少见拼写方式的单词
evidence: Read words with less common spellings for familiar sounds: 'badge', 'giraffe', 'city', 'knock', 'gnaw', 'write', 'treasure'
Identify that the same phoneme can be represented by different graphemes (e.g., /dʒ/ spelled g, ge, dge)
Select the correct alternative GPC to decode an unfamiliar word in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知不知道 /j/ 音可以有不同拼写方式——比如“jump”“cage”和“bridge”中——并且能不能读出含有这些较少见拼写的单词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 有感情且准确地朗读
topics.description: 准确、以适当语速并有感情地（韵律）朗读，反复朗读熟悉的文本以提升流利度和自信，并借助上下文自我纠正
evidence: Read a grade-level passage aloud with expression and appropriate pacing
Self-correct miscues during oral reading by re-reading or using context cues
Re-read a familiar book demonstrating increased fluency and confidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 朗读故事时，会不会根据情绪变化语调——在标点处停顿，悲伤的部分放慢，兴奋的部分加快？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 音节（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 把两个或更多音节的单词拆成音节块来拼读，运用每个音节都必须包含一个元音发音的知识，再把各部分拼合起来
evidence: Read 'rabbit', 'thunder', 'fantastic' by breaking into syllable chunks and blending
Clap or tap syllables in a multi-syllable word, then read each chunk before blending
Identify that every syllable must contain a vowel sound
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 遇到像“fantastic”或“umbrella”这样的长单词时，能把它拆成音节，再把各部分拼合起来读出整个单词吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 拼读不熟悉的单词
topics.description: 读出 Y3-4 阶段中拼写与发音对应关系不常见的例外词，运用不断增长的词形学和词源学知识来拼读不熟悉的例外词
evidence: Read exception words from the Y3-4 statutory word list accurately (e.g. 'business', 'caught', 'knowledge', 'different')
Identify unusual letter-sound correspondences in exception words and explain why the word does not follow common GPC rules
Use growing knowledge of morphology and etymology to attempt unfamiliar exception words (e.g. recognise the root 'know' in 'knowledge')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能读出更难的例外词——比如“ordinary”“promise”“recent”或“island”——而不被那些不符合常规拼写规则的部分难住吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 前缀和后缀
topics.description: 读出 Y3-4 阶段课程中包含常见前缀和后缀的单词，运用词根、前缀和后缀的知识（词形学和词源学）来朗读并理解新单词
evidence: Read words with common prefixes (dis-, mis-, re-, pre-) and suffixes (-ation, -ous, -ly) by identifying the root word first
Apply morphological knowledge to attempt unfamiliar words (e.g. recognise 'happy' inside 'unhappiness')
Explain how a prefix or suffix changes the meaning or word class of a root word (e.g. 'care' → 'careless' → 'carelessly')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到像“disappear”或“comfortable”这样的单词时，能找出词根，并弄明白前缀或后缀给词义增加了什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 预测接下来会发生什么
topics.description: 根据已读内容预测故事接下来可能发生什么；讨论标题和事件的意义
evidence: Make a prediction before turning the page and explain reasoning
Discuss why a title fits or hints at the story content
Revise predictions as new information is encountered in the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当你在故事中途停下来时，{{name}} 能合理猜测接下来可能发生什么，并根据目前发生的情节解释自己为什么这样想吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 书籍特征与作者的理由
topics.description: 识别一本书的封面、封底和扉页；找出信息类文本中作者为支持观点而给出的理由
evidence: Point to and name parts of a book (front cover, back cover, title page)
Use the title page to find the title, author, and illustrator
Identify a reason the author gives for a claim in a simple non-fiction text
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在非虚构类书籍中找到目录或索引，并用它来查找特定信息吗？他们理解作者为什么加入这些内容吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 角色、场景和事件
topics.description: 识别故事中的角色、场景和主要事件；熟悉关键故事、童话和传统故事，并按顺序用关键细节复述它们
evidence: Name the main characters in a story
Describe where and when a story takes place
Retell a familiar story including beginning, middle, and end events
topics.assessmentPrompt: 一起读完一个童话或故事后，{{name}} 能按顺序复述给你听——说出里面有谁、发生在哪里、主要事件是什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比较不同故事中的角色
topics.description: 比较和对照熟悉故事中角色的冒险和经历；找出同一主题的两篇文本之间的相同点和不同点
evidence: Identify what two stories have in common (e.g. 'Both have a bear character')
Compare information from two books about the same topic
Discuss how characters' experiences are similar or different across stories
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读过两个主题相似的故事——比如两个关于勇敢英雄的故事——能告诉你它们之间哪些地方相同、哪些地方不同吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 把阅读与生活经验联系起来
topics.description: 把读到或听到的内容与自己的经历联系起来；借助背景知识和词汇来帮助理解文本
evidence: Make text-to-self connections (e.g. 'This reminds me of when I...')
Use personal experience to understand a character's feelings
Relate events in a story to own life to deepen comprehension
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 听到或读到关于熟悉事物的故事——比如去上学或看望祖父母——会把故事和自己的生话联系起来，并用这些经验帮助理解故事里发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 不同类型的文本
topics.description: 认识常见的文本类型（故事书、诗歌、非虚构类读物）；说出作者和插画师的名字，并说明各自在讲述或呈现文本中的作用
evidence: Distinguish between a story, a poem, and a non-fiction book
Point to and name the author and illustrator on the cover
Explain that the author writes the words and the illustrator makes the pictures
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当你递给 {{name}} 一本书时，他们能告诉你这是故事书还是知识类读物，并指出封面上作者的名字吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 小组讨论文本
topics.description: 参与关于所读内容的讨论，轮流发言并倾听他人；清楚地表达自己的理解；积极参与小组阅读活动
evidence: Share ideas about a book in a group discussion
Listen to and respond to others' opinions about a text
Take turns speaking and build on what classmates have said about a book
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 的班级讨论一本大家都读过的书时，{{name}} 会参与进来吗——分享自己的想法，倾听别人的看法，即使观点不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 听读文本
topics.description: 聆听并讨论超出独立阅读水平的诗歌、故事和非虚构类读物；通过就关键细节提问和回答，确认对朗读文本的理解
evidence: Answer questions about a story or non-fiction text read aloud by the teacher
Discuss events, characters, or ideas from chapter books read to the class
Ask for clarification when something in a read-aloud is not understood
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在你给 {{name}} 朗读一个故事之后，他们能回答关于故事情节的问题吗——比如主角是谁、故事发生在哪里、遇到了什么问题？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 信息类文本的主题
topics.description: 找出信息类文本的主题并复述关键细节；描述人物、事件、观点或信息之间的关联
evidence: State what a non-fiction text is mostly about in one sentence
List two or three important facts learned from an informational text
Explain how two events or ideas in a text are connected
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 读完一本简短的知识类读物——比如关于动物或太空的——之后，他们能告诉你主题是什么，并说出几个从中学到的关键事实吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 图画与文字相互配合
topics.description: 描述插图和文字之间的关系；借助图片支持和加深理解
evidence: Use pictures to predict or confirm story events
Describe what is happening in an illustration and how it relates to the text
Explain how an illustration adds information not stated in words
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在读绘本时，他们会看插图来帮助理解故事内容吗——他们能解释一幅图与页面上文字之间的联系吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 读出言外之意
topics.description: 就文学类和信息类文本中的关键细节提问和回答；根据人物的言行做出简单的推断
evidence: Answer 'who', 'what', 'where' questions about a text using evidence
Infer a character's feelings from their actions (e.g. 'She's sad because she's crying')
Make logical guesses about unstated information using text clues
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在读故事时，{{name}} 能回答“那个人物为什么那样做？”或“你觉得他们当时是什么感受？”这类问题吗——依据文本中的线索，而不只是猜测？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 阅读中的自我纠正
topics.description: 阅读时检查文本是否通顺，通过重读或借助上下文来纠正不准确的阅读
evidence: Notice when reading does not make sense and stop to re-read
Self-correct errors mid-sentence (e.g. 'Wait, that doesn't sound right')
Use meaning, sentence structure, and visual cues together to monitor reading
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在阅读时遇到不太通顺的地方，他们会回去重读那部分吗——或者借助周围的词来判断一个难词或难句的意思？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人物的视角与反应
topics.description: 识别并比较人物的视角，辨认故事是谁在讲述，描述人物如何应对事件和挑战，并比较不同故事或同一故事不同版本中人物的经历
evidence: Identify who is telling a story and explain how you know (e.g. 'The wolf is telling the story because he says I')
Describe how a character responds to a problem or challenge using evidence from the text (e.g. 'When the bridge broke, she decided to swim across')
Compare how two characters from different stories react to a similar situation (e.g. how two heroes show bravery in different ways)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读一个从某个人物视角讲述的故事时，他们能想一想同一故事中另一个人物可能对事件有怎样不同的看法吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 表达性与感官语言
topics.description: 识别故事和诗歌中反复出现的文学语言，找出能表达情感或唤起感官体验的词语和短语，并讨论最喜欢的词语和短语
evidence: Spot recurring story language such as 'Once upon a time' and 'happily ever after'
Identify sensory words and phrases in a poem: 'the icy wind howled'
Share a favourite word or phrase from a story and explain why it appeals
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到一首诗或一个语言生动的故事时，他们能挑出一个自己特别喜欢的短语，并说出它好在哪里、或者让自己有什么感受吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主题与关键细节
topics.description: 识别多段说明文的主旨，确定各段落的重点，并解释关键细节如何支撑中心思想
evidence: Identify the main topic of a multi-paragraph informational text and state the focus of individual paragraphs
Describe how specific details and facts in the text support the main idea
Explain how events, ideas, or steps in a text are connected (e.g. cause-effect, sequence, comparison)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读一篇多页的文章——比如学校课本里关于某个历史事件的内容——他们能说出主旨，再解释每一部分具体讲了什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 非虚构文本特征
topics.description: 认识不同的非虚构文本结构和特征（标题、目录、词汇表、索引），理解文本如何组织以呈现信息
evidence: Use a contents page to find information on a specific topic in a non-fiction book
Identify the purpose of headings, glossary, and index in an information text
Recognise that non-fiction books can be structured as lists, time order, or question-and-answer
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用一本非虚构类书籍做学校作业时，他们知道怎么用标题、目录页和索引快速找到需要的内容吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 有条理地复述故事
topics.description: 按顺序复述故事并包含关键细节，借助文本中的证据描述人物、场景和主要事件，并描述故事的整体结构（开头、中间、结尾）
evidence: Retell a familiar story in order, including at least three key details from beginning, middle, and end
Describe a character's appearance, actions, or personality using details from the text
Explain how the beginning of a story introduces the characters and setting, and how the ending concludes the action
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一个故事后，{{name}} 能借助书中的细节描述主人公吗——包括他们是什么样的人、想要什么，以及最后感受如何？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 故事顺序与中心思想
topics.description: 讨论叙事文本中事件的先后顺序以及非虚构文本中信息之间的关联，复述故事并包含关键细节，展示对中心思想或道理的理解
evidence: Retell a story in correct sequence with beginning, middle, and end
Identify the central message or lesson of a story
Explain how two pieces of information in a non-fiction text are connected
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读完一本章节书后，能用自己的话讲清楚开头、中间和结尾，并说出这个故事核心到底讲了什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 诗歌形式与表演
topics.description: 认识不同的诗歌形式（自由诗、叙事诗、俳句）并讨论其特点；准备诗歌和剧本，通过语调、语气、音量和动作来朗读和表演，展现对内容的理解
evidence: Name at least two different forms of poetry and describe a feature of each (e.g., 'narrative poetry tells a story', 'free verse does not have a regular rhyme or rhythm')
Recognise the form of a given poem and explain how you identified it (e.g., 'This is a narrative poem because it has characters and a plot')
Prepare and perform a poem or play script extract showing understanding through changes in intonation, volume, and expression
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 大声朗读一首诗时，他们会根据情绪变化声音吗——欢快的诗读得兴奋，悲伤的诗读得轻柔——而不是平铺直叙？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 推断人物的感受与动机
topics.description: 从独立阅读的文本中做出推断，例如根据人物的行为推断其感受、想法和动机，并用文本中的证据来支撑推断
evidence: Infer a character's feelings or motives from their actions and dialogue (e.g. 'She slammed the door — how is she feeling?')
Justify an inference by quoting or pointing to specific evidence in the text
Distinguish between what is explicitly stated and what must be inferred from clues in the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读完小说的一章后，能说出某个人物当时的感受和原因，并指出人物说过的话或做过的事作为证据吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主旨与记笔记
topics.description: 找出跨多个段落的主旨并加以概括；用笔记、表格或其他方法从非虚构文本中提取并记录信息
evidence: Read a multi-paragraph non-fiction text and state the main idea of each paragraph in one sentence
Summarise a text of 3+ paragraphs in 2-3 sentences capturing the key points
Retrieve specific information from a non-fiction text and record it using a simple table or notes (e.g., 'Name: hedgehog, Habitat: woodland, Diet: insects')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读一篇较长的非虚构文章或章节时，他们能提炼出最重要的要点并写成简短的摘要——而不是直接大段抄写原文吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 故事中的道理与寓意
topics.description: 判断故事、寓言或民间故事的中心思想、教训或寓意，说明故事想教给读者什么，并用文中的关键细节支持自己的理解
evidence: State the lesson or moral of a fable in one sentence (e.g. 'The Tortoise and the Hare teaches that slow and steady wins the race')
Explain what a story's central message is using at least two details from the text as support
Distinguish the central message from a summary of events — explain what the story means, not just what happens
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完《龟兔赛跑》这样的寓言后，{{name}} 能说出故事想讲的道理吗？还能指出故事中体现这个道理的具体情节吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文本特征与呈现方式
topics.description: 识别语言选择、文本结构和呈现特征（插图、示意图、粗体字、版面布局）如何共同构成文本的整体含义与效果
evidence: Explain how an author's word choices create a particular effect (e.g., 'The author uses "crept" instead of "walked" to make it feel sneaky and tense')
Identify how a text's structure helps the reader (e.g., 'The headings help you find information quickly', 'The story builds suspense before the ending')
Explain how a presentational feature contributes to meaning (e.g., 'The bold words are important vocabulary', 'The diagram shows how the water cycle works')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到带有标题、示意图或粗体词的页面时，能解释这些特征的作用吗？比如“这张示意图展示了水循环，因为光看文字很难想象出来”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主题与信息
topics.description: 在童话、神话、传说和传统故事等各类书籍中，识别反复出现的主题（善与恶、友谊、勇敢）和常见写法（从前、结尾的寓意、英雄之旅）
evidence: Identify a common theme across two different stories (e.g., 'Both "Jack and the Beanstalk" and "The Three Billy Goats Gruff" are about bravery overcoming a threat')
Name literary conventions found in fairy tales and myths (e.g., 'once upon a time', magical numbers like three, a quest or journey, good triumphing over evil)
Explain how the same theme can appear in different genres (e.g., friendship in a realistic story vs a myth)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读过几个不同的童话或神话后，{{name}} 能发现其中的规律吗？比如“英雄总要面对三个挑战”或“好人最终总会赢”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人物性格与动机
topics.description: 借助文本证据分析人物的性格、动机和感受，并区分自己的观点与叙述者或人物的观点
evidence: Identify two character traits from a story and cite the specific actions or dialogue that reveal each trait
Explain why a character made a particular decision by linking their motivation to events in the text
Describe where one's own opinion about a character differs from the narrator's portrayal and explain why
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读故事时，{{name}} 能说出某个人物为什么做出某个选择——解释其动机——同时说明自己是否认同这个人物的做法吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文本中的观点联系
topics.description: 运用时间、顺序、因果和比较类语言，描述信息类文本中事件、观点或概念之间的联系，并识别句子与段落之间的逻辑关联
evidence: Read a science text and identify three cause-and-effect relationships using signal words like 'because', 'as a result'
Explain the sequence of steps in a technical procedure using time-order language ('first', 'next', 'finally')
Describe how two paragraphs in a text are connected (e.g. comparison, cause/effect, or sequence)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一篇关于气候或历史的非虚构文章后，{{name}} 能解释某件事发生的原因、造成的结果，以及作者是如何把这些观点联系起来的吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 寓言、民间故事与神话中的寓意
topics.description: 说明故事的中心思想、教训或寓意如何通过关键细节传达，涵盖寓言、民间故事和神话等多种文本类型
evidence: Retell a fable and identify the moral, citing three key details that convey it
Compare how two myths from different cultures convey a similar central message through different events
Explain the difference between the topic of a story and its central message or lesson
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一个来自其他文化的神话或民间故事后，{{name}} 能说出它想传达的道理或价值观吗？还能指出故事中哪些细节体现了这一点吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 结构术语
topics.description: 使用结构术语（章节、场景、诗节）指称文学文本的各个部分，并描述后续部分如何在前文基础上展开
evidence: Identify chapters, scenes, or stanzas in a given text and use the correct term for each
Explain how the second stanza of a poem builds on the mood established in the first
Describe how a specific chapter advances the plot by referring to events in earlier chapters
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 谈论正在读的书时，能正确使用“章节”“诗节”或“场景”这样的词吗？能解释后面的章节如何在前文基础上发展吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作者为什么写它
topics.description: 区分自己的观点与信息类文本作者的观点，并识别作者的写作目的
evidence: Read an opinion article and state the author's point of view, then state one's own and explain how they differ
Identify whether an author's purpose is to inform, persuade, or entertain, citing evidence from the text
Explain how word choices in an informational text reveal the author's attitude toward the topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读科普书或文章时，{{name}} 能说出作者的写作目的是什么吗？比如是想告知、说服还是娱乐？以及自己是否认同作者的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 整合多篇文本的信息
topics.description: 整合同一主题的两篇文本中的信息，以便有依据地就该主题进行写作或发言，并比较两篇来源各自提供的内容
evidence: Read two informational texts on the same topic and identify information that appears in both, information unique to each, and any contradictions between them
Combine key details from two sources into a coherent summary or short report that draws on both texts
Explain how reading a second text on the same topic added to, confirmed, or challenged understanding gained from the first text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用两本不同的书或文章研究同一个主题，他们能否把从两处收集到的信息整合起来，比单看任何一篇来源更完整地讲述或写出这个主题？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文化典故与词义
topics.description: 判断文学文本中词语和短语的含义，包括理解对神话和文化典故的引用（如 Herculean、Achilles' heel）
evidence: Explain the meaning of an allusion drawn from mythology when encountered in a text, e.g. identify that 'Herculean task' means an extremely difficult task, referencing Hercules' legendary labours
Use context and knowledge of word parts to determine the meaning of unfamiliar words in a poem or story, explaining how the word contributes to tone or meaning
Identify when an author is using a word figuratively rather than literally and explain the intended meaning in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到提到“a Herculean task”或“an Achilles heel”这类说法的故事时，他们能否推断出意思——或者查一查并解释背后的神话典故？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 解释事件与观点
topics.description: 解释信息类文本中的事件、过程、观点或概念，包括发生了什么以及为什么发生，并引用文本中关于原因、结果和过程步骤的具体证据
evidence: Explain a historical event described in an informational text by identifying both what happened and the causes leading to it, using specific details from the text
Describe the steps in a procedure or process presented in an informational text, explaining why each step is necessary based on information in the text
Identify cause-and-effect relationships between ideas or events in an informational passage and explain them using evidence from the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一篇解释某事物如何运作的非虚构文章——比如火山如何形成——{{name}} 能否用自己的话写下主要步骤或原因，并引用作者使用的具体证据？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 找出主题并概括
topics.description: 根据文本细节判断故事、戏剧或诗歌的主题，并提供客观的摘要，抓住关键事件而不掺入个人观点
