evidence: Identify the theme of a story (e.g. courage, friendship, overcoming adversity) by examining what characters learn, how they change, and what the author emphasises across the whole text
Distinguish theme from topic: explain that a topic might be 'war' while the theme is 'the cost of conflict on families'
Summarise a story, chapter, or poem objectively, including only key events and details without inserting personal opinions or minor details
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一本小说或一首诗后，{{name}} 能否解释主题——比如“讲的是不放弃”——然后写一段简短的情节摘要，而不把自己的观点混进去？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 第一手与第二手叙述
topics.description: 比较和对比同一事件或主题的第一手叙述（自传、日记、信件）与第二手叙述（传记、教科书、新闻报道），找出两者在关注重点和所提供信息上的差异
evidence: Explain the difference between a firsthand account (written by someone who experienced the event) and a secondhand account (written by someone who researched it), using specific examples
Compare a diary entry and a textbook passage about the same historical event, identifying what each account includes, omits, and emphasises
Analyse how the perspective of the writer (participant vs observer/researcher) affects the information provided, the language used, and the overall tone
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 既读了亲历某个历史事件的人写的日记，又读了关于同一事件的教科书叙述，他们能否说出两者的不同——比如各自包含哪些细节以及为什么？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作者如何支撑自己的观点
topics.description: 解释信息类文本的作者如何用理由和证据支撑特定观点，并评估论证是否合理、证据是否相关且充分
evidence: Identify the key points an author makes in an informational text and list the specific reasons and evidence provided to support each point
Evaluate whether the evidence an author uses (facts, statistics, examples, expert opinions) is relevant to the point being made and sufficient to be convincing
Distinguish between well-supported claims backed by evidence and unsupported opinions or assertions in an informational text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一篇说服性文章——比如支持或反对某事的文章——{{name}} 能否找出作者给出的理由，并说出每条理由是否有说服力、是否有充分支撑？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 深入分析人物与场景
topics.description: 深入描述故事或戏剧中的人物、场景或事件，依据文本中的具体细节，如人物的想法、话语、行为和互动
evidence: Write a detailed character description drawing on evidence from multiple points in the text, including what the character says, does, thinks, and how others respond to them
Describe a setting in depth by citing specific sensory details, figurative language, and mood clues the author provides
Explain how a key event affects the characters and plot development, citing specific textual details about actions, reactions, and consequences
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 读完发生重要事件的一章后，能否详细地写出或说出这件事——描述人物想了什么、说了什么、做了什么，并引用文本中具体的词句和片段？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 解读文本中的视觉信息
topics.description: 解读信息类文本中以视觉、口头或数量形式呈现的信息（如图表、图形、示意图、时间线、动画），并解释这些信息如何帮助理解文本
evidence: Read and interpret data from a chart, graph, or table included in an informational text and explain how it supports or extends the written information
Explain how a diagram, map, or timeline in an informational text helps the reader understand the topic in ways that words alone might not
Synthesise information from both the written text and a visual element (graph, illustration, infographic) to draw a conclusion that neither source provides independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到包含图表或时间线的非虚构文章时，他们能否解释这些视觉信息额外补充了什么——在文字内容之外？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 叙述者的视角
topics.description: 比较和对比不同故事的叙述视角，包括区分第一人称和第三人称叙述，并解释叙述者的视角如何影响读者的理解
evidence: Identify whether a story is told in first person (I/we) or third person (he/she/they) and explain how this affects what the reader knows about characters' thoughts and feelings
Compare two versions of a story or event told from different points of view and explain how each narrator's perspective changes what is emphasised, omitted, or revealed
Explain why an author might choose first-person narration (immediacy, personal voice) versus third-person narration (broader view, objectivity) for a particular story
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一个用第一人称写的故事后，{{name}} 能解释如果由另一个角色来讲述，或者由一个旁观者在外面讲述，这个故事的感觉会有什么不同吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 诗歌、戏剧与散文
topics.description: 解释诗歌、戏剧和散文之间的主要区别，识别每种形式独有的结构要素：诗歌中的诗节、节奏和韵律；戏剧中的角色表、对话和舞台指示；散文中的章节和段落
evidence: Compare a poem, a play script, and a prose passage on a similar theme, identifying the structural features unique to each form (e.g. stanzas vs scenes vs chapters)
Identify and explain the function of structural elements in drama: cast list, stage directions (in italics or brackets), dialogue format, and scene divisions
Describe how structural elements of poetry such as verse, rhythm, meter, and line breaks affect how a poem is read aloud and how meaning is conveyed
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看着一首诗、一个剧本和小说中的一章，解释它们各自的排版有什么不同吗——比如剧本有舞台指示，诗歌有诗节？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 推荐书籍
topics.description: 向同伴推荐书籍，基于对各种体裁、作者和主题的了解说明选择理由，并在同一本书内和不同书之间进行比较
evidence: Recommend a book to a peer by explaining its genre, theme, and what makes it engaging, comparing it to other books the peer has enjoyed
Justify a book recommendation by referring to specific features such as the author's style, the plot structure, or how a theme is developed
Maintain a reading log or book review collection that captures key responses to books read and serves as a reference for future recommendations
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 向朋友推荐一本书时，能清楚说明为什么觉得对方会喜欢——提到体裁、角色和主题，而不只是说“这本书很好”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 信息类文本的结构
topics.description: 描述信息类文本的整体结构（时间顺序、比较、因果、问题/解决方案），并解释作者选择的结构如何帮助传达信息和观点
evidence: Identify which organisational structure an informational text uses (chronological order, compare/contrast, cause/effect, or problem/solution) and cite textual features that signal it
Explain how signal words (first, then, finally for chronology; however, similarly for comparison; because, as a result for cause/effect; the solution was for problem/solution) reveal text structure
Compare two informational texts on the same topic that use different structures and explain how each structure affects the way information is presented to the reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 阅读非虚构文本时，能识别它是如何组织的吗——比如“这篇是按问题和解决方案来组织的”或“这篇是按时间顺序讲述事件的”——并解释为什么这种结构有效？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文本与媒体的联系
topics.description: 将故事或戏剧的文本与文本的视觉或口头呈现联系起来，识别每个版本在哪些地方反映了文本中的具体描述和指示
evidence: Compare a passage from a book with a film or audio adaptation, identifying specific moments where the visual or oral version matches or departs from the written text
Explain how a film, illustration, or dramatic performance interprets a scene from a story, citing specific textual descriptions the adaptation reflects
Identify details in the written text (descriptions of setting, character appearance, dialogue) that a visual or oral presentation brings to life, and note any differences
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读了一本书，然后看了电影版，能比较两者吗——指出电影中哪些地方与书中的描述不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨文化与传统的主题
topics.description: 比较和对比不同文化的故事、神话和传统文学中相似主题、话题和故事模式（如善与恶、追寻叙事、骗子故事）的处理方式
evidence: Compare how two myths or folk tales from different cultures treat a similar theme (e.g., creation, heroism, the importance of honesty) and explain both similarities and differences
Identify recurring story patterns across cultures such as the trickster figure, the quest, or the transformation, providing specific examples from texts read
Explain how cultural context shapes the way a universal theme is expressed differently in stories from various traditions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读过两个来自不同文化的追寻故事——比如一个希腊神话和一个西非民间故事——能比较它们各自如何处理英雄之旅，以及每个故事看重什么价值观吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比较书籍
topics.description: 在同一本书内和不同书之间进行比较，识别多个文本在主题、角色、背景和作者选择方面的相似之处和不同之处
evidence: Compare how two authors develop similar themes using different narrative techniques
Identify similarities and differences between characters across books by the same author
Analyse how settings function differently in two texts from the same genre
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完同一作者或同一体裁的几本书后，{{name}} 能比较它们吗——讨论这位作者常用的主题、风格或角色类型？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比较角色、背景和事件
topics.description: 比较和对比故事或戏剧中的两个或多个角色、背景或事件，依据角色如何互动、背景如何影响行动或事件如何关联的具体细节
evidence: Create a Venn diagram comparing two characters' traits using textual evidence
Explain how a change in setting affects the mood and characters' actions in a story
Analyse how two events in a narrative are connected through cause and effect
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一本有多个主要角色的小说后，{{name}} 能详细比较其中两个角色吗——解释他们的性格、经历和关系有哪些相似和不同之处？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比较信息类文本的结构
topics.description: 比较并对照两篇或更多信息类文本中事件、观点、概念或信息的整体结构，识别时间顺序、比较、因果、问题与解决等结构模式
evidence: Identify the organisational structure of two texts on the same topic
Explain how one text uses cause/effect while another uses problem/solution to present information
Analyse why an author chose a particular structure for their informational text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到两篇关于同一主题但组织方式不同的非虚构文本——一篇按时间顺序，一篇比较两个方面——他们能说出这些结构上的差异，并解释每种结构如何影响读者的阅读体验吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文本中的不同视角
topics.description: 描述叙述者或说话者的视角如何影响事件的描述方式，认识有限叙述与全知叙述的区别，以及视角如何塑造故事讲述
evidence: Identify whether a story uses first-person or third-person narration and explain the effect
Explain how events would be described differently if told from another character's perspective
Analyse how the narrator's knowledge or bias affects what information the reader receives
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释全知叙述者讲的故事和只知道自己那一面的单个角色讲的故事，读起来有什么不同吗——并举例说明这如何改变读者所知道的内容？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 解释文本中的关系
topics.description: 基于具体信息，解释历史、科学或技术类文本中两个或更多人物、事件、观点或概念之间的关系或相互作用
evidence: Explain the cause-and-effect relationship between events in a historical text
Describe how a scientific process involves sequential steps that depend on each other
Identify how key individuals in a text influenced events or other people
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一篇关于两个事件或发现如何相关联的历史或科学文本后，{{name}} 能清楚地解释这种关系吗——说明一件事如何导致或影响了另一件事？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 事实与观点
topics.description: 区分文本中的事实陈述和观点陈述，认识作者如何将事实信息与主观观点融合在一起
evidence: Identify and label statements as fact or opinion in a newspaper article
Explain why a statement is a fact by citing verifiable evidence or why it is an opinion
Recognise persuasive techniques that present opinions as if they were facts
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读一篇报纸文章或非虚构文本时，他们能指出哪些部分是事实、哪些部分是作者的观点吗——并解释他们是如何分辨的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作者如何处理相似主题
topics.description: 比较并对照同一体裁的故事在处理相似主题和话题时的方式，识别不同作者如何处理共同的想法
evidence: Compare how two mystery stories create suspense using different techniques
Identify common themes in adventure stories and explain how each author develops them differently
Analyse how two authors from the same genre approach the theme of friendship or courage
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完两篇同一体裁的冒险故事后，{{name}} 能比较每位作者如何处理相似的元素——比如主人公的挑战或结局——并说出自己更喜欢哪种处理方式以及为什么吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语言选择如何影响读者
topics.description: 评价作者如何使用语言，包括比喻性语言，考虑词语选择、意象和文学手法对读者的影响
evidence: Explain how a specific metaphor or simile affects the reader's understanding or emotions
Evaluate an author's choice of descriptive language and its impact on atmosphere
Compare how different authors use figurative language to achieve similar effects
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到一段带有比喻性语言的描写——比如“太阳是一只燃烧的眼睛”——他们能解释作者在创造什么画面或感受，以及这种表达是否有效吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 各部分如何构成整篇文本
topics.description: 解释一系列章节、场景或诗节如何组合起来构成故事、戏剧或诗歌的整体结构，分析每一部分如何为整体做出贡献
evidence: Map the structure of a novel showing how each chapter advances plot or character development
Explain how individual stanzas in a poem build toward a central theme or message
Analyse how scenes in a play work together to develop conflict and resolution
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一本小说后，{{name}} 能解释每一章如何为整体做出贡献吗——比如前面某一章引入了一个紧张冲突，直到很后面才得到解决？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 为文本观点提供理由
topics.description: 为关于文本的观点提供有理有据的论证，用证据和逻辑论证来支持解读和看法
evidence: State an opinion about a character's motivations and support it with three pieces of textual evidence
Construct a reasoned argument about an author's message using quotes from the text
Respond to an alternative interpretation by providing counter-evidence from the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 分享对一本书的看法时——比如“我觉得反派也有道理”——他们能用文本中的具体引文或事件来支撑，而不只是说自己感觉如何吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文本中的多媒体元素
topics.description: 分析视觉和多媒体元素如何帮助传达文本的意义、语气或美感，例如图像小说、多媒体演示或小说和诗歌的插图版
evidence: Explain how illustrations in a graphic novel convey emotion or advance the story
Analyse how visual elements such as colour and layout affect the tone of a multimedia text
Compare how the same scene is portrayed in text versus in visual or audio format
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 阅读图像小说或插图版图书时，能否解释图片和排版——而不只是文字——如何帮助讲述故事或营造特定的氛围？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 同一事件的不同叙述
topics.description: 分析同一事件或主题的多种叙述，注意它们所代表的观点之间的重要相同点和不同点
evidence: Compare two news articles about the same event and identify differences in perspective
Explain how the author's background or purpose affects their account of an event
Identify which facts are consistent across accounts and which details differ based on viewpoint
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到同一事件的两篇不同报道——比如两篇新闻报道讲的是同一件事——能否解释每篇报道侧重了什么、省略了什么，以及为什么视角不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 准确引用文本
topics.description: 在解释文本明确表达的内容和进行推断时，从文学和信息类文本中准确引用，正确使用引号和出处标注
evidence: Select and copy exact words from a text to support an inference about character motivation
Use quotation marks correctly when incorporating textual evidence into written responses
Introduce quotes with signal phrases such as 'The author states' or 'According to the text'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 为学校作业写关于一本书或一篇文章的内容时，是否会直接引用原文——把原话放在引号里——来支持自己的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 概括非虚构类文本的主旨
topics.description: 确定信息类文本的两个或多个主旨，解释关键细节如何支撑这些主旨，然后在不加入个人观点的情况下概括全文
evidence: Identify the main ideas in each section of an informational article
List key details that support each main idea in a multi-paragraph text
Write an objective summary capturing the main ideas without adding personal opinions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一篇较长的非虚构类文章后，{{name}} 能否找出文章涉及的两三个主旨，并写一段简短的摘要把它们都涵盖进去——而且不加入自己的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用证据支撑观点
topics.description: 解释作者如何运用理由和证据来支撑文本中的特定观点，指出哪些理由和证据支撑哪些具体观点
evidence: Match each of an author's main points with the evidence used to support it
Evaluate whether the evidence provided adequately supports the author's argument
Identify points in a text that lack sufficient evidence or reasoning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一篇说服性文本后，{{name}} 能否梳理出作者用哪些理由支撑哪些具体观点——表明他们理解的是论证的结构，而不只是结论？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨多篇文本综合信息
topics.description: 整合同一主题的多篇文本中的信息，以便有见地地就这一主题进行写作或发言，在整合信息时不抄袭
evidence: Combine information from three sources into a coherent paragraph using own words
Create a fact sheet that synthesises key information from multiple texts on one topic
Present information orally that draws on multiple sources while crediting the sources
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用多个资料来源写学校报告时，能否把所有来源的信息用自己的话整合起来——而不是一次只引用或照抄一个来源？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 使用多个信息来源
topics.description: 从多种纸质或数字来源中获取信息，展现快速找到问题答案或高效解决问题的能力
evidence: Use search features, indexes, and headings to locate specific information across sources
Synthesise information from two or more sources to answer a research question
Evaluate which source provides the most relevant information for a given question
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 需要为学校的研究问题找答案时，能否在几本书或几个网站中快速搜索到相关信息——而不是把每个来源从头到尾读一遍？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 分析文本结构
topics.description: 分析文本结构——包括整体组织方式、章节、诗节、场景、段落或小节的运用——如何帮助传达意义、风格和思路的发展
evidence: Explain how a non-chronological structure (e.g., flashback, frame narrative) creates suspense or surprise
Analyse the role of a specific paragraph in developing and refining a key concept in a non-fiction text
Compare how two texts use different structures (e.g., epistolary vs. linear narrative) and the effect of each
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 分析一首诗或一部小说时，能否解释作者的结构选择——比如从情节中途开始，或以一个反复出现的意象结尾——如何塑造文本的整体意义？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨文本批判性比较
topics.description: 对多个文本进行批判性比较——比较两部或多部作品中的主题、人物、背景、风格或论点，包括来自不同时期、体裁或文化的文本
evidence: Compare how two novels treat a shared theme (e.g., growing up) using specific evidence from both
Analyse how a modern retelling draws on and transforms elements from a traditional story or myth
Compare conflicting accounts of the same event in two non-fiction texts and evaluate which is more convincing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完来自截然不同时代或文化的文本后，{{name}} 能否深入比较它们——不仅指出表面的相似之处，还能发现价值观、风格以及作者对读者预设方面的深层差异？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 评估非虚构作品中的论点
topics.description: 评估非虚构文本中的论点和主张——判断推理是否合理、证据是否相关且充分，区分事实与观点，并识别偏见、宣传和修辞手法
evidence: Identify the main claim in an argument text and evaluate whether the evidence presented is sufficient
Spot logical fallacies or irrelevant evidence introduced to distract from weak reasoning
Compare two opposing arguments on the same issue and evaluate which is more convincing, with reasons
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到一篇说服性文章——比如社论或演讲——能否识别其中使用的修辞手法，评估论证在逻辑上是否站得住脚，并解释哪些地方可能存在偏见或误导？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比喻性语言与文学手法
topics.description: 结合语境判断比喻性和内涵性语言的含义，分析特定词语选择对意义和语气的影响，并识别隐喻、明喻、拟人、典故和反讽等文学手法
evidence: Identify a metaphor or simile in a passage and explain its effect on the reader
Explain how an author's word choice creates a particular tone (e.g., menacing, humorous, melancholic)
Recognise an allusion to a myth, the Bible, or another text and explain what it adds to the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到含有隐喻、反讽或典故的段落时，能否解释作者真正想表达的意思——超越字面文字，描述该手法为读者带来的效果？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 叙事视角与不可靠叙述者
topics.description: 分析观点和叙事视角——包括第一人称、第三人称有限视角和全知视角，以及不可靠叙述者——并理解作者或叙述者的视角如何塑造读者的理解，以及如何制造悬念、反讽或幽默等效果
evidence: Identify the narrative perspective of a text and explain how it limits or expands the reader's knowledge
Explain how dramatic irony arises when the reader knows something a character does not
Compare how the same event might be told differently from two characters' perspectives
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到有不可靠叙述者的故事——即讲故事的人并不完全可信——能否发现暗示叙述者没有呈现全貌的线索？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 情节结构与人物发展
topics.description: 分析情节如何通过片段或关键事件展开，以及人物如何发展、应对挑战并在叙事过程中发生变化——包括人物、背景和情节之间的关系
evidence: Trace how a character's attitude changes across a story and identify the turning points
Explain how a specific incident in a drama propels the action or provokes a decision
Analyse how the setting influences a character's behaviour or the mood of a scene
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一部小说后，{{name}} 能否解释主人公从开头到结尾发生了怎样的变化——指出导致这些变化的具体事件，以及背景如何塑造了他们的成长？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 诗歌形式与惯例
topics.description: 识别并理解诗歌惯例——包括形式（十四行诗、叙事歌谣、自由诗）、格律、押韵格式、诗节结构、意象和声音手法（头韵、元音韵、拟声）——并分析诗人如何运用这些手法来营造效果
evidence: Identify the form of a poem (e.g., sonnet, haiku, ballad) and explain its key structural features
Analyse how a poet uses rhythm or sound devices to reinforce meaning or mood
Explain how enjambment or a caesura affects the pace and emphasis of a line
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到一首诗时，能否识别它的形式——比如十四行诗或叙事歌谣——并解释诗人如何运用押韵、节奏和意象来传达诗歌的含义或情感效果？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 目的、受众与语境
topics.description: 识别文本的目的、受众和语境，并运用这些知识辅助理解——认识面向不同受众的写作（学术性、通俗性、说服性）如何使用不同的惯例、语域和语气
evidence: Identify the intended audience and purpose of a text and explain how the language choices reflect this
Compare a newspaper article and a scientific report on the same topic, noting differences in register and structure
Explain how knowing the historical or social context of a text deepens understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到面向截然不同受众的内容——比如同一主题的科学期刊文章和儿童读物——能否解释目的和受众如何影响了语言、语气和结构？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 梳理文本中的主题
topics.description: 判断并分析文本的主题或中心思想，通过关键细节和事件梳理其在全文中的发展，并提供独立于个人观点的客观摘要
evidence: Identify a theme in a novel and explain how specific events develop it across the plot
Distinguish between the topic of a text (what it is about) and the theme (what it is saying)
Write a concise, objective summary of a chapter or article without inserting personal opinion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 读完一部小说或长诗后，{{name}} 能否解释它在最深层次上真正讲的是什么——中心思想或主题——并梳理这一思想如何通过文本中的关键时刻逐步展开？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 理解戏剧与表演
topics.description: 理解剧作家如何通过表演传达意义——包括舞台调度、导演、布景设计、灯光和演员的选择——以及不同的制作如何对同一个剧本做出不同的诠释
evidence: Explain how a director's staging choices (e.g., set, lighting, blocking) affect the audience's understanding
Compare two productions or adaptations of the same play and evaluate different interpretive choices
Analyse how a filmed or live production stays faithful to or departs from the original script
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在观看一部读过的戏剧的舞台或影视版本后，{{name}} 能否讨论具体的选择——比如灯光、演员的语气或布景设计——是如何诠释剧本的，以及他们是否认同这些选择？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 使用与评估文本证据
topics.description: 引用具体的文本证据来支持对文本明示内容和可推断内容的分析，区分强证据与弱证据，并解释证据如何支持某个观点
evidence: Identify a relevant quotation to support an inference about a character's feelings
Explain why one piece of evidence is stronger than another for supporting a claim
Use embedded quotations in a written response to back up an analytical point
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在课堂上或写作中对文本提出观点时，他们是否会用具体的引文或引用加以支撑——并且能否解释该证据是强有力地支持了他们的观点，还是只是勉强支持？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨体裁的广泛自主阅读
topics.description: 广泛而自主地阅读虚构与非虚构作品——包括整本小说、短篇故事、戏剧、诗歌，以及来自不同体裁、时期和文化的非虚构作品——培养阅读耐力、广度和个人品味
evidence: Choose books independently that offer appropriate challenge and genuine interest
Read at least two Shakespeare plays and a range of pre-1914 and contemporary literature during KS3
Maintain a personal reading record and articulate preferences with reasons
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否会为了乐趣而广泛阅读各类书籍——虚构、非虚构、诗歌、戏剧——并且能否热情地谈论自己发现的作者、体裁或主题？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 提问
topics.description: 提出相关问题以加深理解；通过提问和回答问题来寻求帮助、获取信息或澄清不明白的地方
evidence: Ask a question when something is unclear or more information is needed
Answer questions with relevant and specific information
Request clarification politely (e.g. 'Can you explain that again?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 不明白某件事——比如游戏的规则或老师的讲解——他们会主动提问去弄清楚，而不是随便猜吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 口头描述
topics.description: 详细描述熟悉的人、地点、事物和事件；说话声音清晰，清楚地表达想法、感受和观点；给出结构良好的描述和解释
evidence: Describe a familiar person or place using several details
Speak clearly and loudly enough for the whole group to hear
Organise ideas logically when sharing information or telling about an event
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否详细地讲述发生的一件事——比如一次旅行或一部电影——让你真的能在脑海中想象出来，并且说得清楚，让你能跟得上？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 通过交谈探索想法
topics.description: 通过推测、假设、想象和探索想法，用口语发展理解；运用交谈中的策略来积累词汇
evidence: Wonder aloud about possibilities (e.g. 'What if...' or 'I think it might be because...')
Try out new vocabulary in conversation after hearing it in a story or lesson
Explore ideas through talk before committing them to writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 试图弄明白某件事时——比如故事中为什么会发生某件事，或某样东西是怎么运作的——他们会把想法说出来、探索各种可能性，然后再确定答案吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 表达与论证观点
topics.description: 清晰表达并论证答案、论点和观点；参与讨论、展示、表演、角色扮演和辩论
evidence: State an opinion and give a reason (e.g. 'I think ... because ...')
Participate in a class presentation or performance with confidence
Explain thinking when answering a question rather than just giving a one-word answer
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 不同意某件事或有自己的看法时，他们能否说出自己为什么这样想，并给出理由来支撑，而不是只说“因为我就是这样想的”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 小组讨论
topics.description: 积极参与合作对话并紧扣主题；通过多轮交流延续对话；在讨论中保持注意力
evidence: Stay on topic during a conversation for multiple turns
Build on what another speaker has said (e.g. 'I agree because...')
Maintain focus and contribute meaningfully in group discussions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 和朋友聊天或参加小组活动时，他们能否让对话来回进行——倾听、回应，并在对方说的基础上继续展开？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 倾听与回应
topics.description: 认真倾听大人和同伴的话并恰当回应；遵守讨论中约定好的规则，比如听别人说话、轮流发言
evidence: Demonstrate attentive listening by making eye contact and responding relevantly
Follow classroom discussion rules (e.g. raise hand, wait for turn)
Show understanding of what was said by paraphrasing or responding appropriately
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在学校的小组讨论或饭桌上聊天时，别人说话时能认真听，轮到自己再开口吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 背诵诗歌
topics.description: 熟记诗歌并背诵，语调恰当；描述时适当配上视觉展示；口头表达时说出完整的句子
evidence: Recite a poem from memory with expression and clear enunciation
Add a drawing or visual display to support an oral description or presentation
Present information to the class using complete sentences and audible voice
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能记住一首短诗，并带着感情背出来——根据诗句的情绪变化调整自己的声音吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 吸引听众与尊重不同观点
topics.description: 说话时能引起、保持并留意听众的兴趣；考虑并评价不同的观点，关注并回应别人的发言；开始根据不同的场合选择合适的语言
evidence: Use strategies to engage listeners during a presentation (e.g., make eye contact, vary tone and pace, ask the audience a question)
Listen to a peer's viewpoint and respond by agreeing, disagreeing, or extending their idea with a reason (e.g., 'I agree with Priya because… but I also think…')
Choose more formal language for a class presentation and more informal language for a group discussion, explaining the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 在小组里说话时，能注意到别人是不是不感兴趣了，并调整自己的说话方式——或者接住别人说的话，认真补充自己的想法吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 为讨论做准备并解释观点
topics.description: 有准备地参与讨论，运用事先的准备和已知信息，并结合讨论内容解释自己的想法
evidence: Read assigned material and prepare three discussion points or questions before a group conversation
During discussion, refer explicitly to the text or preparation notes to support a point
After a group exchange, explain how one's own thinking changed or was confirmed by others' contributions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道课上要讨论某个话题，会提前想一想，带着想法或事实来分享吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 报告与讲述
topics.description: 就某个话题做报告或讲述一段经历，事实有条理、细节有描述，说话清楚，语速让人听得懂
evidence: Deliver a one-minute oral report on a chosen topic, including at least three organised facts
Recount a personal experience using descriptive details and a clear beginning, middle, and end
Self-assess a recorded presentation for pace, clarity, and inclusion of relevant details
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能就自己研究过的话题做一段简短的发言——按合理的顺序讲出关键事实，说话清楚到别人能跟上吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 识别发言者观点背后的理由
topics.description: 找出说话者为支持某些观点给出的理由和证据，判断推理是否合乎逻辑、证据是否相关
evidence: Listen to a speaker's argument or presentation and list the specific reasons and evidence provided to support each main point
Evaluate whether the reasons a speaker gives are logical and whether the evidence cited is relevant to the claim being made
Ask follow-up questions that probe the strength of a speaker's reasoning, e.g. 'What evidence supports that claim?' or 'Are there other explanations?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 听别人论证或说明理由时，能判断出这些理由是否真的支持那个人所说的观点吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用自己的话转述听到的内容
topics.description: 用自己的话转述朗读文本的部分内容，或不同媒介和形式呈现的信息，准确抓住要点
evidence: Listen to a passage read aloud and restate the main idea and key details in own words without looking at the original text
Paraphrase information from a short video, podcast, or presentation, identifying the central message and supporting details
Distinguish between paraphrasing (restating in own words) and copying, demonstrating the ability to capture meaning without repeating exact wording
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听了一段关于某个话题的简短讲话或看了相关视频，能用自己的话把要点讲给你听吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 根据场合调整说话方式
topics.description: 根据不同的场合和任务调整说话方式，在适合任务和情境时使用正式英语，并针对不同听众调整语气、词汇和风格
evidence: Present the same information formally to a panel and informally to peers
Adjust vocabulary and sentence structure when speaking to different audiences
Identify contexts that require formal English and those where informal speech is appropriate
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 会根据说话对象自然地调整说话方式吗——比如跟老师说话比在操场上跟朋友说话更正式一些？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 在讨论中回应他人
topics.description: 在讨论中提出并回应具体问题，发表有助于推进讨论的评论，并对别人的发言做进一步展开
evidence: Ask follow-up questions that build on another speaker's comment
Respond to a classmate's idea by adding supporting evidence or a related example
Redirect a discussion by posing a question that connects to the main topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在课堂讨论中，{{name}} 会提出推动对话继续的问题，并发表建立在别人观点之上的评论，而不是只重复相同的想法吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 从讨论中得出结论
topics.description: 回顾讨论中表达的关键观点，并结合讨论中获得的信息和知识得出结论
evidence: Summarise the main points made by different speakers in a group discussion
Draw a conclusion that synthesises multiple viewpoints expressed in the discussion
Explain how the discussion changed or confirmed initial understanding of a topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在一次小组讨论之后，{{name}} 能把大家提出的要点归纳起来，并说明小组得出了什么结论吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 评价发言者的论证
topics.description: 概括发言者提出的要点，说明每个主张是如何由理由和证据支撑的，并评价这些支撑的逻辑性和相关性
evidence: Identify the main claim in a spoken presentation and the evidence used to support it
Evaluate whether a speaker's reasons logically support their main argument
Explain which pieces of evidence most effectively support a speaker's points
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 听别人为某件事陈述理由时，他们能向你复述发言者主张了什么，以及用了哪些理由和证据来支撑吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 多媒体演示
topics.description: 在演示中适当加入多媒体组件和视觉展示，以更好地展开主要观点或主题
evidence: Select graphics, images, or sound that support and clarify main ideas in a presentation
Create slides or visual aids that enhance rather than distract from the spoken content
Integrate multimedia elements smoothly into an oral presentation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在学校做演示时，他们会考虑加入图表、幻灯片或图片之类的内容，让听众更清楚地理解他们的观点吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 概括口头与媒体演示
topics.description: 概括朗读的书面文本，或以不同媒介和形式（包括视觉、数量和数据、口头）呈现的信息
evidence: Summarise the main points of a video or audio presentation in own words
Identify key information from a graph, chart, or infographic and explain it orally
Listen to a passage read aloud and provide an accurate summary of the content
topics.assessmentPrompt: 听完一场演讲或看完一段信息类视频后，{{name}} 能用自己的话口头概括出主要内容吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 表演剧本与诗歌
topics.description: 即兴表演、排练并演出剧本和诗歌——运用角色、语调、语气、音量、情绪、停顿、静止和动作来生成语言、探索意义，并增强表演的感染力
evidence: Perform a scene from a play using appropriate intonation, volume, and pauses to convey character and mood
Use improvisation to explore how a character might respond in a new situation
Rehearse and perform a poem aloud, using pace and emphasis to bring out the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在剧中表演或朗读剧本时，他们会运用自己的声音——音量、语速和表情——让角色或诗歌鲜活起来吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 正式发言与做演示
topics.description: 在正式和非正式的口语场合自信地使用标准英语——做简短的演讲和演示，清楚表达自己的想法，紧扣主题，并根据听众调整语体和词汇
evidence: Deliver a 2-3 minute presentation on a topic with a clear opening, organised points, and a conclusion
Adapt language between formal and informal registers depending on the context and audience
Maintain eye contact, appropriate pace, and clear articulation when speaking to a group
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用标准英语做一段简短的准备过的演讲或演示——紧扣主题，并调整词汇以适应听众吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 正式辩论
topics.description: 参与正式辩论和结构化讨论——用支撑证据陈述立场，回应他人的观点，概括并发展已发表的意见，并遵守讨论规则
evidence: Present an argument in a debate with a clear claim supported by evidence
Respond to an opposing point by summarising it fairly before offering a counterargument
Build on a previous speaker’s idea by extending, questioning, or challenging it constructively
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 参加过学校辩论吗？在辩论中他们需要用证据论证一个立场、回应对方的观点，并遵守正式讨论的规则。

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 自然拼读词汇
topics.description: 认识并会使用自然拼读与单词结构相关的词汇——音素、字素、GPC（字素-音素对应）、拼读、切分、双字母组合、CVC、元音、辅音、音节、词根、后缀、前缀和同音异形词——并理解这些词描述的是自然拼读教学所依托的构成要素
evidence: Say the sounds for common graphemes (e.g. 'sh', 'ch', 'th', 'ee', 'igh') and use 'phoneme' and 'grapheme' correctly when explaining
Blend sounds together to read an unfamiliar word and explain what they are doing using the word 'blend'
Segment a word into its individual sounds for spelling and use the term 'segment' to describe the process
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 的老师让他们“把一个单词切分成音素”或找出一个“双字母组合”时，他们明白这些词的意思吗？能完成这个任务而不显得困惑吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 把单词切分成音
topics.description: 把说出的单词切分成音素，并通过为每个音写出一个或多个字母来拼写 CVC 单词和简单的符合拼读规则的单词
evidence: Write CVC words from dictation (e.g. 'cat', 'bed', 'hot')
Segment words into individual sounds before choosing letters to write
Spell simple words phonetically drawing on sound-letter knowledge
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能听到像“cat”或“ship”这样的简单单词，并为他们听到的每个音写出对应的字母吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 听写拼写
topics.description: 在老师听写时凭记忆写出简单句子，运用学过的 GPC、拼写规则和常见例外词
evidence: Write a dictated sentence using phonically plausible spellings
Include correct spelling of taught exception words in dictation
Apply sentence punctuation in dictated writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你把一句话大声读给 {{name}} 听，让他们写下来，他们能把单词拼对、字母顺序写对吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 动词词尾的拼写
topics.description: 拼写带有常见后缀的单词（-s/-es 表示复数和第三人称动词，-ing、-ed、-er、-est），且词根不需要发生变化
evidence: Add -s or -es correctly to make plurals (e.g. 'cats', 'boxes')
Spell words with -ing and -ed endings (e.g. 'jumping', 'helped')
Add -er and -est to adjectives (e.g. 'quicker', 'quickest')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写到不止一只狗，或说到正在发生的事情时，他们能加上正确的词尾——比如“dogs”或“jumping”——而不出现拼写错误吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 前缀 un-
topics.description: 使用前缀 un- 拼写单词以改变词义；理解 un- 表示相反或动作的反向
evidence: Spell words with un- prefix correctly (e.g. 'unhappy', 'unfair', 'undo')
Explain how un- changes the meaning of a word
Create new words by adding un- to known words
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道在“happy”或“lock”这样的词前面加上“un-”会改变它的意思吗？他们能把这些词拼对吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 难拼词
topics.description: 凭记忆拼写不符合常规拼读规则的常见例外词，包括一周中的各天
evidence: Correctly spell high-frequency irregular words (e.g. 'said', 'the', 'was')
Write all seven days of the week correctly
Recall and write exception words in dictated sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能凭记忆拼写像“said”“were”“come”这样的日常难拼词以及一周中的各天，而不需要把它们拼读出来吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 音的其他拼写方式
topics.description: 使用已知音素的其他字素选择来拼写单词，为已经遇到过的音学习新的拼写方式（例如 /ɔ:/ 在 ll 前写作“a”，/ʌ/ 写作“o”，以 -tion 结尾的单词），包括区分常见的同音异形词
evidence: Spell 'ball', 'call', 'walk' using alternative grapheme /ɔ:/ as 'a' before ll
Distinguish homophones in writing: 'there/their/they’re', 'here/hear', 'quite/quiet'
Spell words ending in -tion correctly: 'station', 'fiction', 'motion'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在写作中遇到同一个音可以有不同拼写方式的单词——比如“see”和“sea”——他们知道该用哪种拼写吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 表示所属的撇号
topics.description: 在单数名词后使用所有格撇号来表示所属关系（例如 the girl's book、the dog's bone）
evidence: Write 'the cat's tail' to show the tail belongs to the cat
Distinguish plural -s ('the cats ran') from possessive 's ('the cat's bed') in writing
Add a possessive apostrophe to a singular noun in a dictated sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写属于某一个人或事物的东西时——比如“the dog's lead”或“the girl's bag”——他们能把撇号放在正确的位置吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 拼写缩略形式
topics.description: 正确拼写缩略形式，在省略字母的位置加上撇号（can't、didn't、I'll、it's 等）
evidence: Write 'can't' for 'cannot', 'didn't' for 'did not' with apostrophe correctly placed
Distinguish 'it's' (it is) from 'its' (possessive) in a sentence
Expand a contraction back to its full form and explain which letters are missing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写 "can't" 或 "didn't" 这样的缩略形式时，他们能把撇号放在正确的位置，表示省略了哪些字母吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 后缀
topics.description: 运用需要改变词根的后缀拼写规则：在元音后缀前去掉词尾的 -e，把 -y 变成 -i，在短元音单词中双写末尾辅音；使用后缀 -ment、-ness、-ful、-less、-ly
evidence: Spell 'hoping' (drop e), 'cried' (y to i), 'running' (double consonant) applying the correct rule
Add -ful, -less, -ness, -ly correctly: 'careful', 'hopeless', 'sadness', 'slowly'
Identify which suffix rule to apply to a given root word and explain why
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 给单词加上 "-ing" 或 "-ed" 这样的词尾时，他们知道什么时候该去掉不发音的 "e"、双写最后一个字母，或者把 "y" 变成 "i" 吗——比如 "running"、"baked" 或 "happily"？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 表示所属的撇号（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 在规则和不规则复数名词中准确使用所有格撇号（如 the girls' bags、the children's toys），区分单数所有格和复数所有格
evidence: Place the apostrophe correctly in plural possessives: 'the dogs' kennel' vs 'the dog's kennel'
Write possessive forms of irregular plurals correctly (e.g. 'children's', 'women's', 'mice's')
Distinguish singular possession (the boy's hat) from plural possession (the boys' hats) in dictated sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写到属于某个群体的东西时——比如 "the children's coats" 或 "the teachers' cars"——他们能把撇号放在正确的位置吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 同音词
topics.description: 区分并正确拼写 3-4 年级常见的同音词和近音词（如 accept/except、affect/effect、brake/break、grate/great），包括用 ei、eigh 或 ey 拼写 /eɪ/ 音
evidence: Spell pairs of homophones correctly in context (e.g., 'there/their/they're', 'brake/break', 'grate/great')
Choose the correct homophone to complete a sentence (e.g., 'The dog wagged its/it's tail')
Spell words with the /eɪ/ sound as ei, eigh, or ey (e.g., vein, eight, they, neighbour)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写作时，他们能为发音相同但意思不同的单词选对拼写吗——比如 "brake"（自行车上的刹车）和 "break"（折断某物）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 前缀（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 拼写带有各种前缀的单词（dis-、mis-、un-、re-、pre-、anti-、auto-、super-），理解每个前缀如何改变词根的含义而不改变其拼写
evidence: Spell words with prefixes dis-, mis-, re- correctly without altering the root (e.g., disappoint, misspell, return)
Add prefixes un-, pre-, anti-, auto-, super- to root words and use the new word in a sentence (e.g., unhappy, preview, autograph)
Explain how a prefix changes the meaning of a root word (e.g., 'dis-' means 'not' or 'opposite of')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到以 "dis-"、"mis-" 或 "pre-" 开头的单词，他们能通过思考前缀来推断单词的意思并正确拼写吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 拼写词表（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 拼写 3 年级和 4 年级法定词表中的单词，包括不遵循常规规则的常见拼错词
evidence: Spell at least 20 words from the Y3-4 statutory list correctly (e.g., accident, believe, different, favourite, imagine)
Identify tricky parts of statutory words and use a strategy to remember them (e.g., 'separate' has 'a rat' in the middle)
Use statutory list words accurately in own writing across subjects
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在写作时凭记忆拼写学校 3 年级和 4 年级词表上的难词吗——比如 "enough"、"believe" 或 "separate"？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 后缀（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 使用能产后缀（-ation、-ly、-ous）和 3-4 年级课程中引入的较少见的音形对应关系（/ɪ/ 拼作 y，/ʌ/ 拼作 ou，以及听起来像 /ʒə/、/tʃə/、/ʒən/、/ʃən/ 的词尾）拼写单词
evidence: Spell words with suffixes -ation (e.g., information, sensation), -ly (e.g., sadly, gently, happily), and -ous (e.g., famous, enormous, various)
Spell words with less common vowel patterns: /ɪ/ as y (e.g., myth, gym), /ʌ/ as ou (e.g., young, touch, double)
Spell words with endings /ʒə/ as -sure (e.g., measure, treasure), /tʃə/ as -ture (e.g., creature, furniture), /ʒən/ as -sion (e.g., division, television)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能正确拼写以 "-tion"、"-ous" 或 "-ly" 结尾的单词吗——比如 "nation"、"famous" 或 "quietly"——而不需要查字典？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用词典检查拼写
topics.description: 利用单词的前两三个字母在词典中检查拼写；查阅参考材料，包括初级词典，来核实和纠正拼写
evidence: Locate a word in a dictionary using its first two or three letters (e.g., find 'beautiful' by looking up 'be-')
Check and correct a misspelling by comparing with the dictionary entry (e.g., look up 'freind' → 'friend')
Use a glossary or beginning dictionary to confirm spelling of a word used in own writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 不确定某个单词怎么拼，他们能利用前两三个字母快速在词典中查到它吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 源自希腊语、法语和拉丁语的拼写
topics.description: 拼写带有希腊语（ch 发 /k/ 音）、法语（ch 发 /ʃ/ 音、-gue、-que）和拉丁语（sc 发 /s/ 音）词源字母组合的单词
evidence: Spell words with Greek ch such as 'scheme', 'chorus', 'chemist', 'echo' and explain the /k/ sound pattern
Spell words with French ch such as 'chef', 'chalet', 'machine' and -gue/-que endings like 'league', 'unique'
Spell words with Latin sc such as 'science', 'scene', 'discipline' and identify the silent letter pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否知道有些单词的字母组合来自其他语言——比如 "school" 或 "chorus" 中的 "ch" 发 "k" 音——并且能正确拼写这些单词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 进阶拼写规则
topics.description: 运用五年级至六年级的多种拼写规则拼写单词：-fer 结尾且重音不变时双写辅音（referring 但 reference）、用连字符连接前缀与词根（co-ordinate、re-enter）、c 之后发 /iː/ 音的 ei 拼写（receive、ceiling），以及字母组合 ough 表示不同发音（though、through、thought、thorough、plough）
evidence: Apply the -fer doubling rule: double the r when the syllable is stressed (referring, preferred, transferred) but not when stress shifts (reference, preference)
Use hyphens correctly when a prefix ends with the same letter the root begins with (re-enter, co-own) or to avoid ambiguity (re-cover vs recover)
Read and spell words containing ough by recognising its multiple pronunciations: /oʊ/ (though), /uː/ (through), /ɔː/ (thought), /ʌf/ (rough), /aʊ/ (plough)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否正确拼写 "receive"、"though" 或 "co-ordinate" 这类难词，包括知道何时使用连字符或 "c" 之后的 "-ei" 组合？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 同音异形词（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 区分并正确拼写五年级至六年级水平的同音异形词和易混淆词（如 affect/effect、practice/practise、advice/advise、complement/compliment、aisle/isle、led/lead），包括 to/too/two 和 there/their/they're 等易混词
evidence: Select the correct spelling from a pair of homophones by analysing meaning in context, e.g. 'The doctor's advice (noun) was to practise (verb) daily'
Spell commonly confused words accurately by applying word-class clues: advise/advice, practise/practice, licence/license (verb ends in -ise, noun ends in -ice)
Identify and correct homophone errors in extended writing, including to/too/two, there/their/they're, whose/who's, and its/it's
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写作时，能否为容易混淆的单词选对拼写——比如 "affect" 与 "effect"、"practice" 与 "practise"，或 "there"、"their" 和 "they're"？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 单词中的不发音字母
topics.description: 拼写含有不发音字母的单词，这些字母是早期发音或词源的遗留；识别常见的不发音字母规律，并利用词源帮助记忆
evidence: Identify and spell words with silent initial consonants: knight, know, write, wrap, gnaw, psalm, applying knowledge that these letters were once pronounced
Spell words with silent internal letters: doubt (b), island (s), muscle (c), solemn (n), using etymological connections to aid memory (e.g. doubt from Latin dubitare)
Use word families and etymology to remember silent letters, e.g. sign is related to signal where the g is pronounced
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写含有不发音字母的单词时——比如 "knight"、"wrap" 或 "lamb"——能否记得写上那个听不到的字母？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: -able 与 -ible 的拼写
topics.description: 拼写以 -able/-ible 结尾的单词及对应的副词形式 -ably/-ibly，根据词根运用规律判断该用哪个后缀
evidence: Apply the guideline that -able is typically used with complete root words (enjoyable, comfortable) while -ible is used with incomplete roots (visible, possible), noting key exceptions
Convert -able/-ible adjectives into adverbs by changing the ending to -ably/-ibly, e.g. comfortable → comfortably, possible → possibly, terrible → terribly
Determine whether to drop or retain the final -e of the root when adding -able, e.g. adorable (drop e) vs changeable (keep e before soft g)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 需要拼写以 "-able" 或 "-ible" 结尾的单词时——比如 "comfortable" 或 "visible"——能否选对词尾并正确拼写？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 拼写词表（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 拼写五年级和六年级法定词表中的单词，包括拼写规律不规则或不常见、需要逐个记忆的单词
evidence: Spell high-frequency words from the Y5-6 list accurately in dictated sentences, e.g. accommodate, committee, correspond, exaggerate, immediately, necessary
Use look-cover-write-check and mnemonic strategies to learn words with tricky patterns such as 'separate' (a rat in separate), 'rhythm' (rhythm helps your two hips move)
Identify and self-correct misspellings of statutory list words when proof-reading extended writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写作时能否凭记忆拼写出学校五、六年级词表中的挑战性单词——比如 "accommodate"、"conscience" 或 "prejudice"？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 后缀（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 拼写带有拉丁语和法语后缀规律的单词：发 /ʃəs/ 音的结尾拼作 -cious 或 -tious（如 precious、cautious），发 /ʃəl/ 音的结尾拼作 -cial 或 -tial（如 official、essential），以及以 -ant/-ance/-ancy 与 -ent/-ence/-ency 结尾的单词（如 observant/observance、confident/confidence）
evidence: Apply the pattern that -cious follows a vowel (spacious, gracious) while -tious follows a consonant (cautious, ambitious), noting common exceptions like anxious
Choose between -cial (usually after a vowel: special, official) and -tial (usually after a consonant: essential, partial) when spelling words with the /ʃəl/ ending
Select -ant/-ance or -ent/-ence by checking whether the root ends in a hard c or g sound (-ant: significant) or a soft c or g sound (-ent: innocent), and by applying word-family strategies
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否正确拼写以 "-cious"、"-tious" 或 "-cial" 等难词尾结尾的单词——例如 "precious"、"cautious" 或 "official"——而不出错？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 将拼写规则运用于复杂单词
topics.description: 正确且一致地拼写，将关键阶段 1-2 的拼写规律和规则运用于关键阶段 3 阅读和学科学习中遇到的日益复杂的词汇
evidence: Spell subject-specific vocabulary correctly when encountered in new domains (e.g., 'parliament', 'photosynthesis', 'algorithm')
Apply known spelling rules and etymological patterns to unfamiliar words
Use proofreading strategies to identify and correct spelling errors in own extended writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 在中学写更长、更复杂的单词时——比如科学或历史中的学科词汇——能否正确拼写而无需每次检查？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 讨论与提问新词
topics.description: 针对文本中不认识的词提问并回答；讨论词义，把新词汇与已认识的词联系起来
evidence: Ask 'What does ___ mean?' when meeting unfamiliar words during reading
Use context and pictures to work out what a new word might mean
Explain a new word by connecting it to a known word (e.g. 'enormous means really really big')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在书里遇到不认识的词时，会试着根据上下文的其他词推断它的意思，并把它和已经认识的词联系起来吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词义的细微差别
topics.description: 区分描述相似动作的动词之间、以及程度不同的形容词之间的词义差别；把词语和它们的用法与真实生活联系起来
evidence: Compare similar verbs by acting them out (e.g. 'walk', 'march', 'strut', 'prance')
Order adjectives by intensity (e.g. big, huge, gigantic)
Connect vocabulary to personal experiences (e.g. note things at school that are 'colourful')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能注意到相似词语之间的差别吗？比如知道“scorching”比“warm”程度更强，或者“trotted”和“sprinted”不一样？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词语分类与归类
topics.description: 把常见物品和词语按类别归类，理解概念之间的关系；表现出对常见动词和形容词反义词的理解
evidence: Group words or objects by category (e.g. animals, foods, colours)
Identify and produce opposite pairs (e.g. 'big/small', 'hot/cold', 'go/stop')
Explain why items belong together in a category
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把一组词按类别归类吗？比如把水果和蔬菜分开，并说出“hot”或“fast”这类常见词的反义词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 运用新词汇
topics.description: 在对话、听读和回应文本中习得词语和短语，并运用到自己的口语和写作中
evidence: Incorporate new vocabulary from read-alouds into conversations
Attempt to use interesting or topic-specific words in own writing
Use newly learned words appropriately in different contexts
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 从书里或对话中学到一个新词时，会试着自己在写作或说话时用出来吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词缀作为线索
topics.description: 利用常见词形变化和词缀（-ed、-s、un-、-er）作为线索推断生词的意思；理解前缀 un- 如何改变词义
evidence: Recognise that -ed signals past tense (e.g. 'jumped' = already happened)
Explain how un- makes a word mean the opposite (e.g. 'unhappy' = not happy)
Use word parts to figure out the meaning of an unfamiliar word
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到“unhelpful”或“jumped”这样不熟悉的词，能利用词的开头或结尾推断出它的意思吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 给词语下定义
topics.description: 按类别和一个或多个关键特征给词语下定义（如“鸭子是会游泳的鸟”），把词语和它们的用法与真实生活联系起来
evidence: Define 'tiger' as 'a large cat with stripes' — naming category and key attribute
Connect the word 'cozy' to real-life examples: places at home that feel cozy
Sort words into categories and explain why each word belongs
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能通过说明一个词属于哪类事物、有什么特别之处来解释它的意思吗？比如“企鹅是不会飞但很会游泳的鸟”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词根与词形变化
topics.description: 识别常见词根及其词形变化形式（如 look/looks/looked/looking），利用词缀作为推断词义的线索，理解后缀如何构成名词和形容词
evidence: Identify 'play' as the root in 'played', 'playing', 'player'
Explain that '-ful' in 'careful' means 'full of care'
Use '-ness' and '-er' to form nouns from root words: 'sad → sadness', 'teach → teacher'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到“play”“plays”“played”和“playing”这些词时，能理解它们都来自同一个词根，并正确使用每种形式吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 正式与非正式英语
topics.description: 识别并比较英语的正式与非正式用法，理解语言选择会因对象、目的和情境而不同
evidence: Identify whether a spoken or written example uses formal or informal language (e.g., 'Dear Sir' vs 'Hey mate')
Rewrite an informal sentence in a more formal way (e.g., change 'Can I have some?' to 'May I please have some?')
Explain why formal language might be used in one situation and informal in another (e.g., a letter to the headteacher vs a note to a friend)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能理解给朋友发消息和写正式信件在写法上的区别吗？能解释为什么语言会不一样吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词族与词根
topics.description: 探索基于共同词根的词族，理解单词如何通过共同的词根、前缀和后缀在形式和含义上产生关联（例如 solve → solution、solver、dissolve、insoluble）
evidence: Generate at least 4 words in a word family from a given root (e.g., from 'play': player, playful, replay, playground)
Explain how members of a word family are connected in meaning (e.g., 'solve, solution, dissolve all relate to finding answers or breaking apart')
Use knowledge of a word family to predict the meaning of an unfamiliar member (e.g., knowing 'act' helps understand 'actor', 'action', 'react')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 认识“cycle”这个词，他们能通过思考共同的词根，推断出“recycle”“bicycle”或“cyclist”等相关词的含义吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 字面语言与比喻语言
topics.description: 在语境中区分字面语言与非字面（比喻）语言，并理解常见习语和短语的含义
evidence: Identify whether 'It's raining cats and dogs' is literal or nonliteral and explain what it means
Read a passage and circle three phrases used nonliterally, restating each in literal terms
Explain the difference between 'She was on fire' (figurative — performing well) and 'The log was on fire' (literal)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到“it's raining cats and dogs”或“she had butterflies in her stomach”这样的短语时，他们知道它并不是字面上所说的意思吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 反义词与同义词
topics.description: 通过将单词与其反义词（意思相反的词）和同义词（意思相近的词）联系起来，展示对词语的理解，运用同义词和反义词关系来丰富词汇，提升写作的精准度
evidence: Generate synonyms and antonyms for given words and explain subtle differences between synonyms, e.g. happy/joyful/ecstatic differ in intensity
Use a thesaurus to find synonyms and select the most precise word for a given context, e.g. choosing 'sprinted' rather than 'ran' to convey speed
Replace overused words in writing with more precise synonyms and explain how the substitution changes the tone or emphasis
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写作时，他们能把基础词换成更精准的词吗——比如把“happy”换成“elated”，或把“said”换成“whispered”——让意思更清楚？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨学科领域词汇
topics.description: 准确习得并使用与年级主题相关的学术词汇和领域特定词汇，包括在各学科信息类文本中表示精确含义的词语
evidence: Identify and define academic vocabulary (e.g., compare, contrast, summarise, evidence, interpret) used across multiple subject areas and use these words accurately in discussion and writing
Determine the meaning of domain-specific words encountered in science, social studies, or maths texts (e.g., ecosystem, democracy, numerator) using context, glossaries, and prior knowledge
Use newly acquired academic and domain-specific vocabulary in sentences that demonstrate understanding of precise meaning and appropriate context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 学习科学或历史主题时，他们能掌握并正确使用该学科的特定词汇吗——比如“erosion”“parliament”或“habitat”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 希腊语和拉丁语词根与词义
topics.description: 运用希腊语和拉丁语词缀（前缀和后缀）及词根的知识作为线索，判断不熟悉单词的含义，积累常见词根及其含义
evidence: Identify common Greek and Latin roots in unfamiliar words and use root meaning to infer word meaning, e.g. 'aqua' (water) in aquarium/aquatic, 'dict' (say) in predict/dictionary
Break a multi-morpheme word into prefix + root + suffix to determine meaning, e.g. un- (not) + believe + -able = not able to be believed
Use knowledge of Greek-origin prefixes (auto-, tele-, micro-) and Latin-origin prefixes (inter-, trans-, sub-) to decode and define unfamiliar vocabulary in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 遇到一个含有他们认识的希腊语或拉丁语词根的不熟悉单词——比如“transport”中的“port”或“biology”中的“bio”——他们能借助这个词根推断出含义吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 习语与谚语
topics.description: 识别并理解常见习语（break the ice、hit the nail on the head）、格言（actions speak louder than words）和谚语（a stitch in time saves nine），理解它们的比喻含义以及何时使用
evidence: Explain the figurative meaning of common idioms encountered in texts, e.g. 'let the cat out of the bag' means to reveal a secret, not literally releasing a cat
Interpret the meaning and intended lesson of adages and proverbs, e.g. explain that 'the early bird catches the worm' advises that acting promptly gives an advantage
Use context clues to determine the meaning of an unfamiliar idiom or proverb encountered during reading and verify using a reference source
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听到“don't judge a book by its cover”或“the early bird catches the worm”这样的说法，他们知道它真正的意思以及什么时候会用吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 明喻与暗喻
topics.description: 理解并识别文本中的明喻（用 like 或 as 进行比较）和暗喻（直接说某物是另一物的比较），解释它们如何营造意象并传达含义
evidence: Identify similes in a text by locating comparisons using 'like' or 'as' and explain what two things are being compared and what quality is highlighted, e.g. 'The snow was like a white blanket'
Identify metaphors in a text and explain the implied comparison, e.g. in 'Time is a thief', explain that time is compared to a thief because it takes things away
Explain how a simile or metaphor in a poem or story creates a particular image or feeling for the reader that a literal description would not achieve
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到“the moon was a silver coin”或“her smile was like sunshine”这样的描写时，他们能解释作者想营造什么画面吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 选择正式词汇
topics.description: 区分正式与非正式词汇，为正式口语和写作选择合适的词，比如用“discover”而不是“find out”，用“request”而不是“ask for”
evidence: Replace informal words with formal equivalents in a given text
Identify formal vocabulary choices in official letters and reports
Write the same message twice using formal vocabulary for a letter and informal vocabulary for a text message
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写正式内容时——比如一封信或一份报告——他们会选择更讲究的词吗，比如用“enquire”而不是“ask”，或用“sufficient”而不是“enough”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 方言与语域
topics.description: 比较和对比故事、戏剧或诗歌中使用的各种英语变体，包括方言和语域，理解语言如何因地区、语境和目的而不同
evidence: Identify dialect features in character dialogue and explain their effect
Compare formal and informal registers in different types of texts
Explain how an author uses language variety to develop character or setting
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到故事中角色使用方言或老式语言说话时，他们能理解并解释这和我们今天的说话方式有什么不同吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 使用同义词词典选词
topics.description: 使用同义词词典查找同义词并拓展词汇选择，根据语境、内涵和语域选出最合适的词
evidence: Use a thesaurus to find three alternatives for overused words in own writing
Select the most appropriate synonym from thesaurus options based on context and tone
Explain why one synonym is more suitable than another for a specific sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在写作时想找一个比最初想到的更好的词，他们能使用同义词词典并选出适合语境的同义词——而不只是随便找一个意思相近的词吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 学术词汇
topics.description: 准确习得并使用广泛的通用学术词汇和领域特定词汇——从阅读和倾听中获取新词汇，并在写作和口语中有意识地运用，以达到特定效果
evidence: Use academic vocabulary (e.g., analyse, evaluate, justify, convey, imply) accurately and appropriately in essay writing
Incorporate domain-specific terms from a subject studied (e.g., 'photosynthesis', 'legislature') into explanatory writing
Draw a new word or phrase from a text read and use it consciously in own writing or speech
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 会从书本和课堂中吸收新词，并真正用到自己的写作和对话中吗——而不只是在别人使用时能听懂？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 进阶修辞语言
topics.description: 理解和解读修辞语言、词语关系和词义细微差别——包括典故、反讽、双关、矛盾修辞和延伸隐喻——并在分析或选词时区分内涵义和外延义
evidence: Explain the connotative difference between words with similar denotations (e.g., thrifty vs. stingy vs. economical)
Identify irony or an allusion in a text and explain what it adds to the meaning
Analyse an extended metaphor across a paragraph or poem and explain how it develops an idea
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 读到一首诗或一部小说，作者使用了反讽、双关或出人意料的比喻时，他们能解释这产生了什么效果以及作者为什么选择这些词吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词汇策略
topics.description: 运用灵活多样的策略确定生词和多义词及短语的含义——包括上下文线索、希腊语和拉丁语词缀与词根、参考资料，以及对推断含义的验证
evidence: Use context clues (the overall meaning of a sentence, a word’s position or function) to infer the meaning of an unfamiliar word
Break down a word using known Greek or Latin roots and affixes to deduce its meaning (e.g., 'malevolent' = mal- (bad) + volent (wishing))
Look up a word in a dictionary to verify or refine an inferred meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在书或文章中遇到不熟悉的词时，他们能通过上下文线索、词根或词典推断出它的意思——然后再检查自己的猜测是否正确吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 回应写作反馈
topics.description: 在老师指导下，大声重读自己的作品，检查读起来是否通顺；倾听并回应老师或同伴的问题和建议，以补充细节、澄清意思、加强写作——这是写作自我评价的支架式起点，而非独立技能
evidence: Reread own writing and spot a missing word or unclear sentence
Add a detail in response to a question (e.g. 'Can you tell me more about...?')
Make at least one improvement to a piece based on feedback
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 的老师让他们大声读出自己的作品，然后问“这一段说得通吗？”，{{name}} 能听取反馈并做简单的修改来改进吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写前先说句子
topics.description: 大声说出将要写的内容；在写下来之前先口头组织句子，为独立写作做准备
evidence: Say a complete sentence aloud before attempting to write it
Rehearse a sentence orally more than once to hold it in memory
Practise sentences with a partner before writing independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 开始写一个句子之前，他们会先大声说出来——试试听起来怎么样——然后再动笔吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 合作研究项目
topics.description: 参与合作研究和写作项目；回忆经历中的信息或从资料中收集信息来回答一个问题
evidence: Contribute ideas and information to a class writing project
Draw or write facts learned from personal experience about a topic
Help gather information from books or adults for a group research task
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 接到一个需要了解某事物的写作项目——比如某种动物或某个地方——他们能查找信息并用找到的内容来写这个主题吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 分享与发表你的作品
topics.description: 大声朗读自己的作品，声音清晰到同伴和老师都能听见；使用数字工具创作并发表作品
evidence: Read own sentences aloud with clear voice and appropriate expression
Share a piece of writing by reading it to the class
Type simple words or sentences using a computer or tablet
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能向全班大声朗读自己的作品，声音清晰到每个人都能听见并跟上吗？他们是否用电脑或平板电脑打过字或发表过作品？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 有开头和结尾的简单故事
topics.description: 通过排列句子顺序来描述事件，写出简单的记叙文；讲述单个事件或相关联的事件，包含开头、中间和结尾或反应
evidence: Write a short story with at least three sequenced sentences
Use time words like 'first', 'then', 'next' to order events
Include a reaction or ending to a narrative (e.g. 'I felt happy')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能写一个关于某件事的短故事——有清晰的开头、中间和结尾——让不在场的人也能跟上发生了什么、按什么顺序发生的吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写观点
topics.description: 通过画画、口述或写作来创作观点类作品，点明一个话题或一本书，并表达对它的偏好或观点
evidence: State an opinion clearly (e.g. 'My favourite animal is a dog because...')
Give at least one reason for an opinion
Draw, dictate, or write to express a preference about a book or topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能写一两句话表达自己对某件事的看法——比如最喜欢的书或食物——并解释为什么这样想吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作过程词汇
topics.description: 认识并使用写作过程的词汇——创作、构思、打草稿、修改、编辑、校对、体裁、读者、目的、记叙文、叙述、说明、段落、顺序和细节——并理解这些词描述的是所有写作者都会经历的不同步骤和决定，而不只是打勾完成的任务
evidence: Use 'compose', 'revise', and 'edit' correctly when describing the stages of writing
Explain who the 'audience' is for a piece of writing and how that changes what they write
Describe the purpose of a piece of writing (to persuade, inform, entertain, or instruct) and match their language to it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 解释他们在学校写故事时在做什么，他们能用“构思”“打草稿”“修改”这样的词带你走一遍每个步骤吗——表明他们理解这是一个过程，而不只是一次写完？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写说明性文章
topics.description: 通过画画、口述或写作来创作说明性或解释性文章，点明一个话题并提供一些相关信息
evidence: Write or dictate two or three facts about a familiar topic
Label diagrams or drawings with informative details
Name a topic and provide relevant details about it
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能写几句话解释自己知道的某件事——比如蝴蝶怎么长大或怎么做一个三明治——点明话题并分享一些事实吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 基础说明文写作
topics.description: 创作说明性或解释性文章，介绍一个话题，用事实和定义展开要点，并提供结尾陈述或段落
evidence: Write an informative text that introduces a topic clearly and groups related information together
Use facts, definitions, and concrete details to develop and explain points about the topic
Provide a concluding statement or section that wraps up the information presented
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能写一篇解释性或说明性文章——比如“火山是如何工作的”——清楚地介绍话题，用事实和定义展开，并以结论收尾吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 培养写作耐力
topics.description: 写真实事件并针对不同目的写作，培养在记叙文之外多种体裁中持续写作的耐力（如叙述、信件、说明）
evidence: Write a recount of a school trip using temporal connectives (first, then, after that)
Write a simple set of instructions with numbered steps
Sustain writing for an extended period across a full page without stopping
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能为不同目的用不同风格写作吗——比如写一篇学校旅行的叙述、一封给朋友的信，或一套游戏说明？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作前构思想法
topics.description: 写作前先构思：大声说出或记下要写的内容，写下想法和关键词，并在动笔前逐句概括想法
evidence: Verbally rehearse sentences before writing them down
Jot key words or ideas in a planning format (e.g., story map) before drafting
Write a simple plan with beginning, middle, and end for a story
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 开始写一篇作品前，会花几分钟构思——记下想法、关键词或大致结构——而不是直接跳到写第一句吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修改与校对
topics.description: 校对自己的作文，检查拼写、语法和标点错误；在老师或同伴的帮助下评价并修改作文，通过重读确保意思清楚、时态一致
evidence: Re-read own writing and spot a missing full stop or capital letter
Identify and correct a tense inconsistency in a piece of writing
Discuss improvements with a partner and make at least one revision to strengthen the writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 完成一篇作文后，会不会自己检查拼写错误、漏掉的标点和语法问题，并在交上来之前改正？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 结构化的观点写作
topics.description: 写观点类文章，引出话题，表明清晰的观点，用连接词组织理由，并写出结尾句或结尾段
evidence: Write an opinion piece that introduces the topic, states a clear opinion, and provides at least two reasons
Use linking words (because, and, also, for example) to connect the opinion to supporting reasons
End an opinion piece with a concluding statement that restates or reinforces the opinion
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能写一篇有说服力的文章——比如争取更长的午休时间，或者说说为什么养狗比养猫好——观点明确、理由有条理，还有结尾？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写诗
topics.description: 写诗，探索语言的韵律、押韵和节奏，并背诵诗歌，用恰当的语气朗诵
evidence: Write a simple poem using rhyming couplets or a repeated pattern
Recite a poem from memory with expression and appropriate intonation
Identify rhyme and rhythm patterns in poems read aloud
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 有没有尝试写过诗——玩押韵、节奏或重复的句式——能不能有感情地朗诵一首自己学过或写过的诗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 记叙文写作
topics.description: 写记叙文，展开背景、人物和情节，用对话和描写来丰富经历，展现人物对情境的反应
evidence: Write a narrative that includes a described setting, at least one developed character, and a clear plot with a problem and resolution
Use dialogue to show what characters say and reveal their personality or feelings
Use descriptive details and temporal words to organise events into a clear sequence with a satisfying ending
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写故事时，会不会通过描写背景、刻画人物细节和加入一些对话让故事生动起来，而不是只罗列发生了什么？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 按段落组织写作
topics.description: 把文章分成段落，围绕一个主题把相关内容归在一起，并在非记叙类写作中使用标题和小标题等简单的组织方式
evidence: Divide a piece of writing into paragraphs, each focused on one main idea or aspect of the topic
Use headings and sub-headings to organise a non-fiction text (e.g., a report about animals with sections 'Habitat', 'Diet', 'Appearance')
Identify where a new paragraph should begin in a given text and explain why (e.g., 'A new paragraph starts here because the topic changes from appearance to diet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写较长的文章时——比如报告或故事——会不会分段，把相关的想法归在一起，并在合适的地方加上标题帮助读者阅读？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 口头练习与变换句式
topics.description: 写之前先口头组织并练习句子，逐步积累丰富多样的词汇，尝试越来越多样的句式，包括对话
evidence: Rehearse a sentence containing dialogue aloud before writing it (e.g. 'Let's go!' shouted Tom)
Orally compose sentences with varied openers (e.g. time adverbials, subordinate clauses) before writing
Try out two or three different ways to express the same idea orally and choose the most effective version to write
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写句子之前会不会先大声说出来——尝试不同的词语和句式，找到听起来最好的版本？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修改与校对（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过评估写作效果来评价和修改作文，提出语法和词汇上的修改以保持一致，并按 3-4 年级水平校对拼写、语法和标点错误
evidence: Read own or a peer's writing aloud and suggest specific improvements to vocabulary or sentence structure
Propose changes to grammar and word choice to improve clarity and consistency across a piece of writing
Proof-read writing at Y3-4 level for spelling, punctuation, and grammatical errors and correct them independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 回头修改作文草稿时，能不能改进它——把用词改得更准确、修正不一致的时态、改正拼写和标点错误？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修改与校对（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 批判性地、独立地重读自己的作文——发现意思不清楚的地方、可以用更有力词语的地方，或者读者可能困惑的地方；不需要老师提示就能自己修改，用自己的判断决定哪里好、哪里不好
evidence: Reread a paragraph silently and independently identify at least one place where meaning could be clearer or a word choice improved
Make a revision that goes beyond spelling/punctuation — changing a sentence for clarity or effect
Explain in their own words why they changed something ('I thought the reader wouldn't understand what I meant')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能重读自己写的东西——一个故事、一份报告、一封信——自己发现哪里不太对或者可以写得更好，不需要你或老师指出来？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 简短研究项目
topics.description: 开展简短的研究项目，围绕一个主题积累知识，从纸质和数字资源中收集信息，并做简要有条理的笔记
evidence: Generate three research questions about an assigned topic and identify two sources for each
Take brief notes from a print source, sorting key facts into provided categories
Write a short summary paragraph synthesising information gathered from two different sources
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在学校拿到一个研究项目时，他们能从书本或网站上查找信息、做有条理的笔记，然后用自己的话写出来吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 生动的用词选择
topics.description: 选择准确而生动的词语和短语，在写作中营造特定的效果
evidence: Replace vague words in 'The nice man went to the big house' with more precise alternatives and explain the effect
Write two versions of the same scene — one with plain language and one with carefully chosen words for suspense or humour
Select from a word bank the most effective verb and adjective for a given sentence, justifying each choice
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写描写性或创意作品时，他们会选择有趣而准确的词——比如用“sprinted”而不是“ran”，用“crimson”而不是“red”——来营造特定效果吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作技巧词汇
topics.description: 认识并运用写作技巧与效果的词汇——形式、结构、语域、语气、声音、连贯性、衔接、论点、证据、视角、修辞、手法、正式、非正式和风格——并理解这些词描述的是写作者为对读者产生特定效果而有意做出的选择
evidence: Explain the difference between 'formal register' and 'informal register' and give an example of when each is appropriate
Use terms like 'coherence', 'cohesion', and 'paragraph structure' accurately when discussing or improving their own writing
Identify the 'purpose', 'audience', and 'form' of a piece of writing and explain how these shape the language choices
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要写一封说服信，和写一个故事相比，他们能解释“语气”和“语域”上的区别吗——以及为什么两者会选用不同的词语？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 为读者选择形式与语气
topics.description: 动笔前先明确写作的读者和目的，选择合适的形式、语气和语域，以匹配目标读者和沟通目标
evidence: Determine the audience (e.g., peers, teacher, younger children, a public audience) and purpose (to persuade, inform, entertain, or explain) before drafting and explain how these choices affect language and structure
Select an appropriate form for the writing task (letter, report, story, instructions, review) based on audience and purpose
Adjust vocabulary, sentence length, and level of formality to suit the identified audience, e.g. using simpler language for younger readers and more formal language for an official letter
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 开始写一篇东西之前，他们会想一想谁会读、为什么读——并据此调整语气、词汇和格式，比如写给老师比写给朋友更正式吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 基于证据的写作
topics.description: 从信息类文本中提取证据，支持写作中的分析、反思和研究，并将相应年级的阅读标准应用于非虚构作品
evidence: Write a research-based paragraph or short report that cites specific facts, details, and evidence from informational texts to support key points
Synthesise information from two informational sources into a written summary that accurately represents both, noting areas of agreement and difference
Paraphrase information from informational texts accurately and cite sources appropriately, avoiding plagiarism
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写一篇非虚构作品——比如一份关于气候变化的报告——他们会引用读过的具体事实和证据，把这些信息融入自己的写作中吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作中的文学证据
topics.description: 从文学文本中提取证据，支持写作中的分析、反思和研究，并将相应年级的阅读标准应用于文学作品
evidence: Write a response to a literary text that includes direct quotations and specific details from the text as evidence to support a claim or observation
Explain how a character's actions or dialogue reveal their traits or motivations, citing specific passages from the story as evidence
Compare how two literary texts treat a similar theme, using textual evidence from both to support the comparison
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写关于读过的书——比如一篇关于人物或主题的文章——他们会用直接来自文本的具体引文或细节来支持自己的观点吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 面向读者写作
topics.description: 写出清晰连贯的作品，其展开和组织方式适合任务、目的和读者，并始终保持一致的风格和结构
evidence: Identify the task, purpose, and audience before writing and make deliberate choices about structure, tone, and vocabulary to suit them
Organise ideas logically so that the writing flows from introduction through development to conclusion, with each section serving a clear purpose
Review a draft to check that the organisation, style, and level of formality are consistent and appropriate for the intended reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 为学校写作时，这篇作品是否组织得当、符合其目的——无论是正式文章、创意故事还是说服性论证——并且通篇语气一致？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 信息类写作中的版式与格式
topics.description: 使用标题、小标题、分栏、项目符号和表格等版式手段来组织文本，引导读者阅读信息类和说明类写作
evidence: Organise an informational text using headings and sub-headings to separate sections
Present comparative information using a table with clear row and column headers
Use columns and bullet points to display information in a scannable format
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写一篇非虚构作品——比如一份指南或一段说明——他们会使用标题、项目符号和分栏等版式特征，帮助读者轻松浏览信息吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 规划叙事写作
topics.description: 通过思考作者如何塑造人物和场景来规划叙事写作，借鉴从阅读、聆听或表演的文本中观察到的技巧
evidence: Identify specific authorial techniques for character development from a mentor text
Plan a character using techniques such as showing through action borrowed from a studied author
Analyse how an author builds setting and apply similar techniques in planning own narrative
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 准备写一个故事时，他们会在动笔前先想好主角是什么样的人、故事发生在哪里吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 研究与记笔记
topics.description: 从纸质和数字资源中收集相关信息，在笔记和最终作品中概括或转述信息，并提供基本的参考书目或来源列表
evidence: Take organised notes from multiple sources using own words rather than copying
Create a bibliography listing sources used in a research project
Paraphrase key information from a source without changing the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在为学校项目研究一个主题，他们能从书本或网站上找到信息，用自己的话写出来，并记录信息来源吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 撰写摘要
topics.description: 通过简洁地概括主要观点和关键信息来压缩较长的段落，同时保留核心含义并去除非必要的细节
evidence: Reduce a three-paragraph text to a single paragraph capturing all main points
Identify and remove redundant information while preserving essential meaning
Write a precis that is no more than one-third the length of the original text
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读了一篇关于所学主题的长文章，他们能用自己的话写一段简短的摘要，抓住要点而不照抄句子吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 全文的衔接与过渡
topics.description: 使用多样的过渡词、衔接手段和段落连接策略，使整篇文章连贯统一——包括时间过渡、因果连接词，以及标示论点、时间或场景转换的技巧
evidence: Use a range of causal and logical connectives (consequently, nevertheless, as a result) appropriately across a discursive essay
Signal a shift in time or setting within a narrative using a transitional phrase or paragraph break
Link paragraphs using a cohesive device such as a topic sentence that refers back to the previous paragraph
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写好几段文字时，他们会使用“然而”“因此”或“另一方面”等连接短语，让各部分之间的观点顺畅衔接吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 充分展开的说明性与解释性写作
topics.description: 撰写说明性和解释性文本，探讨一个主题并清晰地传达观点——用标题和格式有条理地组织信息，用相关的事实、定义、细节和引文展开主题，并使用准确的词汇
evidence: Organise an explanatory essay with a clear introduction, logical body paragraphs, and a conclusion
Develop a topic using well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, and quotations from sources
Use domain-specific vocabulary and formatting (headings, graphics) to aid the reader's comprehension
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能清楚地解释某件事是如何运作的吗——比如火山如何喷发或面包如何制作——让从未学过这方面知识的人也能看懂？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 说服性写作
topics.description: 撰写论证来支持主张，用清晰的理由和相关证据——包括提出主张、承认对立观点、有条理地组织理由、保持正式风格，并提供结论性陈述
evidence: Write an argument essay with a clear claim supported by at least three pieces of evidence
Acknowledge and respond to a counterclaim rather than ignoring opposing views
Use linking words and phrases (however, furthermore, consequently) to connect claims, reasons, and evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想说服你让他们晚点睡，他们能写下清晰的理由和例子来支持自己的观点，而不只是说“因为我想”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 规划、修改与编辑写作
topics.description: 规划、修改和编辑写作，以提高连贯性和表达效果——考虑写作如何体现目标读者和目的，调整词汇、语法和结构，并校对拼写、标点和语法的准确性
evidence: Revise a draft to improve paragraph structure, adding or removing material for coherence
Edit sentence-level issues including word choice, grammar, and punctuation before finalising
Reflect on whether the writing achieves its intended effect on the target audience and adjust accordingly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写完初稿后，会回头做实质性的改进吗——不只是改拼写，而是调整句子或重新组织观点，让文章更好？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 研究与来源评估
topics.description: 概括并整理阅读和研究所得的材料——从多个来源收集相关信息，评估可信度，在不抄袭的前提下整合证据，并用事实细节支撑观点
evidence: Take notes from multiple sources on a topic and organise them under logical headings
Paraphrase information from a source accurately without copying word-for-word
Assess whether a source is credible and relevant before including it in research writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在准备学校项目，他们能从多个来源收集笔记，并在开始写作前把它们整理成合理的顺序吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨文体写作
topics.description: 为叙事以外的多种目的和读者写作——包括剧本、诗歌、私人信件和正式信件、演讲笔记及其他形式——为每种形式选择合适的体裁、语域和规范
evidence: Write a formal letter using appropriate layout, salutation, register, and sign-off conventions
Compose a script with stage directions, character names, and realistic dialogue
Adapt writing style (vocabulary, sentence structure, tone) to suit different audiences and purposes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能根据任务写出不同风格的文章吗——比如一封说服信、一份操作说明或一篇日记——并让每一篇都读起来得体合适？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人物与对话写作
topics.description: 运用有效的写作技巧创作叙事，展开真实或想象的经历——包括交代背景和视角，通过对话、节奏和描写塑造人物，使用多样的过渡，并给出有反思的结尾
evidence: Open a narrative by establishing setting, point of view, and a hook that engages the reader
Use dialogue, pacing, and descriptive detail to develop characters and advance the plot
Craft a conclusion that reflects on the narrated events rather than simply ending the action
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 写故事时，会运用描写感受、制造悬念或呈现对话等技巧，让故事读起来更有趣吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 增强表达效果的写作技巧
topics.description: 把不断增长的词汇、语法和文本结构知识运用到写作中——借鉴阅读中遇到的文学与修辞手法（如反问、三叠式、首语重复、对比）来增强表达效果
evidence: Use a rhetorical question or tricolon deliberately in a persuasive piece and explain the intended effect
Employ varied sentence openings and structures to maintain reader interest across a whole piece
Draw on a literary device encountered in reading and apply it consciously in own writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 修改自己的文章时，会斟酌词序、句式或词汇，让文章更有力量或更清晰吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 发现图坦卡蒙陵墓
topics.description: 理解我们之所以了解古埃及，是因为考古学家挖掘并研究了埋在沙土中数千年的物品——而最激动人心的发现之一，是霍华德·卡特在 1922 年找到了隐藏的图坦卡蒙陵墓，里面装满了黄金宝藏
evidence: Explain that archaeologists find and study old objects to learn about people who lived long ago
Retell the story of Howard Carter discovering Tutankhamun's tomb
Understand that discoveries like this help us learn about how ancient Egyptians lived and what they believed
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看了一部关于霍华德·卡特打开满是黄金的陵墓的纪录片，他们能说出卡特是谁，以及他的发现为什么如此重要吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及神明与来世
topics.description: 理解古埃及人信仰许多神祇，并相信人死后会在美好的来世继续生活——所以他们精心处理遗体，并在陵墓中放满食物、珠宝和珍贵物品，供逝者在来世使用
evidence: Explain that ancient Egyptians worshipped many different gods and goddesses
Describe the basic belief that Egyptians thought life continued after death
Give a reason why tombs were filled with treasures and everyday objects
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 了解到埃及陵墓里放满了食物、游戏和黄金，他们能解释埃及人为什么要把这些东西放进去吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及、尼罗河与沙漠
topics.description: 在非洲地图上找到埃及，理解它是一个位于炎热干燥沙漠中的国家，但世界上最长的河流——尼罗河——流经这里，带来水和肥沃的土壤，让人们得以种植粮食，并建立起最早的伟大文明之一
evidence: Point to Egypt on a map and identify the River Nile running through it
Explain why the Nile was so important to the ancient Egyptians (water, food, transport)
Describe how the desert and the river created two very different environments side by side
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张沙漠中金字塔的图片，他们能说出金字塔在哪个国家，以及为什么一条河让人们得以在那里生活吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及人的日常生活
topics.description: 描述古埃及普通人的日常生活：农民在尼罗河附近种植小麦和大麦，家庭住在泥砖房里，孩子们玩游戏、养宠物，人们吃面包、鱼、水果和蔬菜
evidence: Describe at least two things ordinary Egyptian families did in their daily lives
Name foods that ancient Egyptians ate or crops they grew
Identify at least one similarity and one difference between life in ancient Egypt and life today
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 一个和他们同龄的孩子在古埃及的普通一天可能会做什么，他们能描述一些活动吗——比如玩游戏、帮忙干农活，或者吃面包和鱼？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 象形文字与纸莎草
topics.description: 知道古埃及人使用一种叫象形文字的特殊书写系统——代表声音和词语的图画与符号——并且他们写在一种叫纸莎草的类似纸张的材料上，这种材料由生长在尼罗河沿岸的植物制成
evidence: Describe hieroglyphs as a writing system that uses pictures and symbols
Explain that papyrus was a material like paper made from a river plant
Understand that only specially trained people called scribes could read and write hieroglyphs
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆的文物上看到象形文字，他们能告诉你那是什么，并说明埃及人写在一种叫纸莎草的特殊纸上吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 法老与图坦卡蒙
topics.description: 知道古埃及由被称为法老的强大国王和王后统治，他们住在宏伟的宫殿里并制定法律——最著名的法老之一是图坦卡蒙，他小时候就成为法老，他的黄金陵墓在数千年后被发现
evidence: Explain that a pharaoh was the ruler of ancient Egypt, like a king or queen
Name Tutankhamun as a famous pharaoh and describe at least one fact about him
Understand that pharaohs were very powerful and made important decisions for everyone in Egypt
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张埃及黄金面具的图片，能告诉你它属于一位叫图坦卡蒙的法老，并解释法老是什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 金字塔与狮身人面像
topics.description: 知道古埃及人建造了巨大的石头金字塔作为法老的陵墓，吉萨大金字塔是古代世界七大奇迹之一，至今仍然矗立，而大狮身人面像——一座狮身人面的雕像——守护着金字塔
evidence: Explain that pyramids were built as tombs to protect the pharaoh's body for the afterlife
Describe the Great Pyramid as very large, very old, and still standing at Giza
Describe the Sphinx as a stone statue with a lion's body and a human head
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到金字塔的照片，能告诉你它们为什么被建造，并描述旁边的狮身人面像吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 词汇：古埃及
topics.description: 认识并运用古埃及的关键词汇——法老、金字塔、陵墓、木乃伊/木乃伊制作、象形文字、纸莎草、石棺、卡诺匹斯罐、泡碱、考古学家、文物、尼罗河、三角洲、灌溉、沙杜夫、书吏、维齐尔、方尖碑、狮身人面像、王名圈——并在描述埃及社会、宗教和物质文化时准确使用这些术语
evidence: Use 'pharaoh', 'pyramid', and 'hieroglyphs' correctly and naturally in a spoken or written account of ancient Egypt
Explain what mummification is and why the Egyptians did it, using 'sarcophagus', 'canopic jar', and 'natron'
Use 'archaeologist' and 'artefact' correctly when discussing how we know about ancient Egypt
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 参观博物馆的古埃及展览，能读懂展签并向你解释法老是什么、为什么有金字塔、象形文字是什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 时间线上的古埃及
topics.description: 把古埃及放在跨越 3000 多年的时间线上——从约公元前 3100 年（第一位法老统一埃及）到公元前 30 年（被罗马征服）——理解这个文明存在的时间比从罗马时代到今天还要长，并分为几个主要时期：古王国（金字塔时代）、中王国和新王国（帝国时代）
evidence: Place ancient Egypt on a timeline showing it lasted over 3,000 years
Name the three main periods (Old, Middle, New Kingdom) and associate one fact with each
Compare the length of ancient Egyptian civilisation with another time period the child knows
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 古埃及人生活在什么时候、持续了多久，能解释那是数千年前，而且比大多数其他文明持续得更久吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 建造金字塔
