topics.description: 理解金字塔是如何建造的：成千上万的工人用斜坡、滚木和雪橇搬运巨大的石块，工程由法老的官员组织，设计从平顶的马斯塔巴发展到阶梯金字塔（如左塞尔金字塔），再到表面光滑的大金字塔——并知道后来的法老被葬在帝王谷隐蔽的岩凿陵墓中
evidence: Describe at least two methods used to move and raise heavy stone blocks
Explain that pyramid design changed over time from simple tombs to the Great Pyramid
Explain why later pharaohs chose hidden tombs in the Valley of the Kings instead of pyramids
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 好奇埃及人没有现代机器是怎么建造金字塔的，能描述一些使用的方法，并解释陵墓设计如何随时间变化吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及的神与女神
topics.description: 说出并描述埃及主要的神与女神：每天驾船穿越天空的太阳神拉、冥界统治者奥西里斯、魔法与母性女神伊西斯、胡狼头的木乃伊制作之神阿努比斯、隼头的天空之神荷鲁斯、朱鹭头的书写之神托特，以及猫头保护女神巴斯特
evidence: Name at least four Egyptian gods/goddesses and describe their roles
Explain why many gods were shown with animal heads and what the animals represented
Understand that Egyptians built temples as homes for the gods and performed daily rituals there
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一座胡狼头的埃及雕像，能告诉你它代表阿努比斯，并解释他是掌管什么的神吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及的社会等级
topics.description: 把古埃及的社会结构描述为金字塔形的等级：法老在最顶端，然后是祭司和贵族，接着是书吏和士兵，再是工匠和商人，最底层是农民和劳工——理解一个人的地位通常是继承的，并决定了其一生的生活方式
evidence: Draw or describe the social pyramid with at least four levels correctly ordered
Explain that most people were farmers and had very different lives from the pharaoh
Give an example of how social position affected someone's daily life (e.g., only scribes could read)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 被问到在古埃及谁更重要——书吏还是农民——能解释社会金字塔以及每个人处在什么位置吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及陵墓壁画与文物
topics.description: 把古埃及的陵墓壁画、文物和物品作为掌握证据来了解日常生活：内巴蒙的陵墓壁画展示了狩猎和宴饮，珠宝和家具展现了工艺水平，陶罐和工具等日常用品告诉我们普通人使用什么——理解这些资料是我们拼凑一个数千年前结束的文明信息的方式
evidence: Describe what can be learned about Egyptian life by studying a tomb painting or artefact
Explain that objects found in tombs and ruins are evidence that helps archaeologists understand the past
Give an example of something specific a painting or object reveals (e.g., what food they ate, what games they played)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一幅展示人们捕鱼和宴饮的古埃及壁画，能解释它告诉了我们埃及人是怎样生活的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 木乃伊制作步骤
topics.description: 描述木乃伊制作的逐步过程：清洗遗体，取出内脏放入卡诺匹斯罐，用泡碱盐干燥遗体 40 天，然后用亚麻绷带包裹，并在层间夹入护身符，最后放入装饰华丽的石棺
evidence: List the main steps of mummification in the correct order
Explain the purpose of canopic jars and what was stored in them
Describe why mummification was performed (to preserve the body for the afterlife)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 古埃及人如何制作木乃伊，他们能说出主要步骤吗——比如取出内脏、干燥遗体、用绷带包裹？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 书吏与罗塞塔石碑
topics.description: 知道书吏是经过专门训练、能读会写象形文字的人；罗塞塔石碑——一块刻有三种文字相同内容的石板——是破解象形文字密码的关键；让-弗朗索瓦·商博良在 1822 年用它破译了困扰人们数百年的象形文字
evidence: Explain the importance of scribes as the only people who could read and write
Describe the Rosetta Stone as having the same message in three different scripts
Name Champollion as the person who decoded hieroglyphs using the Rosetta Stone
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆看到罗塞塔石碑（或它的图片），他们能解释它为什么如此重要，以及它如何帮助我们读懂象形文字吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 上埃及与下埃及
topics.description: 理解古埃及分为上埃及（南部狭窄的河谷）和下埃及（北部宽阔的三角洲），两地统一在一位法老之下；埃及人通过灌溉渠和桔槔管理尼罗河的水，实现全年耕种
evidence: Identify Upper and Lower Egypt on a map and explain why they had different landscapes
Describe how irrigation tools like shadufs and canals helped farmers water their fields
Explain that uniting the two lands was an important achievement of the early pharaohs
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张显示尼罗河在靠近大海处分成多条支流的地图，他们能解释上埃及与下埃及的区别，以及农民如何利用河水吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及的深远遗产
topics.description: 评价古埃及的深远遗产：埃及人发展了早期医学、数学（用于建造金字塔和洪水后丈量土地）、天文学（基于星象观测的历法）和工程学，影响了包括古希腊与古罗马在内的后世文明；并将古埃及与其他早期文明（美索不达米亚、印度河流域、商朝）进行比较，找出文字、农业、城市和有组织宗教等共同特征
evidence: Name at least two Egyptian achievements that influenced later civilisations
Identify at least two features that ancient Egypt shared with other early civilisations
Explain why studying ancient Egypt helps us understand how human civilisation developed
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 古埃及人给世界留下了什么，他们能说出一些持久的成就，并解释埃及与其他古代文明相比如何吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 克利奥帕特拉与埃及的终结
topics.description: 知道古埃及最终走向终结：最后一位法老是克利奥帕特拉七世，她与罗马结盟，但在公元前 31 年被屋大维（后来的奥古斯都）击败，此后埃及成为罗马帝国的一个行省——结束了 3000 多年的法老统治，开启了埃及历史的新篇章
evidence: Name Cleopatra VII as the last pharaoh of ancient Egypt
Explain that Egypt was conquered by Rome and became part of the Roman Empire
Understand that the end of pharaonic rule did not mean the end of Egyptian culture
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 古埃及最后发生了什么，他们能讲讲克利奥帕特拉，以及埃及如何成为罗马帝国的一部分吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及艺术与建筑
topics.description: 分析埃及艺术与建筑：理解埃及绘画遵循严格的规范（人物侧面、眼睛正面，大小表示重要性）；陵墓和神庙设计从马斯塔巴发展到阶梯金字塔、平滑金字塔，再到阿布辛贝勒这样的岩凿神庙；方尖碑、巨型雕像和卡纳克神庙等展示了法老的权力和对神的虔诚
evidence: Identify at least two conventions used in Egyptian painting and explain their purpose
Describe how monument design changed over the course of Egyptian history
Explain why pharaohs built such enormous structures (power, religion, afterlife)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 注意到埃及绘画总是把人物画成奇怪的侧身姿势，他们能解释这是有意为之的艺术规则，并说明埃及人为什么这样画吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及时间线与地图
topics.description: 阅读并制作历史时间线——将古埃及各时期、法老和重大事件按彼此之间以及与今天的相对位置放在时间线上；解读显示尼罗河三角洲、贸易路线和重要遗址位置的地图
evidence: Place the Old, Middle, and New Kingdoms on a timeline and calculate the number of years between them
Read a map of ancient Egypt and identify the Nile, Memphis, Thebes, and the Valley of the Kings
Compare the age of Ancient Egypt on a timeline against other civilisations studied (e.g. Ancient Greece, Roman Britain)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一张古代历史时间线，他们能把古埃及各王国按正确顺序排列，并大致说出它们发生在多久以前——还能读地图找到底比斯等重要地点在哪里吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及贸易与经济
topics.description: 理解古埃及拥有繁荣的经济，建立在农业剩余、贸易和专业化劳动之上：尼罗河肥沃的土壤产出足够养活工匠、祭司和官员的粮食，埃及沿尼罗河并穿越地中海进行贸易——用黄金、纸莎草和谷物换取黎巴嫩的雪松木、阿富汗的青金石和蓬特的香料
evidence: Explain how agricultural surplus along the Nile allowed people to specialise in non-farming jobs
Name at least two goods Egypt exported and two it imported, and where they came from
Describe how the barter system worked and why trade routes were important to Egypt's wealth
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到埃及人用黄金换取黎巴嫩的雪松木，他们能解释埃及为什么需要与其他国家贸易，以及拥有剩余粮食如何使这成为可能吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 亡灵审判
topics.description: 描述埃及人对亡灵审判的信仰：人死后，心脏会在审判厅里与玛阿特的羽毛一起称量，阿努比斯负责看管天平，托特记录结果——心脏纯净的人可以进入芦苇原（天堂），心脏沉重的人则会被怪物阿米特吞噬；还要知道《亡灵书》中记载了帮助死者通过这一考验的咒语
evidence: Describe the weighing of the heart ceremony and name the gods involved
Explain the role of the Book of the Dead as a guide through the underworld
Connect the concept of the ka (life force) and ba (personality) to why Egyptians preserved the body
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一幅心脏在天平上称量的画，能解释埃及人相信人死后会发生什么，以及他们为什么认为过好一生如此重要吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 作为活神存在的法老
topics.description: 理解法老不仅是统治者，还被认为是一位活神——是神与人之间的中介——并且玛阿特（真理、正义与宇宙秩序）这一概念指导着埃及的法律和政府，维齐尔和官员代表法老管理王国
evidence: Explain the pharaoh's dual role as both political ruler and divine figure
Describe Ma'at as the principle of truth, justice, and order that governed Egyptian society
Identify the role of viziers and officials in running the government day to day
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 法老为什么如此强大，能解释埃及人相信法老是地上的神，以及一个叫玛阿特的概念让一切保持平衡吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 现代考古学与埃及伦理
topics.description: 理解现代埃及学家在传统发掘之外还使用先进技术——对木乃伊进行 CT 扫描、用卫星图像寻找地下建筑、DNA 分析——并批判性地思考考古学的伦理问题：木乃伊是否应该在博物馆展出、古代文物归谁所有，以及殖民时期的收集行为如何影响我们今天研究和展示古埃及的方式
evidence: Name at least two modern technologies used in Egyptology and explain what they reveal
Discuss at least one ethical question about how ancient Egyptian artefacts are treated today
Understand that how we study ancient Egypt reflects our own values and biases, not just facts about the past
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 参观展出埃及木乃伊的博物馆，能思考这样做是否合适，并解释关于这个问题的不同观点吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及的数学与工程
topics.description: 描述埃及人在数学和工程方面的成就：莱因德数学纸草书展示了面积、体积和分数的计算；金字塔对齐的精确度（与真北偏差在 0.05° 以内）需要精密的测量技术；埃及医学纸草书描述了详细的解剖知识和药物疗法——这些使埃及成为早期科学技术史的重要贡献者
evidence: Describes the Rhind Mathematical Papyrus as containing worked examples of arithmetic, geometry, and unit fractions
Explains one specific engineering achievement: pyramid alignment, ramp logistics, or the accuracy of the Great Pyramid's dimensions
Names at least one medical papyrus (e.g. Ebers Papyrus) and describes the type of medical knowledge it contains
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果告诉 {{name}} 古埃及人在 3500 多年前就在解决分数问题和计算田地面积，能描述莱因德纸草书是什么，并解释它告诉我们关于埃及数学的哪些信息吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 关于古埃及的历史资料
topics.description: 解释关于古埃及的知识是如何从多种资料来源建立起来的——铭文、纸草书、文物和实物遗存——并对每一种进行批判性评估：存在哪些偏见、缺失和歪曲？探讨商博良破译象形文字如何改变了这一领域，以及为什么同一件文物会被不同学者做出不同解读
evidence: Identifies at least four types of historical source (inscriptions, papyri, tomb art, physical artefacts) and explains what each type can and cannot tell us
Explains that hieroglyphic sources were created by the literate elite and therefore tend to record official versions of events, not ordinary people's experiences
Describes at least one example where the same artefact or text has been interpreted in significantly different ways by scholars, and explains why this happens
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看两本关于古埃及说法矛盾的历史书，能解释历史学家为什么有时意见不一致，并描述他们用哪些证据来试图弄清真正发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及与邻国
topics.description: 考察埃及与邻近文明的关系：通往努比亚、黎凡特和蓬特的贸易网络；喜克索斯人的入侵和马车的引入；新王国帝国及其与赫梯人的冲突，最终导致卡迭石战役和世界上现存最早的和平条约——理解埃及并非孤立存在，而是一个相互联系的古代世界的一部分
evidence: Describes the trade relationship with Nubia and Punt, naming at least two goods exchanged in each direction
Explains how the Hyksos invasion introduced new military technologies to Egypt, including the horse-drawn war chariot
Describes the Battle of Kadesh (Ramesses II vs. the Hittites) and the resulting Egypto-Hittite peace treaty as a landmark in diplomatic history
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 古埃及人是否曾与其他文明交战或与远方国家贸易，能各举至少一个例子，并解释这些互动如何改变了埃及吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 金字塔究竟是谁建造的
topics.description: 分析金字塔是谁建造的以及为什么建造，评估证据以反驳外星人建造说和奴隶劳动说：吉萨工人村的考古证据显示，这是一支有报酬、有技能、伙食良好的劳动力队伍；讨论建造纪念碑的社会功能，即作为国家组织、宗教义务和就业的一种形式；并评估当前关于新发现的建造坡道和后勤的争议
evidence: Cites at least three pieces of archaeological evidence from Giza that point to an organised, skilled, fed workforce rather than slaves or aliens (e.g. worker villages, bakery remains, graffiti tags, medical care)
Explains why the alien hypothesis fails to meet the standards of historical evidence and what the burden of proof in history requires
Evaluates at least two proposed explanations for ramp logistics and describes which is currently supported by the most evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一部声称外星人建造了金字塔的纪录片，能解释考古学家为什么否定这个说法，并描述关于谁建造了金字塔的实际证据——以及他们的工作条件是什么样的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及文明的衰落
topics.description: 追溯古埃及文明的终结，历经 successive 征服——亚述、波斯、马其顿（亚历山大大帝），最后是罗马——并解释每位征服者如何同时受到埃及文化的影响；考察克利奥帕特拉七世作为最后一位法老和多语种政治策略家的身份；思考古埃及在现代文化、宗教和语言中留下了什么
evidence: Names the main conquerors of Egypt in chronological order (Assyrians, Persians, Macedonians under Alexander, Romans) and gives approximate dates
Describes Cleopatra VII accurately: not as a romantic icon but as a politically sophisticated ruler who spoke multiple languages and tried to preserve Egyptian independence

Identifies at least two enduring legacies of ancient Egypt in the modern world (e.g. the Coptic language as a descendant of ancient Egyptian, obelisks in Rome and Paris, Egyptian motifs in Western art and architecture)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 古埃及何时终结以及为什么，能描述最后几个世纪——包括谁征服了埃及、克利奥帕特拉究竟是谁，并说出一样至今仍是当今世界一部分的古埃及事物吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 地图上的古希腊与古罗马
topics.description: 在地图上找到希腊和意大利，知道它们是地中海周边的国家，几千年前，两大古老文明——古希腊与古罗马——就在这里发展起来，时间远在古埃及人之后，又远在我们这个时代之前
evidence: Point to Greece and Italy on a world map or globe
Say that Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome were around the Mediterranean Sea
Place Greece and Rome on a simple timeline after Ancient Egypt and before today
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一张地图，他能不能指出古希腊和古罗马在哪里，并告诉你这些地方靠近地中海？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古代生活与今天
topics.description: 比较古希腊或古罗马的孩子和今天的孩子怎样生活——包括学校的不同（在蜡板上写字、在斯巴达学习格斗）、食物的不同（橄榄、面包、葡萄）、游戏的不同，以及服装的不同（束腰外衣和凉鞋）——并理解这些文明存在于几千年前
evidence: Name two ways a child's life in ancient Greece or Rome was different from today
Describe what ancient Greek or Roman children might have eaten or worn
Say that these civilisations existed thousands of years ago — long before grandparents were born
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能告诉你，在古希腊或古罗马当个孩子可能是什么样——穿什么、吃什么、在学校做什么——以及和今天有什么不同？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊众神与奥林匹斯山
topics.description: 知道古希腊人信奉许多神和女神，他们住在奥林匹斯山上——包括宙斯（众神之王，掌管雷电）、雅典娜（智慧）、波塞冬（海洋）、赫尔墨斯（传递消息）和阿佛洛狄忒（爱）——并且每位神都有特殊的能力，在世界中各有各的角色
evidence: Name at least three Greek gods and say what each one was god of
Say that the Greek gods were believed to live on Mount Olympus
Explain that the ancient Greeks prayed to different gods for different things
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张宙斯手持雷电或波塞冬手持三叉戟的图片，他能不能告诉你他们是谁、是掌管什么的神？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊神话与英雄
topics.description: 至少复述一个关于英雄与怪兽的希腊神话——比如忒修斯在迷宫中与弥诺陶洛斯、赫拉克勒斯（海格力斯）与狮子，或珀尔修斯与美杜莎——并理解这些是古希腊人用来解释世界、传授道理的故事
evidence: Retell a Greek myth naming the hero, the monster, and what happened
Explain that myths were stories the ancient Greeks told to make sense of the world
Describe what made a Greek hero brave or clever in the story
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能给你讲一个希腊英雄的故事，比如忒修斯大战弥诺陶洛斯或赫拉克勒斯大战狮子，并解释希腊人为什么讲这些故事？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马士兵与建筑者
topics.description: 知道罗马士兵行军穿越庞大的帝国，修建笔直的道路和坚固的城墙，而且今天仍能看到一些罗马的道路、城墙和建筑——这说明罗马人是强大的建造者，他们的工程历经几千年仍留存至今
evidence: Describe Roman soldiers as part of a powerful army that marched across an empire
Name something the Romans built that we can still see today such as roads or walls
Explain that Roman buildings and roads lasted because the Romans were skilled builders
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你们家沿着一条非常笔直的古道开车，或参观罗马遗迹，{{name}} 能不能告诉你，罗马人建造的东西非常坚固，历经几千年仍留存至今？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗慕路斯与雷穆斯
topics.description: 知道罗马建城神话罗慕路斯与雷穆斯——这对双胞胎兄弟还是婴儿时被遗弃，由一头母狼抚养长大，后来建立了罗马城——并理解这是罗马人讲述自己城市起源的传说
evidence: Retell the story of Romulus and Remus being raised by a wolf
Say that Romulus founded the city of Rome
Explain that this is a legend — a story people told, not necessarily true
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一座母狼哺育两个婴儿的雕像，他能不能告诉你这是罗慕路斯与雷穆斯的故事，以及罗马人相信他们的城市是这样开始的？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 第一届奥运会
topics.description: 知道奥林匹克运动会起源于古希腊一个叫奥林匹亚的地方，是为纪念宙斯而举行的体育竞赛，而我们今天观看的现代奥运会正是受到那些古代运动会的启发
evidence: Say that the Olympic Games started in ancient Greece at Olympia
Name at least one sport or event from the ancient Olympics such as running or wrestling
Explain that today's Olympic Games got the idea from the ancient Greek ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在电视上看奥运会时，他能不能告诉你，奥运会最初是几千年前在古希腊开始的？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 雅典民主
topics.description: 理解雅典发明了民主——一种自由男性公民聚集在公民大会上，为城邦的重要决定辩论和投票的制度——但妇女、被奴役的人和外国人不允许投票
evidence: Explain what democracy meant in Athens: citizens voted on decisions together
Identify who could vote in Athenian democracy (free men born in Athens) and who could not
Say that the idea of people voting on decisions started in Athens and still influences us today
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能解释，民主——人们投票做决定——是在古雅典发明的，但并不是每个人都被允许参与？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 雅典与斯巴达
topics.description: 比较雅典和斯巴达这两个截然不同的希腊城邦：雅典重视学习、艺术、辩论和民主，而斯巴达重视军事训练、纪律和服从——并理解城邦就是一个像小国家一样自治的城市
evidence: Name at least two differences between life in Athens and life in Sparta
Explain what a city-state was and why Greek city-states were independent from each other
Describe what was valued most in Athens (learning, arts) versus Sparta (military strength)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 关于雅典和斯巴达的事，他能不能说出雅典以思考和民主闻名，而斯巴达以勇猛的战士闻名？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 布狄卡反抗罗马
topics.description: 讲述爱西尼部落女王布狄卡的故事：她领导了一场反抗罗马统治的激烈起义，烧毁了科尔切斯特、伦敦和圣奥尔本斯，最终她的军队被击败；并理解她作为反抗强大帝国的象征的重要意义
evidence: Retell the story of Boudicca: who she was, why she revolted, what happened
Name at least one town Boudicca's army destroyed during the revolt
Explain why Boudicca is remembered as a symbol of resistance against the Romans
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能告诉你布狄卡是谁，以及她领导反抗不列颠罗马人时发生了什么？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马城镇的日常生活
topics.description: 描述罗马城镇的日常生活——广场（集市和聚会场所）、公共浴场、圆形剧场和别墅——并说明罗马人是杰出的工程师，他们修建了笔直的道路、输水的高架渠、地暖系统（火炕）以及标记帝国在不列颠北部边界的哈德良长城
evidence: Describe at least three features of a Roman town such as forum, baths, or amphitheatre
Explain what an aqueduct was and why the Romans built them
Describe Hadrian's Wall and say why it was built
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你们全家参观了罗马浴场或哈德良长城这样的罗马遗迹，{{name}} 能不能解释它们是用来做什么的，以及罗马人是怎样建造的？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 角斗士与庞贝
topics.description: 知道罗马人在罗马斗兽场等巨大竞技场里观看角斗士搏斗，角斗士通常是受过搏斗训练的奴隶或囚犯，以及庞贝城在公元 79 年被维苏威火山喷发掩埋，保存了罗马日常生活的珍贵缩影
evidence: Describe what gladiators were and where they fought
Explain that the Colosseum in Rome was a giant arena for public entertainment
Retell what happened to Pompeii and why it is important for understanding Roman life
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能告诉你角斗士是什么，描述罗马斗兽场，并解释庞贝城发生了什么？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 众神与帕特农神庙
topics.description: 说出主要希腊神祇及其职责——宙斯（众神之王、雷电）、赫拉（天后、婚姻）、雅典娜（智慧、战争）、波塞冬（海洋）、阿波罗（太阳、音乐）、阿尔忒弥斯（狩猎、月亮）、阿瑞斯（战争）、阿佛洛狄忒（爱情）、赫尔墨斯（信使）、赫菲斯托斯（火、工艺）、哈迪斯（冥界）——并知道雅典的帕特农神庙是一座为纪念雅典娜而建的宏伟神庙
evidence: Name at least five Greek gods and say what each was responsible for
Describe the Parthenon as a temple to Athena built on the acropolis in Athens
Explain that Greeks built temples to honour their gods and held festivals and sacrifices
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到帕特农神庙的图片，能不能告诉你它是雅典供奉雅典娜的神庙，并说出其他几位希腊神祇以及他们各自掌管什么？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 有罗马名字的希腊神祇
topics.description: 理解罗马人沿用了希腊神祇但给了他们新名字——宙斯变成朱庇特，赫拉变成朱诺，阿瑞斯变成玛尔斯，雅典娜变成密涅瓦，波塞冬变成涅普顿，阿佛洛狄忒变成维纳斯——这说明罗马受希腊文化影响之深
evidence: Match at least four Greek gods to their Roman names
Explain that the Romans took Greek gods and gave them Latin names
Say that this borrowing shows Rome was strongly influenced by Greek culture
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能告诉你罗马人和希腊人信奉同样的神，只是名字不同——比如宙斯变成朱庇特，雅典娜变成密涅瓦？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊戏剧
topics.description: 知道古希腊人发明了戏剧，在大型露天圆形剧场里表演悲剧和喜剧，演员戴着面具——戏剧演出是纪念酒神狄俄尼索斯的宗教节庆的一部分，观众多达数千人
evidence: Explain that the Greeks invented theatre with two types of plays: tragedies and comedies
Describe how Greek actors wore masks and performed in open-air amphitheatres
Say that plays were part of festivals honouring the god Dionysus
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 参观了一座古代圆形剧场或看到希腊面具的图片，能不能告诉你希腊人发明了戏剧，并解释演员为什么戴面具？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 马拉松与温泉关
topics.description: 描述马拉松战役和温泉关战役是希腊城邦联合抵抗入侵的波斯帝国的时刻——信使菲迪皮德斯带来马拉松胜利的消息（马拉松赛跑的起源），以及 300 名斯巴达人在温泉关的英勇坚守——并理解这些战争是为了保卫希腊的独立
evidence: Retell the story of the Battle of Marathon and the runner Pheidippides
Describe the Spartan stand at Thermopylae against a much larger Persian army
Explain that the Persian Wars were about Greek city-states defending their freedom
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能讲述著名的马拉松战役和温泉关战役，并解释希腊人是在为保卫自由而抵抗波斯帝国？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马军队与征服不列颠
topics.description: 描述罗马军队如何被组织成由训练有素的士兵组成的军团，尤利乌斯·凯撒如何在公元前 55 年首次袭击不列颠，以及克劳狄乌斯皇帝后来在公元 43 年征服不列颠，并解释罗马人为什么要扩张帝国——为了土地、资源、税收和荣耀
evidence: Describe a Roman legion as a large unit of highly trained, disciplined soldiers
Explain that Julius Caesar raided Britain first and Claudius conquered it later
Give at least one reason why the Romans invaded Britain
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出罗马军队是如何组织的，并解释罗马人为什么要入侵不列颠——谁先来、谁最终征服了它吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 亚历山大大帝的帝国
topics.description: 描述马其顿的亚历山大大帝如何征服了一个从希腊延伸到埃及、再到印度的庞大帝国，把希腊语言、文化和思想传播到古代世界——开创了一个希腊文化与东方文化交融的时期，史称希腊化时代
evidence: Describe the extent of Alexander's empire on a map (Greece to Egypt to India)
Explain that Alexander spread Greek culture and language across the lands he conquered
Say what the Hellenistic Age was — a blending of Greek and Eastern cultures
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出亚历山大大帝是谁、他的帝国疆域有多辽阔，以及他的征服给希腊文化带来了什么影响吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊与古罗马生活的证据
topics.description: 理解历史学家和考古学家是依据证据来还原古希腊和古罗马生活的——陶器上的绘画、钱币、铭文、庞贝等遗址，以及荷马、普林尼等作家的文字——并且同样的证据在不同历史学家眼中可能有不同的解读
evidence: Name at least three types of evidence historians use to learn about ancient Greece and Rome
Explain why Pompeii is especially valuable as a source of evidence about Roman life
Give an example of how the same piece of evidence could be interpreted in more than one way
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆看到一件古希腊陶罐或一枚古罗马钱币，能解释历史学家能从这类物品中学到什么，以及为什么不同专家可能有不同的解读吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 西罗马帝国的衰亡
topics.description: 描述西罗马帝国如何因多种因素逐渐衰落——入侵民族的军事压力、政治动荡、经济问题以及帝国过度扩张——最终在公元 476 年灭亡，而东罗马（拜占庭）帝国又延续了近一千年
evidence: Name at least two reasons why the Western Roman Empire declined and fell
State the date AD 476 as when the last Western Roman emperor was removed
Explain that the Eastern (Byzantine) Empire survived for nearly 1,000 years after the West fell
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释罗马帝国为什么会瓦解，并说出西半部崩溃后东半部又延续了几个世纪吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊与古罗马建筑
topics.description: 识别希腊柱式——多立克柱式（朴素坚固）、爱奥尼柱式（涡卷形柱头）和科林斯柱式（华丽叶形柱头）——以及罗马建筑创新——拱、穹顶和混凝土——并能在法院、博物馆、政府大楼和纪念碑等现代公共建筑中发现它们的影响
evidence: Identify the three Greek column orders (Doric, Ionic, Corinthian) from pictures
Name Roman architectural innovations: the arch, the dome, and concrete
Point out Greek or Roman architectural features in a modern public building
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果路过一座有大柱子的法院或博物馆，{{name}} 能说出它们是多立克柱式、爱奥尼柱式还是科林斯柱式，并解释这种设计源自古希腊或古罗马吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊与古罗马的今日遗产
topics.description: 评价古希腊和古罗马文明对现代生活的持久贡献——民主、法律、语言（拉丁词根）、建筑（柱、拱、穹顶）、体育（奥运会）、哲学、文学和戏剧——并理解希腊思想是经由罗马、再经由后来的欧洲文明，在一连串文化传播中传到我们这里的
evidence: List at least five ways ancient Greece and Rome still influence modern life
Explain how Greek culture spread to Rome and then from Rome across Europe
Give a specific modern example of a Greek or Roman legacy such as democratic voting or architectural columns
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能列举几样因为古希腊人和古罗马人而留存至今的东西——比如民主、奥运会、拉丁词汇和建筑风格——并解释这些思想是如何传到我们这里的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊哲学家与医学
topics.description: 知道被称为哲学家的希腊思想家发展出了至今仍影响我们的理解世界的方式——苏格拉底用尖锐的问题检验观点（苏格拉底式提问法），柏拉图构想理想社会，亚里士多德观察并分类自然界——并知道希波克拉底被称为医学之父，因为他坚持疾病有自然原因，而不是归咎于神
evidence: Describe what Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle each contributed to thinking and learning
Explain the Socratic method as learning by asking questions rather than just being told answers
Say why Hippocrates is called the father of medicine
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲讲苏格拉底、柏拉图和亚里士多德——他们各自以什么闻名——并解释希腊思想家为什么至今仍然重要吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马法、拉丁语与基督教
topics.description: 理解罗马法成为欧洲乃至更广地区法律体系的基础；拉丁语是法语、西班牙语、意大利语、葡萄牙语和罗马尼亚语的根源，并为英语贡献了数百个单词（如 exit、video、annual、education）；基督教在罗马帝国境内传播，最终在君士坦丁皇帝统治下成为国教
evidence: Give examples of English words that come from Latin
Explain that Roman law influenced modern legal systems in Europe and beyond
Describe how Christianity spread through the Roman Empire and became its official religion
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能举出几个源自拉丁语的英语单词，并解释罗马法和基督教是如何通过罗马帝国传遍欧洲的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马共和国与罗马帝国
topics.description: 解释罗马最初如何以共和国形式治理——有选举产生的执政官、权力很大的元老院，以及贵族与平民的区分——后来又如何变成由奥古斯都（他带来了和平，即“罗马和平”）和尼禄等皇帝统治的帝国，并比较共和制政府与雅典直接民主制的不同
evidence: Describe the Roman Republic's structure: consuls, Senate, patricians, and plebeians
Explain how Rome changed from a republic to an empire under Augustus
Compare Athenian direct democracy (citizens vote on decisions) with Roman republican government (citizens elect representatives)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释罗马共和国和罗马帝国的区别，并比较罗马和雅典各自如何让人民在政府中拥有发言权吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊与罗马中被忽视的声音
topics.description: 考察那些通常被排除在希腊罗马故事之外的人的生活——约占雅典人口 30%、支撑罗马经济的被奴役者；在雅典（大多被限制在家中）和斯巴达（接受体能训练、拥有财产）生活差异巨大的女性；以及两个帝国中被征服的民族——并评价历史记录中缺失了谁的声音以及原因
evidence: Describe the daily life of an enslaved person in Athens or Rome using available evidence
Compare the lives of women in Athens and Sparta, explaining key differences
Explain why the historical record favours elite men and what this means for our understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲讲古希腊和古罗马被奴役者或女性的生活，并解释为什么我们对他们的了解比对著名领袖的了解少吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 雅典的包容与排斥
topics.description: 分析雅典民主制中谁被纳入、谁被排斥——只有自由的成年男性公民（约占成年人的 30%）可以参与，而女性、被奴役者（可能占人口的三分之一）和外国居民（外邦人）都被排斥在外——并通过与现代代议制民主比较，评价雅典是否真的配得上“民主发源地”的称号
evidence: Calculate approximately what fraction of the Athenian population could participate in democracy
List the groups excluded from Athenian democracy and explain why each was excluded
Construct an argument for or against calling Athens a true democracy, using evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释雅典民主制把谁排除在外，并有条理地论证它是否真的配被称为民主的发源地吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 特洛伊：神话还是历史？
topics.description: 探讨海因里希·施里曼在现代土耳其希萨利克的发掘如何引发疑问：荷马《伊利亚特》中描述的特洛伊战争是历史、部分历史，还是完全神话——理解考古学和文献资料可能相互支持也可能相互矛盾，而古代世界中神话与历史的界限往往模糊不清
evidence: Describe Schliemann's excavation at Hisarlik and what he claimed to have found
Explain how archaeological evidence at Troy both supports and complicates Homer's story
Discuss why the boundary between myth and history is difficult to draw for the ancient world
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讨论特洛伊战争是否真的发生过，解释考古学家在特洛伊发现了什么，以及为什么答案并不简单吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马共和国的衰亡
topics.description: 梳理罗马的政治暴力——格拉古兄弟被谋杀、马略与苏拉之间的内战、凯撒渡过卢比孔河并在三月十五日被刺杀，以及屋大维与安东尼之间的最终战争——如何摧毁了共和国并导致奥古斯都的一人统治，并辩论共和国的衰亡是不可避免的还是一系列选择的结果
evidence: Describe at least three key events in the collapse of the Roman Republic in chronological order
Explain what 'crossing the Rubicon' meant and why it was a point of no return
Construct an argument about whether the Republic's fall was inevitable or could have been prevented
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释摧毁罗马共和国的一连串事件——从格拉古兄弟到凯撒被刺再到奥古斯都——并讨论它是否本可以避免吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 同一事件的不同说法
topics.description: 认识到不同的人对同一事件可以有不同的说法——而且两种说法都可能是真实的，即使彼此不一致
evidence: Wineburg corroboration heuristic
Initiating Historical Thinking in Elementary Schools
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听到同一历史事件的两种不同版本，他们能理解两个人都可能是在从自己的角度说真话——并想知道为什么版本不同吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 来自过去的证据
topics.description: 理解我们对过去的一切了解都来自证据——留存下来的物品、建筑、图画、文献和故事
evidence: Wineburg historical thinking framework
Historical Thinking in the Elementary Years (ERIC)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 了解到很久以前发生的事情时，他们会问我们是怎么知道的——并理解必须有人找到或留下那些证据吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 词汇：历史思维
topics.description: 认识并使用历史思维的词汇——史料、证据、一手史料、二手史料、文物、年代学、时间顺序、公元前、公元、世纪、十年、时代、时期、时间线、发掘、考古学家、解读、相互印证、偏见、视角——并在讨论我们如何了解过去以及我们的知识有多可靠时运用这些术语
evidence: Correctly use BC/BCE and AD/CE to place events in time and explain what the letters stand for
Distinguish between a primary source and a secondary source with an example of each
Use 'evidence', 'interpretation', and 'bias' correctly in a sentence about a historical source
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 在历史书上读到的东西是否一定真实，他们能解释为什么可能不真实——并用上“史料”“证据”或“偏见”这样的词吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 核对多个来源
topics.description: 相互印证：检查多个来源是否对同一事实说法一致——并探究为什么可能不一致
evidence: Wineburg corroboration heuristic
Historical Thinking in the Elementary Years (ERIC)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想弄清一个历史事件的真相，他们会不会想到查看多个来源，并比较它们的说法？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 质疑历史资料
topics.description: 在相信一份历史资料之前，先问：这是谁做的、什么时候做的、为什么做？——答案决定了这份资料该有多大分量
evidence: Wineburg sourcing heuristic
Teaching Historical Thinking Using Primary Sources (Library of Congress)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到一份历史文件、照片或记述时，他们会不会问是谁创作的，以及那个人可能有什么目的或观点？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 理解当时的人
topics.description: 理解过去的人看世界的方式和我们很不一样——要结合他们所处的时代背景来判断他们的行为，而不只是用今天的价值观
evidence: Historical Empathy: A Cognitive-Affective Theory (ERIC)
Year 4-6 historical empathy research
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 了解到过去的人做了今天看来不对的事，他们能不能想一想，为什么当时的人可能觉得这很正常或很正确？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 证据与解读
topics.description: 区分历史证据与历史解读——证据是留存下来的东西，解读是历史学家据此建立的论点，而同样的证据可以支持不同的论点
evidence: Development of historical understanding among 9-14 year olds
Ways of Seeing: Evidence and Learning in the History Classroom (RRCHNM)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否明白，两位历史学家可以看同样的证据却得出不同的结论——历史包含论证和判断，而不只是事实？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 国王与女王
topics.description: 中世纪的国王和女王做什么：统治土地、制定法律、收税；王冠和王座作为权力的象征；伦敦塔
evidence: Explain what a medieval king or queen did (ruled, made laws, led armies, collected taxes)
Describe at least one symbol of royal power (crown, throne, sceptre)
Name one famous medieval monarch or describe the Tower of London's role
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能说出中世纪的国王或女王除了戴王冠之外，实际都做些什么？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 骑士与盔甲
topics.description: 骑士是什么：为领主效力的受训战士；盔甲、盾牌、剑和长矛；骑士准则作为骑士行为规范的规则
evidence: Describe what a knight wore and carried (armour, helmet, shield, sword, lance)
Explain that knights trained from a young age and served a lord
Name one rule of the code of chivalry (be brave, be honest, protect the weak)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能描述骑士的样子、他们做什么，以及至少一条他们应该遵守的规则？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪服饰
topics.description: 中世纪人们穿什么：平民的衣服（羊毛、亚麻）与贵族的衣服（丝绸、毛皮、鲜艳的颜色）；没有拉链和纽扣；衣服如何体现你的社会地位
evidence: Describe what a medieval peasant would typically wear
Explain how noble clothing was different from peasant clothing
Give one way that what you wore showed your place in society
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到不同中世纪人物的图片，能不能只看衣服就说出哪些人富有、哪些人贫穷？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪饮食与宴会
topics.description: 中世纪人们吃什么：普通人的面包和浓汤，富人的盛大宴会；没有叉子，用手吃饭；大厅是城堡生活的中心
evidence: Describe what ordinary people ate most days (bread, pottage, vegetables, ale)
Explain how a feast in a great hall was different from everyday meals
Name one surprising table manner from medieval times (no forks, shared cups, food thrown on the floor)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 去参加一场中世纪宴会，能不能描述会端上什么食物，以及哪些餐桌礼仪会让他们吃惊？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗宾汉与亚瑟王
topics.description: 罗宾汉（舍伍德森林、劫富济贫、快乐伙伴）和亚瑟王（圆桌骑士、王者之剑、卡美洛）的传说；这些是故事，不是被证实的历史，但反映了中世纪的价值观
evidence: Retell the basic story of Robin Hood or King Arthur
Name at least two characters from one of these legends
Explain that these are legends (stories) rather than proven facts
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出罗宾汉或亚瑟王的故事，并说明这些是传说，而不是确凿的真实历史吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 维京人
topics.description: 维京人是谁：来自斯堪的纳维亚的航海战士和商人；长船；维京人对不列颠的劫掠；维京人也定居下来并务农
evidence: Describe who the Vikings were and where they came from
Explain what made longships special (fast, could sail in shallow water, dragon prows)
State that Vikings were not just raiders but also farmers, traders, and settlers
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出维京人是谁、他们来自哪里，并说明他们不只是劫掠和打仗吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 村庄生活
topics.description: 中世纪村庄里普通人的日常生活：茅草屋、务农、烤面包、打水；当时的生活与今天有多么不同
evidence: Describe what a typical medieval village looked like (thatched cottages, fields, church)
Name at least three daily tasks a medieval villager would do
Give two differences between life in a medieval village and life today
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述中世纪村庄里一个孩子平常的一天是什么样的，以及这和自己的生活有什么不同吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 什么是城堡？
topics.description: 城堡是什么：既是住所又是防御工事的加固建筑；关键部分包括塔楼、护城河、吊桥和厚墙；为什么要建造城堡
evidence: Name at least four parts of a castle (tower, moat, drawbridge, walls, gatehouse)
Explain that castles were both homes and defences
Describe why someone in medieval times would need a castle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 参观一座城堡废墟，能指出主要部分并解释为什么要那样建造吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 盎格鲁-撒克逊时期的不列颠
topics.description: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人是谁：罗马人离开后定居不列颠的日耳曼民族；他们的王国、村庄、地名、艺术，以及最终皈依基督教
evidence: Explain who the Anglo-Saxons were and when they came to Britain (after the Romans left)
Name at least two Anglo-Saxon kingdoms (e.g. Wessex, Mercia, Northumbria)
Give an example of Anglo-Saxon influence still visible today (place names ending in -ton, -ham, -bury)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说明盎格鲁-撒克逊人是谁，并指出许多英国地名来自盎格鲁-撒克逊词语吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 黑斯廷斯战役与 1066 年
topics.description: 1066 年的事件：忏悔者爱德华去世、三位王位争夺者、黑斯廷斯战役、征服者威廉，以及作为历史资料的贝叶挂毯
evidence: Explain why there was a crisis when Edward the Confessor died in 1066
Describe the Battle of Hastings and its outcome
Explain what the Bayeux Tapestry is and why it is important as a historical source
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出 1066 年发生了什么、为什么重要，以及贝叶挂毯向我们展示了关于这些事件的什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 历代城堡设计
topics.description: 城堡如何建造和演变：从木制土丘-外堡式到石制主楼再到同心圆城堡；各个房间及其用途；城堡设计如何应对新的进攻方式
evidence: Describe the difference between an early motte-and-bailey castle and a later stone castle
Name at least three rooms or areas in a medieval castle and their purpose
Explain one way castle design changed to resist new attack methods
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说明城堡如何随时间变化，并描述城堡内不同房间的用途吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪权力金字塔
topics.description: 中世纪社会如何组织：国王在最顶端，然后是领主，然后是骑士，然后是农民/农奴；谁欠谁什么；权力金字塔与相互义务
evidence: Draw or describe the feudal pyramid showing king, lords, knights, and peasants
Explain what each level owed to the level above (loyalty, military service, labour)
Describe what a serf's life was like and why they couldn't easily leave
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释中世纪的等级制度——谁在最上面、谁在最下面，以及每个群体必须为其他人做什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 攻城战
topics.description: 城堡如何被攻击和防守：攻城武器（投石机、破城槌、攻城塔）、滚烫的液体、箭孔、谋杀孔；中世纪攻城战的惊险场面
evidence: Name at least three siege weapons or attack methods
Describe at least two ways a castle was designed to resist attack
Explain what a siege was and why it could last weeks or months
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 正在读关于中世纪攻城战的内容，他们能说出攻击城堡用了哪些武器，以及守军有哪些巧妙的还击方式吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 黑死病
topics.description: 1348-49 年的黑死病：这场瘟疫是什么、如何传播、造成了多么惨重的死亡；它如何通过让幸存的工人获得更多权力和更高工资而改变了社会
evidence: Describe what the Black Death was and at least two symptoms
Explain how the plague spread (fleas on rats, person to person)
Describe one major way the Black Death changed society (fewer workers led to higher wages, peasants gained power)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能告诉你黑死病是什么、如何传播，以及它为什么最终以意想不到的方式改变了社会吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 十字军东征
topics.description: 对十字军东征的简化讲述：欧洲人为什么前往圣地、他们在那里发现了什么、基督教欧洲与伊斯兰世界之间的文化交流
evidence: Explain in simple terms why European armies travelled to the Holy Land
Describe at least one thing Europeans learned from the Islamic world during the Crusades
Acknowledge that the Crusades involved violence and suffering on both sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释十字军东征是什么，并说出欧洲人通过这些旅程对更广阔的世界有了哪些了解吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪教会
topics.description: 中世纪教会的巨大权力：修道院以及修士和修女的日常生活；建造宏伟的大教堂；朝圣作为一种宗教旅程；教会对日常生活的影响
evidence: Explain why the Church was so powerful in medieval times (owned land, controlled education, people feared God's punishment)
Describe what daily life was like for a monk or nun
Explain what a pilgrimage was and give one reason people went on them
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么教会在中世纪是人们生活中如此重要的一部分，以及修士和修女整天都做些什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人
topics.description: 维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人争夺英格兰控制权的冲突：维京人的劫掠、阿尔弗雷德大帝的抵抗、丹麦法区、作为全英格兰第一位国王的埃塞尔斯坦、忏悔者爱德华
evidence: Describe the Viking raids on Anglo-Saxon England and their impact
Explain who Alfred the Great was and why he was important
Describe what the Danelaw was (the area of England under Viking control)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能给你讲讲维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人争夺英格兰控制权的斗争，以及阿尔弗雷德大帝是谁吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 艺术与建筑
topics.description: 中世纪的文化成就：泥金装饰手抄本、哥特式大教堂（飞扶壁、彩色玻璃）、格里高利圣咏、贝叶挂毯；艺术和建筑作为信仰与权力的表达
evidence: Describe what an illuminated manuscript is and who made them
Name at least two features of Gothic cathedral architecture (pointed arches, flying buttresses, stained glass)
Explain how medieval art and buildings were connected to the Church and religious belief
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 参观一座哥特式大教堂，他们能指出彩色玻璃窗和飞扶壁等特征，并解释中世纪人为什么建造如此令人惊叹的建筑吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 犯罪与惩罚
topics.description: 中世纪的司法如何运作：神判法、决斗审判、郡长的角色；包括枷锁、颈手枷和地牢在内的惩罚；与现代司法有多么不同
evidence: Describe at least two medieval methods of deciding guilt (trial by ordeal, trial by combat)
Name at least two medieval punishments and explain what they involved
Compare one aspect of medieval justice to how justice works today
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述中世纪罪犯是如何被抓捕和惩罚的，并说出按今天的标准哪些做法显得不公平吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 《大宪章》与限制王权
topics.description: 约翰王、男爵们的反抗，以及 1215 年《大宪章》的签署；《大宪章》对限制国王权力说了什么；它对民主和权利的持久重要性
evidence: Explain why the barons rebelled against King John
Describe what the Magna Carta said (the king must follow the law too, fair trial rights)
Explain why the Magna Carta still matters today (foundation of democracy and human rights)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能告诉你《大宪章》是什么，以及为什么一份 1215 年的文件至今仍被认为很重要吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪对现代生活的影响
topics.description: 中世纪留给我们什么：议会、大学、普通法、哥特式建筑、英语语言（盎格鲁-撒克逊语与诺曼法语）、地名、姓氏；以及我们为什么至今仍对中世纪世界着迷
evidence: Name at least three things from the Middle Ages that still affect our lives today
Explain how the English language was shaped by Anglo-Saxon and Norman French
Give a reason why people today are still fascinated by the medieval period (castles, knights, fantasy literature, games)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出几样我们今天仍然拥有、其实起源于中世纪的事物吗——从议会到英语单词再到大学学位？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 欧洲之外的中世纪世界
topics.description: 欧洲之外的中世纪世界：伊斯兰黄金时代（数学、医学、建筑）、马里帝国与曼萨·穆萨、中国宋朝；中世纪世界如何通过丝绸之路等贸易路线彼此相连
evidence: Name at least two achievements of the Islamic Golden Age (algebra, hospitals, architecture)
Describe who Mansa Musa was and why he is remembered
Explain how the Silk Road connected distant parts of the medieval world through trade
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲一讲中世纪时期欧洲以外的重要文明，并解释丝绸之路如何把世界不同地区连接起来吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 印刷机与文艺复兴
topics.description: 古腾堡发明印刷机，以及威廉·卡克斯顿把它带到英格兰；印刷书籍如何改变了一切；从中世纪到文艺复兴的过渡
evidence: Explain what the printing press was and why it was revolutionary
Describe William Caxton's role in bringing printing to England
Give at least one way printed books changed society (more people could read, ideas spread faster)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么印刷机的发明是历史上最重要的时刻之一，以及它如何改变了世界吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 城镇与贸易
topics.description: 中世纪城镇的发展：集市、行会、商人阶层；城镇如何争取到自治特许状；从纯乡村生活向部分城市生活的转变
evidence: Describe how medieval towns were different from villages (markets, walls, guilds, more people)
Explain what a guild was and why it mattered for tradespeople
Describe one way towns changed medieval society (new merchant class, more freedom for townspeople)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释中世纪城镇为什么发展起来，以及集市和行会的兴起如何改变了人们的生活和工作方式吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪的女性
topics.description: 中世纪女性的生活：管理庄园的贵族女性、农民女性艰辛的日常劳作、修女与女修道院长，以及阿基坦的埃莉诺和圣女贞德等著名人物
evidence: Describe the different lives of noblewomen, peasant women, and nuns
Name at least one notable medieval woman and explain what she did
Explain one way women's lives in medieval times were more restricted than today
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲一讲中世纪女性的生活是什么样的，并说出一位在历史上留下印记的著名中世纪女性吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 寻求帮助
topics.description: 自己先试过、还是卡住了，就去寻求帮助——知道什么时候该求助本身就是一种能力
evidence: Hattie visible learning
self-regulated learning research
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 尝试过某件事还是卡住了，他们会来寻求帮助，而不是干坐着着急或直接放弃吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 检查自己的作业
topics.description: 完成任务后，回头看看自己做的，问问自己：这样看起来对吗？
evidence: After finishing a piece of work, re-read or review it without being asked to
Spot and correct at least one error in their own work by checking back through it
Describe what they checked for — e.g. 'I re-read each line to make sure my answers matched the question'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 完成一项作业或活动后，会自己检查一遍、确认看起来没问题再说自己做完了吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 遇到困难时坚持下去
topics.description: 当事情感觉很难时继续尝试——犯错再试一次，学习就是这样发生的
evidence: Keep working on a difficult task for a sustained period without giving up or asking someone else to do it
After making a mistake, try again with a different approach rather than saying 'I can't do it'
Talk about difficulty positively — e.g. 'This is hard but I'm getting better' rather than 'I'm no good at this'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 觉得一个谜题或活动真的很难，他们会不断尝试不同的方法，而不是马上放弃吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 没弄懂的感觉
topics.description: 留意没弄懂的感觉——当某件事让人困惑时能意识到，而不是读过去或听过去就算了
evidence: comprehension monitoring research
Flavell metacognitive monitoring
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在阅读或听讲时遇到不明白的地方，会察觉到并说出来吗——而不是装作听懂了继续往下走？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 做任务前先计划
topics.description: 开始一项任务前先做个简单计划：我需要做什么，应该先做哪一步？
evidence: Before starting a task, describe what they need to do and what order to do it in
Break a larger task into smaller steps without being prompted — e.g. 'First I'll read the question, then I'll draw a diagram'
Gather the materials or information they need before beginning, rather than starting and then stopping to find things
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 开始一项较大的任务之前——比如写故事或动手做东西——会先花点时间想想第一步做什么吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 开始前先想一想
topics.description: 开始学新东西之前，先停下来想一想：关于这个话题，我已经知道什么？
evidence: prior knowledge activation research
Ausubel meaningful learning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 要学新内容时——比如科学课的新主题或一种新的应用题——会先想想自己已经知道什么吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 把新旧知识连起来
topics.description: 寻找新想法和已有知识之间的联系——这和我以前学过的东西有什么关系？
evidence: elaborative encoding
schema theory (Bartlett, Rumelhart)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 学到新东西时，会不会说“哦，这就像……”并把它和自己已经知道的东西联系起来？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 发现规律
topics.description: 发现规律和反复出现的结构——在数字、词语、自然、声音或事件中——并用它们来理解新信息
evidence: Spot a pattern in a set of numbers, shapes, or facts without being told to look for one
Use a pattern they noticed to make a prediction — e.g. 'The next one should be 16 because it's doubling each time'
Explain the pattern they found and why they think it works
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 注意到一个规律——比如数字规律、词尾规律或反复出现的事物——会用这个规律来推断接下来是什么或预测新情况吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 讲给别人听
topics.description: 学到新东西后，用自己的话讲出来——讲给自己、家人，甚至玩具听
evidence: Explain a concept they've learned to someone else in their own words, not just repeating what the teacher said
After teaching something to a friend or sibling, identify a gap in their own understanding that they only noticed through explaining
Summarise a lesson by pretending to teach it back, using examples they made up themselves
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 在学校学了新内容后，能用自己的话讲给你听吗——而不只是重复别人说过的话？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 换个方法试试
topics.description: 当第一种方法行不通时，换一种方法——灵活调整策略是优秀学习者的特质
evidence: When stuck on a problem, try a completely different approach rather than repeating the same method — e.g. drawing a picture instead of writing equations
Describe a time they changed strategy mid-task and explain why the new approach worked better
Accept that their first idea might not work and show willingness to start over with a fresh plan
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用一种方法解题行不通，会换一种思路，而不是重复同样的做法吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 描述规则与规律
topics.description: 当你发现一个规律反复出现时，把它描述成一条每次都成立的规则——再检验这条规则在新情况下是否成立
evidence: Describe a pattern or rule they've noticed in their own words — e.g. 'Every time you add 0 to a number, it stays the same'
Test whether a rule they've described holds for new examples they haven't seen before
Explain the difference between noticing a pattern and proving it always works
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 发现了一个规律——比如语法规则或数字规律——能把它描述成一条通用规则，再检验它在新例子中是否成立吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 从错误中学习
topics.description: 当你做错一件事时，去探究原因——你误解了什么，或者忽略了什么？分析错误是最有效的学习方式之一
evidence: error analysis research
Hattie feedback effect size
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在测验或活动中做错时，他们会去看这个错误、弄明白哪里出了问题——而不是直接跳过去吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 迁移技能
topics.description: 能识别出在一门学科或一种情境中学到的技能或策略，可以应用到完全不同的学科或情境中
evidence: transfer of learning research
Perkins & Salomon transfer taxonomy
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 有没有发现过，自己在一门学科里学到的东西——比如整理信息的方法——能帮到另一门完全不同的学科？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 理解为什么
topics.description: 不止于知道某件事*是真的*——还要追问它*为什么*是真的、*如何*运作
evidence: Ask 'why?' or 'how does that work?' about something they've been told, rather than just accepting it
Explain the reason behind a rule or method — e.g. 'We carry the ten because 13 ones is the same as 1 ten and 3 ones'
Show deeper understanding by connecting a new idea to something they already know — e.g. 'Oh, that's like when we...'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 学到某个知识点时，会经常问“可是为什么”吗——想弄明白背后的原因，而不只是接受它？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 选择策略
topics.description: 开始学习任务前，有意识地选择一种策略；完成后，诚实地评估这个策略是否真的有用
evidence: Before starting a task, name the strategy they plan to use and explain why — e.g. 'I'll make a mind map first because there's a lot to organise'
After finishing, honestly evaluate whether their chosen strategy helped or whether a different one would have been better
Describe at least three different learning strategies and explain when each works best
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 会聊到自己打算*怎么*学习或练习某件事吗——事后还会想一想这个方法有没有用？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 学习后反思
topics.description: 完成一段学习后，反思整个过程：什么帮助最大，哪里让人困惑，下次你会怎么做不一样？
evidence: Kolb reflective learning cycle
Hattie & Timperley feedback model
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 在学校完成一个项目或主题后，会反思学习过程吗——不只是结果好不好，而是什么有效、什么无效？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 发现知识缺口
topics.description: 审视自己对整个主题的理解——找出哪些知识扎实、哪些不牢固、哪些还需要加强
evidence: metacognitive monitoring research
Flavell metacognition framework
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 对某个完整主题理解得怎么样，他们能诚实地说出哪些部分有信心、哪些部分还需要多练吗？

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 设定学习目标
topics.description: 设定一个具体的学习目标，用有计划的行动去实现它，然后诚实评估自己是否达成、会做哪些改变
evidence: Set a specific, achievable learning goal for themselves — e.g. 'By Friday I want to know all my 7-times tables' rather than just 'get better at maths'
Make a simple plan for how to reach their goal and follow through on it over several days
After the deadline, honestly assess whether they achieved the goal and describe what they would do differently next time
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 会给自己设定具体的学习目标吗——比如“我想在这周末前把乘法口诀练得更好”——然后诚实判断自己有没有做到？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 买家与卖家
topics.description: 当有人制作或拥有某样东西时，可以把它卖出去；当有人想要某样东西时，可以把它买下来；这是对交换和交易概念的入门
evidence: Explain what a buyer does and what a seller does
Act out a simple buying and selling transaction with a partner
Describe a time they or a family member bought something from a person (market stall, car boot sale, bake sale)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在学校集市上摆了个摊位，他们能说清楚谁是买家、谁是卖家，以及各自做什么吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 商品与服务
topics.description: 有些人制造东西（商品），有些人为他人做事（服务）；能在日常生活中识别这两种形式，并理解两者都有价值
evidence: Sort a set of pictures into goods (things you can touch) and services (things people do for you)
Give three examples of goods and three examples of services from their everyday life
Explain that both making things and helping people are valuable kinds of work
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出在商店买的产品和理发这样的服务有什么区别，并各举几个例子吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 制作东西来卖
topics.description: 亲手制作产品来出售的体验——手工艺品、绘画、烘焙食品；什么让一件东西值得购买；为自己做出的、别人想要的东西感到自豪
evidence: Create a simple product (craft, drawing, baked item) that could be sold
Explain what makes their product good enough for someone to want to buy it
Suggest a fair price for their product and give a reason
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在家里做了些东西——比如友谊手链或装饰饼干——他们能解释为什么有人会想买吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 谁是顾客？
topics.description: 理解顾客就是购买你所制作或所做之事的人；思考顾客想要什么、需要什么；生意是为人服务的这一理念
evidence: Define what a customer is in their own words
Suggest what a customer might look for when deciding whether to buy something (quality, price, looks nice)
Explain why it matters to think about what the customer wants, not just what you want to make
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 打算在学校活动上卖柠檬水，他们能想到怎样让人们更愿意买自己的柠檬水，而不是别人的吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 做一个好卖家
topics.description: 商业中的客户服务、公平和诚实；对顾客信守承诺；为什么值得信赖对回头客和声誉很重要
evidence: Explain why being honest about what you're selling matters
Describe what good customer service looks like (being polite, helpful, keeping promises)
Give an example of how being unfair or dishonest could hurt a business
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把东西卖给了朋友，第二天就坏了，他们能理解为什么应该把事情处理好，而不是置之不理吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 成本与收入
topics.description: 制作东西要花钱（成本/支出）；卖出去能赚钱（收入）；收入大于成本就是利润；成本大于收入就是亏损
evidence: Explain what costs, revenue, and profit mean using a simple example
Calculate profit from a given scenario (e.g. spent £3 on ingredients, sold cakes for £8, profit = £5)
Explain what happens if costs are higher than revenue (you make a loss)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 花了 4 英镑买柠檬水摊的材料，卖柠檬水赚了 10 英镑，他们能说出自己赚了多少利润吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 拥有一个商业点子
topics.description: 商业点子从哪里来；发现日常生活中的问题并想出解决办法；发明新东西和改进已有东西之间的区别
evidence: Identify a simple everyday problem and suggest a product or service that could solve it
Explain the difference between an invention (something new) and an innovation (making something better)
Describe where one real entrepreneur got their business idea from
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 想一个在学校或家里遇到的问题，并通过制作或出售东西来解决它，他们能想出一个点子吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 从失败中学习
topics.description: 不是每个商业点子都能成功；创业者尝试、失败、学习，然后再试一次；迭代和抗挫力是核心的创业能力；从失败走向成功的著名故事
evidence: Give an example of a famous entrepreneur who failed before succeeding
Explain what they would do differently if a business idea didn't work the first time
Describe why failing and trying again is better than giving up
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 第一次尝试某个项目或商业点子没有成功，他们会把它看作改进的机会，而不是放弃的理由吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 做一个简单的计划
topics.description: 开始做生意之前，做一个简单的计划：我要做什么或做什么事，谁来买，我需要什么，要花多少钱，我要定什么价格？
evidence: Write or draw a simple business plan covering: product, customer, materials needed, and price
Identify at least three things they would need before they could start selling
Explain why planning ahead is better than just starting without thinking
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想在学校集市上做点小生意，他们能写一个简单的计划，说明要卖什么、需要什么、收多少钱吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 营销基础
topics.description: 人们如何了解到你在卖的东西：招牌、海报、社交媒体、口口相传；如何说服别人；广告和推广的基础知识
evidence: Design a simple poster or advert for a product or service
Name at least three ways to let people know about something you're selling
Explain why a catchy name or eye-catching design helps sell more
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想为洗车活动或烘焙义卖做宣传，能设计出一张让人想来参加的海报吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 商业中的团队合作
topics.description: 大多数企业都需要不止一个人；一起合作、分工、发挥不同人的长处；团队合作在商业中的价值
evidence: Describe how they would divide tasks in a team business project (one person makes, one sells, one designs)
Explain why using people's different strengths makes a business better
Give an example of a problem that could happen if a team doesn't work well together
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 和朋友们一起在集市上摆摊，能提出怎样分工，让每个人都发挥自己的长处吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 商业伦理
topics.description: 诚实、公平、善待员工、不破坏环境；什么样的企业算是“好”企业；企业是否应该不只关心利润
evidence: Name at least two things that make a business ethical (fair wages, honest advertising, environmentally responsible)
Explain why a business that only cares about profit might cause problems
Describe a situation where a business owner faces an ethical choice and suggest what they should do
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说一家公司给员工的工资很低，只为了赚更多利润，能解释为什么这不公平，并提出更好的做法吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 推介一个想法
topics.description: 有说服力地向别人展示一个商业想法；说明它好在哪里、为什么人们应该支持它；培养在公众面前表达想法的自信
evidence: Deliver a 1-2 minute pitch for a business idea covering: what it is, who it helps, and why it's good
Answer at least two questions about their idea from an audience
Explain why being able to explain your idea clearly matters for getting support
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要站在全班面前，用两分钟讲一个商业想法，能自信而有说服力地讲出来吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 真实的创业者
topics.description: 从小就开始创业的真实创业者的故事：Mikaila Ulmer（Me & the Bees）、Moziah Bridges（Mo's Bows）、Cory Nieves（Mr. Cory's Cookies）；是什么让人成为创业者
evidence: Retell the story of at least one real entrepreneur who started as a child
Identify three qualities that helped that entrepreneur succeed (creativity, persistence, passion)
Explain what the word 'entrepreneur' means in their own words
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲一个从小就开始创业的真实人物的故事，并说明哪些品质帮助他们取得了成功吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 扩大规模
topics.description: 小企业成长时会发生什么；生产更多产品、招人、接触更多顾客；扩大规模的挑战和机会
evidence: Describe what 'scaling up' means for a business
Identify at least two challenges of growing a business (need more money, more people, more materials)
Explain how a lemonade stand could grow into a bigger business step by step
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在学校集市上的小生意变得特别受欢迎，有更多人都想买，能说明需要做哪些改变吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 社会企业
topics.description: 用商业技能帮助他人或解决社会和环境问题；既赚钱又带来改变；社会企业的例子
evidence: Explain what a social enterprise is in their own words (a business that helps people or the planet)
Give an example of a real social enterprise or charity shop
Suggest a social enterprise idea that could help their school or community
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能想出一个既赚钱又能帮助他人或环境的商业点子吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 供应链
topics.description: 产品到达顾客手中之前来自哪里；原材料、制造、运输和销售；一个产品从头到尾的旅程
evidence: Trace the journey of a familiar product (e.g. chocolate bar) from raw material to shop shelf
Identify at least three stages in a supply chain
Explain why a long supply chain can make a product more expensive
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 一块巧克力从可可农场到商店货架要经过哪些环节，能说出这段旅程的主要步骤吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 买东西
topics.description: 买卖是怎么回事：价格、付钱、找零；商店和市场里基本的交易过程
evidence: Explain what happens when you buy something in a shop (choose, pay, get change)
Read a price label and say whether they have enough money to buy the item
Act out a simple buying scenario using real or play coins
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有一枚 2 英镑硬币，想买一份 80 便士的零食，能大致算出该找回多少钱吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 硬币与纸币
topics.description: 认识常见的硬币和纸币，知道它们的面值，并理解不同的组合可以凑出同样的金额
evidence: Sort a handful of mixed coins into groups by value
State the value of common coins and notes when shown them
Find two different ways to make the same amount using different coins
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果把一罐硬币倒出来，{{name}} 能把它们分类，并说出每种值多少钱吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 人们做的工作
topics.description: 人们从事的各种工作；人们通过工作挣钱；工作如何帮助社区；把个人兴趣和可能的工作联系起来
evidence: Name at least five different jobs and describe what each person does
Explain that people get paid money for the work they do
Connect a personal interest to a job (e.g. 'I like animals so I could be a vet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能跟你聊聊你们社区里人们做的不同工作，并说明人们工作是有报酬的吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 保管好钱
topics.description: 把钱保管好；不弄丢硬币或纸币；理解钱有真实的价值，应当小心对待；基本的金钱责任感
evidence: Describe at least two ways to keep money safe (purse, wallet, money box, giving to a grown-up)
Explain why it matters if you lose money
Show that they treat real coins and notes carefully rather than leaving them lying around
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果在商店里给 {{name}} 一些硬币让他保管，他能保管好，并记得自己放在哪儿了吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 需要与想要
topics.description: 我们需要的东西（食物、住所、衣服）和我们想要的东西（玩具、零食）之间的区别；因为钱有限，有时必须做选择
evidence: Sort a set of pictures into 'need' and 'want' categories and explain their choices
Give an example of something everyone needs and something that is a want
Explain why a family might choose to buy a need before a want
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一件冬衣、一个玩具机器人和一条面包的图片，他能说出哪些是需要、哪个是想要吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 存钱
topics.description: 人们为什么要存钱；存钱罐和储蓄罐；设定储蓄目标；现在不花意味着以后拥有更多的道理
evidence: Explain why someone might save money instead of spending it straight away
Describe a savings goal they could set and how they would work towards it
Tell you what delayed gratification means in their own words (waiting to get something better)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 收到一些生日钱，他能说出为什么存下一部分、而不是一次全花掉可能更明智吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 钱是什么
topics.description: 钱是什么，我们为什么用钱；钱用来交换商品和服务；从以物易物到硬币再到数字支付的简要历史
evidence: Explain that people use money to pay for things they need or want
Give an example of how buying worked before money existed (swapping or bartering)
Name at least two forms money can take (coins, notes, card, phone payment)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 为什么人们用钱而不是直接交换东西，他能给你一个合理的回答吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 广告与消费
topics.description: 广告如何试图影响我们买什么；做一个有判断力的消费者；理解“物有所值”；情绪化消费和理性消费的区别
evidence: Spot at least two persuasion techniques in a real advert (bright colours, celebrity, special offer)
Explain what 'value for money' means and compare two similar products at different prices
Describe a time when advertising made them want something they didn't really need
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到玩具或游戏的广告时，他能意识到广告是在设法让他想买吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 银行与储蓄
topics.description: 银行是做什么的，人们为什么使用银行；银行账户是存放钱的安全地方；存在银行里的钱可以赚取利息；儿童储蓄账户
evidence: Explain what a bank does in simple terms (keeps money safe, lets you save)
Describe what interest means (the bank pays you a little extra for keeping money there)
Name one reason a bank account is safer than keeping all your money at home
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释银行是做什么的，以及为什么人们把钱存进银行而不是全放在家里吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 零花钱预算
topics.description: 什么是预算；规划如何花一笔固定金额的零花钱或生活费；在想买的不同东西之间做取舍
evidence: Create a simple spending plan for £10 showing what they would buy and how much is left
Explain what a budget is and why it helps to plan spending
Identify a trade-off (choosing one thing means not having enough for another)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 10 英镑要在学校集市上花，他们能提前规划好买什么，让钱够用吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 赚钱
topics.description: 儿童和成人赚钱的方式；工作、技能与报酬之间的联系；更辛苦或技能要求更高的工作通常报酬更高
evidence: Name at least three different ways people can earn money
Explain why a doctor might earn more than a shop assistant (training, skills, responsibility)
Describe a way a child could earn money (chores, car wash, selling crafts)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么有些工作报酬比其他工作高，并说出一种自己可以赚钱的方式吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 公平贸易与道德
topics.description: 产品来自哪里、由谁制造；世界各地的人们生产我们购买的东西；工人获得公平报酬；作为消费者做出符合道德的选择
evidence: Explain that the things we buy are made by real people, sometimes in other countries
Describe what 'fair trade' means in simple terms (workers get paid fairly)
Give an example of a kind choice a shopper could make (buying fair trade chocolate, choosing less packaging)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在巧克力棒上看到公平贸易标志，他们能解释这个标志是什么意思、为什么重要吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 找零
topics.description: 计算购物后的找零；熟练地同时处理英镑和便士；解决涉及加法和减法的实际金钱问题
evidence: Calculate the change from £5 when buying items costing pounds and pence
Add two or three prices together to find a total cost
Check whether they have been given the correct change in a role-play scenario
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 花 2.75 英镑买了一本漫画，用 5 英镑纸币付款，他们能算出应该找回 2.25 英镑吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 支付方式
topics.description: 不同的支付方式：现金、借记卡、非接触式支付、网上支付、手机支付；数字支付用的仍然是真钱；保护好支付信息
evidence: Name at least four different ways people can pay for things
Explain that tapping a card or phone still spends real money from a bank account
Give one reason why you should keep card numbers and passwords private
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否明白，当你刷卡或用手机支付时，即使看不到硬币易手，真实的钱也已经从你的银行账户里扣掉了？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 借贷与债务
topics.description: 借钱意味着什么；贷款必须连本带息偿还；什么是信用；为什么债务过多会有风险；负责任地借贷
evidence: Explain what a loan is and that borrowed money must be paid back with extra (interest)
Give an example of when borrowing might be sensible (buying a house) versus risky (buying luxuries you can't afford)
Describe what happens if someone borrows too much money and can't repay it
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么借钱要还的钱比借的金额多，以及为什么这很重要吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 财务规划
topics.description: 设定较长期的财务目标；规划并安排花钱的优先顺序；定期储蓄如何随时间积少成多；在金钱上提前规划的价值
evidence: Set a realistic savings goal and calculate how long it would take saving a fixed amount each week
Create a simple financial plan for a specific purpose (birthday party, school trip, gift)
Explain why planning ahead with money is better than spending everything as it comes in
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想攒钱买一件 30 英镑的东西，他们能制定一个切合实际的计划，算出需要攒多久吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 全球贸易
topics.description: 为什么国家之间要互相贸易；进口与出口；商品如何走遍世界；不同国家使用不同的货币
evidence: Explain why countries buy goods from other countries (they can't make everything themselves)
Give examples of imported and exported products from their own country
Explain that different countries use different currencies and you need to exchange money when travelling
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看看你家厨房里物品上的标签，能说出为什么这么多东西来自不同的国家吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 经济如何运转
topics.description: 什么是经济；生产者与消费者；供给与需求；价格为什么会变；市场如何运转的基础知识
evidence: Explain what 'supply and demand' means using a simple example (ice cream on a hot day)
Describe the difference between a producer and a consumer
Give a reason why the price of something might go up or down
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么夏天在海滩上买冰淇淋可能比冬天在超市买更贵吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 诈骗与网络安全
topics.description: 识别金融诈骗和套路；钓鱼邮件和假网站；在网上保护个人和财务信息；“好得不像真的，多半就是假的”
evidence: Identify at least two warning signs of a scam (asking for personal details, too-good-to-be-true offers, urgency)
Explain why you should never share passwords or bank details online
Describe what to do if they receive a suspicious message or email (don't click, tell an adult)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 收到一条消息说自己中奖了，只需填写个人信息，他们能判断出这很可能是诈骗吗？

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 税收与公共服务
topics.description: 什么是税、人们为什么要交税；税收如何为学校、医院、道路和紧急服务提供资金；政府决定如何花税款
evidence: Explain what tax is and that most working adults pay it
Name at least three things that taxes pay for (schools, hospitals, roads, police, fire service)
Describe why taxes are needed (everyone chips in so everyone benefits)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释大家都能用的学校、医院这类设施，钱是从哪里来的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加法与减法应用题
topics.description: 借助实物或图画，解决 10 以内的加法与减法应用题
evidence: Solve 'There are 6 apples, 2 are eaten, how many left?' using counters
Solve 'add to' and 'take from' result-unknown problems
Solve 'put together/take apart' problems with total unknown
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你说“篱笆上有 7 只鸟，飞走了 3 只——还剩几只？”，{{name}} 能掰手指、用计数物或快速画一画算出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加法就是把两组合在一起
topics.description: 理解加法就是把两组合在一起或放到一起，求出总数
evidence: Model 'putting together' with physical objects and say the total
Act out an 'add to' situation (e.g. 3 children arrive, then 2 more join)
Explain that addition means finding how many altogether

Decide whether to round to the nearest 100 or 1,000 for a given estimation context
Identify that a calculated answer of 3,421 cannot be correct because the estimate gives approximately 50,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 做加法得出 4,213，他们能把数字估算一下来复核——比如“4,000 + 1,000 ≈ 5,000”——并发现答案是不是差得太远吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 熟练的加法与减法（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 用标准竖式算法熟练计算四位数以上的整数加法和减法
evidence: Calculate 34,567 + 28,945 using columnar addition
Calculate 500,000 − 234,178 using columnar subtraction with multiple exchanges
Add three five-digit numbers in a single column layout
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用竖式准确计算大数加法或减法——比如“23,846 + 14,579”——不管有多少位，都能正确进位和退位吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 心算加法与减法（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 运用位值知识和推导出的事实，心算越来越大的数的加法和减法
evidence: Mentally calculate 45,000 + 8,000
Mentally subtract 3,200 from 10,000 by counting up
Use near-doubles: 2,500 + 2,600 = 5,100
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用心算算出像“4,700 − 1,300”这样的题吗——用他们掌握的位值知识，不用全部写出来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加法与减法（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 在情境中解决加法和减法的多步问题，判断该用哪些运算和方法并说明理由，涉及一千万以内的数和小数
evidence: Solve a two-step word problem involving addition and subtraction of numbers beyond 1,000,000
Choose between mental, written, and calculator methods for a multi-step problem and justify the choice
Interpret a real-life context to identify which addition/subtraction operations are needed across multiple steps
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一道涉及大数或小数的复杂应用题——比如计算几件商品的总价——他们能规划并正确完成所有步骤吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加法与减法策略（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 运用基于位值、运算性质以及加法与减法关系的策略，计算到百分位的小数加法和减法；把策略与笔算方法联系起来并说明推理过程
evidence: Correctly compute 3.45 + 2.78 and explain regrouping across decimal places
Use a number line or base-ten blocks to model 5.03 − 2.67
Explain why the standard algorithm works for decimal addition by connecting to place-value understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能计算像“4.73 + 2.68”或“10.00 − 3.47”这样的小数加法或减法，把小数点对齐并正确逐位计算吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 正数与负数
topics.description: 理解正数和负数用来描述方向或数值相反的量；在温度、楼层、银行余额等情境中使用它们
evidence: Represent positive and negative numbers on a number line and explain what zero means in context
Add a positive or negative number to any integer using number line reasoning
Subtract a positive or negative number from any integer, understanding that subtracting a negative is equivalent to adding
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在天气预报里看到 −3°C 和 +5°C 这样的温度，他们能算出一天比另一天暖和多少吗——即使答案要跨过零？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 含两个未知数的方程
topics.description: 找出满足含两个未知数方程的数对（例如找出满足 a + b = 10 或 2a + b = 15 的数对 (a, b)）
evidence: List all whole-number pairs (a, b) where a + b = 12 with a, b > 0
Find three pairs that satisfy 2x + y = 20
Explain systematically how to generate all integer solutions to a two-variable equation within a given range
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能找出满足同一规则的不同数对吗？比如，所有相加等于 10 的整数对。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 线性数列
topics.description: 生成并描述线性数列，包括步长为负数和步长为小数的数列；找出相邻两项之间的规律
evidence: Continue the sequence 2.5, 4.0, 5.5, ... and state the rule as 'add 1.5'
Generate terms of a sequence that crosses zero (e.g. 3, 1, −1, −3, ...)
Describe the term-to-term rule for a given linear sequence and predict the 10th term
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到像 3、7、11、15……这样的数列，能说出规律、接着往下写，并预测第 10 个数是多少吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数字规律之间的关系
topics.description: 按照两条给定规则生成两个数字规律；找出对应项之间的关系；组成有序数对并在坐标平面上描点作图
evidence: Generate sequences starting at 0 with rules 'add 3' and 'add 6'; observe terms in one are twice the other
Form ordered pairs from corresponding terms and plot them on a coordinate grid
Explain informally why the relationship between the two sequences holds
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能同时跟踪两个数字规律吗？比如“加 2”和“加 4”，把对应的项配成对，再把这些数对作为点画在图上。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 系统列举
topics.description: 系统地列举两个变量组合的所有可能（例如从一组选项中选出的所有方式）
evidence: List all possible meal combinations from 3 starters and 4 mains
Organise combinations into a systematic table to ensure none are missed
Explain why the total number of combinations equals the product of the options in each category
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 可以从 3 种 T 恤颜色和 2 种裤子颜色中任意搭配，能把所有可能的搭配都列出来，既不遗漏也不重复吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 使用简单公式
topics.description: 使用用文字或符号表示的简单公式进行计算（例如周长 = 2 ×（长 + 宽））
evidence: Substitute values into P = 2(l + w) to find the perimeter of a rectangle
Use the formula for area of a triangle (A = 1/2 × b × h) given base and height values
Interpret a formula expressed in words and use it to compute an output
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果告诉 {{name}} 长方形的周长用公式“周长 = 2 ×（长 + 宽）”计算，能把测量数据代入公式并算出答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 列代数方程
topics.description: 用字母表示未知数，把求缺失数的问题用代数方式表达出来；把文字题转化成方程
evidence: Write 'I think of a number, double it, and add 5 to get 17' as 2n + 5 = 17
Solve a one-step equation such as 3x = 24 and explain the reasoning
Express a word problem as an algebraic equation and find the unknown value
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到“我想一个数，把它翻倍，再加 5 得到 17”，能用字母表示未知数写成方程并求解吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代数记号
topics.description: 使用并理解代数记号，包括：ab 表示 a × b，3y 表示 y + y + y，a² 表示 a × a，a/b 表示 a ÷ b，系数用分数表示，以及用括号分组；能流利地读写代数式
evidence: Read and interpret expressions using standard algebraic conventions for multiplication, division, and powers
Write algebraic expressions from word descriptions using correct notation
Understand that juxtaposition means multiplication and that a/b means a divided by b
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在数学题中看到“3y”或“a²”这样的写法时，知道这些简写记号是什么意思，并能用它们进行计算吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代数转换
topics.description: 把情境或过程转化成代数式或公式，并借助图象建立模型；在文字题、代数表示、表格和图象表示之间灵活转换
evidence: Translate a word problem or real-world situation into an algebraic expression or formula
Construct a table of values from an algebraic rule
Plot the corresponding graph and interpret it in the context of the problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能针对一个真实情境——比如出租车起步价 £2、每英里 £1.50——写出总费用的代数公式，并画出大致图象吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 合并同类项
topics.description: 通过合并同类项来化简代数式——把变量和指数相同的项合并在一起（例如 3a + 2b + 5a = 8a + 2b），同时保持等式成立
evidence: Identify like terms in an algebraic expression
Combine like terms involving positive and negative coefficients
Simplify expressions involving multiple variables and constant terms
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到像“5a + 3b + 2a”这样的式子，能通过合并同类项把它化简成“7a + 3b”吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 坐标（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 在笛卡尔平面的四个象限中描点和读坐标，用正负 x 值和 y 值精确描述位置
evidence: Plot points with negative coordinates accurately in all four quadrants
Identify the quadrant a point belongs to from its coordinate signs
Read coordinates from a graph including fractional and negative values
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在坐标网格上正确描出像 (−3, 4) 这样的点，并读出四个象限中各个点的坐标（包括负数）吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 展开单项式乘括号
topics.description: 利用分配律把括号外的单项式乘进括号里展开，例如 3(2x + 5) = 6x + 15；能展开含负系数的式子
evidence: Multiply a single positive term over a bracket to expand the expression
Multiply a negative term over a bracket, correctly handling signs
Combine expanding brackets with collecting like terms to simplify fully
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把 3(2x + 5) 这样的括号展开，把括号里的每一项都乘一遍，得到 6x + 15 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代数式与方程词汇
topics.description: 理解并使用代数式、方程、不等式、项和因式等概念与词汇；能区分代数式（没有等号）、方程（有等号）和不等式（有不等号）
evidence: Define and distinguish between expression, equation, and inequality
Identify terms, coefficients, and factors in algebraic expressions
Use the vocabulary of algebra precisely in mathematical discussions
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出像“3x + 2”这样的代数式、“3x + 2 = 11”这样的方程和“3x + 2 > 11”这样的不等式之间有什么区别吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 生成数列
topics.description: 根据相邻项之间的规律（如“每次加 3”）或项与序号之间的规律（如“2n + 1”）写出数列的各项，并判断一个数列是等差数列、等比数列还是都不是
evidence: Continue a sequence given a term-to-term rule involving addition, subtraction, or multiplication
Generate the first five terms from a position-to-term formula such as 3n − 2
Classify sequences as arithmetic (constant difference), geometric (constant ratio), or other
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能算出 5, 8, 11, 14… 这样的数列接下来几项，并说明规律是“每次加一个固定的数”还是别的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的数
topics.description: 把不等式理解为比较代数式的语句，在数轴上表示解集，并用与解方程相同的逆运算方法解简单的一元一次不等式
evidence: Write an inequality from a worded constraint (e.g., 'must be at least 12' → x ≥ 12)
Represent the solution set of an inequality on a number line with open or closed circles
Solve a one-step or two-step inequality such as 3x + 1 < 10
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解出像 2x + 1 < 9 这样的不等式，把答案表示在数轴上，并说出所有解有什么共同点吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 解一元一次方程
topics.description: 用代数方法解一元一次方程，包括需要移项、展开括号、两边合并同类项的方程；能解系数为有理数的方程
evidence: Solve one-step and two-step linear equations in one variable
Solve equations requiring expansion of brackets and collection of like terms
Solve equations with the unknown on both sides and with fractional or negative coefficients
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一个像 3x + 7 = 22 这样的方程，能一步步求出 x 的值吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代入公式
topics.description: 把数值代入公式和代数式（包括科学公式）；用给定的值替换变量，并按正确的运算顺序算出结果
evidence: Substitute positive and negative values into algebraic expressions and evaluate
Substitute values into formulae involving multiple operations and powers
Use correct order of operations when evaluating expressions after substitution
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果公式说三角形的面积是 ½ × 底 × 高，{{name}} 能把测量值代进去并正确算出答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 因式分解表达式
topics.description: 通过提取公因式来因式分解代数表达式——找出所有项的最大公因式，把表达式写成乘积形式，例如 6x + 9 = 3(2x + 3)
evidence: Identify the highest common factor of all terms in an expression
Write the factorised form as a product of the HCF and a bracket
Check factorisation by expanding the brackets back out
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看到像“6x + 9”这样的表达式时，能提取公因式把它改写成“3(2x + 3)”吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一次函数图像
topics.description: 认识一次函数的图像是一条直线，理解 y = mx + c 形式的方程与其图像之间的关系，并能结合实际情境解释斜率和 y 轴截距
evidence: Explain that changing m in y = mx + c alters the steepness and direction of the line
Identify the y-intercept of a line from its equation and from its graph
Determine whether a given equation will produce a straight line or a curve
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到方程 y = 2x + 3，能说出它的图像是什么样子吗——包括有多陡、在哪里穿过 y 轴？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 第 n 项规律
topics.description: 通过找出公差和第零项，求出等差数列的第 n 项表达式，并用它确定数列中的任意一项，或检验某个数是否属于该数列
evidence: Derive the nth-term rule for an arithmetic sequence such as 3, 7, 11, 15, … as 4n − 1
Use an nth-term formula to find the 50th or 100th term without listing all preceding terms
Determine whether a given number (e.g., 99) is a term in a specified arithmetic sequence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 数列 4, 7, 10, 13……，能求出第 n 项的公式吗——并用它检验比如 100 是否在这个数列里？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 绘制一次函数图像
topics.description: 通过列出数值表来绘制一次函数图像，把含两个变量的一次方程化为 y = mx + c 的形式，并根据直线上两点计算斜率
evidence: Generate a table of (x, y) values for a linear equation and plot the points accurately
Rearrange an equation such as 2x + 3y = 12 into the form y = mx + c
Calculate the gradient between two coordinate points using rise over run
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能通过列数值表、描点来画出一条直线的图像吗——并根据直线上的两点算出斜率？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 简单公式
topics.description: 理解并使用标准数学公式；通过逆运算把公式变形、更换主元，从而解出另一个变量
evidence: Identify the subject of a given formula
Use inverse operations to rearrange a formula to make a different variable the subject
Rearrange formulae involving multiple steps including fractions and powers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个公式用路程 ÷ 时间来表示速度，当路程或时间未知时，{{name}} 能把公式变形来求它们吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算答案（13 岁以上）
topics.description: 利用一次函数和二次函数的图像，根据给定的输入估算输出值，求方程的近似解，并解读实际情境中的图像信息
evidence: Read off an approximate y-value for a given x from a plotted curve
Find approximate solutions to an equation by identifying where a graph crosses the x-axis or another line
Interpret a real-world graph (e.g., distance–time) to answer contextual questions
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能借助图像——无论是直线还是曲线——近似读出方程的解，而不是用代数方法求解吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 展开双括号
topics.description: 展开两个或多个二项式的乘积，例如 (x + 3)(x - 2) = x² + x - 6，可用网格法或 FOIL 法；再通过合并同类项化简结果
evidence: Expand the product of two binomials using a systematic method (grid or FOIL)
Collect like terms after expansion to simplify the result
Expand products involving negative terms correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把 (x + 3)(x − 2) 这样的两个括号乘开，合并同类项得到 x² + x − 6 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二次函数图像
topics.description: 认识二次函数的图像是曲线（抛物线），能把它与一次函数图像区分开，并利用画出的二次函数图像估算数值、求近似解
evidence: Explain why x² produces a U-shaped curve rather than a straight line
Plot a simple quadratic such as y = x² − 4 from a table of values
Read approximate solutions from a quadratic graph (e.g., where y = 0)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能认识到 y = x² 这样的方程画出来是曲线而不是直线，并利用画出的曲线估算数值吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 联立方程
topics.description: 理解两个线性方程可以通过找到它们图像相交的点来同时求解，并能从图像和代数两个角度理解：这一对数值同时满足两个方程
evidence: Explain that the intersection of two lines represents values satisfying both equations
Find the approximate solution to a pair of simultaneous equations by reading a graph
Verify a proposed solution by substituting into both equations
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释同时解两个方程就是找到一对同时满足两个方程的值吗？能展示这在图像上是什么样子吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较两组：更多或更少
topics.description: 比较两组物体，判断哪组更多、哪组更少，或者两组是否相等，可以运用配对和数数的方法
evidence: Use one-to-one matching to compare two groups
State which group has more/fewer after counting both
Use the language 'equal to', 'more than', 'less than', 'fewer', 'most', 'least'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你一只手放 6 颗葡萄干，另一只手放 4 颗，问 {{name}} 哪只手更多，他能判断出来吗？不管是数一数还是直接看？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一共有多少？
topics.description: 基数原则：数一组物体时，最后说出的那个数字就代表这组物体的总数，不管怎么排列、按什么顺序数
evidence: After counting a set, answer 'how many?' with the last number stated
Understand that rearranging objects does not change the count
Understand that counting in a different order gives the same total
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 数出 7 辆玩具车，你问“那一共有几辆车？”，他会马上说“7”吗？还是又从 1 开始重新数一遍？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 每次多一个
topics.description: 每一个后续的计数数字都代表比前一个数字多一的量
evidence: Given a set of 5, know that adding one object makes 6
Explain that 8 is one more than 7
Given a number, identify one more and one less
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 5 张贴纸，你再给他一张，他能马上知道现在有 6 张吗？不需要从 1 开始重新数一遍？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一一对应数数
topics.description: 数物体时的一一对应：每个物体只对应一个数字名称
evidence: Point to or touch each object exactly once while saying number names
Do not skip objects or double-count when counting a set
Recognise an error when someone counts an object twice
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在数一堆葡萄，他每说一个数字时，会摸一下或指一下每颗葡萄，而且只摸一次吗？不会跳过任何一颗，也不会把同一颗数两次？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用物体表示数字
topics.description: 用实物、图画和数轴来表示数字
evidence: Show a given number using counters, cubes, or fingers
Draw a pictorial representation of a quantity (e.g. tally marks, dots)
Locate a number on a number line
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 数字 5 长什么样，他能用不止一种方式表示吗？比如画五个点、伸出五根手指，或者在数轴上指到 5？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 两个两个地数
topics.description: 按 2、5、10 的倍数数数（跳数）
evidence: Count 2, 4, 6, 8 … up to at least 20
Count 5, 10, 15, 20 … up to at least 50
Count 10, 20, 30 … up to 100
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在数配对的袜子，他能两个两个地跳数吗？2、4、6、8，一直数到 20？他也能五个五个地数硬币，或者在数轴上十个十个地数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数物体到 20
topics.description: 数一组物体来回答“有多少？”，数量最多到 20（可以排成一行、排成阵列、围成圈或散放）
evidence: Accurately count up to 20 objects in a line
Count up to 10 scattered objects without losing track
Given a number 1–20, count out that many objects from a larger set
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你把 15 颗纽扣随意散放在桌上，问 {{name}} 一共有多少颗，他能仔细地全部数完并给出正确答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 唱数到 100
topics.description: 从 0、1 或任意给定的数开始，以 1 为单位，从 0 到 100 正向和反向唱数
evidence: Recite the number sequence 1–100 without skipping or repeating
Count backward from 20 to 0
Count forward starting from a number other than 1 (e.g. 'start at 23')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能大声从 0 数到 100 吗？如果你说“从 47 开始”，他能不能接着往下数，而不用回到开头？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 1 到 10 之间的两个书面数字
topics.description: 比较 1 到 10 之间的两个书面数字，判断哪个更大或更小
evidence: Given two written numerals (e.g. 4 and 7), identify which is greater
Correctly use > and < or 'greater than' / 'less than' to compare single-digit numerals
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你在两张纸上分别写下“3”和“8”，问 {{name}} 哪个数字更大，他能答对吗？他能说出为什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 正向和反向数数
topics.description: 从 0 开始，以 3 为单位正向和反向数数
evidence: Count 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 … up to at least 30
Count backwards in 3s from 30
Identify the next number in a sequence of multiples of 3
