topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能三个三个地数吗——3、6、9、12、15——一直数到 30，不数乱也不用重新开始？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 正向和反向数数（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 从任意数（不只是 10 的倍数）开始，以 10 为单位正向和反向数数
evidence: Count 7, 17, 27, 37 … from a non-multiple starting point
Count backwards in tens from 83
Explain the pattern of adding/subtracting 10
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 从 37 开始，你让他十个十个地往上数，他能说出 37、47、57、67——顺利跨到下一个百位而不卡住吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 1000 以内数数
topics.description: 在 1000 以内数数，包括以 5、10 和 100 为单位跳数
evidence: Count forwards and backwards within 1000 from any starting number
Skip-count by 5s from any multiple of 5 to 1000
Skip-count by 100s from any number (e.g. 150, 250, 350 …)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能自信地数到 1000 吗？如果你让他从 200 开始一百一百地数，或者从 650 开始十个十个地数，他能不数乱吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 跳数（4、8、50、100）
topics.description: 从 0 开始，以 4、8、50 和 100 的倍数数数
evidence: Recite the multiples of 4 from 0 to at least 48
Recite the multiples of 8 from 0 to at least 96
Count in steps of 50 and 100 from 0 to 1000
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能四个四个地一直数到 48，能八个八个地数，或者从任意起点一百一百地往上数吗——比如 350、450、550？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 六个六个地数
evidence: Recite the multiples of 6 from 0 to at least 72
Recite the multiples of 7 from 0 to at least 84
Count in steps of 25 from 0 to 1000 and in steps of 1000 up to 10,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能七个七个地数吗——7、14、21、28——或者九个九个地数，或者在认识硬币时二十五个二十五个地数，或者在说千米这样的距离时一千一千地数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 按类别分类
topics.description: 把物体按给定类别分类，数出每个类别里的数量，并按数量给类别排序
evidence: Sort a set of shapes by colour and count how many in each group
Sort objects by size (big/small) and state how many in each category
Identify which category has the most/fewest after sorting and counting
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把一堆东西——比如纽扣、硬币或玩具动物——分成几组，并数出每组有多少个吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和计数表
topics.description: 解读并制作简单的象形图、计数表、方块图和简单表格
evidence: Read a pictogram where each symbol represents one item
Construct a tally chart from collected data
Draw a block diagram to represent data from a survey
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看懂简单的图表或象形图——比如显示每个孩子选了哪种最喜欢的水果——并回答“哪一种最受欢迎”这样的问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和计数表（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 读、写并运用数据收集与展示的词汇——数据、计数、计数表、频数、频数表、调查、象形图、条形图、轴、刻度、标签、类别、离散数据、连续数据、折线图、饼图——并在收集、整理和展示数据时使用这些术语
evidence: Correctly label the axes of a bar chart including a title, axis labels, and scale
Distinguish between discrete data (counted) and continuous data (measured) with an example of each
Use 'tally', 'frequency', and 'pictogram' correctly when describing how to record and display data
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想向你展示班上不同孩子上个月读了多少本书，他们能画出条形图、标出坐标轴，并说明每根柱子代表什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 把数据分类整理
topics.description: 通过数出每个类别中的物体数量，整理并展示最多三个类别的数据，并按数量对类别排序
evidence: Sort a set of objects into 2-3 given categories and count each group
Create a simple table or list showing category names and counts
Order categories from most to fewest or fewest to most
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看着一堆物体——比如不同颜色的计数器——把它们分成最多三组，数出每组有多少，并把结果整理成简单的图表吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分类整理（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过提出并回答关于总数、每个类别有多少、一个类别比另一个多多少或少多少的问题，来解读分类数据
evidence: Answer 'how many?' for each category in a data set
Calculate the total number of data points across all categories
Compare two categories using 'how many more/fewer' language
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看一张显示每个孩子选了哪种冰淇淋口味的图表，他们能回答“有多少人选了巧克力？”和“选香草的人比选草莓的人多多少？”这样的问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和条形图
topics.description: 绘制象形图和条形图（单一单位刻度），展示最多四个类别的数据集；利用条形图中的信息解决合并、拆分和比较问题
evidence: Draw a picture graph with a symbol representing one unit for each data point
Draw a bar graph with labelled axes and a single-unit scale
Use a bar graph to answer comparison questions (e.g. 'How many more votes did cats get than dogs?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能画出简单的条形图或象形图来展示信息——比如一袋糖里每种颜色各有多少颗——并根据图表回答问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 条形图
topics.description: 使用合适的图形方法（包括条形图和时间图）解读并展示离散数据和连续数据
evidence: Read a time graph showing temperature changes over a day
Present data about plant growth over weeks as a time graph
Explain the difference between a bar chart (discrete) and a time graph (continuous)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能为一些数据选择合适的图表类型——比如用条形图表示最喜欢的颜色，或用折线图表示一周的气温——并正确画出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 带刻度的象形图和条形图
topics.description: 绘制带刻度的象形图和条形图来展示数据集；利用条形图、象形图和表格解决一步和两步的比较、求和与求差问题
evidence: Draw a bar graph where each square represents 5 pets
From a scaled pictogram, answer: how many more children chose football than tennis?
Solve a two-step problem: how many votes in total for the top two choices?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看一张显示不同孩子上个月读了多少本书的条形图，他们能算出总数、找出最多和最少之间的差，并自己画一张刻度为“每格 = 2 本书”的图表吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 折线图问题
topics.description: 利用折线图中的信息解决比较、求和与求差问题
evidence: Read a line graph of temperature over a week and identify the warmest day
Find the difference in rainfall between two months from a line graph
Explain what a rising/falling line means on a time-series graph
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张显示一株植物几周来高度变化的折线图，他们能读出数值、找出它长得最快的时候，并算出两点之间的差吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 读表格
topics.description: 在表格中填写、读取和解读信息，包括时刻表
evidence: Read a bus timetable to find the departure time for a particular stop
Complete a two-way table from given data about favourite sports by gender
Calculate how long a train journey takes using a timetable
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}}能读懂时刻表——比如火车或公交时刻表——找出某趟行程几点出发、几点到达、路上要花多长时间吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 统计分析词汇
topics.description: 读、写并运用统计分析词汇——平均数、中位数、众数、极差、频数、数据、样本、平均值、图表、表格、图形、饼图、散点图、相关性——并理解每个词所描述的内容
evidence: Correctly define and calculate the mean, median, mode, and range of a small data set
Use 'outlier' correctly to identify a value that doesn't fit the pattern, and explain its effect on the mean
Use 'correlation' correctly when describing the relationship shown in a scatter graph
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到班里一次测验的成绩，能找出平均数、中位数和极差，并说明每一项分别反映了班级的什么情况吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 计算平均数
topics.description: 计算并解释一组数据的平均数
evidence: Calculate the mean of five test scores: 72, 85, 90, 68, 95
Explain what the mean represents and how it differs from individual data values
Find a missing data value given the mean and all other values
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一家人在五轮桌游中分别得了 6、8、7、5、9 分，{{name}}能算出平均分吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 折线图
topics.description: 为连续数据（如随时间变化的温度、植物生长）绘制并解读折线图；读取中间值、识别趋势，并解决比较和差值问题
evidence: Read values from a line graph showing temperature over a day, including estimating between plotted points
Construct a line graph from a table of continuous data, choosing an appropriate scale and labelling axes correctly
Use a line graph to solve a two-step problem, such as finding the time period with the greatest rate of change
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 每小时记录一次室外温度，记录了一整天，能把读数画成标注规范的折线图，再用它回答“什么时候最暖和？”或“下午 3 点到 6 点降了多少度？”这样的问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 饼图
topics.description: 解读并绘制饼图：根据数据计算各扇形的角度，准确画出扇形，并从饼图中读取数值来解决问题
evidence: Read a pie chart and determine what fraction or percentage of the total each sector represents
Construct a pie chart from given data by calculating sector angles
Use a pie chart to determine the actual quantity represented by each sector given the total
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}}能读懂饼图——比如一张显示家庭每周预算怎么花的饼图——并用它来回答问题、解决问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数
topics.description: 制作线点图，展示以单位分数（1/2、1/4、1/8）表示的测量数据；运用分数运算解决线点图中的数据问题（如把总量平均重新分配）
evidence: Create a line plot showing lengths measured to the nearest 1/8 inch
Use the line plot to find the total of all measurements by adding fractions
Solve: 'If the total liquid were redistributed equally among all beakers, how much would each have?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把几个物体的长度量到最接近的四分之一或八分之一英寸，并标在数轴上，能用这些测量值算出总量或平均分配吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较测量数据
topics.description: 用合适的集中趋势指标（平均数、中位数、众数）和离散程度指标（极差）描述、解读并比较单一变量的分布，包括异常值的影响
evidence: Calculate mean, median, and mode for a data set and explain when each is most appropriate
Find the range of a data set and explain how an outlier affects the mean versus the median
Compare two data sets using their averages and ranges to draw conclusions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拿到全班同学的测验成绩，能找出平均数、中位数和极差，并说明每一项分别反映了班级的什么表现吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 描述分布
topics.description: 从中心、离散程度和整体形状描述一组数值数据的分布——识别聚集、空隙、峰值、对称或偏斜（一侧尾巴更长）以及异常值——并结合数据收集的实际情境解读每个特征，认识到中心相近的分布也可能在离散程度和形状上差别很大
evidence: Describe a dot plot of 25 pupils' reaction times by its centre (a typical value), its spread (where most values lie and how far they extend) and its shape — naming any cluster, gap, symmetry or skew and unusual value — and link each feature to the context (e.g. a gap between two groups of times might reflect pupils who had practised and pupils who had not)

Compare two distributions with the same mean — e.g. two classes both averaging 60% on a test, one with scores clustered between 52% and 68%, the other spread from 20% to 95% in two separate clusters — and explain what the shared mean hides and why the difference matters in context

Use the context to judge whether an unusual value is more likely a recording error or a genuine extreme (e.g. a reaction time of 4.2 s among times near 0.3 s), and identify claims the display alone cannot support, such as the reason for a skew or that the same pattern would hold for a different group
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张点图，显示班里孩子跑 100 米各用了多长时间，能说出大多数成绩集中在哪里、分散程度如何、有没有特别不一样的，并为看到的情况提出一个合理的解释吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 直方图
topics.description: 在连续数轴上，把连续数据或数值数据按等宽的组距分组，绘制并解读直方图，条形之间没有空隙；说明所用的区间边界约定（例如 140 ≤ h < 150，所以恰好等于 150 的值归入下一个区间）；从条形高度读出频数；描述所呈现的分布；并解释直方图与分类条形图有何不同。不包含不等宽区间和频率密度。
evidence: Group 30 pupils' heights into equal-width 10 cm intervals (130 ≤ h < 140, 140 ≤ h < 150, …), stating that a height of exactly 150 cm is counted in the 150 ≤ h < 160 interval, and draw the histogram with a continuous horizontal scale, touching bars and labelled axes

Read frequencies accurately from a histogram (e.g. how many pupils are at least 150 cm but less than 160 cm, and how many are shorter than 150 cm in total) and describe the distribution's centre, spread and shape in context

Explain why a histogram's bars touch and sit on a numerical scale while a bar chart of categories (e.g. favourite sport) has gaps and an order that could be rearranged — and identify claims the histogram cannot support, such as the exact height of the tallest pupil or how many pupils are exactly 145 cm tall
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把全班每个人的身高按“130 厘米到 140 厘米”“140 厘米到 150 厘米”这样的组来分，他们能画出一个条形彼此相接的直方图吗？能解释为什么它和“最喜欢的颜色”条形图不是同一种图吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和计数表（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 为分类数据和分组数值数据制作并解读频数表、条形图、饼图、象形图和竖线图，并根据数据类型选择合适的表示方式
evidence: Construct a grouped frequency table from raw continuous data, choosing appropriate class intervals
Draw a pie chart by calculating the angle for each category
Interpret a bar chart comparing two data sets and draw a conclusion about the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 为某个项目收集数据时，他们能选对合适的图表类型来展示数据，并准确绘制出来，标好标签、选好合适的刻度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 统计问题
topics.description: 区分统计问题——即预期所收集的数据会有变异性、因此答案必须考虑这种变异性的问题（即使答案只报告为一个汇总值，如平均数或中位数）——与靠单一固定事实就能回答的问题；对于统计问题，能指出总体（问的是谁或什么）、所调查的属性，以及答案中预期的变异
evidence: Sort questions such as 'How tall am I?', 'How tall are the pupils in my class?', 'How many days are in March?' and 'How many hours of sleep do 12-year-olds usually get?' into statistical and non-statistical, explaining each choice by whether the answers are expected to vary

For a given statistical question, name the population and the attribute being measured, describe the variation they expect (e.g. 'sleep times will differ from person to person, perhaps from 7 to 11 hours'), and explain that a good answer must account for that variability in the data — even a single-number summary such as 'a typical 12-year-old sleeps about 9 hours' stands for many differing values, unlike the one fixed answer to 'How many days are in March?'

Explain why a question about a group can still be non-statistical (e.g. 'How many pupils are in my class?' has one fixed answer), and rewrite a non-statistical question as a statistical one (e.g. 'How long is my journey to school?' becomes 'How long are journeys to school for pupils in my year?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}}，“我们家有几只宠物？”和“你们班同学有几只宠物？”是不是同一类问题，他们能解释第二个问题有很多不同的答案——所以需要向很多人收集数据——而第一个问题只有一个答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 箱线图
topics.description: 根据五数概括（最小值、下四分位数、中位数、上四分位数、最大值）在数值刻度上绘制并解读箱线图，采用所述约定：须线延伸到最小值和最大值；解读中位数、四分位数、四分位距和极差，认识到无论画得多长多短，每条须线和箱体的每一半都大致代表数据的四分之一；解释箱线图不显示什么（各个具体数值、聚集、空隙、数值个数或平均数）；并用箱线图比较两个分布
evidence: Draw a box plot for the five-number summary 3, 6, 9, 14, 21 on a labelled scale, stating that the whiskers run from the minimum to the maximum, and read the median, quartiles, IQR (8) and range (18) back from a given box plot

Explain that the longer upper whisker (from 14 to 21) shows the top quarter of values is more spread out — not that it contains more values — and reject claims a box plot cannot support, such as 'the mean is 9', 'most values are close to 9' or the exact number of data values

Explain with an example how two data sets can have the same box plot but different shapes (e.g. one with values spread evenly, the other with two clusters separated by a gap), and compare two classes' box plots using their medians and IQRs in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到比较两个班做作业时长的箱线图，他们能说出哪个班的中位时间更高、哪个班的数据更分散吗？能解释为什么须线更长并不代表那部分孩子更多吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 根据样本进行估计
topics.description: 利用随机样本的数据估计总体的某个特征，如比例、总数或平均数；把结果呈现为估计值，而不是总体的精确测量值；说明该推断所依赖的假设（样本是从所描述的总体中随机抽取的，且具有合理的代表性），并解释当这些假设不成立时，结论如何受到限制或变得无效
evidence: Use a sample proportion to estimate a population count — e.g. 18 of a random sample of 60 pupils walk to school, so estimate about 270 of the school's 900 pupils walk — and state the answer as an approximate estimate rather than an exact count

Use the mean of a random sample (e.g. the mean weekly reading time of 25 randomly chosen pupils) to estimate the population mean, and explain why the true population mean is likely to be close to, but probably not exactly equal to, the sample mean

State the assumptions behind an estimate and explain why it becomes unreliable or invalid when they fail — e.g. using a sample of only Year 7 pupils to estimate for the whole school, or using a volunteer online poll — and identify what can and cannot be concluded from the data
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 得知学校里随机抽取的 40 名学生中有 12 人会演奏乐器，他们能估计全校 600 名学生中有多少人会演奏吗？能解释为什么这个数字是合理的估计，而不是精确的计数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 样本如何变化
topics.description: 从同一总体中生成或比较若干个大小相同的随机样本（通过从列表中实际抽取——每次抽取新样本前把抽出的项目放回并重新混合——或通过模拟），观察它们的估计值因偶然因素而不同，并利用这些估计值的离散程度来判断单个估计或预测有多不确定——区分随机样本之间的偶然变异与有偏抽样方法造成的系统性误差，并区分样本估计值之间的变异与样本内各个观测值之间的变异
evidence: Take or are given several random samples of the same size from one population (e.g. draw 20 counters from a bag without looking, record them, return all 20 and mix thoroughly, then draw the next 20 — five times; or five random samples of 20 names from a list), calculate each sample's proportion or mean, and show that the estimates differ

Explain that equal-sized random samples give different estimates because of chance in which individuals are selected, so a different result does not mean a sample was wrong — and contrast this with a biased method whose estimates are consistently too high or too low

Use the spread of several sample estimates (e.g. 'the estimates ranged from 25% to 40%') to say how far off a single estimate might be, and explain why one sample cannot make a prediction certain and why larger samples tend to give estimates that vary less

Distinguish the variation among individual observations within one sample (e.g. pupils' sleep times in one sample range from 6 to 11 hours) from the variation between sample estimates (e.g. the means of five samples of 20 pupils range from 8.6 to 9.3 hours), and explain why sample means usually vary much less than the individual values they are calculated from
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 班上同学轮流从同一个大罐子里不看地摸出 20 颗糖——数出红色糖的数量，然后把 20 颗全放回去，把罐子好好摇一摇，再让下一个人摸——{{name}} 能解释为什么每个人摸到的红色糖数量略有不同，并用大家结果的离散程度来说明他们对整罐糖中红色糖所占比例能有多确定吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 总体、样本与公平抽样
topics.description: 区分总体与从总体中抽取的样本；解释为什么图方便的或有偏的样本（选最容易接触到的人、自愿参与者，或与答案相关的群体）可能无法代表总体；解释随机抽取使总体中每个成员都有同等被选中的机会，这往往能产生有代表性的样本——同时认识到任何单个随机样本仍可能因偶然因素而不具代表性
evidence: In a described survey (e.g. a school asks 40 of its 800 pupils about the lunch menu), identify the population and the sample, and explain why a sample is used instead of asking everyone

Identify the selection bias in a sampling method (e.g. asking people leaving a gym how often they exercise, or surveying only the lunch queue on pizza day), explain the direction in which it would likely distort the result, and propose a better method using random selection from the whole population (e.g. drawing names from the full school register)

Explain the difference between random selection and simply choosing whoever is easiest to reach, and explain — with an example such as a random sample of 10 pupils that happens to contain mostly Year 7s — why random sampling makes a representative sample likely but does not guarantee it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果学校想了解全体学生对午餐菜单的看法，却只在披萨日问了排队吃午饭的孩子，{{name}} 能解释为什么这可能得出误导性的答案吗？能提出更公平的选人方式吗，比如从全校名单中随机抽名字？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 四分位数与四分位距
topics.description: 采用一种明确的约定求出一组数据的中位数、下四分位数和上四分位数——把数据排序，找出中位数，把数据分成下半部分和上半部分（数值个数为奇数时去掉中位数本身），再分别取每一半的中位数作为下四分位数和上四分位数——同时认识到其他教材、计算器和软件可能采用略有不同的约定；计算四分位距（IQR = 上四分位数 − 下四分位数），并把它理解为中间一半数据的离散程度；比较极差和四分位距所揭示的信息，包括它们对极端值敏感程度的不同
evidence: Using the stated convention, find the median (9), lower quartile (6, the median of 3, 5, 6, 7, 8) and upper quartile (14, the median of 11, 12, 14, 15, 21) of the 11 values 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 14, 15, 21, giving IQR = 8; and for the 10 values 2, 4, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 15, find median 7.5, lower quartile 4 and upper quartile 10, giving IQR = 6

Interpret an IQR in context (e.g. 'the middle half of the puzzle times lie between 6 and 14 minutes, a spread of 8 minutes') and explain that about half of the values lie between the quartiles, with about a quarter below the lower quartile and about a quarter above the upper quartile

Show that changing the largest value from 21 to 40 increases the range from 18 to 37 but leaves the IQR at 8, and use this to decide — and justify — whether the range or the IQR gives the better summary of spread for a data set with an extreme value or a long tail
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把朋友们完成拼图所用的时间排成一排，他们能找出中间的时间和它两侧“四分之一处”的时间吗？能解释为什么这两个四分之一处时间之间的差距，比最快和最慢之间的差距更能说明大多数人有多分散吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 散点图
topics.description: 在散点图上绘制双变量数据，坐标轴标注正确、刻度合适；描述相关性（正相关、负相关、无相关），并在合适时画出估计的最佳拟合线
evidence: Plot 10 data points on a scatter graph with correct axis labels and a consistent scale
Draw a line of best fit by eye, ensuring roughly equal numbers of points above and below
Use the line of best fit to estimate a y-value for a given x-value within the data range
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拿到 10 名学生睡眠时长与考试分数的数据，他们能在散点图上标出这些点、画出最佳拟合线，并用它预测睡 7 小时的人的分数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 散点图与相关性
topics.description: 用散点图描述两个变量之间的简单数学关系，识别正相关、负相关或无相关，并用最佳拟合线做出预测
evidence: Plot bivariate data on a scatter graph and describe the type of correlation observed
Draw a line of best fit by eye and use it to estimate a value within the data range
Explain what positive, negative, and no correlation mean in the context of real data (e.g., temperature vs. ice-cream sales)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 画了一张散点图——比如比较复习时长和考试分数——他们能画出最佳拟合线、描述其中的规律，并用它做出预测吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识一半和四分之一（5 岁以上）
topics.description: 认识、找出并说出四分之一，即一个物体、图形或数量分成四个相等部分中的一份
evidence: Fold a shape into four equal parts and identify each as 'a quarter'
Find a quarter of 12 objects by sharing into 4 equal groups
Identify whether a shape has been divided into quarters (four equal parts)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你把一张正方形纸折成四个相等的部分，{{name}} 能告诉你每一份是四分之一，并只指出其中的一份吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 什么是一半？
topics.description: 认识、找出并说出二分之一，即一个物体、图形或数量分成两个相等部分中的一份
evidence: Fold a shape into two equal parts and identify each as 'a half'
Find half of 8 objects by sharing into 2 equal groups
Identify whether a shape has been divided into halves or not (equal vs unequal parts)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 帮忙把一块三明治平均分给两个人，他们能切得两块一样大，并告诉你每块叫一半吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 把图形分成更多等份
topics.description: 理解把图形分成更多等份，每一份就会更小
evidence: Explain that a quarter of a pizza is smaller than a half of the same pizza
Demonstrate that fourths are smaller pieces than halves
Compare the size of halves and quarters of the same shape
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一张披萨分给 2 个人，然后同一张披萨分给 8 个人，{{name}} 能解释为什么分给更多人时每块更小吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数写法
topics.description: 正确读、写和使用分数写法——分数、分子、分母、单位分数、非单位分数、真分数、假分数、带分数、等值分数、最简形式——并理解每个术语的含义，包括分子和分母在表示整体中的部分时各自的作用
evidence: Point to and name the numerator and denominator in any given fraction and explain what each tells you
Correctly classify fractions as unit, proper, improper, or mixed number with an example of each
Explain in own words why 2/4 and 1/2 are equivalent fractions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到写出来的分数 3/4，他们能指出分子和分母，并解释每个数字实际表示什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 求数量的几分之几
topics.description: 认识、找出、说出并写出长度、图形、一组物体或数量的 1/3、1/4、2/4 和 3/4
evidence: Find 1/3 of 12 objects by sharing into 3 equal groups
Shade 3/4 of a rectangle that has been divided into 4 equal parts
Identify 1/4 of a length on a number line or ruler
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你在桌上放 12 颗葡萄，{{name}} 能数出其中的四分之一，然后给你看四分之三的葡萄是什么样吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形的一半与四分之一
topics.description: 把圆形和长方形分成两个和四个相等的部分，并用一半、四份和四分之一这些词来描述
evidence: Divide a circle into two equal halves
Divide a rectangle into four equal quarters
Describe the whole as 'two halves' or 'four quarters'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 一个圆形披萨或一块长方形巧克力，他们能把它分成四个相等的部分，并告诉你每块叫四分之一吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识分数
topics.description: 写出简单的分数（如 1/2 of 6 = 3），并认识 2/4 和 1/2 的等值关系
evidence: Write 1/2 of 10 = 5
Explain that 2/4 is the same as 1/2 using a diagram
Calculate simple unit fractions of quantities and write the result
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 6 颗草莓，吃掉了一半，他能写成“1/2 of 6 = 3”吗？能解释为什么 2/4 和 1/2 是同样的量吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较分数
topics.description: 比较和排序单位分数，以及分母相同的分数
evidence: Order 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 from largest to smallest
Explain that a larger denominator means smaller unit fractions
Compare 2/5 and 4/5 and explain that 4/5 is larger because it has more fifths
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 吃了一个蛋糕的 3/8，朋友吃了同一个蛋糕的 5/8，他能说出谁吃得多吗？能把这些分数从小到大排好序吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较分数（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 解决涉及十分之一计数、数量的分数、等值、分数加减和分数比较的问题
evidence: Solve a word problem requiring finding a fraction of a quantity
Solve a problem that requires comparing or ordering fractions
Choose and apply appropriate fraction knowledge to a multi-step problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一袋 20 颗糖平均分给 5 个朋友，{{name}} 能算出每人分到几分之几吗？能算出那是几颗糖吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 等值分数
topics.description: 借助图示认识并展示分母较小的等值分数
evidence: Show that 1/2 = 2/4 using a diagram of equal parts
Use a fraction wall or bar model to find equivalent fractions
Explain why two fractions are equivalent by comparing the shaded areas
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一个长条被分成 4 等份、其中 2 份涂了色，他能说出这和 1/2 一样吗？能换一种方式再画一个长条表示同样的量吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数
topics.description: 把分数当作数来认识和使用：在数轴上标出单位分数和分母较小的非单位分数
evidence: Place 1/2, 1/4, 3/4 on a number line from 0 to 1
Identify that 1/3 lies between 0 and 1/2 on the number line
Understand that a fraction is a single number, not just 'part of a shape'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果画一条从 0 到 1 的数轴，{{name}} 能在不需要额外帮助的情况下标出 1/4、1/2 和 3/4 的位置吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 简单的分数加法
topics.description: 在一个整体内，计算分母相同的分数加减法（如 5/7 + 1/7 = 6/7）
evidence: Calculate 2/5 + 2/5 = 4/5
Calculate 6/8 − 3/8 = 3/8
Explain that when denominators are the same, you add/subtract the numerators
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一份食谱需要 2/8 杯牛奶，再加 3/8 杯，{{name}} 能不用计算器算出总共是多少吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 把图形分成相等的部分（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 把圆形和长方形分成二、三或四个相等的部分；用一半、三分之一和四分之一来描述这些部分；认识到相同整体的相等部分形状可以不同
evidence: Partition a circle into 3 equal parts and label each 'a third'
Partition a rectangle into 4 equal shares in more than one way
Explain that two different-looking shares can still be equal in size
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你用两种不同的方式把长方形分成三等份（三条长条和三个方块），{{name}} 能认识到两种分法都得到相等的三等份吗？即使每块的形状看起来不一样。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分之一
topics.description: 按十分之一往上数和往下数；认识到十分之一来自把一个物体分成 10 等份，或把一位数或数量除以 10
evidence: Count: one tenth, two tenths, three tenths … up to ten tenths (one whole)
Show that dividing a shape into 10 equal parts gives tenths
Explain that 3 ÷ 10 = 3/10
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把一块有 10 等份的巧克力掰开，他能说出每份是十分之一吗？能按顺序从 1/10 数到 10/10 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 单位分数
topics.description: 认识、找出并写出离散物体集合的分数：单位分数和分母较小的非单位分数
evidence: Find 1/4 of 12 objects by dividing into 4 equal groups
Find 3/4 of 12 objects
Write the fraction of a set that is shaded or selected
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果书架上有 15 本书，{{name}} 能算出其中三分之二有多少本吗——并把书分成三堆相等的来验证？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数加法（同分母）
topics.description: 同分母分数的加法和减法，包括结果大于一个整体的情况（如 5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8）
evidence: Calculate 3/5 + 4/5 = 7/5 and explain it equals 1 2/5
Subtract 2/6 from 5/6
Solve addition problems where the sum exceeds the whole: 7/8 + 3/8
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个食谱用了 5/8 袋面粉，又用了 6/8 袋，{{name}} 能算出总共用了多少，并解释答案作为带分数是什么意思吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数比较（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过推理大小来比较分子相同或分母相同的两个分数；用 >、= 或 < 符号记录比较结果
evidence: Compare 3/8 and 3/4: same numerator, larger denominator means smaller pieces so 3/8 < 3/4
Compare 5/6 and 2/6: same denominator so 5/6 > 2/6
Justify a comparison using a visual model and explain why both fractions must refer to the same whole
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到 3/5 和 3/8，他们能只靠想每份的大小就说出哪个更大吗——不需要画出来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分位和百分位的小数等值
topics.description: 认识并写出任意十分位或百分位的小数等值（如 3/10 = 0.3，27/100 = 0.27）
evidence: Write 7/10 as 0.7 and vice versa
Convert 45/100 to 0.45
Place 0.3 and 3/10 at the same point on a number line
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在价格标签上看到 7/10，他们能把它改写成小数吗——43/100 也能同样处理吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数与百分数记法
topics.description: 正确读、写和使用小数与百分数记法——小数、小数点、十分位、百分位、千分位、百分数、百分比、% 符号、换算、有限小数——并理解分数、小数和百分数之间的关系，它们是表示同一个值的三种方式
evidence: Read and write decimal numbers correctly, identifying the value of each digit (ones, tenths, hundredths)
Use the % symbol correctly and explain that per cent means 'out of 100'
Convert between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages (e.g. 1/2 = 0.5 = 50%) and explain why they are equal
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到写着“0.5”和“50%”，他们能解释两者表示相同的量吗——并把它们也写成分数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值
topics.description: 把一位小数四舍五入到最接近的整数
evidence: Round 3.7 to 4 and 3.2 to 3
Place 6.5 on a number line between 6 and 7 and decide it rounds to 7
Round a set of one-decimal-place numbers and explain the rounding rule
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 量出某物是 3.7 米，他们能说出这四舍五入到 3 米还是 4 米吗——并解释为什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 比较小数位数相同、最多两位小数的数
evidence: Order 0.45, 0.54, 0.39 from smallest to largest
Compare 3.72 and 3.27 using place-value reasoning
Place three two-decimal-place numbers on a number line in order
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在比较两个价格——£4.75 和 £4.57——他们能不用计算器就说出哪个更贵吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数与分数
topics.description: 解决涉及分数和两位小数的简单测量和金钱问题
evidence: Calculate 1/4 of £3.20
A rope is 2.5 m long; how much is left after cutting 0.75 m?
Find 3/10 of 1 kg and express the answer in grams and as a decimal of a kg
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个瓶子装 1.5 升，{{name}} 喝了 0.75 升，他们能算出还剩多少吗——并分别用小数和分数写出来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 除以 10 和 100
topics.description: 理解一位数或两位数除以 10 和 100 的结果，并识别各位数字分别表示个位、十分位和百分位
evidence: Calculate 37 ÷ 10 = 3.7 and identify 3 as ones and 7 as tenths
Calculate 4 ÷ 100 = 0.04 and identify 4 as hundredths
Explain that dividing by 10 shifts each digit one place to the right
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 从数字 48 开始，把它除以 10，能说出答案吗？还能解释每个数字的位值发生了什么变化吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 等值分数（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 生成简单的等值分数，并用可视化分数模型解释它们为什么相等
evidence: Given 1/3, generate 2/6 as equivalent and show with area model
Simplify 4/8 to 1/2 and justify with a fraction strip
Complete equivalence chains: 1/4 = ?/8 = ?/12
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一个分成 3 份、涂了 1 份的分数条（= 1/3），能画出一个分成 6 份、涂色部分完全相同的等值分数条吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的等值分数
topics.description: 理解两个分数如果大小相同或在数轴上对应同一个点，就是等值分数；能用图示识别并展示常见的等值分数家族
evidence: Use fraction strips to show 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6
Verify on a number line that 2/3 and 4/6 land on the same point
Identify at least three fractions equivalent to 1/2 using diagrams
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到 2/4 和 1/2 在数轴上落在完全相同的点上，能用自己的话解释这两个分数为什么相等吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数与小数的等值关系
topics.description: 认识并写出 1/4、1/2 和 3/4 的小数形式
evidence: Match fractions to decimals in a sorting activity
Explain why 1/4 = 25/100 = 0.25 using a hundredths grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一份食谱需要 3/4 杯面粉，{{name}} 能不查资料就说出它的小数形式吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数表示图形的部分
topics.description: 把图形分割成面积相等的部分，并用单位分数表示每部分占整体的面积
evidence: Partition a rectangle into 6 equal-area parts and label each 1/6
Show two different ways to partition a square into 4 equal parts
Given a pre-partitioned shape, write the unit fraction for one part
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 把一张正方形纸折成 8 个相等的部分，能说出每部分占整个正方形的几分之几吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 求数量的几分之几（进阶）
topics.description: 解决用越来越复杂的分数计算数量的问题，包括答案为整数的非单位分数
evidence: Find 3/5 of 20
Calculate 2/3 of 18 and explain the two-step process (divide then multiply)
Solve: A bag has 24 sweets, 3/8 are red — how many red sweets?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个班 28 名学生中有 3/4 交了作业，{{name}} 能算出具体是多少名学生吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整体的分数
topics.description: 理解分数 1/b 是把一个整体分成 b 个相等部分后其中 1 份的数量；理解 a/b 是 a 个大小为 1/b 的部分
evidence: Given a shape divided into 5 equal parts, identify one shaded part as 1/5
Explain that 3/4 means 3 parts each of size 1/4
Draw a model showing 2/6 as 2 pieces of a whole cut into 6
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你把披萨切成 6 块相等的切片，{{name}} 能解释 1/6 是什么意思吗？然后能说出 4/6 个披萨是什么样子吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整体的分数（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 把整数表示为分数（如 3 = 3/1），并认识与整数相等的分数（如 4/4 = 1，6/1 = 6）
evidence: Write 5 as 5/1 and explain why
Locate 4/4 and 1 at the same point on a number line
Identify which fractions from a list equal a whole number: 6/3, 8/4, 5/2
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 把数字 3 写成分数，能写出 3/1 吗？还能说出哪个分数正好等于 1 个整体，比如 4/4 或 5/5 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 在数轴上表示分数：把 0 到 1 的区间平均分成 b 份，找到 1/b 的位置，再从 0 开始量出 a 段 1/b，找到 a/b 的位置
evidence: Partition a 0-to-1 number line into 4 equal parts and mark 1/4
Explain that each part on the line has size 1/b
Locate 1/3 and 1/6 on separate number lines
Locate 3/4 on a number line by counting three 1/4-jumps from 0
Place 5/6 on a number line and explain the process
Identify a fraction shown by a point on a pre-partitioned number line
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 画一条从 0 到 1 的数轴，并把它平均分成 5 份，能标出 2/5 和 4/5 的位置吗？还能说出自己是怎么想出来的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分位（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 以百分之一为单位顺数和倒数；认识百分之一是把一个物体平均分成 100 份、或把十分之一再平均分成 10 份得到的
evidence: Count from 3/100 to 12/100 in hundredths
Explain that 1/10 ÷ 10 = 1/100
Place several hundredths on a number line between 0 and 1/10
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 1 英镑，花了 37 便士，能说出 37 便士是 1 英镑的 37/100 吗？还能从 0/100 数到 100/100 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 带分数的加法与减法
topics.description: 同分母带分数相加、相减，包括化成假分数或运用运算性质来计算
evidence: Calculate 2 3/5 + 1 4/5 and express as a mixed number
Subtract 3 1/4 from 5 3/4
Solve 4 2/6 − 1 5/6 by regrouping the whole number
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一份食谱需要 1 又 2/5 杯燕麦，再做一批需要 2 又 3/5 杯，{{name}} 能把它们加起来算出总数吗？包括五分之几加起来超过 1 时的换算。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数加法（不同分母）
topics.description: 分母为同一个数的倍数的分数相加、相减，先找出公分母再计算
evidence: Calculate 1/3 + 1/6 by converting to sixths: 2/6 + 1/6 = 3/6 = 1/2
Calculate 3/4 − 1/8 by converting to eighths
Add 2/5 + 3/10 and simplify the answer
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要算 1/3 加 1/6，能找到公分母并算出结果吗？把计算过程写出来。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加法与减法应用题
topics.description: 解决同分母分数加减法的应用题，借助直观模型和算式来思考
evidence: A jug contains 3/4 litre of juice; 2/4 litre is poured out — how much remains?
Two pieces of ribbon are 2 3/8 and 1 5/8 inches — what is their total length?
Draw a fraction model to represent and solve a fraction word problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到一条自然步道的一段是 3/8 千米，另一段是 5/8 千米，能不用计算器算出总路程吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较小数
topics.description: 借助位值理解，通过比较大小来比较两个小数（精确到百分位或最多三位小数）；用 >、=、< 记录结果
evidence: Compare 0.45 and 0.405 and explain which is greater
Order 3.142, 3.14, 3.2 from smallest to largest
Justify that 0.7 = 0.70 = 0.700 using place-value reasoning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 比较 0.45 和 0.54，能借助位值说出哪个更大吗？不用计算器。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较分数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 比较和排序分子、分母都不同的分数，可以通分、同分子，或与 1/2 这样的参照数比较；用直观模型说明结论
evidence: Compare 3/8 and 5/12 by finding a common denominator of 24
Order 2/3, 3/5, and 7/10 from smallest to largest
Use the benchmark 1/2 to decide that 5/8 > 3/7
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 吃掉了自己午餐的 2/3，朋友吃掉了自己午餐的 3/4，能判断出谁吃得更多吗？先找到一种共同的比较方法。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 把十分位换算成百分位
topics.description: 把分母是 10 的分数写成等值、分母是 100 的分数，并用它来计算分母是 10 和 100 的分数加法（如 3/10 + 4/100 = 34/100）
evidence: Rewrite 7/10 as 70/100
Explain why 5/10 = 50/100 using a hundredths grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要算 3/10 加 17/100，能先把 3/10 写成百分位，再把两个分数加起来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 把两位小数四舍五入到最接近的整数和一位小数
evidence: Round 3.47 to the nearest whole number (3) and to 1 d.p. (3.5)
Round 12.95 to 1 d.p. (13.0) and explain the boundary case
Estimate 4.83 + 2.17 by rounding each to the nearest whole number
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 量出一段长度为 4.67 米，他能不能把它四舍五入到最接近的整米数——也能不能四舍五入到最接近的十分之一米？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分位与百分位的小数
topics.description: 用小数表示分母为 10 或 100 的分数；把小数读写成分数（例如 0.62 = 62/100，0.71 = 71/100）
evidence: Rewrite 0.62 as 62/100
Write 3/10 as 0.3 and locate on a number line
Read 0.07 and express as 7/100
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到价签上写着 £0.65，他能不能把它改写成分数——再反过来，把 47/100 变成小数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三位小数
topics.description: 解决涉及最多三位小数的数字问题
evidence: Calculate the total of three measurements: 1.234 m + 0.567 m + 2.199 m
A bottle holds 1.5 litres; 0.375 l is poured out — how much remains?
Find two numbers with 3 d.p. that add to make 1
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 正在给一个容量为 5.000 升的水箱加水，已经倒入了 2.375 升，他能不能算出还需要加多少才能装满？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 等值分数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 用直观模型解释为什么分数 a/b 与 (n×a)/(n×b) 相等；运用这一原理识别并生成等值分数，包括十分位和百分位
evidence: Use a fraction strip to show 2/3 = 4/6 = 6/9
Explain that multiplying numerator and denominator by the same number gives an equivalent fraction because the size of the whole is unchanged
Generate three fractions equivalent to 3/5 and verify with diagrams
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想让 2/3 看起来不一样但数值不变，他能不能把分子和分母同时乘以同一个数，并解释为什么分数保持不变？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数加法概念
topics.description: 理解分数的加法和减法就是把部分合起来和分开；用不止一种方式把一个分数分解成同分母分数的和
evidence: Write two different decompositions of 5/6
Use a visual model to justify a decomposition of 2 1/8 into whole-number and fraction parts
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 7/8 块巧克力，送出去 3/8，他能不能算出还剩多少——然后再用两种不同的方式把 7/8 分成两部分？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整体的分数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 用直观模型和算式解决涉及分数乘以整数的应用题
evidence: Each person eats 3/8 of a pizza and there are 5 people — how many pizzas are needed?
A ribbon is cut into pieces of 2/3 metre; how long are 4 pieces altogether?
Between what two whole numbers does 6 × 3/4 lie?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果花园的每一块区域要用掉 3/4 袋堆肥，一共有 4 块区域，{{name}} 能不能算出总共需要多少袋？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 带分数与假分数
topics.description: 认识带分数和假分数；在两种形式之间互相转换（例如 2/5 + 4/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5）
evidence: Convert 11/4 to 2 3/4
Convert 3 2/5 to 17/5
Write 6/5 + 4/5 = 10/5 = 2 as both improper fraction and whole number
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到分数 9/4，他能不能把它转换成带分数——然后再把 2 又 3/5 变回假分数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数乘法
topics.description: 理解 a/b 是 1/b 的倍数；借助直观模型，把真分数和带分数乘以整数（例如 3 × 2/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5）
evidence: Calculate 4 × 3/8 using repeated addition or the rule n × a/b = (n×a)/b
Multiply 2 1/3 × 3 and express as a mixed number
Use a visual model to show why 5 × 1/4 = 5/4
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个食谱要用 2/3 杯黄油，{{name}} 想做三倍的量，他能不能算出总共需要多少黄油？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 百分数与小数等值
topics.description: 解决需要掌握 1/2、1/4、1/5、2/5、4/5 以及分母为 10 或 25 的倍数的分数的百分数与小数等值的问题
evidence: State that 1/5 = 20% = 0.2 and use this to find 20% of 60
Convert 3/4 to 75% and to 0.75
A shop offers 25% off a £40 item — what is the sale price?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道 1/4 = 25% = 0.25，他们能借此算出 80 英镑的 25% 是多少吗？还能算出 60 颗糖的 4/5 是多少吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 千分位（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 认识并使用千分位；将其与十分位、百分位及其小数等值联系起来（如 1/1000 = 0.001，35/1000 = 0.035）
evidence: Explain that 1 tenth = 100 thousandths
Place 0.345 on a number line between 0.34 and 0.35
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到小数 0.003，他们能把它写成分数，并大致说出它在 0 到 0.01 之间的数轴上的位置吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 理解 a > 1 时的分数 a/b 是若干个 1/b 之和（如 3/5 = 1/5 + 1/5 + 1/5）
evidence: Express 5/8 as a sum of five copies of 1/8
Show on a number line how 4/3 is built by iterating 1/3 four times
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 把 4/5 表示成几个相同小分数之和，他们能写成 1/5 + 1/5 + 1/5 + 1/5 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解百分数
topics.description: 理解百分号（%）；知道百分数表示“每一百份中的份数”；把百分数写成分母为 100 的分数和小数
evidence: Write 35% as 35/100 and as 0.35
Shade 40% of a 10×10 grid and write the fraction 40/100
Explain that 100% means the whole, 50% means half
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果商店打出五折优惠，{{name}} 能解释这意味着半价吗？还能把 50% 写成分数和小数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数加法（异分母）
topics.description: 通过把给定的分数替换为等值分数以得到公分母，来对异分母分数（包括带分数）进行加法和减法
evidence: Compute 2/3 + 5/4 by converting to twelfths: 8/12 + 15/12 = 23/12
Subtract 1 3/5 from 3 1/4 using a common denominator
Explain the strategy of finding a common denominator and verify using a visual model
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一份食谱用一种食材 2/3 杯、另一种食材 3/4 杯，{{name}} 能把这两个分数加起来吗？即使分母不同也能算吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数面积
topics.description: 通过用单位分数小正方形铺满来求边长为分数的长方形的面积；说明面积等于边长的乘积
evidence: Tile a 2/3 × 3/4 rectangle with 1/12 squares and count to find area = 6/12 = 1/2
Explain why the number of unit-fraction tiles equals the product of the two fractions
Calculate the area of a rectangle with sides 1 1/2 and 2/3 using fraction multiplication
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一块布料长 2/3 米、宽 3/4 米，{{name}} 能算出它的面积吗？还能解释用微小的分数小正方形铺满与相乘得到相同答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数比较（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过转换为公分母或使用基准数，比较和排序分数，包括大于 1 的分数
evidence: Order 3/4, 7/8, 5/6, and 11/12 from smallest to largest
Compare 7/5 and 4/3 using common denominators
Place improper fractions and mixed numbers on a number line in correct order
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要把 5/3、7/4 和 2/1 从小到大排序，他们能把它们转换为公分母并正确排序吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数与分数（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 把分数与除法联系起来，计算简单分数的小数等值（如 3/8 = 0.375）；在不同情境中回忆并使用简单分数、小数和百分数之间的等值关系
evidence: Convert 3/8 to 0.375 by dividing 3 ÷ 8
State that 1/5 = 0.2 = 20% from memory
Use fraction–decimal–percentage equivalences to compare 30%, 1/3, and 0.35 and put them in order
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在练习纸上看到 3/8，他们能把它转换成小数吗？还能大致说出这相当于百分之多少吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数除法
topics.description: 理解并计算整数除以单位分数（如 4 ÷ 1/5 = 20）；借助直观模型和乘除法之间的关系，解释为什么商比被除数大
evidence: Compute 4 ÷ (1/5) = 20 and explain: 'How many fifths fit in 4 wholes?'
Create a story context for 6 ÷ (1/4) and solve it
Verify 4 ÷ (1/5) = 20 by showing 20 × (1/5) = 4
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有 4 米丝带，每个蝴蝶结需要 1/5 米，{{name}} 能算出可以做多少个蝴蝶结，并解释为什么答案比 4 大吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数除法（单位分数）
topics.description: 理解并计算单位分数除以非零整数（如 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12）；借助直观模型和乘除法之间的关系，解释计算结果
evidence: Compute (1/3) ÷ 4 = 1/12 and explain using a visual model of splitting 1/3 into 4 equal parts
Create a story context for (1/6) ÷ 3 and solve it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 1/3 袋米，并把它平均分成 4 份，能算出每份占整袋米的几分之几，并解释为什么答案比 1/3 小吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 单位分数与整数的除法
topics.description: 解决涉及单位分数除以整数、整数除以单位分数的实际问题，借助直观模型和算式
evidence: Solve: '3 people share 1/2 lb of chocolate equally — how much each?' (1/6 lb)
Solve: 'How many 1/3-cup servings in 2 cups of raisins?' (6 servings)
Create a story context for a given unit-fraction division expression
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有半张披萨，要平均分给 3 个人，能算出每人分到整张披萨的几分之几，并说明自己的计算步骤吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整体的分数（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 把分数理解为分子除以分母（a/b = a ÷ b）；解决整数除法得到分数或带分数答案的应用题
evidence: Explain that 3/4 means 3 ÷ 4 and verify by showing 3/4 × 4 = 3
Solve: '9 people share a 50-pound sack equally — how many pounds each?' and express the answer as 5 5/9
Use a visual model to show that sharing 3 wholes among 4 people gives each person 3/4
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把 3 张披萨平均分给 4 个朋友，能算出每人分到几分之几，并解释为什么 3 ÷ 4 和 3/4 的答案一样吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数应用题
topics.description: 解决涉及异分母分数加减法的应用题，借助直观模型和基准分数进行估算并判断答案是否合理
evidence: Solve: 'Tara ate 2/5 of a pizza and Sam ate 1/3. How much did they eat together?'
Recognise that 2/5 + 1/2 ≠ 3/7 because 3/7 < 1/2 but the sum should exceed 1/2
Estimate a fraction sum using benchmarks (0, 1/2, 1) before computing exactly
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 走 1 又 1/2 英里到学校，再走 3/4 英里到朋友家，能算出总路程，并检查答案是否合理吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法作为缩放
topics.description: 把乘法理解为缩放（改变大小）：不计算，根据另一个因数的大小比较积与因数的大小；解释乘以大于 1、等于 1 或小于 1 的分数会产生什么影响
evidence: Predict without calculating whether 3/4 × 7 is greater or less than 7
Explain why multiplying by 5/3 makes a number larger and multiplying by 2/5 makes it smaller
Relate multiplying a/b by n/n = 1 to the principle of fraction equivalence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用 20 乘以 1/4，能在计算之前预测答案是比 20 大还是小，并解释原因吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数乘法（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 用分数或整数乘以分数，包括真分数乘真分数；把 (a/b) × q 理解为把 q 分成 b 等份后取其中 a 份；答案写成最简形式
evidence: Compute (2/3) × (4/5) = 8/15 and show with an area model
Use a visual model to demonstrate (2/3) × 4 = 8/3 = 2 2/3
Simplify the product 3/4 × 2/3 = 6/12 = 1/2
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个食谱用 2/3 袋面粉，而 {{name}} 只想做食谱的 3/4，能把这两个分数相乘，算出需要多少面粉吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 现实生活中的分数乘法
topics.description: 解决涉及分数和带分数乘法的实际问题，借助直观分数模型或算式
evidence: Solve: 'A recipe needs 2 1/3 cups of flour; you want to make 1 1/2 batches. How much flour?'
Draw a fraction model to represent and solve a multiplication word problem
Check the reasonableness of a fraction product in context using estimation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个食谱用 1 又 1/2 杯糖做 12 块饼干，而 {{name}} 只想做食谱的 2/3，能算出需要多少糖吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 约分
topics.description: 用公因数把分数约成最简形式；用公倍数把分数通分到相同的分母
evidence: Simplify 18/24 to 3/4 by identifying the HCF of 18 and 24
Express 2/3 and 5/8 with a common denominator of 24
Explain why dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor produces an equivalent fraction
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拿到分数 12/16，能把它约成最简形式吗？还能说出分子和分母分别除以了几吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数与分数（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 在有限小数和对应的分数之间灵活转换（如 3.5 和 7/2，或 0.375 和 3/8）；两种形式之间能熟练互化
evidence: Convert any terminating decimal to a fraction in simplest form
Convert any fraction with a denominator whose prime factors are only 2 and 5 to a terminating decimal
Explain why some fractions produce terminating decimals and others do not
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在计算器上看到 0.375，能不用计算器把它化成最简分数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数除法
topics.description: 用“颠倒相乘”的方法和直观模型，做分数除以分数；能理解并解决分数除以分数的应用题
evidence: Divide a fraction by a fraction using the reciprocal method
Use visual fraction models to represent and explain fraction division
Create story contexts for fraction division problems and solve them
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 3/4 升果汁，每个杯子能装 3/8 升，能算出可以倒满几杯吗？用分数除法来算。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 带分数与假分数
topics.description: 用规范的笔算方法，对整数、小数、真分数、假分数和带分数进行四则运算，正数和负数都要涉及
evidence: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide with positive and negative integers
Apply formal written methods to calculations with decimals of any size
Perform all four operations with proper fractions, improper fractions, and mixed numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在一道较长的题里要算 −1/2 + 3/4 − 1 又 1/4，能用笔算做出来吗？每一步都要写清楚。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数乘法（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 把分数和百分数理解为运算；通过乘法求一个量的几分之几或百分之几，理解“的”就是乘（如 200 的 3/4 = 3/4 × 200 = 150）
evidence: Calculate a fraction of a given amount by multiplying
Calculate a percentage of a given amount by converting to a decimal and multiplying
Use the operator interpretation to solve multi-step problems involving discounts, taxes, and portions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一件 120 英镑的外套降价 35%，{{name}} 能算出售价吗？先算出 120 英镑的 35%，再减掉。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 平面图形
topics.description: 认识并说出常见平面图形的名称（圆形、三角形、长方形，包括正方形）
evidence: Name a triangle, circle, rectangle, and square when shown them
Identify a shape correctly regardless of its size or orientation
Pick out all the triangles from a mixed set of shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能指着家里的东西——比如钟、窗户或披萨——正确说出它是圆形、三角形、长方形还是正方形吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 立体图形
topics.description: 认识并说出常见立体图形的名称（正方体、长方体、棱锥、球体、圆柱、圆锥）
evidence: Name a cube, sphere, cylinder, and cone when shown them
Identify 3-D shapes in the environment (e.g. a tin is a cylinder)
Recognise a cuboid and a pyramid among a set of solid shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出身边常见立体图形的名称吗？比如一罐豆子（圆柱）、一个球（球体）或一颗骰子（正方体）。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 方位语言
topics.description: 用上面、下面、旁边、前面、后面、紧挨着等词语描述物体的位置
evidence: Describe a toy as being 'on top of' the table
Follow instructions like 'put the cube behind the box'
Use 'left' and 'right' in simple contexts
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用“上面”“下面”“旁边”“前面”或“后面”这样的词，告诉别人怎么在家里找到某样东西吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 立体图形（5 岁以上）
topics.description: 用日常语言描述边、顶点和其他特征，分析和比较平面图形与立体图形
evidence: Count the sides and corners of a shape
Compare a triangle and a rectangle by number of sides
Describe a cube as having 'square faces' and 'corners'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出两个图形哪里不同吗？比如解释三角形有 3 个角和 3 条边，而正方形有 4 个角和 4 条边。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 搭建与绘制图形
topics.description: 用组件（如小棒和黏土球）搭建图形，也通过绘画来表现图形
evidence: Build a triangle from three sticks and three clay balls
Draw a recognisable rectangle
Construct a cube from straws and connectors
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能搭出或画出看到的图形吗？比如用折纸做一个正方体，或在点纸上照着画一个三角形。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 组合简单图形
topics.description: 把简单图形组合成更大的图形（如两个三角形拼成一个长方形）
evidence: Join two triangles to make a rectangle or larger triangle
Use pattern blocks to fill a hexagon outline
Create a picture or design by combining basic shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把小图形拼在一起组成更大的图形吗？比如把两个三角形拼成一个长方形。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 平面图形与立体图形
topics.description: 区分平面图形（二维）和立体图形（三维）
evidence: Sort shapes into 'flat' and 'solid' groups
Explain that a circle is flat but a sphere is solid
Identify whether a given shape is 2-D or 3-D
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能分清正方形这样的平面图形和正方体这样的立体图形吗？能把日常物品按平面或立体分类吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 转向与方向
topics.description: 描述移动和方向，包括整圈、半圈、四分之一圈和四分之三圈转向
evidence: Follow instructions to move forward, backward, turn left/right
Demonstrate a whole turn, half turn, and quarter turn with their body
Describe a route using directional language
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在玩向左转或向右转的游戏，他们明白四分之一圈、半圈和整圈是什么意思吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 立体图形上的平面
topics.description: 找出立体图形表面上的平面图形（如圆柱上的圆、金字塔上的三角形）
evidence: Point out a circular face on a cylinder or cone
Identify triangular faces on a pyramid
Recognise that the faces of 3-D shapes are 2-D shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看着一个立体图形，说出它各个面上的平面图形吗？比如圆柱两端是圆，侧面展开是长方形。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 平面图形（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 识别并描述平面图形的特征，包括边的数量和竖直方向的对称轴
evidence: Count the number of sides of a given 2-D shape
Identify whether a 2-D shape has a vertical line of symmetry
Use properties (number of sides, symmetry) to describe and distinguish between shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能数出一个图形的边数，并说出它有没有对称轴吗？比如知道长方形是对称的，而不等边三角形不是。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用立体图形搭建
topics.description: 组合立体图形（正方体、直四棱柱、直圆锥、直圆柱）并拼出组合图形；用组件图形搭出新图形
evidence: Stack cubes and prisms to build towers or structures
Combine 3-D shapes to make a new solid (e.g. cone on top of cylinder)
Describe a composite 3-D shape in terms of its component shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把立体图形组合起来吗？比如把正方体和圆柱叠在一起，搭出一个新的组合立体。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 组合图形
topics.description: 把二维图形（长方形、正方形、梯形、三角形、半圆、四分之一圆）拼在一起，组成组合图形，再用组合图形拼出新图形
evidence: Combine two triangles to form a rectangle or larger triangle
Put together half-circles and quarter-circles to form circles or new shapes
Decompose a composite shape and describe which simpler shapes make it up
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把三角形、长方形这样的平面图形像拼图一样拼在一起，拼出一个更大的新图形吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形的本质属性
topics.description: 区分图形的本质属性（比如三角形是封闭的、有三条边）和非本质属性（比如颜色、摆放方向、整体大小）
evidence: Build and draw shapes that possess defining attributes
Identify that a shape remains a triangle regardless of its size, colour, or orientation
Explain why a given shape is or is not a particular type based on its defining properties
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 明白一个图形之所以是三角形，是因为它有 3 条边和 3 个角，而不是因为它的颜色或朝向吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 棱、顶点和面
topics.description: 识别并描述三维图形的特征，包括棱、顶点和面的数量
evidence: Count the edges, vertices, and faces of common 3-D shapes
Use the terms edge, vertex (vertices), and face correctly
Describe a 3-D shape by its properties (e.g. a cube has 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能数出正方体或三棱柱这样的三维图形有几个面、几条棱、几个顶点吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 规律与序列
topics.description: 按规律和序列排列、组合数学对象
evidence: Continue a repeating pattern of shapes or colours
Describe the rule for a given sequence of objects
Create own patterns and sequences using mathematical objects
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能发现由图形或物体组成的重复规律并接着往下排，或者自己创造一个重复规律吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 位置、方向和移动
topics.description: 用数学词汇描述位置、方向和移动，包括直线，以及用直角来区分旋转（四分之一圈、半圈、四分之三圈，顺时针和逆时针）
evidence: Use terms such as clockwise, anti-clockwise, quarter turn, half turn, three-quarter turn
Describe a right angle as a quarter turn
Give and follow directions involving straight-line movement and turns
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在方格或简单的导航游戏中听懂并执行“顺时针转四分之一圈”或“向右移动三格”这样的指令吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 给二维和三维图形分类
topics.description: 按属性比较并给常见的二维图形、三维图形和日常物品分类
evidence: Sort a collection of 2-D shapes by number of sides
Sort 3-D shapes by number of faces or whether faces are flat/curved
Explain criteria used to sort a group of shapes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把一堆图形分成几组吗？比如把所有带曲线边的图形和只有直线边的图形分开。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二维图形（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 画二维图形，用模型材料制作三维图形；从不同方向辨认三维图形并描述它们
evidence: Draw a triangle, rectangle, pentagon, or hexagon accurately
Construct a cube or cuboid from modelling materials (e.g. straws and connectors)
Recognise a 3-D shape (e.g. a pyramid) when it is rotated or seen from a different angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一个正方体看，他们能在纸上画出来，再用橡皮泥或搭建材料做一个正方体模型吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 平行线和垂直线
topics.description: 识别水平线和垂直线，以及垂直和平行的线对
evidence: Point out horizontal and vertical lines in shapes and real-world contexts
Identify a pair of parallel lines (lines that never meet and are always the same distance apart)
Identify perpendicular lines (lines that meet at a right angle)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看着一组铁轨或一个窗框，能指出哪些线是平行的（永不相交），哪些是垂直的（相交成直角）吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 按属性识别和绘制图形
topics.description: 识别并绘制具有特定属性的图形（例如给定数量的角或相等的面）；识别三角形、四边形、五边形、六边形和立方体
evidence: Draw a shape with exactly 5 sides (pentagon)
Identify all quadrilaterals in a set of mixed shapes
Name and draw a hexagon, explaining it has 6 sides and 6 angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 指令，比如“画一个有 5 条边的图形”或“画一个所有角都相等的图形”，他能画对吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 直角与旋转
topics.description: 识别直角；认识两个直角构成半圈、三个直角构成四分之三圈、四个直角构成一整圈
evidence: Use a right-angle checker to identify right angles in shapes and the environment
Classify angles as right angles, less than a right angle, or greater than a right angle
Explain that 4 right angles make a full turn (360°)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看着一张纸的角，他能告诉你那是直角——并且知道转一整圈需要四个直角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识角
topics.description: 认识角是图形的一种属性，也可以用来描述旋转
evidence: Identify angles at the corners of 2-D shapes
Describe a turn (e.g. quarter turn, half turn) in terms of the angle made
Explain that an angle measures the amount of turn between two lines meeting at a point
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 指出书本角上或门框上的角，他能找到——并解释推开门也是一种旋转（角）吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二维图形（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 识别不同方向摆放的二维图形的对称轴；认识轴对称图形并画出对称轴
evidence: Find all lines of symmetry in a rectangle, square, and equilateral triangle
Determine whether a given shape has a line of symmetry when rotated
Identify which shapes in a set have exactly one line of symmetry
Determine how many lines of symmetry a regular hexagon has
Draw all lines of symmetry for a given figure
Identify which figures from a set are not line-symmetric
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张蝴蝶或星星的图片，他能画出那条（或那些）可以正好对折、让两边完全重合的线吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 四边形的分类
topics.description: 理解不同类别的图形可能共有某些属性，从而构成一个更大的类别；对四边形（菱形、长方形、正方形）进行分类，并画出不属于这些子类别的四边形示例
evidence: Explain that a square is a special rectangle and also a special rhombus
Sort shapes into a Venn diagram: quadrilaterals vs rectangles vs squares
Draw a quadrilateral that is not a rectangle, rhombus, or square
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一个正方形、一个长方形和一个菱形，他能解释为什么它们都是四边形——以及每个图形和其他图形有什么不同吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 坐标（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 在坐标网格上标出指定点，并连接各边完成给定的多边形
evidence: Plot points (1,1), (1,4), (5,4), (5,1) and join to make a rectangle
Given three vertices of a square, plot the fourth vertex
Complete a triangle by plotting the third vertex at given coordinates and drawing sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果在网格上给 {{name}} 三组坐标，他能标出每个点，再把点连起来画出正确的三角形或长方形吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 描述移动
topics.description: 把位置之间的移动描述为向左/右、向上/下平移给定的单位
evidence: Describe moving from (2,3) to (5,3) as 3 units to the right
Translate a shape 4 units right and 2 units up and state the new coordinates
Predict where a point will be after a given translation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个图形在网格上的位置是 (2, 3)，你让 {{name}} 把它向右移四格、向上移两格，他能在不先画图的情况下算出新位置吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 第一象限坐标
topics.description: 用第一象限的坐标描述二维网格上的位置
evidence: Read the coordinates of a point on a grid as (3, 5)
Explain that the first number is the horizontal distance and the second is the vertical distance
Identify the coordinates of all vertices of a shape plotted on a grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在玩网格寻宝地图游戏，他能从角落开始用两个数字正确说出宝藏的位置吗——比如“横着三格、竖着四格”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 对称轴
topics.description: 根据指定的对称轴，补全一个简单的对称图形
evidence: Given half a butterfly shape and a mirror line, complete the other half on a grid
Complete a symmetric pattern on squared paper with a vertical line of symmetry
Check a completed figure by folding along the mirror line
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果在方格纸上画出一个图形的一半并标出对称轴，{{name}} 能画出缺失的另一半，让整个图形完全对称吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 立体图形的展开图
topics.description: 识别、绘制并理解常见立体图形的展开图——正方体、长方体、三棱柱和四棱锥：预测给定的平面面片组合会折成哪种立体图形，检查展开图能否完全合拢，并根据描述或立体模型画出展开图；理解面的数量与展开图结构之间的关系
evidence: Draw the net of a cube, cuboid, or triangular prism and fold it mentally to identify which faces connect
Build a 3-D shape from its net and check that all faces, edges, and vertices match
Identify which of several given nets will fold into a specific 3-D shape and explain why the others won't
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张由六个正方形组成的 T 形平面卡纸，他们能在折叠之前就说出它能折成正方体，并指出每个正方形会变成哪个面吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 方格纸上的图形变换
topics.description: 在方格纸或坐标网格上表示并进行几何变换：轴对称（沿水平、竖直和对角线方向的对称轴，包括坐标轴）、平移（用向量或左/右/上/下移动来描述）和旋转（绕指定中心点旋转 90° 或 180°）；用准确的术语精确描述每种变换；通过比较位置、方向和大小，判断哪种变换把一个图形映射到它的像上
evidence: Reflect a shape in a given mirror line on a grid and label the new coordinates
Translate a shape by a given number of squares horizontally and vertically and describe the movement
Rotate a shape 90° or 180° about a given centre on a grid and check the image is congruent to the original
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在方格纸上看到一个图形和它的镜像，他们能准确画出对称轴，并精确描述这次轴对称——包括对称轴的位置——而不是只说“它翻过来了”吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 角的类型
topics.description: 识别锐角和钝角；按大小比较并排列不超过两个直角的角
evidence: Classify given angles as acute, right, or obtuse
Order four angles from smallest to largest by visual comparison
Identify all acute and obtuse angles in a given triangle or quadrilateral
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看一个显示不同时间的钟面，他们能说出哪两根指针之间的角是锐角（比直角小）、哪一个是钝角（更宽）吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 角的类型（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 使用并理解标准几何图形标注约定：用小正方形标记直角，用单条或双条短划线标记等长线段，用弧线标记相等的角；用三个字母的记法（∠ABC）标注角，用单个字母或数字标注单独的角；用这些约定画出表示同一点处的角、直线上的角和多边形内角的图形；读懂带有这些标记的图形，找出已知信息并求出未知值
evidence: Mark a right angle with a small square symbol in a diagram and explain what it means
Use tick marks to show equal lengths in a shape and double tick marks for a second pair of equal sides
Read and interpret angle notation (e.g. angle ABC) and identify the angle being referred to in a diagram
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 的数学图形中一个角上画了小正方形，另外两个角上有相同的弧线标记，他们能说出每个标记的含义——并利用它们在不重新测量的情况下求出一个缺失的角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 立体图形（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 从二维表示中识别立体图形，包括正方体和其他长方体
evidence: Identify a cuboid from its net
Name the 3-D shape shown in an isometric drawing
Match 2-D representations to the correct 3-D shape
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一张盒子或棱锥的平面建筑草图，他们能说出它所表示的立体图形的名称吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 角的和定理
topics.description: 知道同一点处的角之和为 360°（一整圈），直线上的角之和为 180°，对顶角相等；利用这些事实求缺失的角
evidence: State that two angles on a straight line add to 180°
Explain that four right angles at a point make 360°
Identify 270° as three right angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果三个角交于一点，其中两个分别是 120° 和 95°，{{name}} 能知道同一点处的角之和为 360°，从而算出第三个角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 按线的性质给图形分类
topics.description: 根据是否有平行线或垂直线，或是否有指定大小的角，对二维图形进行分类；把直角三角形作为一个类别来认识
evidence: Sort a set of quadrilaterals into those with parallel sides and those without
Identify which triangles in a set are right triangles
Classify shapes that have both perpendicular and parallel sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一组混合的三角形和四边形，他们能把它们分组——比如“至少有一个直角的图形”或“有平行边的图形”——并解释自己的理由吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 度与旋转
topics.description: 知道角用度来度量，1 度是一整圈的 1/360；理解转过 n 个 1 度角的角，其度数就是 n 度
evidence: Explain that a full turn is 360° and a right angle is 90°
Describe what 'one degree' means in terms of a fraction of a circle
State that an angle of 45° has turned through 45 one-degree angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道一整圈是 360 度，他们能说出四分之一圈是多少度吗——并大致解释 1 度看起来有多大？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算角的大小
topics.description: 以度为单位估算并比较锐角、钝角和优角；按类型对角分类，并按大小排序
evidence: Estimate an angle as approximately 130° and classify it as obtuse
Identify a reflex angle in a diagram and estimate it as about 270°
Order four angles from smallest to largest by estimation before measuring
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看纸上画的三个不同的角，他们能估算出哪个最大、把每个标为锐角、钝角或优角——然后用量角器验证吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 直线、射线与角
topics.description: 画出并识别点、直线、线段、射线、角（直角、锐角、钝角）以及垂线和平行线；在二维图形中识别这些元素
evidence: Draw a pair of perpendicular lines and a pair of parallel lines
Identify all pairs of parallel sides in a trapezoid
Mark a right angle, an acute angle, and an obtuse angle in a given figure
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张纸和一把尺子，他们能画出一条线段、标出一个点，然后过这个点再画一条与第一条完全平行的直线吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量角的大小
topics.description: 使用量角器以整度数测量角；画出给定的角，并画出指定度数的角
evidence: Measure an angle with a protractor and read 47°
Draw an angle of 135° using a protractor
Identify which scale on the protractor to use for an obtuse angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一个量角器和纸上画的一个角，他们能准确测量，然后画出一个你指定大小的新角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量角的大小（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 认识到角的度数是可加的；通过在图上用含未知数符号的等式进行加法或减法，求出未知角
evidence: Two angles on a straight line are 65° and x°; find x = 115°
An angle is decomposed into 35° and 40°; state the whole angle is 75°
Solve: angles at a point are 120°, 90°, and x°; find x = 150°
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一条直线上相邻两个角，其中一个角是 65°，{{name}} 能算出另一个角吗——知道直线上的角加起来总是 180°？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 正多边形与不规则多边形
topics.description: 基于对等边和等角的推理，区分正多边形和不规则多边形
evidence: Classify a set of polygons as regular or irregular
Explain that a regular pentagon has 5 equal sides and 5 equal angles
Identify that a rectangle is irregular (equal angles but not all equal sides) unless it is a square
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一个停车标志（正八边形）和一个歪歪扭扭的八边形，他们能说出哪个是正多边形、哪个是不规则多边形——以及为什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 方格纸上的图形变换
topics.description: 用恰当的语言识别、描述并表示图形经过翻折或平移后的位置；知道图形本身没有改变
evidence: Reflect a triangle in a vertical mirror line on a coordinate grid and state the new coordinates
Translate a shape 3 units right and 2 units up and describe the movement
Explain that a reflected/translated shape is congruent to the original
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在方格纸上平移或翻折一个图形，他们能准确描述它最终到了哪里，并确认图形本身的大小和角度都没有改变吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解角（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 利用长方形的性质推导相关事实，求出缺失的边长和角
evidence: Given one side of a rectangle is 8 cm and the perimeter is 28 cm, find the other side
Explain that all angles in a rectangle are 90°
Find a missing side of a rectangle given its area and one side length
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道一个长方形花园的一条边是 7 米，他们能不测量就说出对边的长度和四个角的角度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 什么是角？
topics.description: 理解角是由两条共享同一端点（顶点）的射线组成的几何图形；能在现实情境和二维图形中识别角
evidence: Identify the vertex and arms of an angle in a diagram
Find examples of angles in the classroom (e.g. open door, clock hands)
Explain why two rays meeting at a point form an angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你在纸上从同一个点画出两条线，{{name}} 能告诉你它们之间的空间就是一个角，并指出它们相交的顶点吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二维图形（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 根据给定的尺寸和角度，准确使用直尺和量角器画出二维图形
evidence: Draw a triangle with sides 5 cm, 7 cm and an included angle of 60°
Construct a rectangle with given length and width using a ruler and set square
Draw a regular pentagon given the side length and interior angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 画一个两边分别为 5 厘米和 7 厘米、夹角为 40° 的三角形，他们能用直尺和量角器准确画出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三维图形（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 识别、描述并搭建简单的三维图形，包括制作展开图
evidence: Identify which net will fold into a given 3-D shape
Construct the net of a triangular prism and fold it to verify
Describe a 3-D shape by naming its faces, edges, and vertices
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张十字形的平整卡纸（展开图），他们能预测折起来后会变成什么三维图形，然后动手折一折来验证吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三角形中的角（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 利用角度和的性质，求出三角形、四边形和正多边形中的未知角
evidence: Find a missing angle in a triangle given two angles (using angle sum = 180°)
Calculate a missing angle in a quadrilateral (angle sum = 360°)
Calculate the interior angle of a regular hexagon from the angle sum formula
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道三角形的内角和总是 180°，且一个三角形的两个角分别是 55° 和 70°，他们能不测量就算出第三个角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 按属性给图形分类
topics.description: 根据属性和大小比较并分类几何图形；理解属于某一类别的属性也属于其所有子类别；按属性对二维图形进行层级分类
evidence: Explain why all squares are rectangles but not all rectangles are squares
Place quadrilaterals in a hierarchy diagram showing subset relationships
Identify properties shared by all parallelograms and explain why rhombuses and rectangles are special cases
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}“正方形也是长方形吗？”，他们能解释为什么答案是肯定的——因为正方形具备长方形的所有属性，而且四条边相等吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 坐标（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 在完整的坐标网格（四个象限）上描述位置；使用含负值的坐标
evidence: Plot points with negative coordinates such as (−3, 4) and (2, −5) on a four-quadrant grid
Identify the quadrant in which a given point lies
Describe the position of a shape using coordinates in all four quadrants
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在玩一个船只也可以位于负坐标的游戏，他们能在网格上正确标出并读出像 (−3, 2) 或 (1, −4) 这样的位置吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的数
topics.description: 理解由两条互相垂直的数轴（坐标轴）定义的坐标系，原点在 (0,0)；知道有序数对 (x, y) 确定唯一一个点，其中第一个数表示距原点的水平距离，第二个数表示距原点的垂直距离
evidence: Identify the x-axis, y-axis, and origin on a coordinate grid
Explain that (3, 5) means go 3 along the x-axis and 5 up the y-axis
Distinguish (2, 4) from (4, 2) by explaining each coordinate's meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看着一张带网格的地图，你把一个位置描述为“从原点向右 3 格、向上 5 格”，他们能找到确切的点，并解释这两个数各自代表什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 圆的各部分
topics.description: 图示并说出圆的各部分名称，包括半径、直径和周长；知道直径是半径的两倍
evidence: Label the radius, diameter, and circumference on a circle diagram
Calculate the diameter given a radius of 4.5 cm (diameter = 9 cm)
Explain the relationship between radius and diameter in their own words
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 一个圆盘和一把直尺，他们能测出直径，并解释半径与直径的关系吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 在第一象限中描点
topics.description: 在坐标平面的第一象限中描出并读出有序数对；通过描点和在情境中解读坐标值，来表示现实世界和数学问题
evidence: Plot the point (4, 7) accurately on a first-quadrant grid
Graph a set of data pairs (e.g. time vs distance) as points on the coordinate plane
Read coordinates of a plotted point and explain what they represent in a given scenario
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你告诉 {{name}} 一段汽车旅程在地图上经过网格点 (2, 3)、(5, 7) 和 (8, 4)，他们能描出这些点并描述这段旅程的样子吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形的平移与对称
topics.description: 在坐标平面上绘制并平移简单图形；沿坐标轴对图形作对称
evidence: Translate a triangle 3 units right and 2 units down on a coordinate grid and state the new coordinates
Reflect a shape in the x-axis and list the coordinates of the reflected vertices
Explain how translation changes coordinates (add/subtract) while reflection changes the sign of one coordinate
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在网格上以坐标 (1, 2)、(3, 2) 和 (2, 4) 画出一个三角形，他们能再沿 x 轴作对称，并告诉你每个顶点的新坐标吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识角（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 认识相交于一点、位于同一直线上或互为对顶的角；利用这些性质求未知角
evidence: Find a missing angle at a point given the other angles (total 360°)
Use the straight-line property (angles sum to 180°) to find an unknown angle
Identify vertically opposite angles and use the property that they are equal to find unknowns
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果两条直线相交，{{name}} 能告诉你哪几对角相等（对顶角）吗？如果你给出其中一个角，他们能求出未知角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 立体图形（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 利用立体图形（正方体、长方体、棱柱、圆柱、棱锥、圆锥和球）的面、表面、棱和顶点的性质解决问题，包括想象截面
evidence: Count and describe the faces, edges, and vertices of a triangular prism and a square-based pyramid
Describe the 2-D cross-section produced by slicing a cylinder horizontally or a cone vertically
Use properties of 3-D shapes to determine whether a given net will fold into a specified solid
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 像把一罐豆子切成两半那样，从正中间横切一个圆柱，他们能描述切面的形状吗？如果斜着切呢？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三角形与多边形的内角和
topics.description: 推导并使用三角形内角和（180°），用它推出任意多边形的内角和（(n−2) × 180°），并计算正多边形的内角和外角
evidence: Calculate a missing angle in a triangle by subtracting the known angles from 180°
Find the sum of interior angles in a hexagon by dividing it into triangles
Calculate each interior and exterior angle of a regular polygon given the number of sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道三角形的两个角是 50° 和 70°，他们能算出第三个角吗？他们能算出正五边形内部的各个角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 面积与体积公式
topics.description: 推导并应用三角形、平行四边形和梯形的面积公式，以及长方体和其他棱柱（包括圆柱）的体积公式，把每个公式与它的几何推理联系起来
evidence: Calculate the area of a trapezium using A = ½(a + b) × h and explain why the formula works
Find the volume of a triangular prism by calculating cross-sectional area × length
Derive the formula for the volume of a cylinder as π × r² × h by reasoning from the prism formula
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要给露台一块底边 4 米、高 3 米的三角形区域铺瓷砖，他们能算出面积，从而知道要买多少块瓷砖吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 坐标变换
topics.description: 识别平移、旋转和对称的性质；对给定图形描述并执行这些变换，并理解变换后的图形与原图形全等
evidence: Reflect a shape in a given mirror line (including diagonal lines) and state the coordinates of the image
Rotate a shape about a given centre by 90° or 180° and describe the result
Translate a shape by a given vector and verify that lengths and angles are preserved
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果要求 {{name}} 把一个三角形绕一个固定点顺时针旋转 90°，他们能算出每个顶点最终的位置吗？能确认这个三角形的大小和形状仍然不变吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量角（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 用直尺和量角器准确绘制并测量线段和角，并解读比例图以得出实际测量值
evidence: Draw a triangle accurately given two sides and the included angle (SAS)
Measure angles in a geometric figure to the nearest degree using a protractor
Read a scale drawing to determine actual lengths, explaining the scale used
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张建筑师的比例平面图，图上 1 厘米代表 2 米，他们能在图上量出一个房间并算出它的实际尺寸吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三角形与四边形的性质
topics.description: 用恰当的语言推导并说明三角形、四边形和圆的性质，包括内角、对角线、对称性以及边长之间的关系
evidence: List and verify properties of a parallelogram (opposite sides parallel/equal, opposite angles equal, diagonals bisect each other)
Explain why a square is a special case of both a rectangle and a rhombus
Derive the relationship between the radius, diameter, and circumference of a circle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 为什么长方形的对角线总是等长，他们能用图形的性质来解释吗——而不是只靠测量来验证？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 角的类型（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 使用规范的几何术语和符号来描述、草绘和绘制点、线、平行线与垂线、直角、正多边形，以及具有反射对称或旋转对称的多边形
evidence: Use correct notation for line segments (AB), angles (∠ABC), and parallel lines (AB ∥ CD)
Sketch a regular hexagon and describe its rotational and reflective symmetry
Identify and label perpendicular and parallel lines in a given figure using standard symbols
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 用规范的几何符号描述一个三角形——用字母标出它的角和边——他们能说得足够清楚，让别人照着画出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识角（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 运用同一点上的角（360°）、直线上的角（180°）以及对顶角的性质，在多步问题中求出未知角
evidence: Find a missing angle using the fact that angles on a straight line sum to 180°
Use vertically opposite angles are equal to set up and solve an equation for an unknown
Combine multiple angle facts in a single diagram to find several missing angles step by step
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张图，上面在交叉线处标出了几个角，其中一些是未知角，他们能运用直线和交叉线的规律，一步步求出所有缺失的角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三角形中的角（12 岁以上）
topics.description: 了解并运用三角形全等的判定条件（SSS、SAS、ASA、RHS），使用三角形 ABC 边和角的标准标注约定，并判断两个三角形是否全等
evidence: State which congruence criterion (SSS, SAS, ASA, or RHS) applies to a given pair of triangles
Use the notation △ABC ≅ △DEF and match corresponding sides and angles
Determine whether given measurements produce a unique triangle, more than one, or none
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看两个三角形，其中一个的三条边与另一个的三条边分别相等，他们能解释为什么这两个三角形在形状和大小上一定完全相同吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 平行线与角
topics.description: 理解并运用平行线被截线所截时角之间的关系：同位角、内错角和同旁内角；用这些关系求未知角
evidence: Identify alternate, corresponding, and co-interior angle pairs in a diagram with parallel lines
Explain why alternate angles are equal using the concept of translation along the transversal
Find missing angles in a parallel-line diagram using a combination of angle relationships
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在图中看到两条平行线和一条截线构成的 Z 形或 F 形，他们能找出相等的角并解释为什么相等吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 圆：周长与面积
topics.description: 使用公式 C = πd（或 2πr）和 A = πr² 计算圆的周长和面积，并解决涉及含圆形部分的组合图形周长和面积的问题
evidence: Calculate the circumference and area of a circle given its radius or diameter
Find the perimeter or area of a composite shape made from rectangles and semicircles
Explain the relationship between π, diameter, and circumference informally
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想知道自行车轮转一整圈能走多远，他们能用车轮的直径和 π（圆周率）算出周长吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 相似与放大
topics.description: 理解相似是一种图形放大另一个图形的关系；在给定比例因子和中心的情况下，借助和不借助坐标网格，通过放大构造相似图形
evidence: Enlarge a shape by a given scale factor from a specified centre of enlargement
Determine the scale factor between two similar shapes by comparing corresponding sides
Explain why corresponding angles in similar shapes are equal while sides are in proportion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想把一张照片放大到三倍大，他们能算出新的尺寸吗——并解释形状不变，但所有长度都按同一比例增加？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识角（12 岁以上）
topics.description: 使用直尺和圆规进行标准作图：线段的垂直平分线、过已知点或在该点处作已知直线的垂线，以及角平分线
evidence: Construct the perpendicular bisector of a line segment using compasses and a straight edge
Construct an angle bisector and verify by measuring both halves
Construct a perpendicular from a point to a line using compasses only
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 只有一把直尺和一副圆规，他们能作出一条与另一条线段成直角且恰好将其平分的直线吗——不用量角器？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 应用勾股定理
topics.description: 运用勾股定理（a² + b² = c²）计算直角三角形中未知的边长，包括在现实情境和坐标几何情境中的应用
evidence: Calculate the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle given the two shorter sides
Find a shorter side given the hypotenuse and the other short side
Use Pythagoras’ Theorem to find the distance between two points on a coordinate grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想检验一个搁板支架是否构成完美的直角，且三边分别长 30 厘米、40 厘米和 50 厘米，他们能用勾股定理来验证吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三角学基础
topics.description: 在直角三角形中使用三角比 sin、cos 和 tan 求未知的边和角，包括针对给定问题列出正确的三角比
evidence: Identify which trigonometric ratio to use (SOH CAH TOA) based on the known and unknown sides
Calculate an unknown side using sin, cos, or tan and a known angle
Find an unknown angle using the inverse trigonometric function (e.g. tan⁻¹)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道一架梯子长 5 米，与地面成 70° 角斜靠在墙上，他们能用三角学算出梯子能到达墙上的高度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 早期数学词汇
topics.description: 在计数、比较以及描述形状和位置时，准确使用数学词汇
evidence: Use 'more than', 'fewer than', and 'the same as' correctly when comparing groups
Name shapes correctly and describe their features using words like 'sides' and 'corners'
Use positional words (above, below, next to) precisely to describe where objects are
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 谈论数学时——比如比较数字或描述形状——他们会用对词吗，比如“大于”“更少”“在旁边”或“角”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 寻找高效方法
topics.description: 发现计算或规律中的重复，并借此更高效地计数或预测结果
evidence: Notice that skip counting by 2s follows a repeating odd/even pattern
Recognise that adding 1 to any number always gives the next counting number
Use a repeated pattern (e.g. +10 on a hundred chart always moves down one row) to predict answers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在计数或做重复加法时，他们是否开始注意到规律——比如“5、10、15、20……”——并利用它来预测下一个数，而不用一个一个地数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 动手解决问题
topics.description: 选择并使用熟悉的工具（实物、手指、十格框）来帮助解决数学问题
evidence: Choose cubes, counters, or fingers to help solve an addition or subtraction problem
Use a ten frame to organise objects for counting or comparing
Explain why a particular tool (e.g. cubes rather than fingers) was chosen for a given problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在解决数学问题时，他们会主动拿有用的工具——比如用手指、计数器或数轴——来辅助思考吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解问题
topics.description: 通过弄清题目在问什么、选择实物或图片来表示情境，并说明解题路径，从而理解问题
evidence: When given a word problem within 10, explain what the problem is asking before attempting to solve
Choose objects, fingers, or drawings to represent a problem situation
After finding an answer, check it makes sense (e.g. re-count objects to verify a total)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 遇到一道一时不知道怎么解的数学题时，他们会先停下来想想题目在问什么——也许画个图——再动手做吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 现实与数学的联系
topics.description: 在现实情境与数学表示之间转换，使用实物、图画、示意图、表格、算式或条形模型
evidence: Given a story about combining groups, represent it with counters or cubes and find the total
Given a set of objects, tell a simple addition or subtraction story to match
Connect a physical action (putting together, taking away) to the matching operation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在解决一个现实生活中的数学问题——比如把 8 颗糖分给 2 个人——他们能先用实物或画图来表现发生了什么，然后再写数字吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 展示解题过程
topics.description: 用实物、图画和口头语言展示并说明数学答案是如何得出的
evidence: Use objects or drawings to demonstrate how an addition or subtraction was solved
Respond to 'how do you know?' by pointing to objects or a drawing and describing what was done
Listen to a peer's explanation and say whether they agree or disagree
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 解完一道数学题后，他们能说明自己是怎么得到答案的——用计数器、图画或语言——而不只是写下最后的数字吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 发现数学规律
topics.description: 注意简单的规律和结构：发现改变顺序不会改变总数，并认识数字之间的相互关系
evidence: Notice that 3 + 2 gives the same answer as 2 + 3 (early commutativity)
Recognise that teen numbers are 'ten and some more' (e.g. 14 is 10 and 4)
Spot a pattern in a sequence of objects or numbers and predict what comes next
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否注意到，用不同顺序相加会得到相同的答案——比如 3 + 5 和 5 + 3 都等于 8——并且能解释为什么这样说得通？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用实物模拟真实问题
topics.description: 用实物、图画或简单的算式来表示现实生活中的情境（早期数学建模）
evidence: Draw a picture or use objects to represent a simple real-world situation involving counting or comparing
Write or dictate a number sentence to describe a real-world situation (e.g. 'I had 5 apples and ate 2')
Use the model to answer a question about the situation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你向 {{name}} 描述一个简单的现实情境——比如“栅栏上有 3 只鸟，又飞来 2 只”——他们能写出像 3 + 2 = 5 这样的算式来表示吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 把数学与真实生活联系起来
topics.description: 用算式、条形模型或图表来表示现实问题，并把数学结果放回情境中解读
evidence: Choose and write an appropriate number sentence for a measurement or money word problem
Draw a bar model or diagram to represent a two-step or comparison problem
Interpret the numerical answer in context (e.g. '15 cm means the ribbon is 15 centimetres long')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 通过画条形模型或写等式解决一道应用题时，他们也能解释自己的答案在现实情境中意味着什么吗——比如“也就是说每个孩子分到 4 颗糖”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 建立不同表征之间的联系
topics.description: 在现实情境、图画和算式之间转换，并解释每种表征之间是如何相互联系的（定量推理）
evidence: Write a number sentence (e.g. 14 + 5 = 19) to match a word problem and explain the connection
Draw a bar model or part-whole diagram to represent a problem, then solve using the diagram
