Translate between a concrete model and a symbolic equation, describing what each number represents
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 解决一道应用题时，他们能画图或写算式来展示自己的思路——然后解释图和数字如何与真实情境对应吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 解释数学推理
topics.description: 在老师引导下，用图画、算式或语言来解释和说明数学推理
evidence: Explain a solution strategy using a drawing or number sentence (e.g. 'I made ten first, then added the rest')
Justify why an answer is correct by showing an alternative method that gives the same result
Identify and explain an error in a worked example or a peer's solution
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}}“你是怎么算出来的？”，他们能画给你看，或用简单的话解释自己的步骤吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 归纳规律
topics.description: 认识并运用重复推理来归纳：发现计算规律，描述数列的规则，并利用已知的数学事实预测结果
evidence: Use a known doubles fact to derive a near-doubles answer (e.g. 6 + 7 = 6 + 6 + 1 = 13)
Notice that subtracting 10 from any two-digit number always reduces the tens digit by 1
Describe a rule for a pattern and use it to extend or predict (e.g. 'each time we add 5, the ones digit alternates between 0 and 5')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 练习乘法口诀或数字规律时，他们能发现捷径吗——比如“如果 6 × 7 = 42，那么 6 × 8 一定是 48”——并利用已知事实算出还没记住的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 在引导下解决多步问题
topics.description: 在老师指导下，通过规划解题路径、找出相关信息并选择合适的运算，来理解多步和更复杂的问题
evidence: When given a word problem within 20 or 100, identify the known information and what needs to be found
Try a strategy (drawing, number line, known fact) and switch approach if the first attempt stalls
Check the reasonableness of an answer using estimation or a different method
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 算出 3 个孩子每人分 12 颗糖，结果却得到 5，{{name}} 会停下来想一想并说“这好像不对”，而不是直接写下来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的数
topics.description: 选择并使用合适的工具和表征（数轴、百数表、尺子、部分—整体模型）来帮助解决问题
evidence: Choose a number line or hundred square to support adding or subtracting two-digit numbers
Select a ruler when a problem requires measuring length
Explain why one representation (e.g. a number line vs cubes) is more helpful for a particular problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在做数学题时，他们会选择有用的工具吗——比如用数轴做加法，或用百数表接着数——而不是总在脑子里算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 精确的数学表达
topics.description: 用数学的精确性来交流：使用正确的词汇、标明单位，并准确使用符号
evidence: Use the = sign correctly to mean 'is the same as' rather than 'the answer is'
Include units when giving a measurement answer (e.g. '12 cm' not just '12')
Use precise terms such as 'edge', 'vertex', 'face' when describing 3-D shapes, and 'greater than', 'less than' when comparing numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写出或说出一个数学答案时，会带上单位吗——比如写"5 厘米"而不是只写"5"——并且会正确使用 = 或 < 这样的符号吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形规律
topics.description: 发现并运用数学结构：运用运算性质、位值规律和图形之间的关系，高效地解决问题
evidence: Use the commutative property deliberately (e.g. reorder 3 + 9 as 9 + 3 to count on from the larger number)
Use place-value structure to add or subtract tens (e.g. 47 + 10 = 57 because only the tens digit changes)
Recognise structural similarities between shapes (e.g. rectangles and squares both have 4 sides and 4 right angles)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在数学学习中注意到某个规律时——比如乘以 10 总是在末尾添一个零——会用这个规律更快地解决类似的问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 选择合适的策略
topics.description: 有策略地选择并使用合适的工具和表征方式，包括在多位数、小数和分数的运算中，在口算、草稿、规范竖式和计算器之间做出选择
evidence: Choose a mental method for 345 + 200 but a written method for 345 + 278
Select a ruler vs a metre stick based on the object being measured
Decide when a number line is more useful than base-ten blocks for a given problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 面对一道数学题时，会想一想哪种方法最适合吗——比如简单的题心算，较大的计算用笔算，几何题画个示意图？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 拓展乘法表规律
topics.description: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳：拓展乘法表规律，由已知事实推出未知事实，并描述数列的规则
evidence: Notice that all multiples of 4 are even and use this to check answers
Derive 8 × 7 from 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 by spotting the pattern
Describe a rule for a growing pattern (e.g. 'add 50 each time') and use it to predict the next terms
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 学习乘法表时，会用已经记住的算式推算出不太确定的算式吗——比如用 5 × 6 = 30 推算出 6 × 6 = 36？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 论证数学推理
topics.description: 构建并理解多步数学论证；找出推理中的错误，并解释某种方法为什么成立或不成立
evidence: Explain step by step why a columnar addition method gives the correct answer
Find and explain an error in a worked example (e.g. incorrect regrouping)
Construct a simple argument for why a general statement is true (e.g. 'adding two even numbers always gives an even number')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听到别的孩子解释自己是怎么解一道数学题的，{{name}} 能说出这个推理是否说得通吗——如果说不通，能准确指出逻辑错在哪里吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多步问题解决
topics.description: 在老师的支持下，理解涉及较大数字或混合运算的多步问题：把问题拆成几部分、选择策略，并检查答案是否合理——这个阶段的孩子是在引导下养成习惯；独立评估策略要到更晚的阶段
evidence: Break a two-step word problem within 1000 into sub-problems and solve each part
Estimate an answer before calculating to set a reasonableness benchmark
Check an answer using a different method or inverse operation and revise if needed
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 算出的答案对一道数学题来说明显太大或太小，即使你没有指出来，他们也会自己发现并回头检查吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形规律（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 发现并运用数学结构：把位值规律用于三位数运算，运用乘除关系，并利用图形性质进行分类
evidence: Use the structure of place value to explain why adding hundreds only changes the hundreds digit
Use commutativity and the relationship between multiplication and division to derive unknown facts
Classify shapes by their structural properties (number of sides, right angles, parallel lines)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 做乘法或处理较大的数字时，会运用自己知道的位值或数的关系来简化计算吗——比如把 24 × 3 拆成 20 × 3 + 4 × 3？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数
topics.description: 在涉及三位数和分数的真实情境、图示和符号等式之间自如转换，并解释每一部分代表什么
evidence: Write an equation with three-digit numbers to match a measurement or money word problem
Draw a bar model to represent a fraction problem and use it to solve
Explain how a number line diagram relates to the quantities in a word problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 解决涉及分数或三位数的数学题时，能在画示意图、用数轴和写等式之间切换，并解释每一种方式说明了什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 用数学的精确性来表达：正确使用位值和分数词汇，在测量答案中写明单位，并准确使用符号
evidence: Consistently specify units in measurement answers (e.g. '35 cm' not '35')
Use fraction vocabulary precisely (numerator, denominator, equivalent)
Write equations with correct notation including £/p, >, <, = and fraction symbols
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 给出涉及测量或分数的数学答案时，是否会带上正确的单位——比如“3½ 米”或“2.5 千克”——并且全程使用正确的符号？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 处理金钱问题
topics.description: 通过选择合适的表示方式，并在实际情境中解读结果，来为涉及测量、金钱和时间的现实问题建立模型
evidence: Choose whether to use a bar model, number line, or equation for a measurement problem
Model a multi-step money problem with equations and interpret the final answer as change or total cost
Create a line plot from measurement data and use it to answer questions about the real-world situation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 解决一个现实生活中的数学问题——比如计算一个项目需要多少布料——他们能否选择合适的表示方式（示意图、表格、算式），并解释答案在真实情境中意味着什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 选择合适的数学工具
topics.description: 有策略地选择并使用合适的工具和表示方式：在口算、笔算和画图方法之间做选择；用计算器检查；选择适合任务的分数模型
evidence: Decide to use mental multiplication for 25×4 but a written method for 167×3
Choose fraction strips rather than a number line to compare 3/8 and 1/4
Use a ruler and squared paper to verify area by counting squares after calculating l×w
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 做数学时，是否会选择合适的方法——简单的计算用心算，复杂的用笔算，遇到涉及图形或分数的问题时画个示意图？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数
topics.description: 在涉及乘法、分数和小数的现实情境、示意图、数轴和符号算式之间自如转换，并解释每种表示方式所展示的内容
evidence: Represent a sharing problem as both a fraction diagram and a division equation
Explain how a bar model for 4 × 23 connects to the area model and the written method
Translate a decimal on a number line into a fraction and explain the equivalence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 做涉及小数或分数的数学题时，能否在分数条、数轴和书面算式之间转换——并解释每一种表示的是什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 论证数学推理（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 构建并呈现多步数学论证；评判他人的推理，并清楚解释一种方法为什么有效或为什么行不通
evidence: Explain why 1/3 > 1/5 using the idea that more parts means smaller pieces
Find and explain an error in a peer's column subtraction with exchanges
Present a chain of reasoning: since 6×8=48 and 6×2=12, then 6×10=60 so 6×8=60−12=48
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果同学说“分数乘出来不可能得到更大的数”，{{name}} 能否想一想这是否总是成立——并举例支持或反驳这个说法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数学精确性
topics.description: 用数学的精确性来表达：正确使用分数/小数词汇，准确说出角的类型，在测量和金钱中写明单位，并正确使用符号（=、<、>、÷、×）
evidence: Distinguish between 'three fourths' and 'three quarters' and use both correctly
State an answer in the correct unit: '63 square centimetres' not just '63'
Write 15:45 in 24-hour notation and explain the distinction from 3:45 pm
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 写出涉及角、分数或金钱的数学答案时，是否会使用精确的词汇和正确的符号——比如写“锐角”“3/4”或“£2.50”，而不是含糊的描述？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用乘法和分数建立模型
topics.description: 通过选择合适的表示方式，并在实际情境中解读数学结果，来为涉及乘法、面积、分数和单位换算的现实问题建立模型
evidence: Model a tiling/area problem with an array and write the corresponding multiplication
Represent a recipe-scaling problem as a fraction calculation and interpret the answer in grams
Use a bar model to set up a unit conversion problem (metres to centimetres)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 解决一个现实问题——比如算出房间的面积是多少平方米——他们是否会选择适合这项任务的数学工具，并结合真实情境解读最后的数字？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多步问题解决
topics.description: 通过识别子步骤、选择策略并监控进展，理解涉及四则运算、分数和面积/体积的多步问题
evidence: Break a two-step word problem into parts and explain a plan before calculating
Choose between drawing a diagram or writing equations for a perimeter problem
Check a fraction-of-quantity answer by estimating: 3/5 of 20 must be more than half of 20
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 面对涉及面积、分数和多个步骤的复杂数学题时，是否会先规划思路——在计算前大致估算答案应该是多少，最后再检查结果是否合理？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法口诀表（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳：扩展乘法口诀表和等值分数中的规律，从已知事实高效推导未知事实，描述一般规律
evidence: Notice that all fractions equivalent to 1/2 have a numerator that is half the denominator
Use the pattern 3×4=12, 3×40=120, 3×400=1200 and explain the generalisation
Derive 8×7 from 8×5=40 plus 8×2=16 and describe the strategy as a general approach
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 发现一个规律——比如乘以 4 等于连续翻倍两次——他们会用这个归纳来更高效地解决类似问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 运用数学结构
topics.description: 寻找并运用数学结构：利用位值规律计算 ×10/×100，运用分配律拆分乘法，运用分数等值进行比较和计算，利用图形性质对四边形分类
evidence: Decompose 7×13 into 7×10 + 7×3 using the distributive property
Explain why multiplying by 10 shifts digits one place left using place-value structure
Use the fact that a square is a special rectangle to reason about quadrilateral properties
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在比较分数或计算百分比时，他们会寻找背后的规律吗——比如发现 50% 总是一半，或者等值分数在数轴上都在同一个位置？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 有策略地选择表征方式
topics.description: 有策略地选择和使用工具与表征方式：根据问题的要求，在心算方法、正式笔算方法、量角器、分数条和图示之间做出选择
evidence: Choose mental multiplication for 25 × 40 but long multiplication for 347 × 26
Select a protractor to verify an estimated angle rather than relying on visual inspection alone
Choose a common-denominator approach vs. benchmark comparison for ordering fractions, and explain why
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 面对几何或比例问题时，他们会选择合适的工具吗——比如用量角器量角度或用分数条比较分数——而不是总是默认用同一种方法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 复杂的多步问题
topics.description: 理解涉及大数、分数、小数和百分比的复杂多步问题：分析已知和未知信息，规划多步策略，并通过估算和逆运算评估结果的合理性
evidence: Break a three-step problem involving unit conversion and multiplication into sub-problems and solve systematically
Estimate 4,832 × 7 as roughly 5,000 × 7 = 35,000 to check a calculated answer of 33,824
Identify that a percentage answer over 100% doesn't make sense in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 面对涉及百分比、大数或分数的复杂多步数学问题时，他们会停下来先弄清已知条件、估算一个答案，然后检查最终结果是否合理吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数、小数与百分比
topics.description: 寻找并运用数学结构：利用分数、小数和百分比之间的关系；用因数对简化乘法；运用角度事实求未知角；系统地运用正多边形的性质
evidence: Use the structure 25 × 16 = 25 × 4 × 4 = 100 × 4 = 400 by exploiting factor pairs
Recognise that 0.75 = 3/4 = 75% and use whichever form is most efficient for the problem
Use the fact that angles on a straight line sum to 180° as a structural tool to find missing angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 意识到分数、小数和百分比只是同一个数的不同写法时，他们会在能让计算更简便时灵活地在它们之间转换吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 在涉及多位数乘法、分数、小数和百分比的真实情境、图示、数轴、条形模型和符号等式之间流畅转换，并解释不同表征之间的联系
evidence: Represent a scaling problem as both a bar model and a multiplication equation
Show how 0.35, 35/100, and 35% all represent the same quantity on a hundredths grid
Translate a line-graph reading into a subtraction equation to find the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 解决涉及百分比或多位数乘法的问题时，他们能用条形模型、数轴和等式表示同一个情境，并解释每种表示的含义吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 精确的数学词汇
topics.description: 用数学的精确性进行表达：正确使用质数、因数、倍数、角的类型和正多边形规律等词汇；准确标注单位，包括 cm²、m³、°；准确使用平方/立方的记法和百分比
evidence: Distinguish 'factor' from 'multiple' in a written explanation
Write an area answer as 48 cm² (not just 48) and a volume estimate as approximately 60 cm³
Use 5² notation correctly and read it as 'five squared'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 谈论或书写涉及质数、百分比或多边形的数学内容时，他们会正确而自信地使用精确的术语吗——比如“质因数”“钝角”或“正六边形”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 真实世界的数学建模
topics.description: 对涉及比例缩放、单位换算、面积/周长和百分比的真实问题建模：选择合适的数学表征，并在情境中解读结果
evidence: Model a recipe-scaling problem with multiplication and fractions, then interpret the answer in grams
Represent a room-carpet problem by drawing a scale diagram and applying the area formula
Use a percentage bar model to find a sale price and explain the answer in £
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在解决真实世界的数学问题——比如按比例调整食谱或换算单位——他们会选择合适的表征、完成计算，然后解释结果在真实情境中意味着什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用等价关系进行推理
topics.description: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳：扩展等值分数和百分比换算中的规律，从已知事实推导未知事实，描述数列的一般规律并预测后续项
evidence: Notice that multiplying any number by 25 can be done by multiplying by 100 then dividing by 4, and explain why
Describe the general rule for a sequence and predict the 20th term
Generalise: to find 10% divide by 10, to find 5% halve 10%, and use this to find 35% of any number
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到一串等值分数——比如 1/2、2/4、3/6……——他们能说出其中的规律，并用它找出接下来的几项，或者快速在分数和百分比之间换算吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 构建并呈现包含多个步骤的逻辑数学论证；评判他人关于分数、角度或计算的推理，并清楚地解释错误或替代方法
evidence: Prove that 3/4 > 2/3 using a common denominator argument and a visual model
Find and explain an error in a long multiplication where a partial product was misaligned
Present a chain of reasoning to show that angles in a triangle sum to 180° by tearing and arranging
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 和同学用不同方法解同一道数学题，{{name}} 能比较这两种方法、说明哪种更高效，并找出其中任何一处计算错误吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 进阶数学词汇
topics.description: 用数学语言精确表达：正确使用比、比例、代数、体积、坐标几何和圆的各部分等词汇；标明单位，包括 cm³、m³ 和英里/千米；准确使用代数表达式和运算顺序的符号
evidence: Use 'radius', 'diameter', and 'circumference' correctly when describing a circle
Distinguish between an expression, an equation, and a formula in mathematical writing
Specify units correctly when presenting volume calculations (e.g. 60 cm³ not just 60)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 书写涉及代数或立体图形的数学内容时，他们会使用精确的语言——比如“代数表达式”“立方厘米”或“坐标”——并在全过程中使用正确的符号吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 进阶多步问题
topics.description: 理解涉及比、比例、代数、负数以及分数和小数四则运算的复杂多步问题：分析已知量和未知量，规划解题策略，并用估算和逆运算检验结果的合理性
evidence: Break down a three-step ratio problem into sub-problems and plan a solution pathway
Identify which quantities are known/unknown in an algebraic word problem and set up equations
Use estimation to check whether a decimal division answer is reasonable before finalising
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 面对涉及代数、比或分数的复杂多步数学问题时，他们会把问题拆成可处理的部分、估算合理范围，并用另一种方法验证答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 选择合适的数学工具
topics.description: 有策略地选择和使用工具与表征方式：根据问题需要，在口算方法、规范笔算方法、代数方法、坐标网格和技术工具之间做出选择
evidence: Explain why long division is more appropriate than mental methods for 4,752 ÷ 13
Choose a coordinate grid approach to verify a translation rather than computing from a description alone
Select a formula-based approach rather than counting cubes to find volume efficiently
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 选择如何解决一道数学题时，他们会挑选最高效的方法吗——用代数处理复杂的归纳，用坐标网格解决几何问题，或用口算处理简单计算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 构建数学论证
topics.description: 构建并呈现包含多个步骤和形式化推理的逻辑数学论证；评判他人关于分数、代数、比或几何的推理，并清楚地解释错误或替代方法
evidence: Prove that a given angle must be 60° by chaining angle facts in a logical sequence
Find and explain the error in a peer's fraction division calculation
Construct a counter-example to disprove a false conjecture (e.g. 'multiplying always makes bigger')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 展示一个多步数学解法时，他们能把推理过程讲得足够清楚，让别人能跟上每一步吗——如果一份解答中存在逻辑错误，他们能发现吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用重复推理进行归纳
topics.description: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳：描述第 n 项的代数规律，利用运算性质化简，并用具体例子验证归纳结论
evidence: Explain that the interior angle sum of an n-sided polygon is (n−2) × 180° based on the pattern for triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons
Predict the 20th term of a linear sequence by identifying and applying the general rule
Generalise that dividing by n always gives a denominator of n in the fraction, for any whole numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 找出一个数列的规律——比如“每次加 7”或“把位置序号乘以 3”——他们能直接用这个规律求出任意一项，而不必把前面的项全部列出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 运算顺序（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 寻找并运用数学结构：利用二维图形的层级关系推导性质；运用运算顺序和代数结构化简表达式；建立分数—小数—百分比的等值联系；利用比的结构高效解决比例问题
evidence: Use the property that all rectangles are parallelograms to deduce missing angle facts
Recognise that 3 × (n + 5) = 3n + 15 by applying distributive structure
Use the equivalence 1/8 = 0.125 = 12.5% flexibly to solve a comparison problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 化简代数表达式或比较比时，他们会寻找背后的结构吗——比如运用运算顺序，或发现两个比相等——从而让计算更高效？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 真实生活中的数学建模
topics.description: 运用合适的工具、图表或方程，对涉及比、比例尺、体积、单位换算和比例推理的真实问题建立模型
evidence: Choose a bar model or double number line to represent a ratio problem and solve it
Model a volume problem with a labelled diagram, apply the formula, and interpret the result in context
Determine whether a measurement answer should be rounded and to what degree of accuracy
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 用数学解决真实问题时——比如计算容器的体积或算出百分比折扣——他们会不会判断答案需要精确到什么程度，并解释这个答案在实际情境中意味着什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 在涉及分数、比和代数的真实情境、图表、坐标网格、代数表达式、表格和符号方程之间自如转换，并解释不同表示方式之间的联系
evidence: Translate a word problem into an algebraic equation and also represent it on a bar model
Plot data from a table onto a coordinate grid and interpret the relationship
Explain how a pie chart, a fraction, and a percentage all represent the same proportion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在做代数或比例题时，能不能在图像、数值表、写出的方程和真实情境故事之间自如切换，并解释每种表示方式如何体现同一个关系？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较容量
topics.description: 用满、空、多于、少于、半满等语言比较和描述容量与体积
evidence: Compare two containers and say which holds more/less
Use 'half full' and 'quarter full' to describe a container
Solve practical problems like 'Which cup has more water?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有两个大小不同的杯子，他们能说出哪个装水更多，并用“更满”或“更不满”来描述其中一个吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较时长
topics.description: 用比较性语言描述时间：更快、更慢、更早、更晚
evidence: Compare two events and say which was quicker/slower
Use 'earlier' and 'later' correctly to describe daily events
Solve practical problems like 'Who finished first?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 比兄弟姐妹先吃完晚饭，他们能说出谁吃得更早，以及谁更快吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较长度与高度
topics.description: 直接比较两个物体的长度或高度，并用长、短、高、更长、更短、更高、两倍、一半等语言描述差异
evidence: Stand two children back-to-back and say who is taller/shorter
Directly compare the heights of two towers and describe one as taller
Use 'longer' and 'shorter' to compare two ribbons placed side by side
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 站在餐桌和前门旁边，他们能说出哪个更高，以及自己比它们各自更矮还是更高吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 物体的可测量属性
topics.description: 描述并识别物体的可测量属性，如长度、高度、重量和容量；使用比较性语言（更长、更短、更重、更轻、更多、更少）
evidence: Identify that a pencil has length and can be measured
Describe multiple attributes of one object (e.g. a bottle has height, weight, and capacity)
Use words like 'long', 'heavy', 'full' to describe objects
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拿起一个水瓶和一本书，他们能在不用任何测量工具的情况下说出哪个更重、哪个更高吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量质量与重量（4 岁以上）
topics.description: 直接比较两个物体的质量或重量，并用重、轻、比……重、比……轻等语言描述差异
evidence: Heft two objects and say which is heavier/lighter
Use a simple balance to compare the weight of two objects
Describe one object as 'heavier than' another
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 一只手拿着一袋苹果，另一只手拿着一根羽毛，他们能说出哪个更重，并用“重得多”这样的词来描述差异吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 按时间顺序排列事件
topics.description: 用之前、之后、接着、首先、今天、昨天、明天、早上、下午、晚上等语言按时间顺序排列事件
evidence: Order three daily events using 'first', 'next', 'last'
Use 'yesterday', 'today', 'tomorrow' correctly
Describe an event as happening in the 'morning' or 'afternoon'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你请 {{name}} 按顺序描述今天早上发生了什么，他们能用“首先”“然后”“接着”这样的词，把吃早饭排在去学校之前吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 容量与体积
topics.description: 用非标准单位和标准单位测量并开始记录容量与体积
evidence: Measure capacity by counting how many cups fill a container
Begin to use litres as a unit of capacity
Record capacity measurements with a number and unit
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用小杯子往水壶里装水，他们能数出需要几杯吗？能理解这说明了水壶能装多少吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 硬币面值
topics.description: 认识并知道不同硬币和纸币的面值
evidence: Identify 1p, 2p, 5p, 10p, 20p, 50p, £1 and £2 coins
Know that a £2 coin is worth more than a 50p coin
Recognise £5 and £10 notes
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一把硬币，他们能说出每一枚的面值吗？比如 2p、5p、20p，并按面值从小到大排序吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 日、周、月与年
topics.description: 认识并使用与日期相关的语言，包括星期几、周、月和年
evidence: Name the seven days of the week in order
Name the twelve months of the year in order
Understand that a year is made up of months and weeks
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 今天星期几、昨天星期几、现在是几月，他们能全部答上来吗？能说出一年有几个月吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量长度和高度（5 岁以上）
topics.description: 用非标准单位和标准单位测量并开始记录长度和高度
evidence: Measure the length of a table using cubes and record the result
Begin to use a ruler to measure in centimetres
Record a measurement as a number with a unit
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用小方块首尾相接量一本书的长度，他们能数出用了多少块吗？然后能试着用尺子量同一本书吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量质量与重量
topics.description: 用非标准单位和标准单位测量并开始记录质量/重量
evidence: Use a balance to compare masses of two objects
Measure mass using non-standard units (e.g. 'this book weighs 5 cubes')
Begin to read a simple scale for mass
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用天平比较两个物体，他们能说出哪个更重吗？如果给出 100g 这样的砝码，他们能在秤上把物体称平衡吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识时间：整点与半点
topics.description: 认读整点和半点，并画出钟面指针表示这些时间
evidence: Read an analogue clock showing 3 o'clock
Read an analogue clock showing half past 7
Draw the hour and minute hands on a blank clock face to show a given o'clock or half-past time
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你指着一个显示 3 点或 2 点半的钟，{{name}} 能说出时间吗？然后能在空白钟面上画出指针，表示你报出的时间吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 精确到分钟的时间认读
topics.description: 用小时、分钟和秒测量并开始记录时间
evidence: Use a sand timer or stopwatch to time an activity
Begin to understand that 1 minute = 60 seconds
Record a duration in simple terms (e.g. 'it took about 2 minutes')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看着秒针在钟上走完一整圈，他们能数出这是一分钟吗？能大致估计他们最喜欢的电视节目播多少分钟吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 钱币相加与找零
topics.description: 找出金额相同的不同硬币组合
evidence: Show that 50p can be made with 2×20p + 1×10p, or 5×10p, or 1×50p
Systematically find multiple coin combinations for a given total
Explain why different coin sets give the same total
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要正好凑出 30p，他们能用不同的硬币组合找出两三种凑法吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 选择合适的测量单位
topics.description: 选择并使用合适的标准单位来测量长度（米/厘米）、质量（千克/克）、温度（°C）和容量（升/毫升），并精确到最合适的单位
evidence: Measure the length of a table in centimetres using a ruler
Weigh an object in grams using a scale
Measure the capacity of a container in millilitres using a measuring jug
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}}，游泳池和一张纸分别该用厘米还是米来量，他能给每样东西挑出合理的单位，并说出理由吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较和排序测量结果
topics.description: 比较和排序长度、质量和容量，并用 >、< 和 = 记录结果
evidence: Measure two objects and write 45cm > 32cm
Order three containers by capacity after measuring each
Use = when two measurements are the same
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 量出三根绳子分别是 15 厘米、9 厘米和 22 厘米，他能把它们从短到长排好，并用 < 符号写出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量长度
topics.description: 按长度给三个物体排序，并借助第三个物体间接比较两个物体的长度
evidence: Put three ribbons in order from shortest to longest
Use a piece of string to compare the heights of two objects that cannot be placed side by side
Explain that if A is longer than B and B is longer than C, then A is longer than C
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有三支长短不同的铅笔，但一次只能比较两支，他能借助第三支铅笔当中间人，判断出哪支最长吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量长度（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 用同样大小的长度单位首尾相接、不留空隙也不重叠地测量物体的长度
evidence: Measure a book by laying paper clips end to end and counting them
Understand that the length measurement is the number of units that span the object
Avoid gaps and overlaps when placing units
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用一模一样的玩具积木量桌子的长度，他能把积木首尾相接、不留空隙地摆好，并告诉你桌子有几块积木那么长吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 金钱的加法与减法
topics.description: 解决涉及加法和减法的简单金钱问题，包括找零
evidence: Calculate the total cost of two items priced in pence
Work out change from 50p after buying an item costing 35p
Solve 'How much more money do I need?' problems
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 花 45 便士买了一份零食，付了一枚 1 英镑的硬币，他能算出该找回多少钱，并数出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一小时有多少分钟
topics.description: 知道一小时有多少分钟，一天有多少小时
evidence: State that there are 60 minutes in an hour
State that there are 24 hours in a day
Use these facts to solve simple time problems
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道一小时有 60 分钟，他能告诉你 2 小时有多少分钟，以及一整天有多少小时吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 英镑与便士的写法
topics.description: 认识并使用英镑（£）和便士（p）的符号，并把金额组合成特定的数值
evidence: Write £1.50 or 150p correctly
Combine coins to make a given total, e.g. 50p + 20p + 5p = 75p
Read prices written with £ and p symbols
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拿起面值 50 便士、20 便士和 10 便士的硬币，他能用 p 符号写出总金额，并告诉你这些钱够不够买 75 便士的东西吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 时间间隔的排序
topics.description: 比较和排序时间间隔
evidence: Order three events by how long they took
Compare the duration of two activities (e.g. 'the race took longer than the walk')
Sequence intervals on a timeline
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道看一场电影要 2 小时、坐车要 45 分钟，他能告诉你哪个花的时间更长，并把几项日常活动按所用时间长短排好序吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识时间：分钟
topics.description: 以五分钟为单位读出并写出时间，包括一刻钟和差一刻钟，并画出钟面指针来表示这些时间
evidence: Read an analogue clock showing 3:25
Write 'quarter past 9' or '9:15'
Draw clock hands to show twenty to four
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果钟面显示差一刻四点，{{name}} 能说出这个时间吗——并能在空白钟面上画出指针来表示三点二十吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加法与减法应用题
topics.description: 解决 100 以内涉及长度的应用题，用画图和算式进行加法与减法
evidence: Solve 'The rope is 45 cm long. I cut off 18 cm. How long is it now?'
Draw a diagram (e.g. a ruler drawing) to represent a length word problem
Write an equation with a symbol for the unknown to represent the problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有一根 75 厘米长的绳子，剪掉 28 厘米，能算出还剩多少绳子吗——并画一条数轴图来表示吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量计算
topics.description: 使用标准单位测量、比较、相加和相减长度（米/厘米/毫米）、质量（千克/克）和体积/容积（升/毫升）
evidence: Measure a length in centimetres and millimetres
Weigh an object using grams and kilograms
Add two measurements in the same unit (e.g. 250 ml + 400 ml = 650 ml)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 往壶里倒入 350 毫升，再倒入 275 毫升，能算出总量吗——并说出还需要多少才能到 1 升吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 通过测量比较长度
topics.description: 通过测量判断一个物体比另一个物体长多少，用标准长度单位表示长度差
evidence: Measure two objects and calculate the difference in length
Express the difference using the correct unit (e.g. '7 cm longer')
Solve a comparison problem: 'How much taller is the bookshelf than the desk?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一支铅笔长 16 厘米，一支蜡笔长 9 厘米，{{name}} 能算出铅笔长多少吗——不用并排测量？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较时间长短
topics.description: 比较事件持续的时间，计算特定事件或任务所用的时间
evidence: Calculate how long an activity lasted given start and end times
Compare the duration of two events and identify which was longer
Solve a problem such as 'The lesson starts at 10:15 and ends at 11:00. How long is it?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 下午 4:15 开始做饭，下午 5:00 做完，能算出做饭用了多长时间吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算答案（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 以越来越高的精确度估算和读取时间，精确到分钟；用秒、分钟和小时记录并比较时间
evidence: Read an analogue clock to the nearest minute
Estimate how long an activity takes in minutes or seconds
Compare two durations and determine which is longer
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个电视节目下午 5:17 开始，下午 5:43 结束，{{name}} 能算出它播了多长时间吗——并用分钟表示吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算长度
topics.description: 用英寸、英尺、厘米和米估算长度
evidence: Estimate the length of a classroom object before measuring it
Use a known reference (e.g. width of a finger ≈ 1 cm) to make reasonable estimates
Check estimates by measuring and evaluate how close they were
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看着外面停着的一辆车，能大致估算它有多少米长吗——然后检查自己的猜测是否合理吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 找零
topics.description: 在实际情境中，用英镑和便士进行金额的加法与减法来找零
evidence: Calculate the total cost of two or three items priced in pounds and pence
Work out the change from £5 or £10
Record money calculations using £ and p notation correctly (e.g. £3.47)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用一张 5 英镑纸币买了一本 3.50 英镑的书和一支 1.25 英镑的铅笔，能算出应该找回多少零钱吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量长度（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 选择合适的工具（如直尺、码尺、米尺和卷尺）测量物体的长度
evidence: Choose the most appropriate tool for measuring a given object
Align the zero mark of a ruler with the end of the object and read the measurement
Measure lengths in inches, feet, centimetres, and metres using the correct tool
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要测量一块约 80 厘米长的布料，他能选对工具——短直尺还是卷尺——并准确测量吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量周长
topics.description: 测量简单二维图形的周长
evidence: Measure each side of a rectangle and add the lengths to find the perimeter
Calculate the perimeter of a regular shape given the side length
Explain that perimeter is the total distance around a shape
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想给一个宽 20 厘米、高 30 厘米的长方形画框围一圈装饰边框，他能算出总共需要多长的边框吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量并绘制长度
topics.description: 通过测量长度（精确到最接近的整数单位）生成测量数据，并将数据展示在线形图上
evidence: Measure the lengths of several objects and record the data
Create a line plot with a horizontal scale marked in whole-number units
Interpret a line plot to answer questions about the data
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 测量十片树叶的长度（精确到最接近的厘米）并记录结果，他能把数据展示在简单的数轴图上——把长度相同的树叶归为一组吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用不同单位测量
topics.description: 用两种不同的长度单位测量同一物体的长度，并说明测量结果与所选单位大小之间的关系
evidence: Measure a desk in both centimetres and inches and compare the two numbers
Explain that measuring with a smaller unit gives a larger number
Predict whether a measurement in centimetres will be greater or less than in inches
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 先用厘米、再用英寸测量同一本书，他能解释为什么书的大小没变，数字却不一样吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 金钱应用题
topics.description: 解决涉及美元纸币、25 美分、10 美分、5 美分和 1 美分硬币的应用题，正确使用 $ 和 ¢ 符号
evidence: Determine the total value of a collection of coins
Solve a word problem about making change with US currency
Use $ and ¢ symbols correctly in answers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 2 枚 25 美分、1 枚 10 美分和 3 枚 1 美分硬币，他能算出总共多少钱——并告诉你这些钱够不够买一个 65 美分的东西吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 精确到分钟认读时间（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 从指针钟和数字钟上读出并写出时间（精确到最接近的 5 分钟），使用上午、下午以及 12 小时制和 24 小时制表示法
evidence: Read the time to five minutes on an analogue clock face
Write the time using digital notation (e.g. 3:25)
Distinguish between a.m. and p.m. and relate to daily events
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果钟面显示上午 6:45，{{name}} 能用文字说出这是几点——并用 24 小时制写出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 时间单位与日历常识
topics.description: 知道一分钟有多少秒，以及每个月、每一年和闰年各有多少天
evidence: State that there are 60 seconds in a minute
Name the months and state the number of days in each
Explain that a leap year has 366 days and occurs every 4 years
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 九月有多少天、今年是不是闰年，他能两个都答上来——并告诉你一分钟有多少秒吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 12 小时制与 24 小时制时间
topics.description: 在指针钟和数字钟的 12 小时制与 24 小时制之间读、写和换算时间
evidence: Convert 3:45 pm to 15:45 in 24-hour time
Read 19:30 and state the 12-hour equivalent as 7:30 pm
Match a set of 12-hour and 24-hour times
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果火车时刻表显示 14:35 发车，{{name}} 能把它换算成 12 小时制时间——并告诉你这是上午还是下午吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 面积（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过数单位方格来测量面积（平方厘米、平方米、平方英寸、平方英尺）
evidence: Count unit squares to find the area of an L-shaped figure
Measure the area of a book cover using square-centimetre tiles
Compare areas of two shapes by counting their unit squares
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在厘米方格纸上画一个图形，他们能通过数方格求出它的面积吗——包括对不完整的方格做出合理的估算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 面积与分配律
topics.description: 用铺方格的方式演示分配律：边长为 a 和 (b+c) 的矩形面积等于 a×b + a×c；用面积模型表示分配律
evidence: Tile a 3×(4+2) rectangle and show it decomposes into 3×4 and 3×2
Use an area model to compute 6×13 as 6×10 + 6×3
Draw an area model showing 5×(7+3) = 5×7 + 5×3
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想把 6 × 13 拆成 6 × 10 和 6 × 3 来计算，他们能画出一个分成两部分的矩形，来说明这个方法为什么成立吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用铺方格求面积
topics.description: 用单位方格铺满矩形来求它的面积，并说明结果等于两条边长的乘积
evidence: Tile a 4×6 rectangle and count 24 squares, then verify 4×6=24
Explain why the number of rows times the number in each row gives the area
Draw a rectangle on squared paper, tile it, and write the multiplication
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个长方形房间长 4 米、宽 3 米，{{name}} 能在脑中用 1 米方格铺满它来算出面积吗——并解释为什么这等于 4 × 3？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 组合图形的面积
topics.description: 认识面积的可加性；把直线图形分解成互不重叠的矩形，再把各矩形面积相加，求出总面积
evidence: Decompose an L-shape into two rectangles, find each area, and add them
Find the area of a floor plan shaped like a T by splitting into rectangles
Solve: A room is L-shaped (3m×5m plus 2m×4m) — what is the total area?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果在方格纸上给 {{name}} 一个 L 形房间，他们能把它分成两个矩形，分别求出每部分的面积，再相加得到总面积吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用乘法求矩形面积
topics.description: 用边长相乘求矩形面积，并把整数的乘积表示为矩形的面积
evidence: Calculate the area of a 7 cm × 9 cm rectangle as 63 cm²
Draw a rectangle with area 36 square units and label its side lengths
Solve: A garden is 8 m by 5 m — what is its area?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要给一个长 5 米、宽 4 米的房间铺地毯，他们能用乘法而不是数方格来算出要买多少地毯吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 换算测量单位
topics.description: 在不同测量单位之间换算（如千米与米、小时与分钟、分钟与秒、年与月、周与天）
evidence: Convert 3 km to 3000 m
State 2 hours = 120 minutes
Convert 5 weeks to 35 days
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果告诉 {{name}} 一段路程是 3.5 千米，他们能把它换算成米吗——还能把 2 小时 15 分钟换算成多少分钟吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算与比较金钱
topics.description: 估算、比较和计算不同的量，包括以英镑和便士表示的金钱
evidence: Estimate the length of the classroom in metres
Compare 1.5 kg and 1200 g and identify which is heavier
Calculate the total cost of 3 items at £2.45, £1.30, and £0.75
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在比较三件价格分别为 £2.85、£3.10 和 £2.50 的物品，他们能按从便宜到贵的顺序排列吗——并算出总价吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一半和四分之一（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过测量长度到最接近的半英寸和四分之一英寸来生成测量数据；把数据画在刻度标有整数、一半和四分之一的折线图上
evidence: Measure five objects to the nearest 1/4 inch
Create a line plot showing the lengths of classmates' pencils in half-inches
Read a line plot and answer questions about the data
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把十支铅笔的长度测量到最接近的四分之一英寸，他们能记录数据并画在分成四分之一的数轴上吗——然后找出哪种长度出现得最多？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量液体与质量
topics.description: 用克、千克和升测量并估算物体的液体体积和质量；解决涉及质量或体积的一步应用题
evidence: Estimate the mass of a textbook in grams or kilograms
Read a scale to measure liquid volume in litres
Solve: 3 bags weigh 250 g each — what is the total mass?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要从一个 2 升的果汁容器往每个能装 250 毫升的瓶子里倒果汁，他们能算出可以装满几瓶吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的数
topics.description: 通过加减以分钟为单位的时间间隔来解决涉及经过时间的应用题，包括使用数轴
evidence: A film starts at 2:15 and lasts 47 minutes — when does it end?
Calculate how many minutes between 9:20 and 10:05
Use a number line to show the elapsed time between two events
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 下午 3:20 开始足球训练，训练持续 75 分钟，他们能借助数轴算出训练几点结束吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多边形的周长
topics.description: 解决涉及多边形周长的问题：根据边长求周长、求未知边长，并探索周长相同但面积不同的长方形（或反之）
evidence: Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with sides 8 cm and 5 cm
Find the missing side of a pentagon with perimeter 30 cm and four known sides
Draw two rectangles both with perimeter 24 cm but different areas
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个长方形的周长是 24 厘米，一条边是 8 厘米，{{name}} 能不画图就算出另一条边的长度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 精确到分钟认读时间（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 使用指针钟和数字钟认读并写出精确到分钟的时间
evidence: Read 7:43 from an analogue clock face
Write 11:06 on a digital display given a clock with hands
Match analogue and digital times to the nearest minute
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果钟面的分针刚过 9，{{name}} 能算出精确到分钟的时间，并用数字格式写出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识面积
topics.description: 理解单位正方形的面积是一个平方单位，平面图形的面积就是无缝隙、无重叠地覆盖它的单位正方形的个数
evidence: Identify a unit square and state its area is 1 square unit
Explain why a figure covered by 12 unit squares has area 12 square units
Distinguish between area and perimeter as different measurements
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 数出方格纸上所画长方形内的小方格，他们能说出面积是多少，并解释“一个平方单位”是什么意思吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 换算测量单位（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 了解同一计量体系内测量单位的相对大小（千米/米/厘米/毫米、千克/克、升/毫升、时/分/秒）；在不同公制单位之间换算，并用较小单位表示测量结果；在换算表中记录等值关系
evidence: Convert 3.5 km to 3,500 m
Complete a conversion table for cm and mm: (1,10), (2,20), (3,30)...
Express 2 kg 350 g as 2,350 g
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要把 3.5 千克换算成克，他们能自信地完成吗？还能填好一张简单的两列表格，用千克和克分别表示相同的测量结果吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算答案（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 在现实世界和数学问题中运用长方形的面积公式（长 × 宽）和周长公式（2长 + 2宽），包括正方形；用标准单位（平方厘米、平方米）计算并比较面积，估算不规则图形的面积
evidence: Find the width of a room given area = 48 m² and length = 8 m
Calculate the area of a square with side 7.5 cm
Estimate the area of an irregular pond drawn on a cm² grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想给一个 6.5 米 × 4 米的房间铺地毯，他们能算出面积，还能算出沿边缘需要多少米踢脚线吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算体积
topics.description: 用 1 立方厘米的方块估算长方体的体积；用水估算容器的容量
evidence: Build a cuboid from 1 cm³ blocks and state its volume
Estimate how many cm³ blocks would fill a given box
Estimate the capacity of a jug by comparing to known litre measures
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有一个小纸盒，他们能估算里面能装多少个 1 立方厘米的方块，然后装入方糖来验证吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数
topics.description: 运用分数或小数的四则运算，解决涉及距离、时间间隔、液体体积、质量和金钱的应用题；用包括数轴在内的图示表示
evidence: A 2.5 kg bag of flour is split equally into 4 portions — what does each weigh?
A journey takes 1 hr 45 min; what time do you arrive if you leave at 09:20?
Three ribbons of 0.75 m, 1.2 m, and 0.95 m — what is the total length?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 计划步行 4.5 公里，已经走了 1.75 公里，他们能算出还剩多远吗——并估算剩下的路程大概要花多长时间？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量数据线形图
topics.description: 制作线形图，用分数单位（1/2、1/4、1/8）展示测量数据；利用线形图数据解决分数加减法问题
evidence: Create a line plot of seed growth measurements in 1/8-inch increments
Use a line plot to find the difference between the longest and shortest specimens
Calculate the total length of all items in a line plot by adding the fractional measurements
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把毛毛虫的长度按几分之一英寸记录下来并画在数轴上，他们能通过把图上的分数相加，算出三条毛毛虫的总长度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 公制与英制换算
topics.description: 理解并使用公制单位与常用英制单位（英寸、磅、品脱）之间的近似等值关系
evidence: State that 1 inch ≈ 2.5 cm and use this to estimate length in inches
Know that 1 kg ≈ 2.2 pounds and estimate a person's weight in pounds
Convert approximately between litres and pints (1 litre ≈ 1.75 pints)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说一个婴儿重 7 磅，他们能用自己知道的近似换算，大致说出这相当于多少千克吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 组合图形的周长
topics.description: 以厘米和米为单位，测量并计算由直线构成组合图形的周长
evidence: Find the perimeter of an L-shaped figure by identifying all side lengths
Calculate the perimeter of a composite shape where some sides must be deduced
Draw a composite rectilinear shape with a perimeter of 40 cm
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张标好各边尺寸的 L 形花园平面图，他们能把所有边加起来求出总周长吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 精确到分钟的时间认读（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 解决涉及时间单位换算的问题（小时↔分钟、分钟↔秒、年↔月、周↔天）
evidence: Convert 3 hours 25 minutes to 205 minutes
A programme lasts 150 seconds — express in minutes and seconds
How many days are in 8 weeks and 3 days?
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要把 2 小时 35 分钟换算成只有分钟，他们能做到吗——然后再把 180 秒换算成分钟和秒？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三角形与平行四边形的面积
topics.description: 使用公式计算平行四边形和三角形的面积（平行四边形 A = b × h，三角形 A = ½ × b × h）
evidence: Calculate the area of a parallelogram with base 8 cm and height 5 cm
Calculate the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 7 cm
Explain why the area of a triangle is half the area of a related parallelogram
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在裁剪底为 8 厘米、高为 5 厘米的三角形布片，他们能用公式算出每块布片的面积吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数单位立方体
topics.description: 用立方厘米、立方英寸、立方英尺等单位，通过数单位立方体来测量体积
evidence: Count unit cubes in a 3D diagram to determine volume in cm³
Measure the volume of a small container by filling it with centimetre cubes
Express a measured volume using the correct cubic unit notation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在图中看到一个由小立方体搭成的立体图形，他们能数出它包含多少个立方体——包括藏在后面的——从而求出体积吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值
topics.description: 在同一测量系统内换算不同大小的标准测量单位（如 5 厘米换算为 0.05 米），使用最多三位小数的小数表示；在长度、质量、体积和时间的大小单位之间换算
evidence: Convert 3,250 g to 3.25 kg using decimal notation
Convert 0.45 km to 450 m
Explain the relationship between mm, cm, m, and km using powers of 10
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要把 5 厘米换算成米并用小数写出答案，他们能做到吗——还能把 2.45 千克换算成克吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算答案（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 通过用单位立方体填充来求直四棱柱的体积，并说明它等于 l × w × h（或底面积 × 高）；运用 V = l × w × h 和 V = B × h 解决实际问题；用标准单位（cm³、m³）计算、估算并比较正方体和长方体的体积
evidence: Use V = l × w × h to find the volume of a cuboid 4 cm × 3 cm × 5 cm = 60 cm³
Explain why packing a prism with unit cubes gives the same result as multiplying edge lengths
Compare volumes of two cuboids and identify which has greater capacity
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 想知道一个长 40 cm、宽 20 cm、深 15 cm 的种植箱能装多少土，他们能用公式算出体积吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量单位换算
topics.description: 解决涉及测量单位计算与换算的问题，在真实情境中运用小数记法和多步推理
evidence: Solve: 'A recipe uses 0.75 kg of flour. How many grams are needed for 3 batches?'
Compare 2.5 litres and 2,450 ml by converting to the same unit
Solve a multi-step problem involving time, distance, and unit conversion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要往一个能装 60 升的鱼缸里注水，水龙头每分钟注入 3.5 升，他们能算出注满鱼缸需要多长时间吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 测量长度（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 认识体积是立体图形的一种属性；理解单位立方体（棱长为 1 个单位）的体积是“1 立方单位”，可以用来测量体积；用 n 个单位立方体填满的立体图形体积为 n 立方单位
evidence: Explain what 'volume' means for a 3D shape and how it differs from area
Identify a unit cube and explain that it represents one cubic unit of volume
Determine the volume of a small solid by counting the unit cubes that fill it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用小立方体搭出一个立体图形，他们能数出立方体的个数来求体积吗？能用日常的话解释“1 立方厘米”是什么意思吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 英里与千米
topics.description: 利用近似关系（5 英里 ≈ 8 千米）在英里与千米之间换算
evidence: Convert 40 miles to approximately 64 km
Explain why the conversion factor between miles and km is approximately 1.6
Use the miles↔km relationship to compare a 10 km race with a 6-mile run
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要开车 40 英里去主题公园，他们能用“5 英里 ≈ 8 千米”的规则估算出大约是多少千米吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 周长（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 认识面积相同的图形可以有不同周长，反之亦然；系统地探究这一关系
evidence: Draw two rectangles with area 24 cm² but different perimeters
Find two shapes with perimeter 20 cm but different areas
Explain why a long thin rectangle and a square can have the same area but different perimeters
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 12 块正方形瓷砖可以摆放，他们能摆出不同形状的长方形，并发现面积不变（都是 12 块瓷砖）但周长各不相同吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 体积的可加性
topics.description: 认识体积具有可加性；求由两个或多个互不重叠的直四棱柱组成的组合立体图形的体积
evidence: Decompose an L-shaped solid into two cuboids and calculate total volume
Solve a real-world problem requiring the volume of a composite figure (e.g. a step-shaped structure)
Explain why splitting a composite solid into rectangular prisms allows calculation of total volume
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一个 L 形游泳池由两个长方形区域组成，{{name}} 能分别求出每个区域的体积，再把它们相加得到游泳池的总体积吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 除法即平均分
topics.description: 理解除法是把物品平均分到各组，或按组分配（能分出多少个指定大小的组）
evidence: Share 10 counters equally between 2 plates
Group 12 objects into sets of 3 and count 4 groups
Use concrete objects to solve 'How many groups of 2 in 8?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 12 颗葡萄要平均分给 3 个朋友，他们能算出每人分到 4 颗，并说出自己是怎么分的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用阵列表示乘法
topics.description: 用阵列表示乘法和除法情境
evidence: Build an array of 3 rows of 4 objects to show 3 × 4
Read an array and state the total
Use an array to solve a simple division problem (e.g. 12 objects in rows of 4 → 3 rows)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一盒鸡蛋排成 3 行、每行 4 个，他们能利用这个网格排列同时算出“3 × 4 = 12”和“12 ÷ 3 = 4”吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法即重复加法
topics.description: 理解乘法就是重复加法，以及把相等的几组归在一起
evidence: Explain that 3 groups of 2 is the same as 2 + 2 + 2
Use objects to make equal groups and count the total
Recognise an array as showing equal rows
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要数 4 个袋子、每袋 3 个苹果，他能不能想到不用一个一个数到 12，而是把 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 加起来——或者说“4 组 3”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法的交换律
topics.description: 理解并运用乘法的交换律，并认识到除法不满足交换律
evidence: Explain that 3 × 5 = 5 × 3 and show this with an array rotated
Use commutativity to choose the easier calculation
Demonstrate that 12 ÷ 3 ≠ 3 ÷ 12
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知不知道 4 × 7 和 7 × 4 的答案一样——所以可以从乘法表里挑更好记的那个顺序？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法即重复加法（6 岁以上）
topics.description: 用阵列、重复加法、心算方法和已知事实来解决乘法和除法问题
evidence: Solve 'There are 5 bags with 2 apples in each. How many apples?' using repeated addition or known fact
Solve 'Share 15 sweets equally among 3 children' using grouping
Draw an array to solve a multiplication problem in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你告诉 {{name}}“你有 5 个袋子，每袋 4 颗弹珠——一共多少颗？”，他能不能用实物、画图或心算算出来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 奇数和偶数
topics.description: 认识奇数和偶数
evidence: Identify whether a given number is odd or even
Explain that even numbers can be divided into 2 equal groups
Spot the pattern: even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 一个像 37 或 84 这样的数，他能不能马上告诉你它是奇数还是偶数——并说出他是怎么判断的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识 ×、÷ 和 = 符号
topics.description: 在乘法和除法算式中读出、写出并理解 ×、÷ 和 = 符号
evidence: Read 3 × 4 = 12 aloud as 'three times four equals twelve'
Write a multiplication sentence to match an array
Read 12 ÷ 3 = 4 aloud correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你在纸上写“6 × 4 = 24”或“15 ÷ 3 = 5”，{{name}} 能不能告诉你乘号、除号和等号各是什么意思？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法表
topics.description: 回忆并运用 2、5、10 乘法表的乘法和除法事实
evidence: Quickly answer 5 × 3 = 15 from memory
Quickly answer 20 ÷ 5 = 4 from memory
Recite the 2, 5, and 10 times tables fluently
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能快速回忆 2、5、10 乘法表里的事实——比如“5 × 6 = 30”或“20 ÷ 2 = 10”——正着背和倒着背都行？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用阵列做乘法（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 用加法求出排成矩形阵列（最多 5 行 5 列）的物体总数；写出算式，把总数表示成相同加数的和
evidence: Count objects in a 3×4 array and write 4 + 4 + 4 = 12
Explain that each row has the same number of objects so the total can be found by repeated addition
Draw a rectangular array to model a given repeated-addition equation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张纸上贴了 4 行、每行 5 张贴纸，他能不能用重复加法——“5 + 5 + 5 + 5”——求出总数，并把它写成一个算式？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多步乘除法
topics.description: 解决涉及乘法和除法的问题，包括缩放问题，以及 n 个物体对应 m 个物体的对应问题
evidence: Solve a scaling problem (e.g. 'the ribbon is 3 times as long')
Solve a correspondence problem (e.g. '4 shirts and 3 trousers — how many outfits?')
Solve a missing-number multiplication or division problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一份 4 人份的食谱需要 3 个鸡蛋，{{name}} 能不能算出 8 人份需要几个鸡蛋——并认识到这是一个翻倍或缩放的问题？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 长方形的行与列
topics.description: 把长方形划分成大小相同的小方格，排成行与列，再数一数一共有多少个
evidence: Divide a rectangle into equal rows and columns of unit squares
Count the total number of squares using repeated addition or skip counting
Relate the rows-and-columns structure to a rectangular array
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能画线把长方形划分成整齐的等大方格，再数出所有方格的总数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法口诀表（7 岁以上）
topics.description: 熟记并运用 3、4、8 的乘法口诀进行乘法和除法运算
evidence: Recall 3 × 1 through 3 × 12 and corresponding division facts
Recall 4 × 1 through 4 × 12 and corresponding division facts
Recall 8 × 1 through 8 × 12 and corresponding division facts
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能快速说出 3、4、8 的乘法口诀吗？比如“8 × 7 = 56”或“36 ÷ 4 = 9”，不用每次都重新算一遍。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 竖式乘法与除法
topics.description: 运用已学的乘法口诀，写出并计算乘法和除法的数学算式，包括两位数 × 一位数，先用心算，再逐步过渡到规范的竖式方法
evidence: Calculate 23 × 4 using partitioning (20 × 4 + 3 × 4)
Calculate 96 ÷ 8 using known table facts
Begin to use a formal written layout for short multiplication
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能算出“23 × 4”或“68 ÷ 4”这样的题吗？可以用乘法口诀心算，也可以一步一步写出来。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 12×12 以内的全部乘法口诀
topics.description: 熟记 12 × 12 以内乘法口诀的乘法和除法运算
evidence: Recall any fact from the 1–12 times tables rapidly
Recall the corresponding division fact for any multiplication fact
Use known facts to check or derive answers in calculations
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能快速准确地说出 12 以内所有乘法口诀的乘法和除法结果吗？比如“9 × 8 = 72”或“132 ÷ 12 = 11”。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 除法即求未知因数
topics.description: 理解除法就是求未知因数的问题（例如，通过找出与 8 相乘得 32 的数来求 32 ÷ 8）
evidence: Explain that 32 ÷ 8 = ? is the same as 8 × ? = 32
Use a known multiplication fact to find a division answer
Describe the relationship between multiplication and division as inverse operations
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能通过问自己“8 乘几得 32？”来算出“32 ÷ 8”吗？用的是乘法口诀，而不是另学一套除法方法。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 因数对与交换律
topics.description: 认识并运用因数对和交换律进行心算
evidence: List all factor pairs of a given number (e.g. 24: 1×24, 2×12, 3×8, 4×6)
Use commutativity to reorder a multiplication for easier mental calculation
Explain what a factor pair is and how commutativity helps
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要算“4 × 15”，能发现把它拆成“4 × 5 × 3 = 20 × 3 = 60”是个巧妙的捷径吗？用因数对让计算更简单。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 熟练的乘除法运算
topics.description: 运用乘法与除法之间的关系等策略，熟练进行 100 以内的乘法和除法运算
evidence: Answer any single-digit multiplication fact within 3 seconds
Answer any related division fact within 3 seconds
Use known facts to derive unknown facts (e.g. 9 × 7 from 10 × 7 − 7)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能快速回答 10 × 10 以内任何乘法口诀的题目吗？还能说出对应的除法结果，比如知道“9 × 7 = 63”，就能说出“63 ÷ 9 = 7”。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 心算乘法与除法
topics.description: 运用位值、已知和推导出的运算结果进行心算乘除法，包括乘 0 和乘 1、除以 1，以及三个数相乘
evidence: Calculate 40 × 6 = 240 mentally using place value
Explain why any number × 0 = 0 and any number × 1 = the number itself
Multiply three numbers mentally by choosing a useful pair first (e.g. 2 × 7 × 5 = 2 × 5 × 7 = 70)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能立刻心算出“6 × 0”“1 × 35”或“100 ÷ 100”这样的题吗？用已知的知识，而不是每次都从头算。

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法与除法应用题
topics.description: 在 100 以内运用乘法和除法，解决涉及等量分组、阵列和测量数量的应用题
evidence: Solve an equal-groups word problem using multiplication
Solve a measurement division problem (e.g. 'How many 4-cm pieces from a 28-cm ribbon?')
Solve an array/area word problem using multiplication
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}}“有 7 个盒子，每盒装 9 支铅笔——一共有多少支铅笔？”，他能不能认出这是一道乘法题并正确解答？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法与加法问题
topics.description: 解决涉及乘法和加法的问题，包括运用分配律、整数倍数问题，以及较难的对应关系问题
evidence: Use the distributive law to solve 14 × 6 as 10 × 6 + 4 × 6
Solve a scaling problem (e.g. 'A tower is 3 times as tall as a 15 m building')
Solve a correspondence problem (e.g. '3 types of bread, 4 types of filling — how many different sandwiches?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要算出“5 × 23”，他能不能把它拆成“5 × 20 + 5 × 3 = 100 + 15 = 115”——而不是直接套用竖式方法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整十数乘法
topics.description: 运用基于位值和运算性质的策略，用一位整数乘以 10–90 范围内的 10 的倍数
evidence: Calculate 7 × 30 = 210 by reasoning 7 × 3 tens = 21 tens = 210
Explain why multiplying by a multiple of 10 adds a zero to the product
Use this skill to estimate products of larger numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能先做一位数乘法，再补上零，快速算出“7 × 40”或“6 × 80”——得到 280 和 480？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法表中的规律
topics.description: 识别算术规律（包括加法表或乘法表中的规律），并运用运算性质解释这些规律
evidence: Notice that all products of 5 end in 0 or 5 and explain why
Observe that the sum of two even numbers is always even
Identify a pattern in the multiplication table and explain it using commutativity or the distributive property
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能发现乘法表中的规律——比如 5 的倍数都以 0 或 5 结尾——并解释为什么会有这个规律？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 运算性质
topics.description: 运用运算性质（交换律、结合律、分配律）作为乘法和除法的策略
evidence: Use commutativity: if 6 × 4 = 24 then 4 × 6 = 24
Use the distributive property: 8 × 7 = 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 = 40 + 16 = 56
Use associativity to multiply three numbers: 2 × 3 × 5 = 6 × 5 = 30
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能用拆数这样的技巧——把“6 × 14”算成“6 × 10 + 6 × 4 = 60 + 24 = 84”——让乘法变得更容易？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法与除法中的未知数
topics.description: 在涉及三个整数的乘法或除法等式中，求出未知的整数（如 8 × ? = 48、? × 6 = 42）
evidence: Find the missing factor in 7 × ? = 63
Find the missing dividend in ? ÷ 5 = 9
Explain the strategy used (e.g. using the related multiplication fact)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在纸上看到“8 × ? = 48”或“? ÷ 6 = 7”，他能不能算出空格里该填什么数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 除法的含义
topics.description: 理解整数商的含义（如 56 ÷ 8 表示每份中物体的数量，或等量分组的组数）
evidence: Explain that 56 ÷ 8 can mean sharing 56 into 8 equal groups or making groups of 8
Draw a picture to represent a division expression
Match a division expression to a word problem involving equal sharing or grouping
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不能解释“56 ÷ 8”可以表示“把 56 个东西平均分给 8 个人，每人分到几个？”——而不只是背出答案“7”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法的含义
topics.description: 理解整数乘积的含义（如 5 × 7 表示 5 组、每组 7 个时物体的总数）
evidence: Explain that 4 × 6 means 4 groups of 6 objects
Draw a picture or array to represent a multiplication expression
Match a multiplication expression to a word problem involving equal groups
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到写着的“5 × 7”，他能不能解释这表示 5 组、每组 7 个——而不只是背出答案“35”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 竖式乘法
topics.description: 用规范的竖式方法，将两位数、三位数乘一位数
evidence: Set out and solve 47 × 6 using short multiplication
Set out and solve 234 × 5 using short multiplication with carrying
Check the answer using estimation (e.g. 234 × 5 ≈ 200 × 5 = 1000)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能通过规范的竖式方法计算“347 × 6”吗——逐位相乘，需要时进位？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 有余数的除法
topics.description: 用四种运算解决整数的多步应用题，包括在情境中解释余数；用含未知数字母的等式表示；用估算检验
evidence: 52 children go on a trip in minibuses holding 9 each — how many minibuses are needed? (interpret remainder)
A shop sells packs of 6 pencils for £1.50 each — how much do 5 packs cost?
Represent a two-step problem with an equation using n for the unknown
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到“学校买了 7 盒钢笔，每盒 24 支，平均分给 8 个班”，能一步步算完，并合理判断余数该怎么处理吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 因数、倍数与质数
topics.description: 找出 1–100 范围内一个整数的所有因数对；识别两个数的公因数和公倍数；运用这些概念解决问题
evidence: State the first five multiples of 7
Find the common factors of 24 and 36
Find all common factors of 36 and 48
Identify the first three common multiples of 6 and 8
Determine whether a given number (e.g. 97) is prime and justify the reasoning
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能列出像 36 这样的数的所有因数对吗——(1, 36)、(2, 18)、(3, 12)、(4, 9)、(6, 6)——并找出两个数共有的因数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 因数、倍数与质数（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 运用因数、倍数、平方数和立方数的知识解决乘除法问题
evidence: Is 156 a multiple of 6? Explain how you know
Find two square numbers that add to make 100
Use factor pairs to simplify 24 × 25 as 6 × (4 × 25) = 6 × 100 = 600
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果让 {{name}} 找出所有小于 100 的平方数，能系统地逐一找出，并给出正确列表：1、4、9、16、25、36、49、64、81 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 长乘法
topics.description: 用包括长乘法在内的规范竖式方法，将最多四位的整数乘一位数，以及两位数乘两位数；用面积模型说明
evidence: Calculate 2,347 × 6 using formal written layout
Calculate 34 × 27 using long multiplication
Draw an area model for 45 × 23 and connect to the written method
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用规范的竖式方法计算“2,346 × 7”或“43 × 28”这样的题吗——认真列式，一步步算完？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 心算乘除法（9 岁以上）
topics.description: 借助已知事实进行心算乘除，包括相关事实和位值调整
evidence: Calculate 40 × 60 mentally by using 4 × 6 = 24 then appending zeros
Derive 7 × 15 by calculating 7 × 10 + 7 × 5
Calculate 360 ÷ 9 mentally using 36 ÷ 9 = 4
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能心算“24 × 5”或“360 ÷ 8”这样的题吗——巧妙联系已知事实，而不需要写下来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法比较
topics.description: 用画图和含未知数符号的等式解决乘法比较应用题
evidence: A blue ribbon is 3 times as long as a red ribbon of 7 cm — how long is the blue ribbon?
36 is 4 times a number — what is the number?
Explain why 'Sam has 5 more' is additive but 'Sam has 5 times as many' is multiplicative
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你说“玛雅的贴纸是汤姆的 4 倍，汤姆有 6 张——玛雅有多少张？”，{{name}} 能认出这是乘法问题并解决吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法比较
topics.description: 把乘法等式理解为比较（如 35 = 5 × 7 表示 35 是 7 的 5 倍）；把乘法比较的口头表述表示为等式
evidence: Explain that '4 times as many' means multiply by 4
Write an equation for: Sarah has 3 times as many stickers as Tom, who has 8 stickers
Distinguish multiplicative comparison from additive comparison in word problems
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看到“35 = 5 × 7”时，能解释为“35 是 7 的 5 倍”吗——把它理解为比较，而不只是一个乘法事实？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘与除
topics.description: 用 10、100 和 1000 来乘除整数以及带小数的数
evidence: Calculate 3.45 × 100 = 345
Calculate 72 ÷ 1000 = 0.072
Explain that multiplying by 10 shifts each digit one place to the left
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能快速算出“4.7 × 100”或“3,600 ÷ 1,000”吗——并且知道在乘或除时，数字会在位值表中向左或向右移动？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 质数
topics.description: 认识并使用质数、质因数和合数的词汇；判断 100 以内的数是否为质数；记住 19 以内的质数
evidence: Explain that a prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself
Determine whether 51 is prime or composite and justify the answer
List all prime numbers up to 19 from memory
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出一个数为什么是“质数”——它只能被 1 和它本身整除——并举出 7、11 和 13 这样的例子吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形规律
topics.description: 按照给定规则生成数字或图形规律；找出规律中规则未明确说明的明显特征，并简单解释它们为什么会出现
evidence: Given 'start at 1, add 3', generate terms and notice they alternate odd/even
Given a shape pattern, predict the next three terms and describe the rule
Explain why starting at 2 and adding 4 always gives even numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果告诉 {{name}}“从 3 开始，每次乘 2”，他们能写出这个规律——3、6、12、24、48——并发现它在增长方式上有什么有趣的特征吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 带余数的短除法
topics.description: 用短除法（以及位值/阵列策略）把不超过四位的数除以一位数；根据情境合理处理余数
evidence: Calculate 4,932 ÷ 6 using short division
Solve 125 ÷ 8 and interpret: 15 remainder 5 means 15 full bags with 5 left over
Use the multiplication–division relationship to check a division answer
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用短除法（“公交车停靠站”法）算出像“2,457 ÷ 6”这样的题，并决定余数该怎么处理吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 平方数与立方数
topics.description: 认识并使用平方数和立方数，以及平方（²）和立方（³）的写法
evidence: Identify 49 as 7² and explain that 7 × 7 = 49
Calculate 4³ = 64 and explain it means 4 × 4 × 4
List the first ten square numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道“5²”表示 5 × 5 = 25，“3³”表示 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 吗——他们能算出其他平方数和立方数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数
topics.description: 解决涉及按简单分数缩放的问题，以及涉及简单比率的问题
evidence: A recipe for 4 people needs 200 g of flour — how much for 6 people?
If 3 kg costs £12, how much does 5 kg cost?
Scale a shape by a factor of 1/2 and find the new dimensions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果一份食谱是 4 人份，而 {{name}} 想做 6 人份，他们能按比例放大每种食材吗——比如把“2 杯面粉”改成“3 杯”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 算式中的括号
topics.description: 在数值算式中使用圆括号、方括号或大括号，并计算含有这些分组符号的算式
evidence: Evaluate 3 × (4 + 5) by computing inside the parentheses first
Evaluate {2 × [3 + (7 − 1)]} with nested grouping symbols
Insert parentheses into an expression to make it equal a target value
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看到“3 × (4 + 5)”时，能先算括号——得到“3 × 9 = 27”——而不是直接从左往右乘吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值
topics.description: 用整数乘一位数，乘数最多有两位小数（例如 3.47 × 6）
evidence: Correctly compute 4.56 × 7 using a written method
Use place-value reasoning to explain why 3.2 × 5 = 16.0
Model a decimal multiplication using an area diagram or expanded form
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能算出“3.47 × 6”吗——把小数点放在正确位置，并在每一列正确进位？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 除以两位数
topics.description: 在合适的情况下，用规范的短除法笔算，将不超过 4 位的数除以两位数，并根据情境解释余数
evidence: Use short division to compute 3,648 ÷ 16 efficiently
Explain when short division is more appropriate than long division
Interpret a remainder as a decimal or fraction in a measurement context
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用短除法算出像“2,184 ÷ 12”这样的题吗——每一步都盯住每一位数字，并把余数带到下一列？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数除法
topics.description: 在答案最多有两位小数的情况下使用笔算除法；将精确到百分位的小数除以整数
evidence: Compute 14.76 ÷ 4 using a written method to get 3.69
Explain how to continue long division past the decimal point to obtain a decimal quotient
Solve a context problem that requires dividing a decimal amount equally (e.g. sharing £18.60 among 5 people)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用笔算方法算出像“17 ÷ 4 = 4.25”这样的题吗——把除法越过小数点继续算下去，得到小数答案而不是余数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 有余数的除法（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 用规范的长除法笔算，将不超过 4 位的数除以两位数除数，并根据情况把余数表示为整数、分数或四舍五入
evidence: Compute 4,752 ÷ 13 using long division and express the remainder as a fraction
Decide whether to round up or down a division remainder in a real-life context (e.g. buses needed)
Explain each step of the long division algorithm for a 4-digit ÷ 2-digit calculation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用长除法算出像“1,848 ÷ 24”这样的题吗——按除、乘、减、移下一位的步骤一步步算到答案？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用估算检验计算结果
topics.description: 用估算检验计算结果，并在具体问题情境中判断合适的精确程度
evidence: Estimate 487 × 23 by rounding to 500 × 20 and use this to check a calculated answer
Determine whether an exact answer or an estimate is more appropriate in a given context
Spot an unreasonable answer by comparing with a quick mental estimate
topics.assessmentPrompt: 在 {{name}} 计算较大的乘法或除法之前，能先估一估答案大概是多少——然后检查最终答案是否在合理范围内吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 长乘法（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 熟练使用规范的长乘法笔算方法，计算多位数整数乘法（最多 4 位数乘 2 位数）
evidence: Correctly compute 2,463 × 37 using long multiplication
Explain each partial product in a long multiplication and why they are added
Multiply a four-digit number by a two-digit number without procedural errors
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用长乘法算出像“2,347 × 24”这样的题吗——分两行写，一行算个位、一行算十位，再把结果相加？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 心算策略
topics.description: 进行心算，包括混合运算和大数运算，运用拆分、凑整和由已知事实推导等策略
evidence: Mentally compute 45 × 8 by partitioning into 40 × 8 + 5 × 8
Use known facts to derive 6.5 × 4 mentally
Solve a multi-operation mental calculation such as 250 × 3 + 500 and explain the strategy used
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能完全在脑子里算出像“(200 × 6) + 350 − 75”这样的混合运算吗——每一步都记清楚，不用写下来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘除 10、100 和 1000（10 岁以上）
topics.description: 将数乘以或除以 10、100 和 1000，答案最多保留三位小数，理解数字在位值表中会移动位置
evidence: Compute 3.456 × 100 = 345.6 correctly
Compute 45.2 ÷ 1000 = 0.0452 correctly
Explain why multiplying by 10 shifts each digit one place to the left
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能算出“4.6 ÷ 1,000 = 0.0046”吗——知道每除以 10 数字就向右移一位，即使越过小数点也一样？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多步问题：选择运算
topics.description: 解决涉及加法、减法、乘法和除法的问题，判断该用哪些运算和方法以及为什么；解决情境中的多步问题
evidence: Solve a three-step word problem involving a mix of all four operations
Explain why particular operations were chosen for each step of a multi-step problem
Identify and correct an error in a multi-step solution that used the wrong operation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一道混合不同运算的多步问题——比如算出几件不同价格商品的总价——他们能规划并正确完成每一步吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 运算顺序
topics.description: 理解并运用常规的运算顺序（PEMDAS/BODMAS），完成涉及四则运算的计算
evidence: Explain why 8 + 2 × 5 = 18 (not 50) by referencing multiplication before addition
Evaluate a multi-step expression like 12 ÷ 3 + 4 × 2 correctly as 12
State the correct order: brackets, then orders/exponents, then multiplication/division (L→R), then addition/subtraction (L→R)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到“8 + 4 × 3”，能算出 20 而不是 36，是因为知道要先算乘法再算加法吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 答案取整
topics.description: 解决需要把答案按要求精度取整的问题
evidence: Compute a division and round the result to one decimal place as specified
Determine the appropriate degree of accuracy for a measurement context (e.g. round to nearest penny)
Solve a problem where an unrounded decimal answer must be interpreted in context (e.g. whole containers needed)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 算出的答案是 8.63，但题目要求取整到最接近的整数，能正确取整为 9，并说明为什么在实际情境中这种精度很重要吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 写数字表达式
topics.description: 写出记录数字计算的简单数值表达式，并在不计算的情况下解读数值表达式（例如认识到 3 × (18932 + 921) 是 18932 + 921 的三倍）
evidence: Write an expression for 'add 8 and 7, then multiply by 2' using parentheses
Explain what 4 × (365 − 12) represents without computing it
Compare two expressions and determine which is larger without evaluating
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 看到“4 × (5 + 3)”时，能说出“这是 5 加 3 的结果的 4 倍”，把表达式当作对计算的描述来读，而不必先算出结果吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 因数、倍数与质数（11 岁以上）
topics.description: 运用质数、因数、倍数、公因数、公倍数、最大公因数（HCF）、最小公倍数（LCM）以及质因数分解的概念和词汇，包括乘积表示法和唯一分解性质
evidence: Express any integer as a product of its prime factors using index notation
Find the HCF and LCM of two numbers using prime factorisation
Apply the unique factorisation theorem to explain why every number has exactly one set of prime factors
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能找出 24 和 36 这样的两个数的最大公因数——算出能同时整除两者的最大数——并说明自己是怎么找到的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 运算优先级
topics.description: 使用表示运算优先级的常规符号，包括括号、乘方、根和倒数；一致地运用 BIDMAS/BODMAS 计算复杂的数值表达式
evidence: Evaluate expressions involving brackets, indices, and all four operations in the correct order
Explain why the order of operations is necessary to avoid ambiguity
Use the reciprocal of a number and understand that a number multiplied by its reciprocal gives 1
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能正确计算“5 + 2³ ÷ 4”这样的复杂表达式——按正确的运算顺序，先算乘方再算除法，先算除法再算加法吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 乘法的符号规则
topics.description: 进行正整数、负整数和有理数的乘除运算，理解积或商的符号规则
evidence: Apply the sign rules when multiplying two integers (positive × negative, negative × negative)
Apply the sign rules when dividing two integers
Solve multi-step real-world problems involving all four operations with positive and negative rational numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道负负得正，能运用这条规则算出“−3 × −4 = 12”这样的计算，并说明为什么这样是合理的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 运用逆运算
topics.description: 认识并运用运算之间的关系，包括逆运算；利用这些关系检查答案、简化计算
evidence: Use addition and subtraction as inverse operations to check and solve problems
Use multiplication and division as inverse operations to check and solve problems
Recognise that squaring and square-rooting are inverse operations
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 算出“252 ÷ 7 = 36”，能立刻用逆运算检验——“36 × 7 = 252”——而不必重新做一遍除法吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二十以内的数字单词
topics.description: 读、写一到二十的数字单词
evidence: Read the word 'twelve' and identify it as 12
Write the word form of a given number 1–20
Match numeral cards to number word cards
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能写出“fourteen”或“twenty”这样的数字单词，并在生日贺卡或故事书里读出来，不需要别人帮忙吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 读写 100 以内的数
topics.description: 读写 0 到 100 的数字
evidence: Read two-digit numerals up to 100 correctly
Write any number 0–100 as a numeral from dictation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能读写 100 以内的任意数字吗——既能写出数字，也能说出它表示多少？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 读写 20 以内的数
topics.description: 读写 0 到 20 的数字
evidence: Read any numeral 0–20 when shown it
Write numerals 0–20 legibly from dictation
Represent a number of objects with the correct written numeral
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能读出纸上写的数字（比如“17”）并自己写出来吗——他们知道每个数字代表什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十几的数
topics.description: 理解十几的数（11–19）是由十个一和几个一组成的（位值的早期概念）
evidence: Compose 14 as a group of ten and four ones using objects
Decompose 17 into 10 + 7 and record as an equation
Explain that 13 is 'one ten and three ones'
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 14 块积木，他们能看出这是一整摞 10 块加上剩下的 4 块吗——理解“十几”就是十加几？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多 10 或少 10
topics.description: 不用数，心算找出比给定两位数多 10 或少 10 的数
evidence: Given 56, quickly say 66 is 10 more and 46 is 10 less
Explain that adding 10 increases the tens digit by 1
Answer '10 more than 73' without using fingers or counting on
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能很快说出比 43 多 10 或比 71 少 10 的数吗——不用一个一个地数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一个十就是十个一
topics.description: 理解 10 可以看作十个一捆成的一捆——叫做“一个十”
evidence: Group 10 single cubes into one rod of 10 and explains why
Explain that 10 ones is the same as 1 ten
Exchange 10 ones for a single tens block
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释十个单个物体捆在一起就是“一个十”——这就是为什么写 10 时十位上写 1、个位上写 0 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较和排序数
topics.description: 基于位值理解，用 >、=、< 符号比较和排序两位数
evidence: Correctly place > or < between 34 and 43
Order a set of two-digit numbers from smallest to largest
Explain a comparison by referring to the tens digit first, then ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看 34、67 和 21 这三个数，他们能从小到大排好——并正确使用 > 或 < 符号吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 100 以内的数词
topics.description: 用文字读写至少 100 以内的数
evidence: Read 'fifty-seven' and write the numeral 57
Write 'eighty-three' when shown the numeral 83
Read and write all decade words (twenty, thirty … ninety) correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把“seventy-four”或“one hundred and three”写成数词——并在书里或标牌上看到时正确读出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 位值理解与数的运算事实
topics.description: 运用位值理解和数的运算事实解决问题
evidence: Use knowledge that 34 = 30 + 4 to help add 34 + 20 = 54
Solve 'I think of a number, add 10, and get 45. What was my number?'
Apply partitioning to solve a problem in an unfamiliar context
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}}“哪个数最接近 50——47 还是 54？”，他们能用自己的数感快速回答并解释原因吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 读写 120 以内的数
topics.description: 从任意小于 120 的数开始数到 120；读写 120 以内的数字
evidence: Count from 47 to 120 without errors
Read the numeral 108 correctly
Write the numeral for one hundred and fifteen
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能从 120 以内的任意一个数开始数吗？比如从 87 开始一直数到 120，中间不会数乱？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数的表示
topics.description: 用不同的方式识别、表示和估算数，包括数轴
evidence: Place a two-digit number on a 0–100 number line in approximately the right position
Estimate 'about how many' objects are in a set of 30–50 without counting
Represent the same number using base-ten blocks, a number line, and a drawing
Represent a three-digit number using base-ten blocks, a number line, or a place-value chart
Estimate where a number falls on a 0–1000 number line
Match a base-ten representation to the correct numeral
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用不同的方式表示像 346 这样的数吗？比如用十进积木、在数轴上表示，或者画出来，并说出每种表示方式说明了什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 10 的倍数
topics.description: 理解 10 的倍数（10、20、30……90）表示一到九个十和零个一
evidence: Explain that 30 means 3 tens and 0 ones
Represent 50 using 5 tens rods and no unit cubes
Match decade numbers to their tens representation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释 60 表示 6 个十、没有一吗？能说出这就是个位上写 0 占位的原因吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 两位数的两个数字
topics.description: 理解两位数的两个数字分别表示几个十和几个一
evidence: Explain that in 47, the 4 represents 4 tens (40) and the 7 represents 7 ones
Use base-ten blocks to show a two-digit number as tens and ones
Identify the tens digit and ones digit in any two-digit number
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到数字 47，能说出里面有 4 个十（四十）和 7 个一吗？而不是只把数字读成“四七”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多 10 或少 10、多 100 或少 100
topics.description: 找出比给定数（1000 以内）多 10 或少 10、多 100 或少 100 的数
evidence: Given a three-digit number, state what is 10 more and 10 less
Given a three-digit number, state what is 100 more and 100 less
Explain the strategy using place-value understanding (e.g. only the tens/hundreds digit changes)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能很快心算出“比 342 多 10”或“比 875 少 100”吗？知道哪个数位变了、哪个没变吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一百就是十个十
topics.description: 理解 100 可以看作十个十捆成的一捆，叫做“一百”
evidence: Explain that 10 groups of 10 ones make 100
Bundle ten tens sticks into one hundred and describe what happened
Represent 100 using base-ten blocks showing 10 tens
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释十个整十叠在一起就是一百吗？能说出这就是 100 的百位写 1、其余数位写 0 的原因吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 奇数还是偶数
topics.description: 判断一组物体（最多 20 个）的数量是奇数还是偶数
evidence: Pair objects and determine whether there is one left over (odd) or not (even)
Count a group by 2s to determine if the total is even
Write an equation to express an even number as a sum of two equal addends (e.g. 8 = 4 + 4)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有 14 个物体，能判断这个数是奇数还是偶数吗？比如两两配对，看看有没有剩下的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 1000 以内数的排序
topics.description: 基于位值理解，用 >、= 和 < 符号比较和排列 1000 以内的数
evidence: Compare two three-digit numbers by examining hundreds first, then tens, then ones
Use >, =, and < correctly to record comparisons of three-digit numbers
Order a set of numbers up to 1000 from smallest to largest
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一组三位数，比如 456、231 和 789，能按顺序排列并正确使用 > 和 < 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 1000 以内的位值
topics.description: 解决涉及 1000 以内数字位值的数字问题和实际问题
evidence: Solve a problem that requires identifying how many hundreds, tens, or ones are in a number
Apply place-value knowledge to a practical context (e.g. counting money in pounds)
Explain the strategy used to solve a place-value problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}}“我有 4 个百、3 个十和 7 个一——这是哪个数？”，他能把这些合起来，说出 437 吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 读写 1000 以内的数
topics.description: 用数字、数词和展开形式读写 1000 以内的数
evidence: Read a three-digit numeral aloud correctly
Write a three-digit number in words (e.g. 'three hundred and forty-two')
Write a number in expanded form (e.g. 600 + 30 + 7)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能读写 1000 以内的数吗——既能用数字写，也能用文字写——比如把“642”读成“六百四十二”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 100 的倍数
topics.description: 理解 100 的倍数（100–900）各自表示若干个百，十位和个位都是 0
evidence: Identify that 300 means 3 hundreds, 0 tens, 0 ones
Place multiples of 100 on a number line to 1000
Read and write multiples of 100 and explain their place-value structure
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释 700 表示 7 个百、没有十也没有一吗——并用十进积木或画图展示出来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 三位数的三个数字
topics.description: 理解三位数的三个数字分别表示百、十、一的多少
evidence: State the value of each digit in a three-digit number (e.g. in 362, the 3 represents 3 hundreds)
Partition a three-digit number into hundreds, tens, and ones (e.g. 485 = 400 + 80 + 5)
Explain why 706 has 7 hundreds, 0 tens, and 6 ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到数字 348，他能告诉你这里有 3 个百、4 个十和 8 个一吗——而不是只把数字读成“三、四、八”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 多 1000 或少 1000
topics.description: 求比给定数多 1000 或少 1000 的数
evidence: Given 4,562, state that 1000 more is 5,562 and 1000 less is 3,562
Explain using place value that only the thousands digit changes
Apply this skill to numbers beyond 10,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能快速心算“比 3,456 多 1,000”或“比 7,200 少 1,000”吗——知道只有千位上的数字会变？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较大数
topics.description: 给 1000 以上的数排序并比较大小
evidence: Compare two four-digit numbers using >, <, and = by examining digits from the highest place value
Order a set of numbers up to 10,000 from smallest to largest
Justify the ordering using place-value reasoning
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把 4,321、1,876 和 9,045 这样一组四位数从小到大排序吗——逐位进行比较？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 负数
topics.description: 倒着数经过零，包括负数
evidence: Count backwards from 5 through zero: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2 …
Place negative numbers on a number line
Understand that negative numbers are less than zero and use them in context (e.g. temperature)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能倒着数经过零进入负数吗——比如 3、2、1、0、−1、−2、−3——在零那里不卡壳？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 10000 以内的数
topics.description: 用不同的表示方式识别、表示和估算 10000 以内的数
evidence: Represent a four-digit number on a place-value chart or with base-ten materials
Estimate where a number falls on a 0–10,000 number line
Match different representations of the same number (e.g. expanded form, place-value counters, numeral)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在 0 到 10,000 的数轴上把 6,400 这样的数标在差不多正确的位置吗——并说出他是怎么决定放在哪里的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 每个数位上的位值
topics.description: 认识四位数中每个数字的位值（千位、百位、十位和个位）
evidence: State the value of each digit in a four-digit number (e.g. in 7,345 the 7 represents 7 thousands)
Partition a four-digit number into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones
Compose a four-digit number from given place-value parts (e.g. 3000 + 400 + 50 + 2 = 3,452)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到数字 5,347，能说出每个数字的值吗——5 表示 5,000，3 表示 300，4 表示 40，7 表示 7？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 位值问题解决
topics.description: 用越来越大的正数解决涉及位值的数字问题和实际问题
evidence: Solve a problem requiring rounding, comparing, or ordering numbers beyond 1000
Apply place-value knowledge in a practical context (e.g. population figures, distances)
Explain the strategy used, referencing place-value understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}}“用数字 3、7、1 和 8 能组成的最大四位偶数是多少？”，能一步步有条理地做出来并给出答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 100 以内的罗马数字
topics.description: 认读 100 以内的罗马数字（I 到 C），并理解数字系统随着时间发展，加入了零和位值
evidence: Read and write Roman numerals I, V, X, L, C and combinations up to 100
Convert between Roman numerals and Hindu-Arabic numerals (e.g. XLIV = 44)
Explain that Roman numerals have no zero and no place-value system
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能认读像 XIV（14）或 XLII（42）这样的罗马数字吗——并且知道为什么在发明了零和位值之后，大多数场合就不再使用罗马数字了吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 四舍五入到 10、100、1000
topics.description: 把任意数四舍五入到最接近的 10、100 或 1000
evidence: Explain the rounding rule using a number line (which multiple is closer)
Apply rounding to estimate calculations
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把像 4,738 这样的数四舍五入到最接近的 10（4,740）、100（4,700）或 1,000（5,000）吗——并说明自己是看哪一位数字来决定的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 正着数和倒着数（9 岁以上）
evidence: Count on in 10,000s from 462,000
Count back in 100,000s from 800,000
Identify the next three terms: 375,000; 475,000; 575,000; ...
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能从任意起始数开始，按 1,000 或 10,000 正着数和倒着数吗——比如 34,500、44,500、54,500——而且不会数乱？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 情境中的负数
topics.description: 在情境中理解负数（温度、海平面、银行余额）；用正整数和负整数正着数和倒着数，包括经过零
evidence: Place –3, –1, 0, 2, 5 on a number line
The temperature is –4°C and rises by 7 degrees — what is the new temperature?
Count backwards from 3 in ones: 3, 2, 1, 0, –1, –2
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果夜里温度降到 −5°C，白天升到 3°C，{{name}} 能把这两个温度标在数轴上，并说出白天比夜里暖多少度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 位值 × 10 的规律
topics.description: 认识在多位数整数中，某一位上的数字所表示的值是它右边一位的十倍（例如 700 ÷ 70 = 10）
evidence: Explain that the 3 in 3,000 is ten times the 3 in 300
Complete: 700 ÷ 70 = __ and explain using place-value reasoning
