State that plesiosaurs lived in the sea but were not dinosaurs
Identify at least one way a movie or cartoon dinosaur differs from the real animal
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在恐龙书里看到一只会飞的爬行动物，能告诉你它其实不是恐龙，而是另一种史前动物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 世界各地的恐龙
topics.description: 了解不同的恐龙生活在不同的大陆上，世界各地的化石发现表明恐龙是全球性现象，有些种类只在特定地区被发现
evidence: State that dinosaur fossils have been found on every continent including Antarctica
Name at least one dinosaur discovery location (e.g. T. rex in North America, Velociraptor in Mongolia)
Suggest a reason why the same type of dinosaur is sometimes found on continents now far apart
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一张世界地图，能告诉你每个大洲都发现过恐龙化石吗——也许还能说出某个著名恐龙的发现地点？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 恐龙粪便化石
topics.description: 描述粪化石是什么（恐龙粪便形成的化石），以及古生物学家如何分析它们来发现恐龙吃什么，包括植物碎片、骨骼和种子
evidence: Define a coprolite as fossilised dung (animal droppings preserved as rock)
Explain that scientists cut coprolites open to find plant seeds, bone fragments, or fish scales inside
State one example of what coprolite contents reveal about a dinosaur's diet
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道粪化石是什么吗？能咯咯笑着解释化石粪便如何帮助科学家弄清恐龙吃了什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化石揭示远古环境
topics.description: 了解化石不仅告诉我们远古动物的信息，也告诉我们远古环境的信息——例如，在山顶发现的海洋化石说明那片区域曾经在水下
evidence: Give an example of a fossil that reveals a past environment different from today's
Explain that finding marine fossils inland means that area was once covered by sea
State that plant fossils can show whether an area was once a forest, desert, or swamp
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说山上发现了贝壳化石，能解释这说明那片区域过去是什么样的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化石是怎样形成的
topics.description: 用简单的话解释化石是怎样形成的：生物死亡后被迅速埋进沉积物里；经过数百万年，矿物质替换了遗骸，沉积物变成岩石，把形状保留了下来
evidence: Describe the basic sequence: organism dies, buried in sediment, minerals replace remains over time
Explain why fossilisation is rare — most organisms decompose before being buried
Use the words 'sediment', 'minerals', and 'rock' correctly when explaining
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在学校用盐面团做过化石模型，他能解释真正的化石是如何在地下历经数百万年形成的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化石猎人玛丽·安宁
topics.description: 知道玛丽·安宁是谁——她来自英国莱姆里吉斯，是一位开创性的化石猎人，在 19 世纪初发现了鱼龙和蛇颈龙的骨架，帮助我们更好地了解史前生命
evidence: State that Mary Anning lived in England in the early 1800s and hunted for fossils along the coast
Name at least one of her major discoveries (ichthyosaur or plesiosaur)
Explain why her work was important — she helped scientists understand that extinct creatures once lived on Earth
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 听说过玛丽·安宁吗？他能说出她是谁，以及她对化石研究为什么重要吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 解读恐龙足迹
topics.description: 利用恐龙足迹（化石脚印）推断恐龙的大小、速度和行为——脚印间距大说明在奔跑，间距小说明在行走
evidence: Explain that larger footprints generally mean a larger dinosaur
Compare spacing between prints to infer walking versus running
Suggest what a set of parallel trackways might mean (e.g. dinosaurs travelling in a group)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆看到一串恐龙脚印，他能根据脚印之间的距离判断恐龙是在走还是在跑吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 中生代
topics.description: 按顺序排列中生代的三个时期——三叠纪、侏罗纪和白垩纪，并理解不同的恐龙生活在不同的时期，并不是全都同时存在
evidence: List Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous in the correct chronological order
Assign at least one well-known dinosaur to the correct period
Explain that millions of years separated these periods and different species lived in each
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道霸王龙和剑龙其实并没有生活在同一时期吗？他能按顺序说出恐龙的三个时期吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化石的类型
topics.description: 区分实体化石（保存下来的骨骼、牙齿、贝壳）和遗迹化石（脚印、足迹、蛋、洞穴、粪化石），并说明每种类型能让科学家了解到什么
evidence: Sort examples into body fossils (bones, teeth, shells) and trace fossils (footprints, eggs, dung)
Explain that body fossils show what an animal looked like physically
Explain that trace fossils show how an animal behaved — how it moved, what it ate, where it nested
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆的岩石上看到一个恐龙脚印，他能解释它和化石骨骼有什么不同，以及科学家能从中了解到什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化石作为证据
topics.description: 分析和解读化石数据，为很久以前存在的生物和环境提供证据
evidence: Explain that fossils are preserved remains or traces of organisms that lived long ago
Use fossil evidence to make inferences about past organisms and their environments
Describe how comparing fossils with living organisms helps us understand how life has changed
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在山坡的岩石里看到鱼的化石，他能解释这个地区在数百万年前一定在水下吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 鸟类由恐龙进化而来
topics.description: 理解现代鸟类由一类小型、长羽毛的兽脚类恐龙进化而来，证据包括始祖鸟化石、中国发现的带羽毛恐龙化石，以及共有的骨骼特征
evidence: State that birds evolved from small theropod dinosaurs
Name Archaeopteryx or Chinese feathered dinosaurs as key fossil evidence
List at least two features birds share with theropods (e.g. hollow bones, wishbone, three-toed feet)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释科学家为什么说鸟类其实是活着的恐龙吗？能举出带羽毛恐龙化石这样的证据吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 不断变化的科学知识
topics.description: 通过权衡化石证据，评价关于恐龙的相互竞争的科学解释——理解随着新化石的发现和新分析方法的出现，科学知识会不断变化
evidence: Give an example of a scientific idea about dinosaurs that changed when new evidence was found
Explain that different scientists may interpret the same fossil evidence differently
State that the best scientific explanation is the one supported by the most evidence from multiple sources
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 读到两种关于恐龙灭绝原因的不同解释，他能讨论每种说法有哪些证据支持，以及科学家为什么有时会改变想法吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 恐龙的髋部类群
topics.description: 根据髋部结构把恐龙分成两大类：蜥臀目（蜥蜴式髋部，包括兽脚类和蜥脚类）和鸟臀目（鸟类式髋部，包括三角龙和剑龙）
evidence: Name the two major dinosaur groups: Saurischia and Ornithischia
Explain the difference is based on hip bone structure (lizard-hipped vs bird-hipped)
Correctly classify at least two dinosaurs into each group (e.g. T. rex = Saurischia, Triceratops = Ornithischia)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释科学家根据恐龙的髋骨把它们分成两大类吗？能说出霸王龙属于哪一类吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 古生物学家的工作方式
topics.description: 描述古生物学家在野外和实验室里的工作：寻找裸露的化石、用手工工具小心发掘、用石膏包覆以便运输、在实验室里进行修理和清理，以及科学描述与发表
evidence: List the main stages: prospecting, excavation, jacketing, transport, preparation, study, display
Explain why careful excavation with small tools is necessary to avoid damaging the fossil
Describe plaster jacketing as wrapping fossils in plaster for safe transport to a lab
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述古生物学家从在悬崖上第一次发现化石，到化石最终在博物馆展出，中间要经历哪些步骤吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 古生物艺术与推测
topics.description: 理解古生物艺术——恐龙的科普插图和模型——以化石证据为基础，但对通常不会形成化石的皮肤颜色、羽毛和软组织，需要做有根据的推测
evidence: Explain that bones and teeth are known from fossils but skin colour and soft tissues usually are not
State that recent discoveries of preserved skin impressions and feather fossils have improved reconstructions
Give an example of how our picture of a dinosaur has changed over time (e.g. feathered vs scaly Velociraptor)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 明白恐龙图片都是有根据的猜测吗？能解释哪些部分有证据支持、哪些部分要靠科学家想象吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 读懂分支图
topics.description: 读懂并绘制简单的分支图（树状分支图），展示恐龙各类群如何根据共同特征相互关联，理解共享特征越多的物种亲缘关系越近
evidence: Explain that a cladogram shows evolutionary relationships based on shared features
Read a simple cladogram to identify which two dinosaurs share the most recent common ancestor
Add a new species to a partially completed cladogram based on its listed features
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张展示恐龙亲缘关系的树状分支图，能通过看分支在哪里分开，说出哪些恐龙亲缘关系最近吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 岩层与相对年代测定
topics.description: 理解岩层（地层）按顺序形成，最老的在底部、最新的在顶部，越深岩层里的化石越古老——这就是相对年代测定原理
evidence: Explain that sedimentary rock forms in layers with the oldest at the bottom
Use a diagram of rock strata to determine which fossil is older based on its position
Define relative dating as working out the age of something by comparing its position in rock layers
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到有层层岩石的悬崖，能解释最底下的岩层最古老、埋得越深的化石年代越久远吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: K-Pg 灭绝事件
topics.description: 描述约 6600 万年前的白垩纪—古近纪（K-Pg）灭绝事件，包括小行星撞击理论及其证据（铱层、希克苏鲁伯陨石坑），并理解这一事件终结了非鸟恐龙的统治
evidence: State that the K-Pg extinction happened about 66 million years ago and wiped out non-avian dinosaurs
Describe the asteroid impact hypothesis and name the Chicxulub crater in Mexico
Explain one piece of evidence: the iridium-rich layer found worldwide in rocks from that time
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释科学家认为恐龙灭绝的原因吗？能说出至少一条支持小行星撞击理论的证据吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生命随时间而变化
topics.description: 认识到生物会随时间发生变化，化石能提供数百万年前生活在地球上的生物的信息
evidence: State that living things have changed (evolved) over millions of years
Describe how fossils form and what information they provide about the past
Compare a fossil organism with a modern relative, noting similarities and differences
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释今天活着的动植物和数百万年前的动植物不一样，而我们知道这一点是因为有化石吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 从恐龙到鸟类的演化
topics.description: 深入梳理恐龙向鸟类演化的证据：中国辽宁地层中带羽毛的兽脚类恐龙、始祖鸟身上恐龙与鸟类特征的混合，以及关于飞行起源的“从地面起飞”与“从树上滑翔”两种竞争假说
evidence: Describes at least three specific feathered theropod fossils (e.g. Microraptor, Anchiornis, Sinosauropteryx) and what each tells us
Describes Archaeopteryx as showing a mix of bird features (feathers, wishbone) and dinosaur features (teeth, clawed wings, long bony tail)
Outlines the ground-up (running and leaping) and trees-down (gliding from trees) hypotheses for flight origin and the evidence supporting each
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人告诉 {{name}} 麻雀严格来说是一种活着的恐龙，能解释支持这一说法的化石证据链吗？能说出至少一种关键的过渡化石，并描述它为什么既像恐龙又像鸟吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 放射性测年
topics.description: 解释放射性测年的原理——放射性同位素以已知速率（半衰期）衰变，因此测量岩石或化石中母同位素与子同位素的比例，就能得出绝对年龄；区分碳-14（适用于约 5 万年以内）和铀-铅（适用于数百万到数十亿年）
evidence: Defines half-life as the time for half the radioactive parent isotope to decay to the daughter isotope
Explains that the parent:daughter ratio in a sample gives an estimate of absolute age
Distinguishes carbon-14 (for recent organic material) from uranium-lead or potassium-argon (for deep geological time), explaining why carbon-14 cannot be used for dinosaur bones
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人告诉 {{name}}，一块恐龙骨头是用铀-铅放射性测年法测定年代的，{{name}} 能解释这意味着什么吗——什么在衰变、为什么衰变速率有用，以及为什么科学家大致上不会用碳-14 来测定 7000 万年前的骨头？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 地球历史上的大灭绝
topics.description: 比较地球历史上的五次大灭绝事件（奥陶纪末、泥盆纪晚期、二叠纪末、三叠纪末、白垩纪-古近纪），描述每种事件提出的灭绝机制（冰川作用、海洋缺氧、火山大喷发、小行星撞击），并解释为什么大灭绝虽然灾难性，却也为后续的演化辐射打开了生态空间
evidence: Names all five major mass extinctions in chronological order with approximate dates
Describes the End-Permian extinction as the most severe and links it to the Siberian Traps volcanic eruption and its atmospheric consequences
Explains how each mass extinction was followed by an adaptive radiation — e.g. the K-Pg extinction removing non-avian dinosaurs allowed mammals to diversify and eventually produce humans
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释消灭恐龙的小行星其实是地球历史上的第五次大灭绝吗——并描述最严重的那次发生了什么，那次灭绝杀死了超过 90% 的物种？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 重建古代生态系统
topics.description: 利用多条独立的证据线索重建古代生态系统：通过牙齿的同位素分析推断饮食和迁徙，通过骨骼组织学（生长纹）估算年龄和生长速率，通过粪化石化学分析了解饮食，通过古植物学了解栖息地——理解古生物学是一门综合证据的学科
evidence: Explains how stable oxygen isotope ratios in teeth shift with geographic location, allowing detection of seasonal migration
Explains how annual growth rings in bone cross-sections reveal growth rate and approximate age at death
Describes how combining evidence from teeth isotopes, coprolites, and fossil plant assemblages builds a richer picture of ancient ecology than any single source alone
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，科学家怎么知道一只大型恐龙每年迁徙数百公里，{{name}} 能解释他们会寻找什么样的证据，以及如何排除其他解释吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 巨型动物灭绝与去灭绝
topics.description: 利用化石记录、古 DNA 和考古遗址的证据，评估关于是什么导致更新世巨型动物灭绝的争论——人类过度捕杀、气候变化，还是两者共同作用；联系当今的第六次大灭绝，并思考利用古 DNA 进行去灭绝的伦理与可行性
evidence: Summarises the overkill hypothesis (human hunting pressure) and the climate hypothesis (rapid warming) for Pleistocene megafauna extinction, citing specific evidence for each
Explains how ancient DNA sequencing from permafrost-preserved specimens provides information about genetics, diet, and relatedness of extinct species
Evaluates the de-extinction concept — describing what it would take technically and raising at least two substantive scientific or ecological arguments for and against
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说科学家正试图利用古 DNA 让猛犸象复活，{{name}} 能解释什么是古 DNA、存在哪些挑战，以及为什么一些科学家认为复活灭绝物种可能实际上有助于生态系统吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物如何塑造栖息地
topics.description: 用证据支持论点，说明植物和动物如何改变环境以满足自身需求
evidence: Give at least three examples of organisms changing their environment (beaver dams, bird nests, plant roots breaking rock)
Explain why organisms change their environment (to meet needs for shelter, food, water)
Construct an argument with evidence showing how a specific organism changes its environment
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释河狸如何筑坝把河流变成池塘，或者树根如何把岩石撑裂吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 当地天气规律
topics.description: 利用并分享对当地天气状况的观察，描述随时间变化的规律，记录温度、降雨量和其他状况
evidence: Observe and record daily weather conditions (temperature, cloud cover, precipitation, wind)
Identify patterns in weather data over days or weeks
Use observations to make simple predictions about upcoming weather
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 有没有坚持一周或更长时间记录天气日记，记下是晴天、雨天还是刮风天，并注意到一些规律？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 季节变化
topics.description: 观察四季的变化，描述每个季节相关的天气，包括白天长度如何变化
evidence: Name the four seasons and describe typical weather for each
Describe how day length changes through the year (longer in summer, shorter in winter)
Give examples of changes in the natural world associated with each season (e.g. leaves, flowers, animal behaviour)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述每个季节会发生什么——比如秋天落叶、冬天下雪——并注意到冬天白天更短、夏天白天更长吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 蒸发与凝结
topics.description: 说出并运用水循环的词汇——蒸发、凝结、降水、汇集、蒸腾、水蒸气、径流、地下水——并按正确顺序用这些术语描述循环的每个阶段
evidence: Describe the complete water cycle using at least four correct technical terms in the right order
Distinguish 'evaporation' from 'condensation' and explain where each occurs in the water cycle
Use 'water vapour' and 'precipitation' correctly in descriptions of weather and the water cycle
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释雨停后水坑去哪儿了吗——用“蒸发”或“水蒸气”这样的词，而不只是说“它干了”？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化石是怎样形成的
topics.description: 用简单的话描述化石是怎样形成的：曾经活过的生物被埋在岩石里，经过数百万年形成化石
evidence: Describe the basic process: organism dies, gets buried in mud/sand, layers build up, material turns to rock over millions of years
Explain that the organism's shape is preserved as a fossil within the rock
Give examples of common fossils (shells, bones, leaf imprints, footprints)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释古代生物的贝壳或骨头是怎样被保存在岩石里的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 防止侵蚀
topics.description: 比较多种方案，看看哪些能减缓或防止风和水改变地表的形状
evidence: Describe how wind and water can change the shape of land (erosion)
Compare at least two design solutions for reducing erosion (e.g. retaining walls, plants, windbreaks)
Evaluate which solution works best based on evidence from tests or observations
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到沙堡被海浪冲走，能想出保护它的办法吗——比如筑一道墙，或者种上草来固定沙子？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 材料的性质
topics.description: 根据外观和简单的物理性质（如硬度、质地和颜色）比较并给不同的岩石分类
evidence: Describe at least three observable properties of rocks: hardness, texture, colour, grain size
Sort a collection of rocks into groups based on chosen properties
Compare two rocks and describe how their properties differ
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能观察一堆岩石，并按坚硬还是易碎、粗糙还是光滑、浅色还是深色来分类吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 岩石与土壤
topics.description: 认识到土壤由岩石和有机物组成，不同的土壤有不同的性质
evidence: State that soil is a mixture of broken-down rock particles and decomposed organic matter (humus)
Compare at least two types of soil (sandy, clay, loam) and describe their different properties
Explain that soil formation takes a very long time as rocks gradually break down
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释土壤不只是泥土吗——它是由细碎的岩石混合枯叶和其他有机物形成的？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 陆地和水的形态
topics.description: 制作一个模型，表现一个地区的陆地形态（山地、山谷、平原）和水体（河流、湖泊、海洋）
evidence: Name and describe at least four types of landforms (mountain, valley, plain, hill, cliff)
Name and describe at least three types of water bodies (river, lake, ocean, pond)
Create or interpret a simple model or map showing land and water features of an area
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看地图或做一个模型，展示山地、河流和海洋，并说出每种陆地或水体是什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 地球上哪里有水
topics.description: 找出地球上哪里有水，理解水可以是固体（冰）或液体，认识海洋、河流、冰川和地下水中的水
evidence: List where water is found on Earth: oceans, rivers, lakes, glaciers, underground, atmosphere
Explain that water exists as liquid (rivers, oceans) and solid (ice, glaciers, snow)
Recognise that most of Earth's water is in the oceans
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出地球上水的不同去处吗——海洋、河流、冰盖，甚至地下——并解释冰只是冻住的水？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 季节变化（8 岁以上）
topics.description: 用表格和图表呈现数据，描述某个季节典型的天气状况
evidence: Collect and organise weather data in a table (temperature, precipitation, cloud cover)
Create a graphical display (bar chart, pictogram) showing weather patterns for a season
Use the data to describe typical weather conditions for that season and compare with other seasons
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能连续几周收集天气数据，做成图表，并用它描述这个季节通常是什么天气吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 天气与气候
topics.description: 获取并整合信息，描述世界不同地区的气候，区分天气和气候
evidence: Define weather as day-to-day conditions and climate as the long-term pattern of weather in an area
Describe at least three different climate types (tropical, temperate, polar, desert) with examples
Explain that climate varies by region due to factors like distance from the equator
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释天气和气候的区别，并说明为什么北极总是很冷，而热带地区总是很暖吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 侵蚀与风化
topics.description: 通过观察和测量，为风化作用的影响或水、冰、风、植被造成侵蚀的速度提供证据
evidence: Define weathering (breaking down of rock in place) and erosion (movement of broken rock/soil)
Describe the effects of at least three agents of weathering/erosion: water, ice, wind, vegetation
Provide evidence from observations showing how weathering or erosion has changed a landscape
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能观察崩塌的悬崖或河岸，并解释水、风或冰是如何随着时间慢慢侵蚀岩石或土壤的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 从数据中发现规律
topics.description: 分析和解读地图数据，描述地球特征的规律，认识到许多特征源于长期发生的过程
evidence: Use a map to identify patterns in the location of mountains, rivers, lakes, and other features
Describe patterns observed (e.g. mountains in chains, rivers flow from high to low ground)
Explain that Earth's features result from processes like erosion, volcanic activity, and plate movement over long periods
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看地图并注意到一些规律，比如山脉连成一线、河流流向大海、沙漠聚集在赤道附近吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 岩石的类型
topics.description: 使用地球地质过程和岩石类型的词汇——火成岩、沉积岩、变质岩、侵蚀、风化、沉积、化石、沉积物、地层、可渗透、不可渗透——并在解释岩石如何形成、地貌如何随时间变化时运用这些词汇
evidence: Correctly classify igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks and explain in one sentence how each type forms
Use 'erosion', 'weathering', and 'deposition' correctly as three distinct stages in a sequence
Explain how fossils form using 'sediment' and 'sedimentary rock' correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释岩石被风化和被侵蚀的区别吗——这其实是两件不同的事？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 地球的大气层
topics.description: 建立模型，描述岩石圈、生物圈、水圈和大气圈作为相互关联的地球系统如何相互作用
evidence: Name the four Earth systems: geosphere (rock/land), hydrosphere (water), atmosphere (air), biosphere (living things)
Describe at least two interactions between different Earth systems with examples
Create or interpret a model showing how a change in one system affects others
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释雨（大气圈）如何落在山上（岩石圈）、流入河流（水圈），并为植物和动物（生物圈）提供水吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 岩层与地球历史
topics.description: 解读地球内部、地质地层和岩石循环的剖面图；识别并标注各层（地壳、地幔、外核、内核）；理解沉积序列中越深的层越古老
evidence: Label the four layers of the Earth on a cross-section diagram using the correct terms
Interpret a diagram of sedimentary rock layers and identify which layer was deposited first
Read a rock cycle diagram and trace the pathway of a rock from igneous to sedimentary to metamorphic
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张地球剖面图，能指出并说出不同圈层的名称吗——如果给他们看叠放的岩层，能说出哪一层最先形成吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 咸水与淡水
topics.description: 描述并用图表表示各种水体中咸水和淡水的数量，为地球水资源的分布提供证据
evidence: State that about 97% of Earth's water is salt water in the oceans
Describe where fresh water is found: glaciers/ice caps, groundwater, rivers, lakes
Create or interpret a graph showing the relative amounts of salt water vs fresh water
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释地球上的水大部分是咸的海水，只有很小一部分是我们饮用的淡水，并用图表展示出来吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 栖息地中的植物和动物
topics.description: 用模型表示不同植物和动物的需求与它们生活的地方之间的关系，将生物体的需求与栖息地特征联系起来
evidence: Use a simple model (drawing, diagram) to show how a habitat provides what an organism needs
Match at least three organisms to their habitats and explain why each needs that specific place
Describe what would happen if an organism were placed in a habitat that doesn't meet its needs
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能通过把每种生物的需求与它们生活的地方对应起来，解释为什么鱼需要生活在水里，而仙人掌能生活在沙漠里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 减少人类的影响
topics.description: 交流能减少人类对当地环境中土地、水、空气和其他生物影响的解决方案
evidence: Identify at least three ways humans negatively impact the local environment (litter, pollution, habitat destruction)
Propose at least three solutions to reduce human impact (recycling, reducing waste, conserving water, planting trees)
Explain how each solution helps protect land, water, air, or living things
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能提出人们帮助环境的办法吗——比如回收利用、不乱扔垃圾、节约用水或植树？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 栖息地与基本需求
topics.description: 能说出大多数生物都生活在适合它们的栖息地里，并描述栖息地如何满足生物的基本需求，以及生物之间如何相互依赖
evidence: Define a habitat as a place where an organism lives that provides what it needs
Give examples of how specific habitats meet organisms' needs (e.g. pond provides water and food for frogs)
Describe at least one way organisms in a habitat depend on each other (e.g. bees pollinate flowers, flowers feed bees)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么北极熊生活在北极而不是沙漠里，以及栖息地里的动物和植物如何互相帮助吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 栖息地词汇
topics.description: 能说出并运用描述生物生活场所的词汇——栖息地、环境、微栖息地、条件、林地、海洋、沙漠、雨林、池塘——并用这些词描述动物生存所需：食物、水、庇护所、空间和适宜的条件
evidence: Match animals to their habitats and explain the match using 'adapted to', 'conditions', or 'shelter'
Correctly use 'habitat' and 'microhabitat' to describe different scales of environment with examples
Name at least three contrasting habitats and describe what makes each distinctive
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么北极熊无法在雨林里生存吗——能用“栖息地”或“条件”这样的词，而不只是说“太热了”？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物、死亡与从未有生命
topics.description: 探索并比较有生命的、死亡的以及从未有过生命的事物之间的区别
evidence: Sort a collection of objects into three groups: living, dead (was once alive), never alive
Give reasons for each sorting decision (e.g. 'the leaf was on a tree so it was alive once')
List characteristics of living things such as growing, breathing, reproducing, and moving
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一块石头、一片落叶和一条毛毛虫，他们能告诉你哪个有生命、哪个曾经有生命、哪个从未有过生命吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 身边的植物与动物
topics.description: 能识别并说出栖息地中各种植物和动物的名称，包括木头底下或池塘里这样的微栖息地
evidence: Name at least three animals and plants found in a specific local habitat
Explain what a microhabitat is (a very small habitat within a larger one)
Describe conditions in a microhabitat (e.g. 'under a stone is damp and dark, woodlice like that')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你和 {{name}} 一起翻开花园里的一块木头，他们能说出发现的小生物的名字，并解释它们为什么住在那里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 简单食物链
topics.description: 借助简单食物链的概念，描述动物如何从植物和其他动物那里获得食物，并识别不同的食物来源
evidence: Draw a simple food chain with at least three organisms using arrows to show energy flow
Explain that food chains always start with a plant (producer) that makes its own food
Use the terms 'producer' and 'consumer' correctly when describing a food chain
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能画出一条食物链，表示毛毛虫吃叶子、然后鸟吃毛毛虫吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物群体与生存
topics.description: 能论证有些动物会结成群体来帮助成员生存，比如兽群、狼群或群落
evidence: Give at least two examples of animals that live in groups (e.g. wolves, ants, fish schools)
Explain how group living provides survival advantages (protection, finding food, raising young)
Construct a simple argument with evidence for why a specific animal benefits from group behaviour
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么狼成群捕猎、或者为什么鱼成群游动，以及待在群体里如何帮助它们生存吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 变化中的环境
topics.description: 认识到环境会发生变化，而这有时会给生物带来危险和挑战
evidence: Give at least two examples of environmental changes (natural and human-caused)
Describe how a specific change affects the organisms in that environment
Explain why some organisms may not survive if their environment changes too quickly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能举例说明污染、建筑施工或干旱等变化如何让动物和植物更难生存吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 分类检索表
topics.description: 探索并使用分类检索表来识别、归类和命名身边及更广泛环境中的生物
evidence: Follow a branching classification key to identify an unknown organism
Create a simple yes/no classification key for a set of 6-8 organisms
Use a key to identify organisms in the local environment during a field activity
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用简单的“是/否”检索表，查出他们在户外发现的昆虫或植物的名称吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生态学词汇
topics.description: 使用描述取食关系和生态角色的词汇——生产者、消费者、捕食者、猎物、食草动物、食肉动物、杂食动物、分解者、食物链、食物网、养分循环——并运用这些术语描述能量和物质如何在生态系统中流动
evidence: Construct a food chain correctly using producer, consumer, predator, and prey in the right positions
Distinguish between herbivore, carnivore, and omnivore with correct examples from a given ecosystem
Explain what a decomposer does and why it matters, using the correct vocabulary
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能画出一条从植物到顶级捕食者的食物链，并标出每种动物是生产者、消费者、捕食者还是猎物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 食物链与能量传递
topics.description: 构建并解读食物链，识别生产者、捕食者和猎物，理解营养级之间的能量传递
evidence: Construct a food chain with at least four organisms, labelling producer, primary consumer, predator
Define producer, predator, and prey with examples
Interpret a given food chain to predict what happens if one organism is removed
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能构建一条林地食物链，并指出哪些生物是生产者、哪些是捕食者、哪些是猎物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物的分类
topics.description: 认识到生物可以根据可观察的特征以多种方式分组
evidence: Group a set of organisms using at least two different criteria (e.g. by habitat, by body covering, by diet)
Explain the reasoning behind each grouping choice
Recognise that the same organism can belong to different groups depending on the criteria used
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能按照自己的标准（比如“有翅膀”或“生活在水里”）把一组动物或植物分成几类吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 人类对环境的影响
topics.description: 使用描述人类对环境影响的词汇——污染、栖息地破坏、森林砍伐、生物多样性、保护、可再生能源、不可再生能源、化石燃料、碳足迹、可持续性、濒危、灭绝——并在讨论环境问题和人类选择时运用这些词汇
evidence: Distinguish between renewable and non-renewable energy sources using the correct terms and give examples of each
Use 'biodiversity' and 'conservation' correctly in discussing why protecting habitats matters
Apply 'carbon footprint' and 'sustainability' correctly in a discussion about everyday human choices
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释什么是碳足迹吗——不只是说它跟污染有关，而是它实际衡量的是什么？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 读懂食物网示意图
topics.description: 阅读并解读食物网示意图——识别生产者、初级和次级消费者以及分解者；沿着食物网中的食物链追踪能量流动；预测移除或添加某个物种的影响
evidence: Identify the producer, herbivore, and carnivore in a food web from a diagram
Trace two food chains through the same food web and identify shared species
Predict what would happen to fox numbers if rabbits were removed from a food web diagram
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一张用箭头连接植物、昆虫、青蛙和鹰的示意图，他们能追踪出哪种动物吃哪种动物，并解释如果青蛙消失了会发生什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物的生命周期
topics.description: 描述哺乳动物、两栖动物、昆虫和鸟类生命周期的差异，比较变态发育与直接发育
evidence: Describe the life cycle of a mammal, amphibian, insect, and bird with key stages for each
Compare metamorphosis (complete change of form) with direct development (gradual growth)
Identify which groups undergo metamorphosis and which do not
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释蝴蝶的生命周期（卵、毛毛虫、蛹、蝴蝶）和小狗长成大狗的过程为什么完全不同吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物与动物的繁殖
topics.description: 描述一些植物和动物的繁殖生命过程，包括植物的有性繁殖和无性繁殖
evidence: Describe sexual reproduction in plants: pollination, fertilisation, seed production
Give examples of asexual reproduction in plants: runners (strawberries), bulbs, cuttings
Compare reproduction in egg-laying animals (birds, frogs) vs live-bearing mammals
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释植物繁殖的不同方式——不只是从种子，还有扦插或匍匐枝——以及动物如何通过生宝宝或产卵来繁殖吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物的分类
topics.description: 描述生物如何根据共同的可观察特征、相似性和差异被归入大的类别（微生物、植物、动物）
evidence: Name the broad classification groups: micro-organisms, plants, animals (and fungi if known)
Describe observable characteristics used for classification (e.g. plants make own food, animals move and eat)
Give examples of organisms in each group, including micro-organisms like bacteria
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释科学家把所有生物划分成的几个大类——比如植物、动物和微小的微生物——并各举一些例子吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 保护资源的社区
topics.description: 获取并整合信息，了解各个社区如何运用科学理念来保护地球的资源和环境
evidence: Describe at least three real-world examples of communities protecting resources or the environment
Explain the science ideas behind each example (e.g. solar panels convert sunlight to electricity, reducing fossil fuel use)
Discuss how individual actions and community efforts combine to make a difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能举出社区保护环境的真实例子吗——比如使用太阳能板、建立自然保护区或清理河流？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 基于证据的分类
topics.description: 根据具体特征说明动植物分类的理由，用证据来支持分类决定
evidence: Classify an unfamiliar organism using specific observable characteristics with reasoning
Compare two similar organisms and explain which characteristics distinguish their classification
Justify a classification decision using at least two pieces of evidence from observation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 发现了一种不寻常的生物，能一步步说明自己会怎样根据它的特征判断它属于哪一类吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生态系统中的物质循环
topics.description: 建立一个模型，描述物质在生态系统中的植物、动物、分解者和环境之间如何流动
evidence: Describe the role of decomposers (fungi, bacteria, worms) in breaking down dead matter
Trace the movement of matter: plant grows using soil nutrients → animal eats plant → animal dies → decomposers return nutrients to soil
Create or interpret a simple diagram showing matter cycling through an ecosystem
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释森林地面上的一片落叶会怎样吗——微小生物如何把它分解，养分又怎样回到土壤里帮助新植物生长？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 层级之间的能量损失
topics.description: 解释能量在食物链各营养级之间如何传递、为什么每个阶段都会损失能量，并用生物量/数量金字塔来表示
evidence: Explains that only about 10% of energy passes from one trophic level to the next
Constructs a pyramid of biomass from data and explains its shape
Identifies where energy is lost at each trophic level (heat, movement, waste)
Explains why food chains rarely have more than five trophic levels
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，为什么田野里的植物比狐狸多那么多，他们能解释能量在食物链每一步都会损失，以及这对每个种群数量意味着什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 食物网与相互依存
topics.description: 构建并解读展示生态系统中生物相互依存关系的食物网，解释一个种群的变化如何影响其他种群
evidence: Draws a food web from given data with arrows showing energy flow direction
Predicts how the population of one species would change if another species increased or decreased
Distinguishes a food web from a food chain and explains why webs are more realistic
Identifies producers, primary consumers, secondary consumers, and apex predators
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一张用箭头连接许多动物的图，他们能解释这张图的意思吗——追踪谁吃谁——并预测如果网中一种动物消失了会发生什么？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 授粉与传粉者减少
topics.description: 解释昆虫授粉对植物繁殖和人类粮食安全的重要性，并讨论传粉者减少的后果
evidence: Explains why many food crops depend on insect pollination to produce fruit and seeds
Names examples of crops that require insect pollination (e.g. apples, almonds, oilseed rape)
Discusses the potential impact of bee population decline on food production
Connects to plant reproduction — flowers are adapted to attract specific pollinators
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一则关于蜜蜂消失的新闻，他们能解释这对你家厨房里的食物到底意味着什么吗——哪些食物会受影响，为什么？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 水循环
topics.description: 描述水循环，追踪水经过蒸发、凝结、降水、地表径流和植物蒸腾的过程，解释太阳如何驱动这个循环
evidence: Labels a water cycle diagram correctly
Explains what drives each stage of the water cycle (e.g. solar energy drives evaporation)
Explains the role of transpiration (plants releasing water vapour) in the water cycle
Discusses how human activities (deforestation, paving) affect the water cycle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到外面下雨，被问到这些水在下落之前去过哪里，他们能追踪水循环的旅程吗——从海洋到云，到雨，再回来？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物多样性与韧性
topics.description: 解释生物多样性的含义、为什么高生物多样性让生态系统更有韧性，并描述人类活动威胁生物多样性的方式（栖息地破坏、污染、入侵物种、气候变化）
evidence: Defines biodiversity at the species, genetic, and ecosystem levels
Explains why high biodiversity makes an ecosystem more stable and resilient to disruption
Identifies at least three human activities that reduce biodiversity
Discusses why biodiversity loss matters for humans as well as wildlife
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，即使很多物种在其他地方存活下来，为什么雨林被砍伐仍然重要，他们能解释生物多样性的含义，以及为什么失去它会让整个生态系统更脆弱吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 染色体、基因与 DNA
topics.description: 描述染色体、基因与 DNA 在遗传中的关系，包括 DNA 的双螺旋结构，以及 Watson、Crick、Franklin 和 Wilkins 的历史贡献
evidence: Explains the hierarchy: DNA → gene → chromosome → nucleus → cell
Describes what a gene is and what it codes for
States that human body cells contain 46 chromosomes in 23 pairs
Describes the contributions of Watson, Crick, Franklin, and Wilkins to the discovery of DNA structure
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}} DNA 到底是什么、在身体的哪里，他能不能说清 DNA、基因和染色体之间的关系——并大致说出一个人类细胞有多少条染色体？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 进化的证据
topics.description: 描述进化的主要证据类型：化石记录（随时间的变化）、比较解剖学（同源结构），以及相关物种的地理分布
evidence: Explains how fossils form and what they can tell us about past life
Uses the fossil record as evidence that species have changed over time
Describes homologous structures (e.g. pentadactyl limb) as evidence for common ancestry
Explains why island species provide evidence for evolution (e.g. Darwin's finches, Galapagos)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 去自然历史博物馆，看到不同动物的化石和骨架，他能不能解释科学家如何用这些来积累证据，说明物种会随时间变化——而且不同动物之间有亲缘关系？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 灭绝与快速变化
topics.description: 解释环境变化如何可能超出物种通过自然选择适应的速度，从而导致灭绝，并结合历史与当代的例子
evidence: Explains why extinction occurs when environmental change is faster than the rate of adaptation
Gives a historical example (e.g. woolly mammoth, dodo) and a contemporary example of threatened extinction
Distinguishes between background extinction rates and mass extinctions
Explains how human activity (habitat loss, hunting, climate change) is driving current species loss
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，为什么猛犸象已经不存在了，而其他大型哺乳动物却存活了下来，他能不能解释是什么条件导致了猛犸象的灭绝——并把它和今天濒危物种面临的情况联系起来？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 基因突变
topics.description: 解释基因突变是 DNA 序列的随机改变，描述突变的成因（如辐射、化学物质、复制错误），并说明大多数突变是中性的，一些有害，少数有益
evidence: Defines mutation as a change to DNA sequence
Names at least two things that can cause mutations (mutagens)
Explains that mutations are the original source of all genetic variation
Explains that beneficial mutations can be selected for by natural selection
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说 DNA 会受损或改变，他能不能解释什么是突变、可能是什么引起的，以及为什么大多数突变其实不会造成问题——但偶尔有一个会带来新变化？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 自然选择如何运作
topics.description: 解释自然选择作为进化的机制：可遗传的变异 + 资源竞争 + 不同的生存与繁殖 = 等位基因频率随世代变化
evidence: Describes the four conditions required for natural selection to operate (variation, heritability, competition, selection)
Applies the concept to a specific example (e.g. antibiotic resistance in bacteria, peppered moth)
Explains why individuals with advantageous traits leave more offspring
Distinguishes natural selection from evolution (selection is the mechanism; evolution is the result over many generations)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说细菌对抗生素产生了耐药性，他能不能用自然选择解释这是怎么发生的——而不是细菌“选择”去改变？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物种分布与变化
topics.description: 解释环境变化（气候变化、栖息地丧失、污染）如何影响物种分布，包括分布范围移动、局部灭绝和入侵物种
evidence: Describes at least two ways environmental change can affect species distribution
Gives a real example of a species whose range has shifted due to climate change
Explains what an invasive species is and how environmental change can enable invasions
Discusses why some species are more vulnerable to environmental change than others
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说英国的野生植物现在比 50 年前提前几周开花，他能不能解释为什么会这样，以及这可能给依赖这些植物的其他动物带来什么问题？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 碳循环
topics.description: 描述碳循环，追踪碳在光合作用、呼吸作用、摄食、分解和燃烧中的流动，并解释每个过程的作用
evidence: Draws or labels a diagram of the carbon cycle showing the main processes
Explains how photosynthesis removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere
Explains how respiration, combustion, and decomposition return carbon dioxide to the atmosphere
Discusses how human activities (burning fossil fuels, deforestation) disrupt the carbon cycle
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}} 木桌里的碳最初来自哪里，他能不能追踪它在碳循环中的旅程——从大气，经过植物，进入树木，再回到外面？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 食物链中的毒素累积
topics.description: 解释生物如何影响环境、又如何受环境影响，包括有毒物质（如农药、重金属）通过食物链的生物累积
evidence: Defines bioaccumulation and explains why toxins increase in concentration higher up the food chain
Gives a real example of bioaccumulation (e.g. DDT in peregrine falcons, mercury in tuna)
Explains how organisms can change their habitat (e.g. earthworms aerating soil, beavers creating wetlands)
Discusses why top predators are most at risk from bioaccumulation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说金枪鱼这样的大鱼体内的汞含量可能比小鱼更高，他能不能解释为什么会这样——尽管金枪鱼并没有直接接触到汞？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物种内的变异
topics.description: 解释物种内部和物种之间的变异，区分连续变异（如身高）和不连续变异（如血型），并区分遗传原因和环境原因
evidence: Gives examples of continuous and discontinuous variation in humans
Distinguishes between genetic causes of variation (inherited differences) and environmental causes (diet, sunlight, etc.)
Explains why sexual reproduction produces greater variation than asexual reproduction
Draws or interprets a frequency graph showing continuous variation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 环顾教室，发现每个人的身高、发色和眼睛颜色都略有不同，他们能解释这些差异为什么存在吗——哪些是遗传的，哪些是环境造成的，哪些两者都有？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 预测遗传特征
topics.description: 解释等位基因在有性生殖中如何遗传，并使用庞纳特方格预测后代遗传某一特征的概率，包括显性和隐性等位基因
evidence: Defines allele, dominant, and recessive in the context of inheritance
Constructs a Punnett square for a monohybrid cross and calculates probability ratios
Explains the difference between genotype and phenotype
Gives an example of a human characteristic controlled by dominant/recessive alleles
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，为什么两个棕色眼睛的父母能生出蓝色眼睛的孩子，他们能解释什么是显性和隐性等位基因，并用庞纳特方格展示其原理吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 利用阳光搭建遮阴
topics.description: 使用工具和材料设计并搭建一个能减少阳光对某区域升温作用的结构，如遮阴棚或遮蔽物
evidence: Design a structure intended to reduce the warming effect of sunlight on an area
Build the structure using available materials and test whether it reduces temperature
Compare the temperature in the shaded area vs an unshaded area as evidence of effectiveness
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能设计并搭建一个简单的遮阴物——比如伞或顶棚——并测试它是否能让阳光下的区域更凉爽吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 阳光让物体变热
topics.description: 进行观察以确定阳光对地球表面的影响，注意到阳光会使地面、水和物体变热
evidence: Observe that surfaces in sunlight feel warmer than those in shade
Describe that sunlight provides warmth (heat energy) to Earth's surface
Compare temperatures of surfaces in sun vs shade using touch or a thermometer
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能感受到阳光下的路面和阴凉处路面的温度差异，并解释阳光会使其照射的表面变热吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 说出能量的类型
topics.description: 说出并使用能量类型和能量传递的词汇——动能、势能、热能、光能、声能、电能、化学能、储能、能量传递、能量转化——并用这些术语描述熟悉情境中的能量变化
evidence: Name the type of energy stored in a battery, a stretched spring, and a moving ball
Use 'energy transfer' or 'energy transformation' to describe what happens in a simple device such as a torch or a toaster
Distinguish between 'stored energy' and 'transferred energy' with a correct example of each
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拉伸一根橡皮筋然后松手，他们能说出拉伸时它具有哪种能量——以及它变成了什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 搭建简单电路
topics.description: 搭建一个简单的串联电路，识别并说出其基本部件：电池、导线、灯泡、开关和蜂鸣器
evidence: Build a complete series circuit that lights a bulb or sounds a buzzer
Name each component: cell (battery), wire, bulb, switch, buzzer
Explain the role of each component in making the circuit work
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用电池、导线和灯泡搭建一个能工作的电路，并说出他们使用的每个部件吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 导体和绝缘体
topics.description: 认识一些常见的导体和绝缘体，并将金属与良好的导电体联系起来
evidence: Define conductors (allow electricity to flow through) and insulators (block electricity)
Test at least six materials and correctly classify them as conductors or insulators
State that metals are generally good conductors and explain why wires are made of metal with plastic coating
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在电路中测试物体，并解释为什么金属物体能让电通过，而橡胶和塑料不能吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 开关如何工作
topics.description: 认识到开关能接通和断开电路，控制灯泡是否亮起或蜂鸣器是否发声
evidence: Explain that a closed switch completes the circuit (current flows) and an open switch breaks it (current stops)
Demonstrate adding a switch to a circuit and using it to control a bulb or buzzer
Relate the switch concept to everyday switches in the home
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释当他们按下电灯开关时墙里发生了什么——它接通或断开了电路回路吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 家里哪些东西用电
topics.description: 找出家里常见的用电电器，理解电是一种能量，能为日常生活中的各种设备提供动力
evidence: Name at least ten common appliances that run on electricity
Distinguish between mains-powered and battery-powered appliances
Explain that electricity provides the energy that makes these devices work
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能在家里走一圈，指出哪些东西需要用电才能工作吗？比如冰箱、电视和电灯。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 灯泡会亮吗？
topics.description: 判断灯泡在简单串联电路中是否会亮，依据是灯泡是否与电池构成完整的回路
evidence: Predict whether a lamp will light by tracing the circuit for a complete loop
Explain that a gap anywhere in the circuit breaks the loop and the bulb won't light
Identify the fault in a non-working circuit (e.g. loose wire, missing connection)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一张电路图，他们能根据是否有完整回路，说出灯泡会不会亮吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 制作一个能量转换装置
topics.description: 运用科学知识来设计、测试并改进一个装置，把能量从一种形式转换成另一种形式
evidence: Design a device that converts one form of energy to another (e.g. electrical to light, kinetic to sound)
Build, test, and identify what works well and what needs improvement
Explain the energy conversion taking place in the device
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能设计并制作一个简单的装置——比如橡皮筋动力小车或太阳能烤箱——把能量从一种形式转换成另一种形式吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 电路词汇
topics.description: 使用电路的专业词汇——电路、元件、电池单元、电池组、电流、电压、电阻、导体、绝缘体、开关、串联电路、并联电路——并在描述、绘制和设计可工作的电路时运用这些词汇
evidence: Use 'series' and 'parallel' correctly to describe two different circuit configurations and explain the key difference
Apply 'current', 'voltage', and 'resistance' correctly in a written description of how a circuit works
Name at least six standard circuit components and describe what each one does
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道串联电路和并联电路的区别吗——不只是知道哪个是哪个，而是能说清楚它们在电学上到底有什么不同？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 能量如何传递
topics.description: 观察并提供证据，说明能量可以通过声音、光、热和电流从一个地方传递到另一个地方
evidence: Give at least one example of energy transfer by each: sound, light, heat, electric current
Explain that energy moves from a source to a destination through these means
Describe how electric currents transfer energy from a battery to a bulb through wires
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能举例说明能量是怎么传递的吗？比如暖气片的热量让房间变暖、灯光照进眼睛，或者电流通过电线。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 读电路图和画电路图
topics.description: 使用电池单元、灯泡、开关、蜂鸣器和电线的标准符号，绘制并阅读简单电路图；根据电路图判断电路是完整的还是断开的；把电路图和实际电路对应起来
evidence: Draw a circuit diagram for a cell, switch, and bulb using standard symbols
Identify from a diagram whether a switch is open or closed and predict whether the bulb lights
Match a photograph of a physical circuit to the correct circuit diagram from a set of options
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张画有电池、开关和灯泡符号的电路图，他们能说出灯泡会不会亮吗？能根据你描述的简单电路画出电路图吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 速度与能量
topics.description: 用证据来构建解释，说明物体的速度与该物体能量之间的关系
evidence: Explain that a moving object has energy, and the faster it moves the more energy it has
Provide evidence from observations (e.g. faster ball causes more damage/movement)
Use the term 'kinetic energy' or 'energy of motion' appropriately
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用“运动越快的东西能量越大”这个想法，解释为什么快速滚动的球比慢速滚动的球能撞倒更多瓶子吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物体碰撞时会发生什么
topics.description: 提出问题并预测物体碰撞时能量变化的结果
evidence: Predict the outcome of a collision based on the speeds and sizes of the objects
Explain that energy transfers from one object to another during a collision
Describe observable changes: one object speeds up, the other slows down, sound is produced
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把两个球滚向对方，他们能预测相撞时会发生什么，并解释能量在两个球之间发生了传递吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 用规范符号画电路图
topics.description: 在电路图中用公认的符号表示简单电路，包括电池、导线、灯泡、开关、蜂鸣器和电动机
evidence: Draw a circuit diagram using standard symbols for at least five components
Interpret a circuit diagram drawn by someone else and describe what the circuit does
Convert between a physical circuit and its diagram representation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能不用画实物图，而是用规范的符号画出电池、灯泡、开关和导线的电路图吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 电池越多，灯泡越亮
topics.description: 把灯泡的亮度或蜂鸣器的音量与串联电路中电池的数量和电压联系起来
evidence: Describe the pattern: more cells (or higher voltage) = brighter bulb / louder buzzer
Explain that more cells provide more energy to the circuit
Predict the effect of changing the number of cells on a component's behaviour
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么再加一节电池灯泡会更亮，并预测用三节电池会怎样吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 电路元件为什么表现不同
topics.description: 比较电路元件工作时的各种变化并说明原因，包括灯泡的亮度、蜂鸣器的音量和开关的位置
evidence: Explain why adding more components in series reduces brightness/loudness (energy shared)
Compare circuits with different configurations and predict component behaviour
Give reasoned explanations for observed variations in component function
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在串联电路中再加一个灯泡，灯泡变暗了，他们能解释为什么能量要在两个灯泡之间分配吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 电流、电压以及它们测量的是什么
topics.description: 理解电流是电荷流动的速率（用电流表以安培为单位测量），电势差（电压）是每单位电荷转移的能量（用电压表以伏特为单位测量）
evidence: States that current is measured in amperes (A) and is the rate at which charge flows around a circuit
States that potential difference (voltage) is measured in volts (V) and represents energy transferred per unit charge
Correctly connects an ammeter in series and a voltmeter in parallel when building or interpreting a circuit
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 搭了一个带电流表和电压表的电路，他们能说出每个表在测什么，并描述电流和电压的区别吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 能量既不会凭空产生，也不会凭空消失
topics.description: 解释能量守恒原理（能量既不会凭空产生，也不会凭空消失，只会在能量储存之间转移），并说明在所有真实过程中能量都会以热能形式耗散到周围环境中
evidence: States the law of conservation of energy
Explains why the total energy in a closed system is always the same even though it changes form
Explains what dissipation means and why it happens in real machines (friction, air resistance)
Gives an example showing why 'wasted' energy is not lost but transferred to the surroundings
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 晚上给手机充电，被问到电能去哪儿了，他们能解释能量守恒是什么意思吗——以及为什么充电器会发热，尽管这些热并没有做任何有用的功？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 能量储存与转移
topics.description: 识别主要的能量储存（动能、重力势能、弹性势能、热能、化学能、核能、电磁能）以及能量在储存之间转移的途径（机械方式、电学方式、加热方式、辐射方式）
evidence: Names and describes at least five energy stores with a real-world example of each
Identifies the energy stores at the start and end of a given process (e.g. a falling ball, a burning match)
Describes the transfer pathway connecting two energy stores in a given scenario
Traces energy through a system identifying all stores and transfers involved
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一个球被向上抛出后又落下来，他们能说出球在最高点和最低点分别具有哪种能量，并解释这两点之间能量发生了什么变化吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 静电与火花
topics.description: 把静电解释为通过摩擦积累电荷，描述带电物体如何相互吸引或排斥，并把静电放电与闪电等日常现象联系起来
evidence: Explains that rubbing transfers electrons from one material to another, creating opposite charges
States that like charges repel and unlike charges attract
Links the concept of static discharge to the formation of lightning as a large-scale electric spark
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么在头发上摩擦过的气球会粘在墙上，并把这一点与雷暴中闪电形成的科学原理联系起来吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 传导、对流与辐射
topics.description: 描述并比较热传递的三种方式——传导（固体中粒子振动）、对流（液体/气体中流体运动）和辐射（红外波）——并说明传递速率取决于温差
evidence: Explains the particle-level mechanism for conduction and why metals are good conductors
Describes a convection current using particle theory and gives a real-world example
Explains that all objects emit and absorb infrared radiation and how surface colour affects this
States that a greater temperature difference increases the rate of heat transfer
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在炉灶上加热汤，同时又在暖气片旁暖手，他们能说出每种情况发生的是哪种热传递吗——以及为什么汤锅只在底部加热，整锅汤却都会变热？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 效率、桑基图与做功
topics.description: 把能量效率计算为有用输出能量与总输入能量之比，绘制并解读桑基图，并用功 = 力 × 距离计算做功
evidence: Calculates efficiency as a percentage from given input and useful output energy values
Draws a Sankey diagram to represent energy transfers in a device, with arrow widths proportional to energy amounts
Uses W = Fd to calculate work done when a force moves through a distance
Identifies which energy transformations in a Sankey diagram are useful and which are wasted
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说一个灯泡的效率是 10%，消耗 60 J 能量，他们能算出其中有多少能量真正变成了光，剩下的又去了哪里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 加热实验与 Q = mcΔT
topics.description: 设计并开展实验，测量加热过程中传递的能量，包括使用公式 Q = mcΔT、记录温度随时间的变化，并评估误差来源
evidence: Uses a thermometer and stopwatch to record temperature change over time in a heating experiment
Applies Q = mcΔT to calculate the energy transferred to a substance being heated
Identifies sources of energy loss in a heating experiment (e.g. heat to surroundings) and suggests improvements
Plots a temperature-time graph and identifies the energy transfer rate from its gradient
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在烧杯中加热 100 ml 水并每分钟记录一次温度，他们能把结果画成图表，并用数据大致算出有多少能量传递给了水吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 欧姆定律：电压、电流、电阻
topics.description: 运用欧姆定律（V = IR）计算简单电路中的电流、电压或电阻，并解释电阻会阻碍电流的流动
evidence: States Ohm's Law as V = IR and identifies the units for each quantity
Rearranges V = IR to find the unknown value given the other two
Explains that resistance opposes current flow and identifies factors that affect resistance (material, length, thickness)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在电池不变的情况下把电路中的电阻加倍，他们能预测电流会怎样变化，并用 V = IR 公式解释吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 功率：瓦特与每秒能量
topics.description: 把功率定义为能量传递的速率（功率 = 能量 ÷ 时间，单位为瓦特），并比较不同日常情境中的能量传递速率
evidence: States the definition of power and gives its unit (watt)
Uses P = E/t to calculate power, energy, or time given the other two quantities
Compares the power ratings of common appliances and explains what the rating means
Explains why a higher-powered device does the same job faster but uses more energy
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在比较一个 100 W 的灯泡和一个 10 W 的 LED 灯，他们能解释这些数字的含义，并算出各自一小时用多少电吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 可再生能源与不可再生能源
topics.description: 区分可再生能源（太阳能、风能、水能、潮汐能、地热能、生物质能）与不可再生能源（煤、石油、天然气、核能），比较它们的优缺点和环境影响
evidence: Lists at least four renewable and three non-renewable energy resources
Explains what makes a resource renewable or non-renewable
Compares the environmental impact of at least two different energy sources (e.g. wind vs coal)
Discusses trade-offs between cost, reliability, and environmental impact in choosing energy resources
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说要在你们地区新建一座风电场，他们能说出与燃气发电站相比，这在环境和可靠性方面各有哪些优缺点吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 串联电路与并联电路
topics.description: 描述并运用串联和并联电路中电流、电压和电阻的规律，并解释每种电路类型的实际用途
evidence: States the rules for current and voltage in series circuits (current same everywhere; voltages add up)
States the rules for current and voltage in parallel circuits (voltages same across each branch; currents add up)
Explains why household wiring uses parallel circuits and identifies the advantage of each type
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么关掉一个房间的灯时，家里的灯不会全灭，而一串老式圣诞彩灯只要坏了一个灯泡就全都不亮了吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 力的词汇
topics.description: 用准确的词汇说出并描述各种力——力、推、拉、扭转、拉伸、挤压、接触力、非接触力、重力、重量、摩擦力、空气阻力、浮力——并区分需要身体接触的力和隔空作用的力
evidence: Correctly name the force acting in at least five given scenarios (e.g. 'friction slows the sledge', 'gravity pulls the apple')
Distinguish between contact forces (friction, upthrust) and non-contact forces (gravity, magnetism) using the correct terms
Use 'weight' correctly as a force — distinct from 'mass' — in descriptions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 从滑梯上滑下来，快到下面时慢了下来，他们能说出是哪种力在起作用，并把它拼写正确吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 推与拉
topics.description: 理解推和拉是能改变物体运动速度或方向的力，并比较不同大小和方向的力产生的效果
evidence: Describe a push and a pull as types of force that make objects move, speed up, slow down, or change direction
Compare the effects of a gentle push versus a strong push on the same object
Predict the direction an object will move based on the direction of the applied force
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释用力推玩具车会让它跑得更快，而从侧面推会让它改变方向吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 测试推力和拉力设计
topics.description: 分析数据，判断某个设计方案能否通过推力或拉力按预期改变物体的速度或方向
evidence: Test a simple design (e.g. ramp, launcher) and collect data on whether it meets the goal
Analyse results to determine if the design works as intended
Suggest modifications based on the data to improve the design's performance
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 搭了一个斜坡，想让球滚进杯子里，球没进时，他能测试并找出该改哪里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 接触力与非接触力
topics.description: 注意到有些力需要两个物体接触（接触力），而磁力可以在一定距离外起作用（非接触力）
evidence: Define contact forces as those needing objects to touch (e.g. push, pull, friction)
Define non-contact forces as those acting at a distance (e.g. magnetism)
Sort examples of forces into contact and non-contact categories
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么踢球要碰到球，而磁铁不用碰到回形针就能把它吸过来吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 摩擦力与表面
topics.description: 比较物体在不同表面上的运动方式，注意到有些表面产生的摩擦力比其他表面大
evidence: Observe and compare how the same object moves on at least three different surfaces
Describe that rough surfaces slow objects down more than smooth surfaces
Use the word 'friction' to explain why movement differs on different surfaces
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么玩具车在光滑的木地板上比在地毯上滚得更远吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 磁性材料
topics.description: 观察磁铁如何相互吸引或排斥，以及如何吸引某些材料而不吸引另一些材料
evidence: Demonstrate that magnets attract some materials (iron, steel, nickel) but not others (wood, plastic, copper)
Show that two magnets can either attract (pull together) or repel (push apart)
Test at least six objects and correctly predict which are magnetic
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用磁铁测试家里不同的物品，并预测哪些会被吸住吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 磁极
topics.description: 说明磁铁有两个磁极（北极和南极），并根据两极相对的方向预测两块磁铁会相互吸引还是排斥
evidence: Identify and label the north and south poles of a magnet
State the rule: like poles repel, opposite poles attract
Predict the outcome of bringing two magnets together based on their pole orientation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能把两块磁铁放在一起，并根据两端朝向解释为什么它们有时吸在一起、有时互相推开吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 平衡力与不平衡力
topics.description: 设计并开展探究，为平衡力和不平衡力对物体运动的影响提供证据
evidence: Define balanced forces (equal in size, opposite in direction — no change in motion) and unbalanced forces (cause motion to change)
Plan a fair test investigating how different force sizes affect an object's motion
Use results as evidence to explain when forces are balanced versus unbalanced
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么放在桌上的书不动（平衡力），但一推就会滑动（不平衡力）吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 绘制力的示意图
topics.description: 绘制并解读力的示意图，用带标注的箭头表示力——箭头长度代表力的大小，方向表示力的作用方向；在一个物体上标出多个力；从图中判断力是平衡的（方向相反、长度相等的箭头，没有合力）还是不平衡的（箭头大小不同，产生合力）；用单个箭头表示合力
evidence: Draw a force diagram with labelled arrows showing direction and relative size for at least two forces acting on an object
Use their diagram to explain whether forces are balanced or unbalanced and what will happen to the object
Add a resultant force arrow to a diagram and explain how they calculated it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果让 {{name}} 画出放在桌上的静止书本受到的所有力，他能画出两个箭头——一个向下代表重力，一个向上代表桌面的支持力——并解释为什么力平衡时书不会动吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 预测运动规律
topics.description: 观察并测量物体的运动，为“规律可以用来预测未来的运动”提供证据
evidence: Measure an object's motion (distance, speed, direction) under different conditions
Identify a pattern in the data (e.g. steeper ramp = further roll)
Use the pattern to make and test a prediction about future motion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 让球从不同高度的斜坡滚下，他能发现规律并预测球从新高度滚下会滚多远吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 空气阻力与摩擦力
topics.description: 识别空气阻力、水阻力和摩擦力的作用，理解这些力作用于运动的表面之间，阻碍运动
evidence: Define air resistance, water resistance, and friction as forces that oppose motion
Give everyday examples of each force and explain how they slow things down
Describe how these forces depend on factors like speed, surface area, or surface texture
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么降落伞会让你减速、为什么游泳比走路更费力、为什么自行车刹车用橡胶垫吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 力与运动词汇
topics.description: 使用力和运动的技术词汇——平衡力、非平衡力、合力、加速度、减速度、速度、力矩、杠杆、支点、机械优势——并在解释和预测力如何影响物体运动与位置时运用这些词汇
evidence: Distinguish between balanced and unbalanced forces and describe the effect of each on an object's motion
Use 'resultant force' correctly when describing the net effect of two or more forces acting on an object
Apply 'moment', 'lever', and 'fulcrum' correctly when describing how simple machines work
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用“平衡力”或“力矩”这样的词，解释为什么两个体重不同的人坐在不同距离时跷跷板仍能保持水平吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 重力与下落物体
topics.description: 说明没有支撑的物体会因为地球与下落物体之间的重力而向地球下落
evidence: Define gravity as a force of attraction between the Earth and objects
Explain that unsupported objects fall because gravity pulls them towards the Earth
Give examples showing gravity in action (dropping objects, jumping, water flowing downhill)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么你一松手所有东西都会往下掉，并说出造成这一现象的力吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 杠杆、滑轮与齿轮
topics.description: 认识到杠杆、滑轮和齿轮等一些机械装置能让较小的力产生更大的效果
evidence: Describe how a lever works: effort at one end moves a load at the other, with a pivot in between
Explain how a pulley changes the direction of a force and can make lifting easier
Describe how gears transfer and change the size or direction of forces
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释跷跷板、旗杆上的滑轮或自行车上的齿轮如何让人用更小的力气更轻松地移动重物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 读距离-时间图
topics.description: 读取并绘制运动物体的距离-时间图；把直线的斜率（陡峭程度）理解为速度；识别静止时段（水平线段）、匀速运动（斜直线段），并通过比较斜率判断相对速度；利用速度 = 距离 ÷ 时间，从直线段的斜率计算平均速度
evidence: Read a distance-time graph and describe what is happening at each stage — moving, stopped, returning
Calculate speed from the gradient of a straight section of a distance-time graph
Sketch a distance-time graph from a written description of a journey with stops and speed changes
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张中间有一段水平线的行程距离-时间图，能解释当时发生了什么，并指出图上哪一段表示最快的速度吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 磁场
topics.description: 描述磁极（北极和南极），解释磁极之间的吸引和排斥，描述用指南针绘制的磁感线，并解释地球磁场及其实际用途
evidence: States the rule for attraction and repulsion of magnetic poles
Draws the magnetic field pattern around a bar magnet from memory or compass readings
Explains why a compass needle points north
Explains that the Earth has a magnetic field and describes how it is used for navigation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用指南针和铁屑绘制了条形磁铁周围的磁场，能描述磁感线形成什么图案，并解释为什么指南针的指针总是指向大致北方吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 质量与重量
topics.description: 区分质量（物质的量，以 kg 计量）和重量（重力，以 N 计量），使用公式重量 = 质量 × 重力场强度，并解释为什么 g 在其他行星和恒星上不同
evidence: Explains the difference between mass and weight with correct units for each
Calculates weight using W = mg with g = 10 N/kg on Earth
Predicts what would happen to an object's weight on the Moon or Jupiter
Explains why mass stays constant but weight changes in different gravitational fields
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在体重秤上称了体重，然后被问到在月球上会有多重，能解释质量和重量的区别并算出大致答案吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 相对运动
topics.description: 解释相对运动——一个物体的表观速度和方向如何取决于观察者自身的运动——用火车和汽车经过等日常例子说明
evidence: Explains why a train moving at the same speed in the same direction as another appears stationary to passengers on that train
Calculates relative speed when two objects move towards or away from each other
Explains why the frame of reference matters when describing motion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 坐在火车上，另一列火车朝同一方向但更快地经过，能解释为什么它看起来慢，即使它实际上行驶得很快吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 合力
topics.description: 把力描述为既有大小又有方向的矢量，区分平衡力（合力为零，运动状态不变）和非平衡力（合力不为零，会引起加速或减速）
evidence: Explains what a vector quantity is and why force is a vector
Calculates the resultant force when two forces act in the same or opposite directions on an object
Explains what happens to an object's motion when forces are balanced vs unbalanced
Draws free body diagrams showing all forces on a stationary object (e.g. a book on a table)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在沿地面推一个很重的箱子，但箱子没动，他能说出箱子受到的所有力，并解释为什么你在推它却还是不动吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 速度与距离-时间图像
topics.description: 用公式 速度 = 距离 ÷ 时间 计算平均速度，在距离-时间图像上表示行程，并把斜率理解为速度、把水平段理解为静止时段
evidence: Uses speed = distance ÷ time to calculate average speed with correct units (m/s, km/h)
Draws a distance-time graph for a given journey with correct axes and labels
Reads a distance-time graph to determine speed, stopping points, and direction of travel
Identifies which section of a distance-time graph represents the fastest speed
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在地图上记录了一次骑行，知道骑了多远、用了多长时间，他能算出平均速度，再画一张粗略的图像表示这次行程（包括停下来吃午饭）吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 形变与流体压强
topics.description: 解释与物体形变相关的力（弹性形变和非弹性形变）、材料的热膨胀与收缩，以及流体压强如何向各个方向作用并随深度增加
evidence: Distinguishes elastic deformation (returns to shape) from inelastic/plastic deformation (permanently changed)
Explains why bridges and railway tracks have expansion gaps
Explains why pressure increases with depth in a liquid (e.g. why deep-sea divers need pressure suits)
Gives an everyday example of thermal expansion causing a problem or being used usefully
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 发现罐子的盖子很紧，他能解释为什么用热水冲一下就好拧了吗——以及金属受热时发生了什么？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 电磁铁
topics.description: 描述电流的磁效应（通电导线会产生磁场），并探究电磁铁的强度如何取决于电流、线圈匝数和铁芯材料
evidence: Describes that a current-carrying wire produces a circular magnetic field
Lists three factors that affect electromagnet strength: current size, number of coil turns, and core material
Explains why an electromagnet can be switched on and off, unlike a permanent magnet
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用电池、导线和铁钉做了一个电磁铁，他能说出两种让它吸起更多回形针的方法，并解释为什么断开电路后它就不起作用了吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 探究力
topics.description: 设计并开展关于力的探究，包括用弹簧测力计测量力、探究胡克定律，以及收集和解读运动数据来检验牛顿定律
evidence: Uses a newton meter correctly to measure forces in newtons
Sets up and conducts a Hooke's Law investigation, recording force and extension and plotting a graph
Identifies and controls variables in a force investigation
Calculates acceleration from force and mass data and compares with experimental results
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 设计了一个实验，在弹簧上挂重物并测量它伸长多少，他能说明怎样保证公平实验、记录结果，并展示胡克定律在图像上是什么样子吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 力矩、压强与胡克定律
topics.description: 计算转动效果（力矩 = 力 × 垂直距离），解释压强如何在液体中均匀传递（帕斯卡原理）和大气压强的概念，并描述胡克定律（在弹性限度内，伸长量与力成正比）
evidence: Calculates the moment of a force and uses the principle of moments to solve lever problems
Explains why hydraulic systems can multiply force (pressure transmitted equally)
States Hooke's Law and plots force-extension graphs identifying the elastic limit
Calculates spring constant k from a force-extension graph (k = F/x)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用长扳手去拧紧一个很紧的螺栓，他能解释为什么扳手越长越省力，并算出用某个特定长度的扳手需要多大的力吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 牛顿第一定律与第二定律
topics.description: 陈述并应用牛顿第一定律（物体不受合力作用时保持静止或匀速直线运动）和第二定律（力 = 质量 × 加速度），包括质量、力和加速度之间的关系
evidence: States Newton's First Law and gives a real example (e.g. why a moving spacecraft doesn't need engines in space)
Uses F = ma to calculate force, mass, or acceleration given the other two quantities
Explains why a heavier object requires more force to achieve the same acceleration
Explains why seatbelts are needed in cars using Newton's First Law
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 被问到为什么坐车要系安全带、坐着不动却不用，他能解释牛顿第一定律对运动物体是怎么说的，再算出一个 60 kg 的人在急刹车时受到多大的力吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 牛顿第三定律
topics.description: 陈述并应用牛顿第三定律：每一个力都有一个大小相等、方向相反的反作用力，作用在不同的物体上，并区分作用力-反作用力对与平衡力
evidence: States Newton's Third Law correctly, identifying both the action and reaction force and the objects they act on
Gives at least two real-world examples (e.g. rocket propulsion, swimmer pushing off a wall)
Distinguishes a Newton's Third Law pair from balanced forces on the same object
Explains why a gun recoils when fired using Newton's Third Law
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到火箭发射升空的视频，他能解释是什么力把火箭向上推、这个力从哪来，以及这体现了哪条运动定律吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 电动机与电动机效应
topics.description: 解释电动机效应：磁场中通电导体受到的力，并说明这一原理如何应用于电动机和扬声器
evidence: Explains that a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field experiences a force (the motor effect)
Predicts how reversing the current or reversing the magnetic field affects the direction of the force
Describes how the motor effect is applied in an electric motor and in a loudspeaker
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到电动机内部或扬声器背面，能解释线圈为什么会动吗？如果改变电流方向，线圈的运动又会怎样变化？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 照顾小型无脊椎动物
topics.description: 照顾小型无脊椎动物：轻轻观察、小心拿放、放回原处。为什么小型无脊椎动物很重要——它们帮助花园生长、分解枯叶，还为其他动物提供食物。
evidence: Demonstrate careful handling of a minibeast such as letting a woodlouse walk onto a hand rather than grabbing it
Explain one reason why minibeasts are important, such as bees helping flowers grow or worms helping soil
State that minibeasts should be returned to where they were found after observing them
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 发现一只小型无脊椎动物时，会轻轻拿放并放回原处吗？能说出它们对花园为什么重要吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 从毛毛虫到蝴蝶
topics.description: 从毛毛虫到蝴蝶：蝴蝶的生命周期是一种可以观察到的变化。卵 → 毛毛虫 → 蛹 → 蝴蝶。一个生物可以彻底改变形态。课堂蝴蝶观察套装、《好饿的毛毛虫》。
evidence: Describe the four stages of a butterfly's life in order: egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly
Explain that the caterpillar and the butterfly are the same creature at different stages of life
Retell or draw the transformation from caterpillar to butterfly after reading a story or watching it happen
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 观察过毛毛虫结蛹，或读过《好饿的毛毛虫》，能说出接下来会发生什么、它怎样变成蝴蝶吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 常见的小型无脊椎动物：命名与识别
topics.description: 识别并说出常见小型无脊椎动物的名称：瓢虫、蚂蚁、蜜蜂、蝴蝶、蜘蛛、蜗牛、蚯蚓、潮虫、毛毛虫、甲虫。培养对所有小型无脊椎动物的积极态度，而不只是“好看”的那些。
evidence: Name and identify at least six common minibeasts from pictures or real encounters
Describe one visible feature that helps tell a ladybird from a beetle or a spider from an ant
Show interest or curiosity toward less popular minibeasts like woodlice, worms, or spiders rather than only butterflies
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 在花园或公园里看到小虫子时，能说出它是什么吗？即使是潮虫、蚯蚓这类不太可爱的也不例外。
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 小型无脊椎动物怎样移动
topics.description: 小型无脊椎动物怎样移动：爬行（蚂蚁、甲虫）、飞行（蝴蝶、蜜蜂）、滑行（蚯蚓、蛞蝓）、跳跃（蚱蜢、跳蚤）、钻土（蚯蚓）。数腿是给生物分组的第一步。
evidence: Describe at least three different ways minibeasts move such as crawling, flying, and slithering
Match a minibeast to its way of moving, for example grasshoppers jump and worms slither
Count legs on a minibeast and notice that ants have six while spiders have eight
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能观察几种小型无脊椎动物，并说出它们各自怎样移动吗？比如蚂蚁爬、蝴蝶飞、蚯蚓扭动。
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 小型无脊椎动物的栖息地
topics.description: 小型无脊椎动物住在哪里：微型栖息地。不同的小型无脊椎动物喜欢不同的环境——木头下面（潮湿、阴暗）、土壤里（地下）、叶子上（阳光充足）、池水里（潮湿）。不同的地方能找到不同的生物。
evidence: Name at least two micro-habitats where minibeasts live such as under logs, in soil, or on leaves
Predict what type of minibeast might be found in a damp dark place versus a sunny leaf
Explain that different minibeasts prefer different conditions like wet, dry, dark, or light
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 在花园里哪里能找到潮虫或蚯蚓，能说出这类生物喜欢的地方吗？比如潮湿阴暗的角落。
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 食物链中的小型无脊椎动物
topics.description: 食物链中的小型无脊椎动物：简单的花园食物链。毛毛虫吃叶子，鸟吃毛毛虫。小型无脊椎动物是其他动物的食物，它们自己也要吃东西。
evidence: Describe a simple food chain such as leaf → caterpillar → bird
Explain that minibeasts eat plants or other tiny creatures and are eaten by bigger animals
Give an example of what a specific minibeast eats, such as caterpillars eating leaves or ladybirds eating aphids
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 毛毛虫吃什么、什么吃毛毛虫，能描述出这条链吗？叶子、毛毛虫、鸟。
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 什么是小型无脊椎动物？
topics.description: 什么是小型无脊椎动物？没有脊椎的小生物，生活在花园、公园和林地里。找虫活动——在木头、石头和叶子下面搜寻，用放大镜近距离观察小型无脊椎动物。
evidence: Explain that minibeasts are small animals without a backbone found in gardens and parks
Find at least three different minibeasts during a garden bug hunt under logs, stones, or leaves
Use a magnifying glass to observe and describe one minibeast's appearance in detail
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你和 {{name}} 在花园里找虫子，能在木头和石头下面找到生物，并说出什么样的生物算小型无脊椎动物吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 蜜蜂与授粉
topics.description: 蜜蜂与授粉：花朵和昆虫如何相互依存。蜜蜂为了花蜜造访花朵，花粉粘在它们身上，再被带到下一朵花。没有授粉，许多植物就无法结出种子或果实。蜜蜂对我们吃的食物为什么重要。
evidence: Describe how pollen moves from one flower to another when a bee visits to collect nectar
Explain that many fruits and vegetables depend on bees or other insects for pollination
State what would happen to a garden or farm if there were no pollinating insects
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到花园里有只蜜蜂在花丛中嗡嗡飞，他们能解释蜜蜂是怎样帮助植物的吗——以及这对我们吃的食物为什么重要？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 伪装、警戒色与拟态
topics.description: 伪装、警戒色与拟态：昆虫如何靠隐藏自己或发出视觉信号来生存。竹节虫看起来像树枝，叶䗛看起来像叶子。黄蜂有警戒条纹；食蚜蝇模仿黄蜂，但其实无害。“你能找到它吗？”挑战。
evidence: Give at least two examples of insect camouflage such as stick insects resembling twigs or leaf insects resembling leaves
Explain why bright warning colours like a wasp's yellow and black stripes help the insect survive
Describe mimicry by explaining that a harmless insect like a hoverfly copies a dangerous one like a wasp to trick predators
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看竹节虫藏在树枝上或食蚜蝇假装成黄蜂的图片，他们能解释这些昆虫为什么长成这样吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 了不起的昆虫：纪录保持者
topics.description: 了不起的昆虫——纪录保持者和超能力。蜣螂是相对体重而言最强壮的动物。蜻蜓是飞得最快的昆虫之一。跳蚤能跳过超过自身体长 150 倍的距离。投弹手甲虫会喷射滚烫的化学物质。昆虫世界的“惊叹时刻”。
evidence: Name at least three insect record-breakers and their extreme abilities such as dung beetle strength or flea jumping
Compare an insect's ability to a human scale, for example a flea's jump would be like a person leaping over a skyscraper
Explain why being very small helps insects achieve extreme feats of strength or speed relative to their size
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能跟你讲讲昆虫界的纪录保持者吗——比如哪种昆虫按体型算是世界上最强壮的，或者哪种跳得最远？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 昆虫的生命周期：完全变态
topics.description: 昆虫的生命周期——详细了解完全变态。卵 → 幼虫 → 蛹 → 成虫。幼虫（毛毛虫、蛴螬、蛆）和成虫长得完全不一样。在蛹里面，身体会被重新构建。蝴蝶、甲虫、苍蝇和瓢虫都要经历完全变态。
evidence: Name the four stages of complete metamorphosis using the correct terms: egg, larva, pupa, adult
Explain that the larva stage is when the insect eats and grows, and the pupa stage is when its body transforms
Give at least two examples of insects that undergo complete metamorphosis such as butterflies and beetles
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用准确的词——卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫——讲出甲虫或蝴蝶的完整生命周期，并说出每个阶段会发生什么吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 不是所有小型无脊椎动物都是昆虫
topics.description: 不是所有小型无脊椎动物都是昆虫：区分昆虫和其他小型无脊椎动物。蜘蛛有 8 条腿和 2 个身体部分（蛛形纲动物），潮虫有 14 条腿（甲壳类动物），蚯蚓没有腿，蜗牛有壳和一只脚。“它是昆虫吗？”分类游戏。
evidence: Sort a set of minibeasts into 'insect' and 'not insect' groups using the six-legs rule
Explain why a spider is not an insect by noting it has eight legs and two body parts
Name at least one difference between insects and another minibeast group such as worms having no legs or woodlice having fourteen
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一只蜘蛛，问它是不是昆虫，他们能解释为什么不是——比如蜘蛛有八条腿，而不是六条？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 社会性昆虫：蚂蚁和蜜蜂
topics.description: 社会性昆虫：蚂蚁和蜜蜂如何在群体中一起生活和协作。蚁后、工蚁和雄蚁。分工——有的采集食物，有的建造，有的守卫。蚁道和蜂巢是有组织的家。与人类团队合作的相似之处。
evidence: Describe at least two different roles within an ant colony or bee hive such as queen, worker, or guard
Explain that social insects live together in large groups and divide up the jobs needed to survive
Compare an ant colony or bee hive to a human team, describing how different members do different tasks
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看了一部关于蚂蚁或蜜蜂的自然节目，他们能跟你讲讲群体里不同的工作吗——比如蚁后、工蚁和守卫？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 分类与识别小型无脊椎动物
topics.description: 用分类检索表来识别小型无脊椎动物。分支式是/否问题：“它有腿吗？”→“有几条腿？”→“它有翅膀吗？”二歧检索表是分类和识别生物的系统工具。
evidence: Follow a simple branching key to correctly identify at least four different minibeasts
Create a yes/no question that separates insects from spiders, such as 'Does it have six legs?'
Explain why asking questions in a set order helps identify a creature you have never seen before
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 发现了一只不认识的小型无脊椎动物，他们能用一组是/否问题——比如“它有腿吗？有几条？”——来判断它属于哪一类吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 昆虫的身体结构
topics.description: 昆虫的身体结构：所有昆虫都有三个身体部分（头、胸、腹），六条腿长在胸部，头上长有触角。大多数有翅膀。它们有外骨骼——一层坚硬的外壳——而不是身体内部的骨头。
evidence: Label the three body parts of an insect — head, thorax, and abdomen — on a diagram or real specimen
State that all insects have exactly six legs and that the legs attach to the thorax
Explain that insects have an exoskeleton, a hard outer covering, instead of bones inside their body
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看一张甲虫或蚂蚁的图片，他们能指出头、胸和腹，并告诉你所有昆虫都有六条腿和坚硬的外壳吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 昆虫的适应
topics.description: 昆虫的适应与进化：桦尺蛾是自然选择的著名例子（工业革命期间，深色蛾在覆盖煤烟的树上存活得更好）。竹节虫进化出像树枝一样的外形。拟蚁蜘蛛进化出欺骗捕食者的本领。许多代的小小变化如何造就惊人的伪装。
evidence: Retell the peppered moth story and explain how the environment changed which colour moth survived best
Describe how a stick insect's body shape is an adaptation that helps it avoid being eaten
Explain that adaptations develop over many generations through natural selection, not during one insect's lifetime
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释桦尺蛾在工业革命期间为什么改变颜色吗——以及这如何说明生物会经过许多代逐渐适应环境？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 深入认识昆虫的身体结构
topics.description: 深入认识昆虫的身体结构：由数千个微小透镜组成的复眼、气门（身体两侧的呼吸孔）、多样的口器（甲虫的咀嚼式上颚、蝴蝶的吸管式口器、苍蝇的海绵状舐吸盘），以及通过蜕去外骨骼来生长。仿生学——工程师如何模仿昆虫的设计。
evidence: Describe at least two specialised insect structures such as compound eyes or spiracles and explain their function
Compare the mouthparts of a beetle (chewing) and a butterfly (sucking) and explain how each is suited to its food
Give one example of biomimicry where human technology is inspired by an insect structure or ability
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张昆虫眼睛或口器的特写照片，能解释这些身体部位如何工作、为什么和我们的长得这么不一样吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 昆虫的交流与行为
topics.description: 昆虫的交流与行为：蜜蜂跳摇摆舞告诉蜂巢同伴花在哪里。蚂蚁留下信息素踪迹让同伴跟随。萤火虫闪烁光信号寻找配偶。蟋蟀摩擦翅膀鸣叫。帝王蝶跨越大陆迁徙数千英里。昆虫如何不用语言来“交谈”。
evidence: Describe at least three ways insects communicate such as the bee waggle dance, ant pheromone trails, and firefly light signals
Explain what information a bee conveys through its waggle dance, including direction and distance to flowers
Describe the monarch butterfly migration and explain why it is remarkable in terms of distance and navigation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释蜜蜂如何告诉同伴去哪里找花、蚂蚁如何留下看不见的踪迹，或者萤火虫如何用光传递信息吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生态系统中的昆虫
topics.description: 生态系统中的昆虫：昆虫扮演的多种角色。传粉者（蜜蜂、蝴蝶、食蚜蝇）、分解者（蜣螂、蝇类幼虫）、鸟类、蝙蝠、鱼类和青蛙的食物来源，以及害虫控制者（瓢虫吃蚜虫）。思想实验：如果所有昆虫都消失了会怎样？
evidence: Name at least three different ecological roles that insects play such as pollinator, decomposer, and food source
Explain how the removal of one insect group like bees would affect plants, other animals, and humans
Describe a specific example of insects as pest controllers such as ladybirds controlling aphid populations
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}}，如果明天世界上所有昆虫都消失了会怎样，他能解释由此引发的一连串问题吗——对植物、动物和人分别有什么影响？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 地球上最成功的动物
topics.description: 地球上最成功的动物：大约有一百万种已被描述的昆虫物种，科学家估计可能还存在 500 万到 1000 万种。昆虫的物种数比其他所有动物类群加起来还多。为什么这么多？体型小意味着需要的食物少，繁殖快、后代多，飞行让它们能到达新的栖息地，外骨骼的适应性也极强。
evidence: State that insects are the most species-rich group of animals with about one million known species
Give at least two reasons why insects are so successful such as small size, fast reproduction, or flight
Compare insect diversity to another animal group, explaining that there are far more insect species than mammals or birds
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道地球上哪一类动物的物种数比其他任何类群都多吗——能解释昆虫为什么如此成功吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 昆虫面临的威胁与保护
topics.description: 昆虫面临的威胁与保护：全球昆虫数量正在下降。原因包括栖息地丧失、农药使用、光污染干扰夜行昆虫，以及气候变化。传粉者减少威胁粮食生产。孩子能做什么：种植对传粉者友好的花园、减少农药使用、参与“大蝴蝶计数”等公民科学活动。
evidence: Name at least three threats to insect populations such as habitat loss, pesticides, and light pollution
Explain why declining bee populations are a problem for humans and the food we eat
Suggest at least two actions that children or families can take to help insects such as planting wildflowers or joining a butterfly count
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能告诉你为什么全世界的昆虫数量在减少、为什么这对人也很重要，以及你们家可以做些什么来帮忙吗？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 变态的类型
topics.description: 完全变态与不完全变态。完全变态：卵 → 幼虫 → 蛹 → 成虫（蝴蝶、甲虫、苍蝇）。不完全变态：卵 → 若虫 → 成虫——若虫看起来像成虫的小版本，随着生长不断蜕皮（蚱蜢、蜻蜓、蟋蟀）。为什么有些昆虫完全变形，而另一些是逐渐长大？
evidence: Compare complete and incomplete metamorphosis by describing the stages of each on a diagram
Classify at least three insects into the correct metamorphosis type such as butterfly (complete) and grasshopper (incomplete)
Explain that nymphs resemble adults while larvae look completely different from their adult form
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释蝴蝶和蚱蜢的生命周期有什么不同吗——为什么毛毛虫一点也不像蝴蝶，而小蚱蜢一出生就像一只小蚱蜢？
topics.domainZh: 昆虫与小型无脊椎动物

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 描述材料的性质
topics.description: 描述日常材料的简单物理性质，如硬/软、有弹性/坚硬、有光泽/暗淡、粗糙/光滑、防水/吸水、透明/不透明
evidence: Use at least five property words correctly: hard, soft, stretchy, shiny, rough, smooth, transparent, waterproof
Describe the properties of three different materials using at least two property words each
Explain why a property matters (e.g. 'waterproof means water doesn't soak through')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能拿起不同的物体描述它们的性质吗——比如“这个很光滑、有光泽”或“这个很粗糙、能弯曲”？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 材料分组
topics.description: 根据日常材料简单的物理特性，对它们进行比较和分组
evidence: Sort a set of materials into groups based on a chosen property (e.g. transparent vs opaque)
Compare two materials and state which properties they share and which differ
Explain the reasoning behind a grouping decision using property vocabulary
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能根据特性把一堆物品分组吗？比如把所有防水的放在一起，或者把所有透明的放在一起。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 说出日常材料的名称
topics.description: 识别并说出各种日常材料的名称，包括木头、塑料、玻璃、金属、水和岩石
evidence: Name at least six everyday materials: wood, plastic, glass, metal, water, rock
Identify the material of at least ten different objects around the home or classroom
Recognise that some objects are made from more than one material
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能环顾一个房间，正确说出物品是用什么材料做的吗？比如窗户上的玻璃、暖气片里的金属、钢笔上的塑料。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物品与材料
topics.description: 区分物品和制作它的材料，理解物品可以用不同的材料制成
evidence: Explain the difference between an object (e.g. a chair) and the material it is made from (e.g. wood)
Give examples of the same object made from different materials (e.g. plastic cup, glass cup)
Identify what material a given object is made from by looking at and touching it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你举起一把木勺和一把金属勺，{{name}} 能解释两者都是勺子（物品），但用了不同的材料吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物质状态词汇
