topics.description: 说出并区分物质的三种状态——固体、液体和气体——使用描述特性的词汇：硬的、坚硬的、流动的、会流动、保持形状、充满容器；用“状态变化”来描述材料被加热或冷却时发生的情况
evidence: Correctly sort a set of everyday materials as solid, liquid, or gas and give a reason for each
Use the terms solid, liquid, and gas accurately when describing everyday substances
Use 'change of state' to describe what happens when ice melts or water boils
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你指着水、冰和水壶冒出的蒸汽，{{name}} 能正确说出它们分别是液体、固体还是气体，并自然地使用这些词吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 改变固体的形状
topics.description: 探究如何通过挤压、弯曲、扭转和拉伸来改变固体物品的形状
evidence: Demonstrate four ways to change the shape of a solid: squashing, bending, twisting, stretching
Compare how different materials respond to these forces (e.g. clay squashes easily, wood does not)
Explain that the material itself stays the same even when the shape changes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能向你展示如何通过挤压改变黏土的形状、扭弯一根毛根，并解释有些材料会弯曲而有些会折断吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 选择合适的材料
topics.description: 识别并比较日常材料对特定用途的适用性，解释为什么特定用途要选择特定材料
evidence: Explain why a specific material is chosen for a purpose based on its properties (e.g. glass for windows because it's transparent)
Compare two materials and decide which is more suitable for a given use with reasoning
Suggest an alternative material for an object and explain why it would or wouldn't work
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么窗户用玻璃而不用木头，或者为什么雨靴用橡胶而不用纸吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 变化与分离词汇
topics.description: 使用描述状态变化和材料分离的过程词汇——溶解、溶液、可溶、不可溶、蒸发、凝结、融化、冻结、过滤、筛分、混合物、分离——并准确理解每个词描述的是什么，包括溶解和融化之间的重要区别
evidence: Distinguish 'dissolve' from 'melt' correctly in context and explain the difference
Use 'soluble' and 'insoluble' accurately when describing whether a material dissolves in water
Explain the difference between evaporation and condensation using the correct terms
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把糖搅进茶里，他们能解释糖是溶解了还是融化了，并告诉你这是两件不同的事吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 给材料分类
topics.description: 计划并开展一次探究，根据可观察的特性给不同种类的材料分类
evidence: Design a simple test to compare one property across several materials
Record observations in a table or chart during the investigation
Classify the tested materials into groups based on the results
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能测试一组物品，并按特性给它们分类吗？比如是否漂浮、是否导热、是否有磁性。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 绘制粒子示意图
topics.description: 绘制并解读粒子示意图——用圆点表示固体（紧密、规则排列、原地振动）、液体（紧密、随机排列、相互流动）和气体（间隔很大、向各个方向快速运动）中粒子的排列、间距和运动方式——并用这些示意图解释固定形状、固定体积、可压缩性等可观察的性质
evidence: Draw labelled particle diagrams for solids, liquids, and gases showing the correct arrangement and spacing of particles
Use their particle diagram to explain why solids keep their shape but liquids flow
Sketch what happens to particles during a change of state (e.g. melting) and explain the energy changes involved
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 的科学老师画了两张示意图，一张的圆点紧密排列成行，另一张的圆点间隔很远、四处移动，{{name}} 能说出哪张代表固体、哪张代表气体，并用粒子来解释原因吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 加热与冷却引起的变化
topics.description: 观察并描述有些材料在加热或冷却时会改变状态，并用摄氏度测量状态变化发生时的温度
evidence: Describe melting (solid to liquid) and freezing (liquid to solid) with everyday examples
State that water freezes at 0°C and boils at 100°C
Explain that heating adds energy causing particles to move more, leading to state changes
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释冰块加热后会发生什么，以及水在多少摄氏度时结冰、多少摄氏度时沸腾吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 拆开与重建
topics.description: 观察由少量零件组成的物体可以被拆开并重新组成新物体，理解这些零件依然存在
evidence: Explain that taking apart an object and rebuilding it uses the same pieces in a new arrangement
Describe how the pieces themselves don't change even though the object looks different
Give an everyday example of reusing materials to make something new
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用积木搭了一座塔，然后拆开重新搭成一辆车，他们能解释用的是同样的积木，只是排列方式不同吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 测试材料的用途
topics.description: 基于比较测试和公平测试得到的掌握证据，说明金属、木材和塑料等日常材料的特定用途的理由
evidence: Design a fair test to compare a specific property of two or more materials
Present test results as evidence for why a material is suited to a particular use
Explain the link between a material's tested properties and its real-world application
topics.assessmentPrompt: 测试过不同材料后，{{name}} 能用掌握证据解释为什么锅身用金属做，而锅柄用塑料做吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 蒸发与水循环
topics.description: 认识蒸发和凝结在水循环中的作用，并将蒸发速度与温度联系起来
evidence: Describe evaporation as liquid turning to gas and condensation as gas turning to liquid
Explain the water cycle: evaporation from seas/lakes → condensation into clouds → precipitation
Explain why evaporation happens faster at higher temperatures (e.g. puddles dry faster on hot days)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么晴天水坑会消失、水去了哪里，以及为什么洗完热水澡后浴室镜子会起雾吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 固体、液体与气体
topics.description: 根据可观察的性质和行为，将材料比较并归类为固体、液体或气体
evidence: Define solids (fixed shape, hard to compress), liquids (flow, take shape of container), gases (spread out, fill space)
Sort at least eight everyday materials into solid, liquid, or gas categories
Explain tricky cases like sand (solid particles) or steam (gas, not visible water droplets)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释冰这样的固体、水这样的液体和蒸汽这样的气体之间的区别，并把日常物品分到这三类里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 材料的进阶性质
topics.description: 根据进阶性质比较并归类日常材料：硬度、溶解性、透明度、导电性与导热性，以及对磁铁的反应
evidence: Define and test for at least four properties: hardness, solubility, conductivity, magnetism
Group a set of materials based on test results for each property
Use results to explain why certain materials are chosen for specific uses (e.g. copper for wires because it conducts electricity)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能测试材料，并按是否溶于水、是否导电、是否被磁铁吸引来分类吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 溶解与溶液
topics.description: 理解有些材料会溶解在液体中形成溶液，并描述如何通过蒸发从溶液中回收物质
evidence: Explain that dissolving means a solid mixes completely into a liquid to form a solution
Describe how to recover a dissolved substance by evaporating the liquid
Distinguish between a mixture (can see separate parts) and a solution (looks clear, fully dissolved)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释糖溶解在茶里时发生了什么，并想出怎样把盐从盐水中取回来吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 不可逆变化
topics.description: 说明有些变化会生成新物质，而且通常不可逆，比如燃烧、生锈和与酸反应
evidence: Define an irreversible change as one that creates new materials that cannot be changed back
Give at least three examples: burning, rusting, mixing bicarbonate of soda with vinegar
Describe observable signs of irreversible change: gas produced, colour change, heat given off, new substance formed
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么烤焦的吐司没法变回原样、铁锈也没法变回闪亮的铁吗？因为已经产生了全新的物质。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 材料性质词汇
topics.description: 用专业词汇描述和比较材料的性质——导体、绝缘体、热的、电的、透明、不透明、半透明、可溶、不可溶、有磁性、有弹性、刚性、密度——并在为特定用途选择和说明材料时准确使用这些术语
evidence: Classify a set of materials as electrical conductors or insulators and explain why using the correct terms
Use 'transparent', 'translucent', and 'opaque' correctly and distinctly in descriptions
Apply at least four property terms correctly when justifying a material choice for a given purpose
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要选一种材料做窗户，他们能用“透明”和“绝缘体”这样的词来解释自己的选择吗——而不只是说“能看透”？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 可逆变化
topics.description: 证明溶解、混合和状态变化都是可逆变化，不会生成新物质
evidence: Define a reversible change as one where the original materials can be recovered
Give at least three examples of reversible changes: melting, freezing, dissolving, evaporating
Explain how to reverse each example (e.g. freeze melted chocolate, evaporate a solution)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释融化巧克力或溶解糖是可以还原的吗——能拿回原来的材料——因为这些是可逆变化？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 分离混合物
topics.description: 运用关于固体、液体和气体的知识，决定如何通过过滤、筛分和蒸发来分离混合物
evidence: Choose the correct separation method for a given mixture (sieving for large particles, filtering for small, evaporating for dissolved)
Describe a multi-step separation plan for a complex mixture like sand, salt, and water
Explain why each method works based on the properties of the materials
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 有一份沙子、盐和水的混合物，他们能想出一个分步方案，用筛子、滤纸和蒸发把这三样都分离出来吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 质量守恒
topics.description: 测量并提供证据，说明无论发生哪种变化（加热、冷却或混合），物质的总重量都保持不变
evidence: State the principle that matter is neither created nor destroyed during physical or chemical changes
Describe an investigation weighing materials before and after a change to show mass is conserved
Explain why dissolved sugar still contributes to the total weight even though it can't be seen
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把糖溶解在水里，他们能解释为什么水和糖的总重量不变，即使糖看起来消失了？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物质由粒子构成
topics.description: 建立一个模型来描述物质由小到看不见的粒子构成，并用这一点解释固体、液体和气体的性质
evidence: Describe matter as made of particles too small to see with the naked eye
Use a particle model to explain differences: particles tightly packed (solid), loosely arranged (liquid), spread far apart (gas)
Use the particle model to explain a state change (e.g. heating makes particles move faster and spread apart)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释一切都是由我们看不见的微小粒子构成的，而粒子排列的紧密程度决定了某样东西是固体、液体还是气体吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 原子、元素与化合物
topics.description: 解释原子、元素和化合物之间的区别；描述简单的玻尔原子模型（带质子和中子的原子核，电子在壳层中）；书写并解读化学符号和简单化学式
evidence: Defines atom, element, and compound and distinguishes between them with examples
Draws a simple Bohr model of an atom labelling nucleus (protons/neutrons) and electron shells
Reads a chemical formula to identify the elements and number of each atom (e.g. H₂O, CO₂, NaCl)
Identifies the difference between a mixture and a compound
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在标签上看到化学式 H₂O，他们能解释它是什么意思吗——涉及哪些原子、每种各有多少个，以及为什么水是化合物而不只是氢气和氧气的混合物？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 材料如何改变状态
topics.description: 用粒子模型解释熔化、凝固、沸腾、凝结和升华，解读加热和冷却曲线以找出熔点和沸点
evidence: Describes what happens to particles during each change of state
Reads a heating/cooling curve and identifies the melting point and boiling point from the flat regions
Explains why temperature stays constant during a change of state
Distinguishes between evaporation (from surface, any temperature) and boiling (throughout liquid, at boiling point)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在锅里加热一块冰，并画出温度随时间变化的图表，他们能解释为什么线在某些地方会变平——以及这时粒子发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 金属与非金属
topics.description: 比较金属与非金属的物理性质和化学性质，解释金属特性（延展性、光泽、导电性），以及元素在元素周期表中的位置如何预测其反应活性
evidence: Lists physical properties typical of metals (shiny, malleable, good conductor) and non-metals
Explains why metals are used in wires, cookware, and construction based on their properties
Uses the periodic table to predict whether an element is likely to be reactive or unreactive
Explains what lustre and malleability mean in terms of real-world observations
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 拿到一种未知物质，它有光泽、能弯曲而不断裂、还能导电，他们能否判断它很可能是金属，并解释每种性质如何支持这一结论？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 物理变化与化学变化
topics.description: 区分物理变化（可逆、不生成新物质）与化学变化（生成新物质、通常不可逆），并运用质量守恒来理解这两种变化
evidence: Classifies given changes as physical or chemical with justification
Explains what conservation of mass means and why mass is conserved in chemical reactions
Names observable signs that a chemical reaction has occurred (colour change, gas produced, temperature change, precipitate)
Explains why dissolving is a physical change but burning is a chemical change
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 把糖溶在茶里，对比把面包放进烤面包机烤焦，他们能否解释哪个是物理变化、哪个是化学变化——以及用什么检验能说明两种情况质量都守恒？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 纯净物与混合物
topics.description: 区分纯净物与混合物，认识配方是成分精确的有用混合物，并利用熔点和沸点检验纯度
evidence: Explains why a pure substance has a sharp, fixed melting point but a mixture melts over a range
Identifies common formulations (medicines, alloys, paints, fuels) as deliberate mixtures
Explains what impurities do to melting and boiling points
Distinguishes mixtures from compounds at the particle level
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要检验一份水样是否纯净，他们能否说出一种可以做的检验——并说明什么结果能证明它是纯净物、什么结果说明它是混合物？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 分离混合物
topics.description: 针对不同类型的混合物选择并实施合适的分离技术：过滤（不溶性固体）、蒸馏（按沸点分离液体）、结晶（溶解的固体）和色谱法（有色物质）
evidence: Selects the correct separation technique for a given mixture with justification
Describes the steps of simple distillation and explains why it works
Interprets a chromatography result (Rf values, number of components)
Explains why filtration removes sand from water but not salt
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要把盐和沙子在水中的混合物分开，他们能否描述两个分离步骤、所需的器材，并解释每一步为什么有效？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 粒子模型
topics.description: 用粒子模型解释固体、液体和气体的性质——包括排列、运动和间距的差异——并运用该模型解释密度、可压缩性以及水的反常膨胀
evidence: Draws particle diagrams for solids, liquids, and gases showing correct arrangement and spacing
Explains why gases are compressible but liquids and solids are not
Explains why ice floats on water using the anomalous expansion of water
Uses particle spacing to explain why gases are much less dense than solids and liquids
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，为什么气球能捏扁而装满液体的水瓶不能，他们能否用粒子的概念解释气体和液体有什么不同？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 元素周期表
topics.description: 描述元素周期表按周期和族的组织方式，解释门捷列夫的贡献，并利用周期表识别金属、非金属，预测反应活性的规律
evidence: Explains why the periodic table is arranged into periods (rows) and groups (columns)
States that elements in the same group have similar chemical properties
Locates metals, non-metals, and metalloids in the periodic table
Explains how Mendeleev ordered elements by atomic weight and predicted missing elements
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在看元素周期表，他们能否解释为什么同一列的元素性质往往相似——并说出门捷列夫做了什么让这张表对化学家如此有用？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 酸的反应与盐
topics.description: 描述并写出酸与金属、碱（中和反应）以及金属氧化物/氢氧化物反应的文字方程式，指出每种情况下生成的盐
evidence: Writes word equations for: acid + metal → salt + hydrogen; acid + alkali → salt + water; acid + metal oxide → salt + water
Names the salt formed from a given acid and base (e.g. hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → sodium chloride)
Describes the test for hydrogen gas (squeaky pop)
Explains what neutralisation means and gives a practical example (indigestion tablets, treating acidic soil)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，助消化药片如何缓解胃酸，他们能否解释发生的是哪种化学反应，并写出一个简单的文字方程式？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 酸、碱与 pH
topics.description: 从氢离子浓度的角度定义酸和碱，描述 pH 标度（0–14），并解释如何用指示剂识别和测量酸碱性
evidence: States that acids have pH below 7, alkalis have pH above 7, and neutral is pH 7
Explains what hydrogen ions (H⁺) have to do with acidity
Names common indicators (litmus, universal indicator) and describes colour changes
Identifies everyday acids (vinegar, lemon juice) and alkalis (bleach, bicarbonate of soda)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 用一片通用指示剂试纸测试柠檬汁和小苏打溶液，他们能否预测各自会变成什么颜色，并解释这说明每种物质有什么性质？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 地球大气与二氧化碳
topics.description: 描述地球大气的组成（主要是氮气和氧气，含少量二氧化碳和其他气体），解释人类活动如何增加二氧化碳，并说明对全球气候的影响
evidence: States the approximate percentages of nitrogen, oxygen, CO₂, and argon in the atmosphere
Explains how burning fossil fuels and deforestation increase atmospheric CO₂
Describes the greenhouse effect and how it leads to climate change
Discusses one specific consequence of climate change (e.g. rising sea levels, extreme weather)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 为什么科学家担心二氧化碳水平上升，他/她能解释二氧化碳在大气中起什么作用、为什么人类活动会产生更多二氧化碳，以及它对地球造成了哪些影响吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 有限资源与回收利用
topics.description: 说明许多原材料（金属、化石燃料、矿物）都是有限资源，描述开采的环境代价，并评估回收利用和循环经济的好处
evidence: Identifies examples of finite natural resources and explains why they are finite
Describes the environmental impact of mining and fossil fuel extraction
Explains why recycling metals saves energy compared to extraction from ores
Discusses trade-offs between the cost of recycling and the benefit of resource conservation
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 要决定是回收一个铝制易拉罐还是直接扔掉，他/她能解释从零开始制造新铝需要哪些环节——以及为什么回收利用它消耗的能源少得多吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 放热与吸热反应
topics.description: 区分放热反应（释放能量，温度升高）和吸热反应（吸收能量，温度降低），并举例说明日常生活和工业中的例子
evidence: Defines exothermic and endothermic in terms of energy transfer to and from the surroundings
Gives two examples of each type from everyday life (e.g. combustion, hand warmers; photosynthesis, cold packs)
Explains energy changes during changes of state (melting is endothermic, freezing is exothermic)
Interprets a temperature change in an experiment to classify the reaction type
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 摇动一个运动冰袋把它激活，冰袋变冷了，或者划着一根火柴，火柴变热了，他/她能解释每种情况发生的是什么类型的反应，以及为什么一个变热、另一个变冷吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 金属活动性顺序
topics.description: 按活动性顺序排列常见金属，解释活动性较强的金属如何置换活动性较弱的金属；描述工业上如何用碳从金属氧化物中提取金属
evidence: Recalls the order of common metals in the reactivity series (potassium to gold)
Predicts whether a displacement reaction will occur given two metals
Explains why carbon can be used to extract iron from iron oxide but not aluminium from aluminium oxide
Links the reactivity series to the history of metal use (gold found free, iron smelted, aluminium electrolytic)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 为什么人类先使用金和铜，后来才使用铁和铝，他/她能解释金属的活动性如何决定提取的难易程度——以及为什么碳能提取某些金属却不能提取另一些吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 岩石循环
topics.description: 解释岩石循环：岩浆如何形成火成岩，沉积物如何被压缩形成沉积岩，热量和压力如何形成变质岩，以及所有岩石类型如何在地质时间尺度上相互转化
evidence: Describes how each rock type (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic) is formed
Gives an example of each rock type and its formation (e.g. granite, limestone, marble)
Traces a rock sample through possible transitions in the rock cycle
Explains what geological time means and why rock cycle changes are slow
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在学校旅行中捡到一块大理石，他/她能解释它原本是石灰岩、是什么把它变成了大理石，以及这个过程花了多长时间吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 化学反应的类型
topics.description: 识别并描述四种化学反应类型：燃烧（在氧气中燃烧）、氧化（获得氧）、热分解（受热分解）和置换（活动性较强的金属替换活动性较弱的金属）
evidence: Writes a word equation for each type of reaction with an example
Identifies the type of reaction from a given word equation or description
Explains what makes a displacement reaction happen (relative reactivity)
Distinguishes complete combustion (CO₂ and H₂O) from incomplete combustion (CO and soot)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到铁生锈和蜡烛燃烧，他/她能解释每种情况发生的是什么类型的化学反应——并为其中一种写出简单的文字方程式吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 陶瓷、聚合物与复合材料
topics.description: 描述陶瓷（坚硬、易碎、耐热）、聚合物（柔韧、轻便、性能多样）和复合材料（结合组成材料的特性）的性质与用途，并各举现实生活中的例子
evidence: Gives the key properties of ceramics, polymers, and composites with examples of each
Explains why a composite material is used rather than a single material in a given application (e.g. carbon-fibre reinforced plastic in bikes)
Identifies natural and synthetic polymers
Explains why polymer properties can be tailored during manufacturing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一辆碳纤维制成的竞赛自行车，他/她能解释为什么单用碳或单用塑料都不如两者结合效果好——以及是什么让这种组合成为优于任一单一材料的复合材料吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海岸与海滩
topics.description: 知道什么是海岸或海滩——陆地与海洋交汇的地方——以及不同的海岸可以是沙质的、岩石的或泥质的，各自有不同的动植物
evidence: Define a coast as where land meets the ocean
Describe at least two types of coast: sandy, rocky, or muddy
Name an animal likely found at each type of coast
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 去过沙滩又去过岩石海岸，他/她能描述这两种海岸看起来有什么不同，并说出在各自那里可能找到的动物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋动物的多样性
topics.description: 认识海洋是各种各样动物的家园——从微小的海马、色彩斑斓的小丑鱼，到巨大的鲸鱼和鲨鱼——海洋动物形状各异、大小不同
evidence: Name at least five different ocean animals
Describe differences in size between small and large ocean creatures
Express curiosity or wonder about the variety of life in the ocean
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 去水族馆参观或看了一部海洋纪录片，能说出至少五种不同的海洋动物，并描述它们彼此之间有多不一样吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋食物链
topics.description: 描述一条简单的海洋食物链：微小的植物（浮游植物）被小动物吃掉，小动物被大鱼吃掉，大鱼被鲨鱼等顶级捕食者吃掉——说明所有海洋生命都靠吃其他生物获取食物
evidence: Describe a food chain with at least three levels
Identify that ocean food chains start with tiny plants or algae
Explain that bigger animals eat smaller ones in a chain of dependence
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能画出或说出这样一条链吗：微小的海洋植物被小生物吃掉，小生物被大鱼吃掉，大鱼再被鲨鱼吃掉——并解释每种动物都依赖它前面的那一种？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 岩石池栖息地
topics.description: 探索岩石池（潮池）这一小型海洋栖息地，那里能找到螃蟹、海葵、海星和小鱼，并理解这些生物适应了在拍岸海浪和变化的水位中生存
evidence: Name at least three creatures found in rock pools
Describe a rock pool as a small ocean habitat on the shore
Explain one way rock pool animals cope with waves or changing water levels
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在海边探索过岩石池，能指出生活在那里的生物，并解释它们在海浪来时如何紧紧抓住岩石或躲进缝隙里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 鲸鱼和海豚是哺乳动物
topics.description: 知道鲸鱼和海豚是哺乳动物，不是鱼——它们呼吸空气、是温血动物、用乳汁喂养宝宝——尽管它们生活在海洋里
evidence: State that whales and dolphins are mammals, not fish
Give at least two reasons why: they breathe air and feed babies milk
Explain that living in water does not make an animal a fish
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一只海豚跃出水面，能解释海豚和我们一样是哺乳动物——呼吸空气、用乳汁喂养宝宝——而不是鱼吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 什么是海洋？
topics.description: 知道海洋是覆盖地球大部分表面的巨大咸水体，海洋是无数生物的家园
evidence: State that oceans cover more of Earth than land does
Explain that ocean water is salty, unlike the fresh water in rivers and lakes
Describe the ocean as home to a huge variety of living things
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你让 {{name}} 在地球仪上指出海洋，能指给你看并解释我们星球的大部分都被咸水覆盖，那里生活着数以百万计的生物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋动物需要什么
topics.description: 理解海洋动物需要食物、庇护所和合适的条件才能生存——就像陆地动物一样——海洋的不同区域满足不同动物的需求
evidence: List basic needs of ocean animals: food, shelter, suitable water conditions
Give an example of how a specific ocean animal meets its needs
Compare an ocean animal's needs to a familiar land animal's needs
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释小丑鱼需要海葵做庇护所、需要小生物做食物，就像鸟需要树做巢、需要种子做食物一样吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 给海洋动物分类
topics.description: 把海洋动物分成主要类别：鱼类（用鳃呼吸、有鳞片）、海洋哺乳动物（呼吸空气、温血、喂乳汁）和无脊椎动物（没有脊柱——水母、章鱼、螃蟹、海星）
evidence: Sort ocean animals into fish, marine mammals, and invertebrates
Give defining features of each group (gills vs lungs, backbone vs none)
Correctly classify at least two animals in each group
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到金枪鱼、海豹和水母的图片，能把它们分到鱼类、海洋哺乳动物和无脊椎动物中，并解释每一类有什么不同吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 珊瑚礁
topics.description: 知道珊瑚礁是由叫珊瑚虫的微小动物建造的，珊瑚礁栖息的物种比几乎任何其他海洋栖息地都多，有时被称为“海洋中的雨林”
evidence: State that coral is built by tiny living animals called polyps, not made of rock
Describe coral reefs as one of the most biodiverse habitats in the ocean
Explain why reefs are compared to rainforests
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看了一部关于珊瑚礁的纪录片，能解释珊瑚其实是由微小的活体动物建造的，而且珊瑚礁是数量惊人的不同物种的家园吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋动物的适应
topics.description: 理解海洋动物为了适应环境有特殊的本领：流线型的身体帮助它们快速游动，伪装让它们躲避捕食者，脂肪层帮它们在寒冷的海水中保暖，触手或吸盘帮它们捕捉猎物
evidence: Name at least three different ocean animal adaptations
Explain how each adaptation helps the animal survive in its environment
Connect an adaptation to the specific challenge it addresses (cold, predators, catching food)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能选一种海洋动物，说出至少两种它的身体特别适合在海洋中生活的地方吗？比如海豹的脂肪层用来保暖，或者章鱼的伪装用来躲藏。

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋深度分层
topics.description: 理解海洋根据深度和光线分为不同的层：靠近海面的阳光层，大多数生物生活在这里；光线逐渐变暗的微光层；以及完全黑暗的午夜层
evidence: Name the three main ocean zones: sunlight, twilight, and midnight
Explain that light decreases with depth until it disappears completely
State that most ocean life is found in the sunlight zone because plants need light to grow
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张越往深处越暗的海洋示意图，能说出三个主要分层，并解释为什么大多数海洋动物生活在阳光照射的海面附近吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋食物网
topics.description: 理解海洋食物网：多条相互连接的食物链，能量从浮游植物（生产者）流向浮游动物、小鱼和大型捕食者；去掉任何一个物种都会影响整个食物网
evidence: Distinguish a food web from a simple food chain
Trace at least two paths of energy through an ocean food web
Explain what could happen if one species in the web were removed
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么捕捞太多某一种鱼，不只影响这种鱼，还会影响整个食物网，包括吃它的动物和它吃的食物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 五大洋
topics.description: 在世界地图上说出并找到五大洋：太平洋（最大）、大西洋、印度洋、南大洋和北冰洋（最小最冷），并理解它们彼此相连，构成一个全球海洋
evidence: Name all five oceans: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, Arctic
Locate at least three oceans on a world map
Explain that the five named oceans are all connected as one continuous body of water
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看世界地图，能按名字指出五大洋，并解释它们都连在一起，构成一个巨大的全球海洋吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海底地形
topics.description: 知道海底不是平的：有山脉、山谷和地球上最深的海沟；最深处是马里亚纳海沟，比珠穆朗玛峰的高度还深
evidence: State that the ocean floor has varied terrain including mountains, ridges, and trenches
Name the Mariana Trench as the deepest point on Earth
Compare its depth to a familiar reference like Mount Everest's height
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说海底有山脉和山谷，能解释海底不是平的，马里亚纳海沟是地球上最深的地方，比珠穆朗玛峰还深吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 潮汐、海浪与洋流
topics.description: 知道海洋有潮汐（水位一天涨落两次，主要由月球的引力引起）、海浪（由风引起）和洋流（在海洋中流动的水流，把热量和养分带到世界各地）
evidence: Describe tides as the regular rise and fall of water level, caused by the Moon's gravity
Explain that waves are caused by wind blowing across the water surface
Describe ocean currents as large flows of water that carry heat and nutrients around the globe
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 注意到白天海滩的水位在变化，能解释潮汐是月球的引力造成的，海洋还有风引起的海浪和像水下河流一样流动的洋流吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 深海生物
topics.description: 探索深海中的生命：能自己发光的动物（生物发光）、适应巨大压力和完全黑暗的生物，以及没有阳光也能维持生命的深海热泉
evidence: Define bioluminescence as the ability of some deep-sea creatures to produce their own light
Describe at least two adaptations deep-sea animals have for life in darkness and pressure
Explain that hydrothermal vents support life without sunlight through chemical energy
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到发光深海生物的视频，能解释有些动物怎么自己发光，以及为什么在最深最暗的海洋里也能有生命吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 探索海洋
topics.description: 知道海洋学家和海洋生物学家用潜水艇、遥控潜水器（ROV）、卫星和潜水来研究海洋；海洋的大部分仍未被探索——我们对月球表面的了解比深海海底还多
evidence: Name at least two tools scientists use to explore the ocean: submarines, ROVs, satellites
State that most of the deep ocean remains unexplored
Explain why ocean exploration is difficult: darkness, pressure, vastness
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释科学家怎么用机器人和潜水艇探索深海，以及为什么我们只探索了海底的一小部分——比我们对月球的了解还少吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋动物迁徙
topics.description: 知道许多海洋动物会进行惊人的迁徙——座头鲸在觅食地和繁殖地之间游数千英里，海龟回到自己孵化的同一片海滩产卵——并理解这些旅程与季节性食物供应和繁殖有关
evidence: Describe at least one example of marine animal migration in detail
Explain that migrations are driven by seasonal food availability and breeding needs
Estimate the scale of these journeys (thousands of miles)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说座头鲸每年从南极游到热带，能解释为什么吗——夏天跟着食物走，再去温暖的水域生宝宝？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋生态系统
topics.description: 把海洋生态系统理解为相互关联的系统，生物（生产者、消费者、分解者）和非生物因素（温度、盐度、光照、洋流）都在相互作用，任何一部分的变化都会影响整个系统
evidence: Describe an ocean ecosystem as a system of living and non-living parts that interact
Name key non-living factors that affect ocean life: temperature, salinity, light, currents
Explain how a change in one factor (like temperature) cascades through the whole ecosystem
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么海水变暖不只影响一个物种——而是改变整个生态系统，从食物网底部的浮游生物到顶端的鲸吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋污染与危害
topics.description: 识别人类伤害海洋的方式——塑料污染、过度捕捞、石油泄漏，以及二氧化碳导致的海洋酸化——并理解大部分海洋污染来自陆地上的活动，而不只是船只
evidence: Name at least three ways humans harm the ocean
Explain that most ocean pollution originates on land, not from ships
Describe how plastic pollution or overfishing specifically harms marine animals
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到海滩上冲来的塑料，能解释它从哪来、怎样伤害海洋生物，并说出人类破坏海洋的其他方式，比如过度捕捞和工厂污染吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 海洋与气候
topics.description: 理解海洋与气候的联系：海洋吸收热量和二氧化碳，通过蒸发驱动天气模式，洋流把热量分布到全球——海洋是地球的气候引擎
evidence: Explain that the ocean absorbs a large amount of the Sun's heat and atmospheric carbon dioxide
Describe the ocean's role in the water cycle through evaporation
Explain how ocean currents distribute warmth and affect weather patterns in distant places
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么海洋有时被称为地球的气候引擎——它吸收热量、通过蒸发带来降雨、用洋流把温暖送到世界各地吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 保护海洋
topics.description: 理解人们如何保护海洋：海洋保护区限制捕捞和污染，可持续渔业防止过度捕捞，海滩清理减少塑料，国际协议旨在减少导致海洋酸化的碳排放
evidence: Explain what a marine protected area is and why it helps
Describe sustainable fishing as taking only what the ocean can replace
Name at least two actions people can take to protect oceans: reducing plastic, marine reserves, cutting emissions
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说有一个禁止捕捞的海洋保护区，能解释它为什么有帮助——并说出人们保护海洋免受污染、过度捕捞和气候变化影响的其他方式吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 没有阳光的深海生命
topics.description: 对比光合作用（来自阳光的能量）与化能合成（来自氧化硫化氢等化学物质的能量）；描述热液喷口群落：化能自养细菌构成食物网的基础，支撑着管虫、巨型蛤蜊和喷口蟹，全程没有阳光；探索深海生命告诉我们关于地球生命起源的什么；解释 NASA 为什么研究海洋喷口，作为木卫二和土卫二上热液活动附近可能存在生命的类比对象
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述一个生活在海底、能量来自火山化学物质而不是阳光的动物群落——并解释为什么科学家对这对其他星球上生命的意义感到兴奋吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 洋流与全球热量
topics.description: 解释温盐环流（全球传送带）由温度和盐度差异驱动，使密度大的水下沉；描述大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）如何把热量从热带输送到欧洲；说明海洋吸收了人类排放的超过 90% 的多余热量和约 25% 的二氧化碳；探索如果环流减弱，北欧气候会发生什么
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么英国冬天比同纬度的加拿大部分地区温和——洋流跟这有什么关系，如果环流减慢可能会发生什么？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 珊瑚白化与酸化
topics.description: 解释珊瑚虫与光合虫黄藻之间的互利共生；描述热应激如何导致白化（珊瑚排出虫黄藻并变白）；解释海洋酸化化学：二氧化碳溶于海水形成碳酸，降低 pH 值并溶解碳酸钙骨骼；把珊瑚礁消失与约 25% 海洋物种栖息地崩溃联系起来；评估当前的珊瑚礁修复工作
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 听说过珊瑚白化吗？能解释珊瑚到底发生了什么——珊瑚和生活在它体内的微小藻类之间什么被破坏了，为什么更暖或更酸的水会引发这种情况？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 捕食者消失与生态系统影响
topics.description: 量化能量在营养级之间的传递效率（约 10% 定律）；解释营养级联：顶级捕食者消失如何引发一连串生态系统变化（海獭 → 海胆暴增 → 海藻林崩溃）；定义“沿着食物网向下捕鱼”；评估海洋再野化的证据——鲨鱼重新引入、鲸鱼恢复带动养分循环；理解为什么需要基于生态系统的渔业管理
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否梳理出太平洋海藻林在海獭被猎杀到几乎灭绝后发生的一连串事件——移除一个物种在整个生态系统中引发了怎样的多米诺效应？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 深海探索技术
topics.description: 解释载人潜水器（Alvin、Deepsea Challenger）和遥控潜水器（ROV）如何帮助探索深海；描述利用声呐进行海底声学测绘，以及为什么只有约 25% 的海底被高分辨率测绘过；探讨为什么深海比月球表面更难探索（压力、寒冷、黑暗、通信困难）；概览针对太阳系中海洋世界的天体生物学任务
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否解释为什么月球表面被详细测绘的面积比地球海底还多——是什么让深海探索比观测月球难得多？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物身体分组
topics.description: 描述并比较各主要动物类群（鱼类、两栖类、爬行类、鸟类、哺乳类）常见动物的外部身体结构
evidence: Describe key structural features of at least three animal groups (e.g. scales, feathers, fur)
Compare two animals from different groups, noting at least two differences
Use words like 'wings', 'fins', 'legs', 'tail' correctly when describing an animal
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否描述鱼的身体和鸟的身体有什么不同，并解释鳞片、羽毛或鱼鳍等特征？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 身体部位与感官
topics.description: 识别、说出并指出人体的基本部位，并将每个部位与其对应的感官联系起来
evidence: Label eyes, ears, nose, mouth, and skin on a body outline
Match each sense organ to its sense: sight, hearing, smell, taste, touch
Describe a simple scenario for each sense (e.g. 'I use my nose to smell cookies baking')
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否指出自己的眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、舌头和皮肤，并说出每个部位对应哪种感官？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 常见植物与树木
topics.description: 识别并说出常见的野生和园艺植物，包括落叶树和常绿树
evidence: Name at least five common wild or garden plants from direct observation
Sort trees into deciduous (loses leaves) and evergreen (keeps leaves) with examples
Match a plant to its name when shown a picture or real specimen
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你指着公园里的一棵树，{{name}} 能否说出它是什么树，以及它冬天是否保留叶子？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 食草动物、食肉动物与杂食动物
topics.description: 将常见动物分类为食肉动物（吃肉）、食草动物（吃植物）或杂食动物（两者都吃）
evidence: Define carnivore, herbivore, and omnivore in own words
Sort at least six common animals into the three diet groups
Give a reason for each sorting decision based on what the animal eats
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否解释为什么猫是食肉动物、兔子是食草动物、熊是杂食动物？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物词汇
topics.description: 说出并运用描述生物特征的词汇——活的、死的、从未活过、运动、营养、生长、繁殖、感应、排泄——并在对物体分类、解释为什么动植物属于生物时使用这些术语
evidence: Correctly classify objects as living, dead, or never been alive and give a reason using one of the life process terms
Name at least five life processes using the correct vocabulary
Explain why a plant is alive using at least two life process words
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能否解释为什么石头不是活的而杂草是活的——用“营养”或“生长”这样的科学词汇，而不只是说“它会动”？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 说出常见动物的名称
topics.description: 识别并说出主要类群中的常见动物：鱼类、两栖类、爬行类、鸟类和哺乳类
evidence: Name at least two animals from each group: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, mammals
Sort a set of animal pictures into the five groups
Explain one feature of each group (e.g. 'birds have feathers', 'fish have gills')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 当 {{name}} 看到青蛙、知更鸟或金鱼时，能否说出它们分别属于哪个动物类群？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物的组成部分
topics.description: 识别并描述常见开花植物（根、茎、叶、花）和树木（根、树干、树枝、叶）的基本结构
evidence: Label roots, stem, leaves, and flowers on a diagram of a flowering plant
Name the main parts of a tree: roots, trunk, branches, leaves
Explain that roots take in water and leaves catch sunlight
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果从花园里摘一朵花，{{name}} 能指出根、茎、叶和花瓣，并说出每个部分的作用吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物需要什么
topics.description: 理解植物和动物（包括人类）生存所需的条件：水、食物、空气和适宜的环境
evidence: List the basic needs of animals: water, food, air, shelter
List the basic needs of plants: water, light, air, suitable temperature
Explain what happens if one basic need is missing (e.g. 'the plant wilts without water')
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你问 {{name}} 宠物狗或花园里的植物需要什么才能活下去，他们能说出水、食物和空气这些基本条件吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物的生命阶段
topics.description: 认识到动物（包括人类）有后代，后代会长成成体，并描述动物基本的生命阶段
evidence: Describe the basic life stages of a human: baby, child, teenager, adult
Give examples of other animals and their young (e.g. kitten → cat, chick → hen)
Explain that offspring grow and change as they develop into adults
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述小猫如何长成大猫，或者婴儿如何长成大人吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 后代与父母相似
topics.description: 观察幼小的植物和动物与父母相似但并不完全相同，认识遗传的相似性和个体差异
evidence: Describe at least three features that offspring inherit from parents (e.g. eye colour, petal colour, fur type)
Explain that offspring are similar to parents but not identical copies
Give examples from both plants and animals showing resemblance with variation
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能看着全家福指出孩子和父母共有的特征，同时注意到每个孩子看起来都有些不同吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 种子与植物生长
topics.description: 观察并描述种子和鳞茎如何经过发芽和生长阶段长成成熟的植物
evidence: Describe the stages: seed absorbs water → root appears → shoot pushes up → leaves open
Compare how a bulb and a seed start growing differently
Record observations of a growing plant over several days using drawings or a simple diary
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 种过种子或鳞茎，并能描述它生长过程中的变化吗——先长根，再长芽，然后长叶？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物生长需要什么
topics.description: 理解植物需要水、光和适宜的温度才能生长并保持健康
evidence: Name three things plants need to grow: water, light, suitable temperature
Predict what happens to a plant kept in the dark, with no water, or in freezing cold
Describe the results of a simple test comparing plants grown in different conditions
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么窗台上的植物比放在黑暗柜子里的植物长得好吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物分类词汇
topics.description: 使用动物分类和描述生命周期的词汇——脊椎动物、无脊椎动物、哺乳动物、鸟类、爬行动物、两栖动物、鱼类、昆虫、蛛形动物、幼虫、蛹、变态、妊娠、后代、完全变态、不完全变态——并在分类和比较生物体时正确运用这些词汇
evidence: Correctly classify a set of animals as vertebrates or invertebrates, then into more specific groups
Use 'metamorphosis' correctly to describe insect and amphibian life cycles and distinguish complete from incomplete metamorphosis
Compare a mammal's life cycle with an insect's using precise vocabulary
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道脊椎动物和无脊椎动物的区别吗——能把一组动物分到正确的类别里吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物营养
topics.description: 理解动物（包括人类）需要正确种类和数量的营养，并且动物不能自己制造食物
evidence: Name the main food groups: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre, water
Explain that animals get energy from food they eat, unlike plants which make their own
Describe what happens with too much or too little of a food group (e.g. weak bones without calcium)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么人们需要吃水果、蛋白质和碳水化合物等不同种类的食物来保持健康吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 绘制生命周期图
topics.description: 为开花植物、昆虫（完全变态和不完全变态）、鸟类和哺乳动物绘制并解读生命周期图——标注各阶段、描述阶段间的转变，并比较不同物种的生命周期
evidence: Draw a labelled life cycle diagram for a flowering plant including seed, seedling, mature plant, and flower/fruit
Compare a butterfly life cycle (complete metamorphosis) with a grasshopper life cycle (incomplete metamorphosis) using diagrams
Label a blank life cycle diagram for a given organism correctly, including transitions between stages
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一张空白的圆形图，他/她能按正确顺序填入蝴蝶生命周期的各个阶段并加上标注吗？能解释每个阶段发生了什么变化吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物各部分的作用
topics.description: 识别并描述开花植物各部分的功​​能：根吸收水分和养分，茎运输物质，叶制造养分，花帮助繁殖
evidence: Describe the function of roots (absorb water and minerals from soil)
Explain that the stem transports water up and food around the plant
State that leaves use sunlight to make food and flowers produce seeds for new plants
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么花需要地下的根和上面的叶吗——每个部分各做什么工作？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生物的生命周期
topics.description: 建立模型来描述生物有独特而多样的生命周期，但都经历出生、生长、繁殖和死亡这些共同阶段
evidence: Describe the life cycle of at least two different organisms (e.g. butterfly, frog, plant)
Identify the common stages all life cycles share: birth, growth, reproduction, death
Explain how life cycles can look very different (metamorphosis vs gradual growth) but follow the same pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能比较蝴蝶和青蛙的生命周期，并说出它们都有哪些共同阶段——出生、生长、繁殖和死亡吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 传粉与种子传播
topics.description: 理解开花植物的生命周期，包括传粉、种子形成和种子传播
evidence: Describe the stages: pollination → fertilisation → seed formation → seed dispersal
Explain at least two methods of seed dispersal (wind, animal, water, explosion)
Describe pollination as the transfer of pollen from one flower to another, often by insects or wind
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释花如何变成里面有种子的果实，以及这些种子如何传播开来长成新植物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 骨骼与肌肉
topics.description: 认识人类和一些其他动物有骨骼和肌肉，用于支撑、保护和运动
evidence: Name the three functions of the skeleton: support, protection, movement
Identify that muscles are attached to bones and pull to create movement
Give examples of bones protecting organs (skull protects brain, ribs protect heart and lungs)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么我们身体里有骨骼，以及弯曲手臂时肌肉在做什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物中的水分运输
topics.description: 探究水在植物体内如何运输，通过观察有色水被茎向上输送等现象
evidence: Describe an investigation using coloured water to track water movement in a plant
Explain that water travels from roots through the stem to the leaves and flowers
Draw or label a diagram showing the path of water through a plant
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 是否观察过白花在有色水中变色，并能解释是茎把水向上输送到花瓣的？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物茁壮成长需要什么
topics.description: 探索并比较植物生存和生长所需的条件：空气、光照、水、土壤中的养分和生长空间
evidence: List five requirements for plant growth: air, light, water, nutrients, space
Explain how needs vary between plants (e.g. cacti need less water than ferns)
Predict what happens when one requirement is removed or limited
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出为什么一盆挤满幼苗的植物不如只种几株的长得好吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物如何适应环境
topics.description: 认识动物和植物如何适应各自的环境，并理解适应可能随时间推移导致进化
evidence: Define adaptation as a feature that helps an organism survive in its environment
Give at least three examples of adaptations in different organisms and explain how each helps survival
Explain that over many generations, organisms with helpful adaptations survive and reproduce more, leading to evolution
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释骆驼的驼峰、仙人掌的厚皮或北极熊的白毛如何帮助它们在栖息地生存，以及这些适应特征是如何随时间发展而来的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 遗传词汇
topics.description: 使用关于变异和遗传的词汇——遗传特征、获得性特征、变异、后代、性状、物种、品种、遗传的、环境——并在比较生物体、解释同一物种内部及不同物种之间的相似与差异时运用这些词汇
evidence: Distinguish between inherited and acquired characteristics with a correct example of each
Use 'variation' correctly to describe differences within a species and explain what causes variation
Use 'offspring', 'species', and 'trait' correctly in written descriptions of living things
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么孩子长得像父母却不完全一样吗——用上“遗传”或“变异”这样的词？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 遗传特征
topics.description: 分析和解读数据，提供证据说明动植物具有从父母遗传来的性状，并且这些性状在相似生物群体中存在变异
evidence: Define inherited traits as characteristics passed from parents to offspring
Collect or interpret data showing variation within a group (e.g. different heights, colours, sizes)
Explain that while traits are inherited, there is natural variation among individuals of the same species
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 测量花园里所有向日葵的高度，他们能看出它们都是向日葵，但每一株的高度都略有不同吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 消化系统
topics.description: 描述人体消化系统基本部位的简单功能：口腔、食道、胃、小肠、大肠
evidence: Name the main organs in order: mouth, oesophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine
Describe the function of each (mouth chews, stomach breaks down, small intestine absorbs nutrients)
Draw or label a simple diagram of the digestive system
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能追踪一块三明治在身体里的旅程吗——从在嘴里咀嚼一直到肠道？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 性状：遗传与环境
topics.description: 用证据支持这一解释：性状既受遗传影响，也受环境影响
evidence: Explain that traits result from both inheritance and environmental factors
Give examples of environmental influence on traits (e.g. sunlight affects plant growth, diet affects animal size)
Distinguish between inherited traits (e.g. eye colour) and environmentally influenced traits (e.g. muscle strength from exercise)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么两颗相同的种子，如果一颗比另一颗得到更多阳光，会长成大小不同的植物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 牙齿的类型
topics.description: 识别人类不同类型的牙齿（门齿、犬齿、臼齿），并描述它们在进食中的功能
evidence: Name three types of teeth: incisors, canines, molars
Describe the function of each: incisors cut, canines tear, molars grind
Relate tooth type to diet (e.g. herbivores have flat molars, carnivores have sharp canines)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能指着自己嘴里的不同牙齿，解释前面的牙齿切食物、后面的牙齿磨食物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 变异与生存优势
topics.description: 用证据解释同一物种个体间特征的变异如何为生存、寻找配偶和繁殖提供优势
evidence: Explain that variation within a species means some individuals have traits better suited to their environment
Give examples of advantageous variations (e.g. camouflage, speed, drought resistance in plants)
Connect variation to survival advantage: individuals with beneficial traits are more likely to survive and reproduce
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么一群兔子中跑得更快的那只可能活得更久，因为它比慢的兔子更能躲开捕食者吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 人生阶段
topics.description: 描述人类成长到老年过程中的变化，包括人类生命周期各阶段
evidence: Name the main stages of human development: baby, toddler, child, teenager, adult, elderly
Describe key changes at puberty (growth spurt, body changes)
Explain that old age brings changes like reduced strength, greying hair, and slower healing
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能描述人生的主要阶段——从婴儿到幼儿到儿童到青少年到成年到老年——以及每个阶段的一些变化吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 器官系统词汇
topics.description: 使用主要器官系统的专业词汇——器官、器官系统、循环系统、消化系统、呼吸系统、骨骼系统、肌肉系统、营养物质、氧气、二氧化碳、血管、动脉、静脉、毛细血管、酶——并用这些术语描述每个系统的功能
evidence: Name the main organs in at least two body systems and state their functions using the correct vocabulary
Use 'circulatory', 'digestive', and 'respiratory' correctly in written descriptions of the body
Explain the difference between an artery and a vein using the correct anatomical terms
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释循环系统的作用吗——不只是“心脏泵血”，而是用上“氧气”“动脉”和“血管”这样的词？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 感官、大脑与反应
topics.description: 用模型说明动物通过感官接收信息，在大脑中处理信息，并以不同方式做出反应
evidence: Describe the pathway: sense organ detects stimulus → brain processes information → body responds
Give examples of different animal senses (sight, smell, hearing, echolocation, vibration)
Explain how the same stimulus can produce different responses in different animals
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释狗如何用感官发现松鼠，然后决定去追它吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 生存结构
topics.description: 构建论点，说明植物和动物具有支持生存、生长、行为和繁殖的内部与外部结构
evidence: Give examples of external structures and their survival functions (e.g. thorns for protection, claws for catching prey)
Give examples of internal structures and their functions (e.g. heart pumps blood, lungs take in air)
Construct a reasoned argument linking a specific structure to how it helps the organism survive or reproduce
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释仙人掌粗壮的茎如何帮助它在沙漠中生存，或者鸟的翅膀如何帮助它找到食物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 饮食、运动与生活方式
topics.description: 认识饮食、运动、药物和生活方式对人体运作方式的影响
evidence: Describe how a balanced diet provides energy and nutrients the body needs
Explain the positive effects of regular exercise on the heart, muscles, and mental health
Describe harmful effects of drugs, alcohol, or tobacco on the body
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么吃得好、经常运动有助于身体保持健康，以及为什么药物和吸烟有害吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 来自食物与太阳的能量
topics.description: 用模型说明动物食物中的能量曾经是来自太阳的能量，通过植物或其他生物传递而来
evidence: Explain that plants capture energy from sunlight to make food (photosynthesis)
Trace an energy pathway: sun → plant → animal → another animal
Explain that animals use food energy for body repair, growth, movement, and warmth
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能追溯早餐麦片中的能量一路回到太阳，并解释每一步吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 进化词汇
topics.description: 使用进化和自然选择的技术词汇——适应、进化、自然选择、灭绝、绝种、化石记录、物种、共同祖先、突变、变异——并按正确顺序用这些术语解释自然选择的机制
evidence: Use 'adaptation' correctly to describe a feature that helps an organism survive in its environment
Explain natural selection using 'variation', 'selection pressure', and 'reproduction' correctly in sequence
Use 'extinct' and 'extinction' correctly and distinguish them from 'endangered'
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能用自己的话解释长颈鹿为什么有长脖子——使用“适应”或“自然选择”这样的词，而不只是说“这样它们就能够到树叶”吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 动物体内的营养运输
topics.description: 描述营养物质和水如何在动物体内运输，包括循环系统在将消化产生的营养物质输送出去中的作用
evidence: Describe how nutrients from digested food pass through the wall of the small intestine into the blood
Explain that blood transports dissolved nutrients and water to all parts of the body
Connect the digestive system and circulatory system as working together to deliver nourishment
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释午餐吃的三明治究竟如何到达肌肉——从胃进入血液，再运往全身吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物从空气和水中生长
topics.description: 支持这一论点：植物生长所需的材料主要来自空气和水，而不是土壤
evidence: Explain that plants take in carbon dioxide from air and water from soil to make food (photosynthesis)
Argue that most of a plant's mass comes from air (CO₂) and water, not soil minerals
Describe a simple investigation showing soil mass barely changes while a plant grows significantly
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 知道植物需要水和阳光，他们是否也能解释植物的大部分“建筑材料”其实来自空气和水，而不是泥土？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 循环系统
topics.description: 识别并说出人体循环系统的主要部分，描述心脏、血管和血液的功能
evidence: Name the main components: heart, arteries, veins, capillaries, blood
Describe the heart as a pump that pushes blood around the body in a continuous loop
Explain that blood carries oxygen and nutrients to cells and removes waste products like carbon dioxide
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释心脏的作用、为什么全身都有血管，以及血液究竟运输什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 计算膳食能量
topics.description: 计算并评估健康日常饮食中的能量摄入与需求，解读食品标签和营养数据
evidence: Reads and interprets a nutritional information label (kJ and kcal)
Estimates daily energy requirements for a person of a given age/activity level
Compares the energy content of different diets and identifies surpluses or deficits
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 和你在超市一起看食品标签，他们能大致判断出一顿饭提供的能量是太多、太少，还是刚好满足一天的需要吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 从细胞到器官系统
topics.description: 描述多细胞生物的层级结构：细胞 → 组织 → 器官 → 器官系统 → 生物体
evidence: Places cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems in the correct order of organisation
Gives a specific example of each level (e.g. muscle cell → muscle tissue → heart → circulatory system → human)
Explains why specialised cells are needed in a multicellular organism
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果请 {{name}} 解释身体是如何从最小的部分构建成整体的，他们能描述从单个细胞一直到器官系统的各个层级，并给每个层级举一个真实的例子吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 显微镜下的细胞
topics.description: 理解所有生物都由细胞构成，并使用光学显微镜观察、解读和记录细胞结构
evidence: States that all living things are made of cells
Prepares or examines a slide of cells (e.g. onion skin, cheek cells) under a microscope
Draws and labels a diagram of cells observed
Identifies nucleus, cytoplasm, and cell membrane in a microscope image
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 制作了洋葱表皮装片，并通过学校显微镜观察，他们能辨认出看到的是什么，并解释所有生物都是由这些微小单位构成的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 饮食失衡与营养缺乏
topics.description: 解释饮食失衡对健康的影响，包括肥胖（能量过剩）、饥饿（严重能量不足）和营养缺乏病（缺乏特定营养素，如坏血病、佝偻病）
evidence: Defines obesity, starvation, and deficiency disease and links each to dietary imbalance
Identifies at least two specific deficiency diseases and the missing nutrient causing each
Explains why the impact of poor diet can be long-term
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说了肥胖或维生素缺乏病这类情况，他们能解释吃太多、吃太少或食物搭配不当是如何导致这些健康问题的吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 消化与酶
topics.description: 描述人体消化系统的器官，以及食物如何被物理消化和化学消化，包括酶作为生物催化剂的作用
evidence: Traces the journey of food from mouth to large intestine, naming each organ and its role
Explains what enzymes do and names where they are produced (salivary glands, stomach, small intestine)
Distinguishes physical digestion (chewing, churning) from chemical digestion
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 和你一起吃了一顿饭，他们能一步步描述食物在身体里经过时发生了什么，说出经过的器官以及每个器官的作用吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 关节、肌腱与韧带
topics.description: 解释生物力学——关节处骨骼与肌肉的相互作用，包括肌腱（连接肌肉与骨骼）和韧带（连接骨骼与骨骼）的作用
evidence: Distinguishes between tendons and ligaments and gives the function of each
Describes how a synovial joint works (e.g. the knee or elbow)
Explains how force is transmitted from muscle through tendon to bone to produce movement
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 运动时伤了膝盖，他们能解释韧带和肌腱分别是什么、各自在哪里，以及其中一个受损会发生什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 肌肉成对工作
topics.description: 解释肌肉以拮抗对的方式工作——一块收缩时另一块放松——从而产生运动，以肱二头肌和肱三头肌为主要例子
evidence: Explains why muscles can only pull, not push
Describes what happens to the bicep and tricep when the arm is bent and straightened
Gives another example of an antagonistic muscle pair
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 弯曲和伸直手臂，他们能解释为什么需要两块不同的肌肉——一块负责弯曲、一块负责伸直——以及哪块肌肉是哪块吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 健康饮食中的营养素
topics.description: 识别健康饮食的七种成分——碳水化合物、脂质、蛋白质、维生素、矿物质、膳食纤维和水——并解释每种成分在体内的作用
evidence: Names all seven dietary components and a food source for each
Explains what each nutrient does in the body (e.g. proteins for growth and repair)
Identifies which nutrients provide energy and which do not
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在准备一份便当，他们能解释每类食物对身体的作用吗——为什么我们需要蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪、维生素和矿物质？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物细胞与动物细胞的组成
topics.description: 描述植物细胞和动物细胞主要组成部分的功能：细胞壁、细胞膜、细胞质、细胞核、液泡、线粒体、核糖体和叶绿体
evidence: Names the main organelles in plant and animal cells
Explains the function of each organelle in their own words
Links organelle function to the needs of the whole cell (e.g. mitochondria produce energy for cell activities)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 看一张植物细胞示意图，他们能指出细胞核、叶绿体和细胞壁等部分，并用简单的话说明每个部分的作用吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 光合作用
topics.description: 解释光合作用是植物利用光能把二氧化碳和水转化为葡萄糖和氧气的过程，并描述矿物质营养如何通过根吸收
evidence: Writes and explains the word equation for photosynthesis
Identifies the raw materials needed and the products made
Explains the role of chlorophyll in capturing light energy
Distinguishes between what plants get from the air (CO₂), soil (water and minerals), and light
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 为什么植物不像动物那样需要吃东西，他们能解释植物如何利用阳光、水和二氧化碳自己制造食物，并写出反应式吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物细胞与动物细胞的比较
topics.description: 比较植物细胞和动物细胞，找出共同特征以及植物细胞特有的结构（细胞壁、液泡、叶绿体）
evidence: Lists features common to plant and animal cells
Identifies structures found only in plant cells and explains why
Draws and annotates labelled diagrams of both cell types showing similarities and differences
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果把一张植物细胞图和一张动物细胞图并排放在 {{name}} 面前且都不标注名称，他们能找出哪些特征是共有的、哪些只出现在植物细胞中，并说出原因吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 单细胞生物
topics.description: 解释细菌和变形虫等单细胞生物如何在一个细胞内完成所有生命活动
evidence: Names examples of unicellular organisms
Lists the seven life processes (MRS NERG) and explains how a single cell performs each one
Contrasts how unicellular organisms meet their needs compared to multicellular organisms
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 了解到细菌只由一个细胞构成，他们能解释这个单细胞如何完成进食、生长和繁殖——做到整个身体才能做的所有事情吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 人体骨骼
topics.description: 描述人体骨骼的结构和四大主要功能：支撑、保护、运动，以及在骨髓中制造血细胞
evidence: Lists and explains the four functions of the skeleton with examples
Names key bones and identifies which organs they protect (e.g. ribcage protects heart and lungs)
Explains what bone marrow is and where blood cells are made
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果问 {{name}} 我们为什么有骨头，他们能解释骨头不只是支撑身体，还能说出骨骼对身体的至少三种不同作用吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 使用显微镜
topics.description: 正确使用光学显微镜制备、调焦和观察生物标本，包括在合适放大倍数下绘制准确的标注图
evidence: Sets up a light microscope safely and correctly (course focus then fine focus)
Prepares a wet mount slide with a biological specimen (e.g. onion skin)
Calculates the magnification of an image (magnification = image size ÷ actual size)
Draws an accurate labelled diagram of observed cells with a scale
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 需要用学校显微镜观察生物标本，他们能正确安装调试、找到要观察的目标，并画出带标注的科学绘图吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 有氧呼吸
topics.description: 解释有氧呼吸是生物利用氧气从葡萄糖中释放能量、产生二氧化碳和水的过程；写出并解释文字反应式：葡萄糖 + 氧气 → 二氧化碳 + 水
evidence: Writes and explains the word equation for aerobic respiration
Explains where in the cell aerobic respiration takes place (mitochondria)
Links aerobic respiration to why breathing rate and heart rate increase during exercise
Explains that respiration is not the same as breathing
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 刚上完体育课正大口喘气，他们能解释有氧呼吸在肌肉细胞里做了什么，并写出描述这一过程的文字反应式吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 无氧呼吸
topics.description: 解释动物的无氧呼吸是氧气供应不足时葡萄糖不完全分解为乳酸、导致肌肉疲劳的过程；并从能量产出和产物两方面与有氧呼吸进行对比
evidence: Writes the word equation for anaerobic respiration in animals
Explains why lactic acid causes muscle pain and fatigue
Compares the energy released by aerobic and anaerobic respiration
Explains oxygen debt and recovery after vigorous exercise
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 全力冲刺后腿开始发酸发痛，他们能解释肌肉里发生了什么——为什么氧气不够，身体转而产生了什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 体温调节
topics.description: 解释人体如何感知并应对包括温度在内的环境变化，包括皮肤在体温调节中的作用（出汗、发抖、血管舒张、血管收缩）
evidence: Explains what homeostasis means in the context of body temperature
Describes at least two mechanisms the body uses to cool down and two to warm up
Explains why maintaining a constant core body temperature is important for enzyme activity
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在夏天太热开始出汗，他能解释身体在做什么来降温吗——以及为什么保持体温稳定这么重要？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 气体交换与呼吸
topics.description: 描述人体气体交换系统的结构（气管、支气管、细支气管、肺泡），并解释呼吸的机制——利用肋骨和膈肌运动带来的压力变化——如何让空气进出肺部
evidence: Labels a diagram of the lungs showing trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, and alveoli
Explains that breathing in lowers air pressure in the chest and air rushes in
Describes how the structure of alveoli (large surface area, thin walls, good blood supply) aids gas exchange
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 跑步后深吸一口气，他能解释肺里发生了什么吗——空气怎么进去、氧气在哪里进入血液、二氧化碳又怎么排出？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 肠道细菌与消化
topics.description: 解释肠道微生物群细菌在消化中的作用，包括分解膳食纤维和营造健康的肠道环境
evidence: Explains that many gut bacteria are beneficial, not harmful
Describes what gut bacteria do that human digestive enzymes cannot (e.g. break down fibre)
Explains what might happen if the gut microbiome is disrupted
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 听说我们肠道里住着数十亿细菌，他能解释为什么这其实对消化有帮助，而不是需要担心的事吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 心脏结构与双循环
topics.description: 描述心脏的结构（四个腔室、瓣膜、冠状动脉），并解释心脏如何在双循环系统中把缺氧血泵到肺部、把富氧血泵到全身
evidence: Labels a diagram of the heart showing atria, ventricles, valves, aorta, vena cava, and pulmonary vessels
Traces the route of blood through the double circulatory system
Explains the role of valves in preventing backflow
Compares arteries, veins, and capillaries
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 感受到自己的心跳，他能描述心脏在做什么吗——解释心脏的两侧、每侧血液的去向，以及为什么我们需要双循环？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 扩散是如何发生的
topics.description: 解释扩散是粒子从高浓度区域向低浓度区域的净移动，并描述它在细胞内外运输物质（氧气、二氧化碳、葡萄糖）中的作用
evidence: Defines diffusion using particle theory
Explains the direction of diffusion of oxygen and carbon dioxide at the alveoli
Explains how cells get glucose from the blood using diffusion
Identifies factors that affect the rate of diffusion (concentration gradient, surface area, distance)
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果有人问 {{name}}，为什么氧气能从肺部进入血液而不需要身体去泵送，他能解释什么是扩散，以及为什么它总是朝一个特定方向移动吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 人类生殖
topics.description: 描述男性和女性人类生殖系统的结构与功能，并解释受精、妊娠和分娩的过程，包括胎盘的作用
evidence: Labels diagrams of the male and female reproductive systems
Explains the roles of gametes (sperm and egg) in sexual reproduction
Describes what happens during fertilisation and where it occurs
Explains the function of the placenta and the impact of maternal lifestyle on foetal development
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 在学习人类生殖，他能描述男性和女性生殖系统如何协同工作，并解释从受精到出生之间发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 病原体与免疫系统
topics.description: 解释病原体（细菌、病毒和真菌）如何致病，并描述免疫系统如何应对，包括白细胞的作用（吞噬作用、抗体产生）以及免疫力的概念
evidence: Distinguishes between bacteria, viruses, and fungi as pathogens with examples of each
Explains two ways white blood cells destroy pathogens (engulfing and antibodies)
Explains how vaccination works and why it prevents disease
Explains the difference between being infected and being ill
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 感冒了，他能解释是什么类型的病原体引起的、免疫系统如何努力对抗它，以及为什么流感疫苗不能保护你免受所有感冒的侵袭吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 植物生殖
topics.description: 描述花的结构，并解释植物的风媒和虫媒传粉、受精、种子和果实形成以及种子传播的过程
evidence: Labels the main parts of a flower (sepals, petals, stamens, carpel, ovary, ovule)
Compares wind-pollinated and insect-pollinated flowers and explains adaptations of each
Traces the journey from pollination to seed dispersal
Identifies and explains at least two methods of seed dispersal
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到蜜蜂在花园里访问花朵，他能解释蜜蜂在扮演什么角色，并梳理从传粉到种子传播的完整过程吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 毒品与酒精的影响
topics.description: 解释娱乐性毒品（包括酒精、烟草和非法物质）对行为、健康和身体系统的影响，并区分抑制剂、兴奋剂和致幻剂
evidence: Categorises common recreational drugs as depressants, stimulants, or hallucinogens
Explains specific effects of alcohol and tobacco on the body (e.g. liver damage, lung cancer)
Discusses the difference between physical and psychological dependence
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一则关于毒品滥用的新闻，他/她能解释不同类型毒品对身体和行为的影响吗？能说出为什么有些毒品比其他毒品危害更大吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 北极与南极
topics.description: 知道北极（北极点）和南极（南极点）非常不同——北极是被陆地环绕的冰冻海洋，那里有人和北极熊生活；而南极是被海洋环绕的巨大冰封大陆，那里有企鹅但没有永久居民
evidence: State that the Arctic is a frozen ocean surrounded by land, while the Antarctic is a continent covered in ice surrounded by ocean
Explain that polar bears live in the Arctic and penguins live in the Antarctic, not the other way around
Know that people (like the Inuit) live in the Arctic but nobody lives permanently in Antarctica
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出两极之间的重大区别吗——北极是被陆地环绕的冰冻海洋，而南极是被海洋环绕的冰封大陆？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 勇敢的极地探险家
topics.description: 了解勇敢的极地探险家的简单故事——竞相前往南极点的罗伯特·福尔肯·斯科特和罗尔德·阿蒙森，以及船只“坚忍号”被冰压碎但把所有人安全带回的欧内斯特·沙克尔顿——并理解极地探险需要非凡的勇气和毅力
evidence: Name at least two polar explorers: Scott, Amundsen, or Shackleton
Tell the basic story of Scott and Amundsen's race to the South Pole in simple terms
Describe what happened to Shackleton's ship Endurance and how he brought his crew home safely
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出前往南极的探险家的故事吗——比如斯科特和阿蒙森的竞赛，或者沙克尔顿的船被困在冰中但他救了所有船员？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 冰与雪
topics.description: 知道水可以是固体（冰和雪）或液体，雪由微小的冰冻冰晶组成，冰山是漂浮在海洋中的巨大冰块，大部分隐藏在水下，冰会浮起来是因为它比液态水轻
evidence: Explain that ice and snow are frozen water (solid) and that water can change between solid and liquid
Describe an iceberg as a huge piece of ice floating in the ocean with most of it hidden below the surface
State that ice floats because frozen water is lighter than liquid water
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道冰山就像漂浮的冰山，大部分冰隐藏在水下吗？知道极地地区被冰覆盖是因为太冷了水一直保持冰冻吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 午夜太阳与极夜
topics.description: 知道在极地，白天和黑夜非常极端——夏天太阳从不完全落下（午夜太阳），冬天太阳从不升起（持续数月的极夜）——这与我们在家经历的情况非常不同，那里每天都有白天和黑夜
evidence: Describe midnight sun: in polar summer, the Sun stays above the horizon all day and night
Describe polar night: in polar winter, the Sun stays below the horizon for weeks or months
Compare this to normal day-night patterns at home, noting the dramatic difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道这个神奇的事实吗——在极地，夏天太阳完全不落，冬天太阳完全不升，所以可能有连续几个月的白天或连续几个月的黑夜？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 企鹅
topics.description: 了解企鹅的关键事实——它们生活在南极和南半球，不会飞但游泳非常出色，帝企鹅是最大的企鹅，冬天挤在一起取暖，企鹅父母轮流在严寒中把蛋放在脚上保暖
evidence: State at least three facts about penguins: they can't fly, they're excellent swimmers, and Emperor penguins are the biggest
Describe how Emperor penguins huddle together in winter to keep warm
Explain that penguin parents take turns keeping their egg warm on their feet in freezing temperatures
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出企鹅的事吗——它们不会飞但游泳很棒，帝企鹅挤成大群取暖，企鹅爸爸把蛋放在脚上平衡好几周？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地动物
topics.description: 了解企鹅和北极熊之外的其他极地动物——在冰下游动的海豹、长着长牙的海象、冬天变白的北极狐、雪鸮、长着独角兽般长牙的独角鲸，以及迁徙到极地水域觅食的鲸鱼——并知道这些动物都有在极寒中生存的特殊特征
evidence: Name at least four polar animals beyond penguins and polar bears, such as seals, walruses, Arctic foxes, snowy owls, or narwhals
Describe one way each named animal survives the cold (e.g. walrus blubber, Arctic fox white winter coat)
State that narwhals have a long spiral tusk and live in Arctic waters
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出几种生活在严寒极地的动物吗——比如海象、北极狐、雪鸮或独角鲸——并解释它们如何应对寒冷？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 北极熊
topics.description: 了解北极熊的关键事实——它们只生活在北极（不在南极），有厚厚的白色皮毛和一层脂肪（鲸脂）来保暖，游泳非常出色，它们在海冰的洞口耐心等待来捕猎海豹
evidence: State that polar bears live in the Arctic, not the Antarctic
Describe at least two ways polar bears stay warm: thick white fur and a layer of blubber (fat)
Explain how polar bears hunt seals by waiting at breathing holes in the sea ice
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲出北极熊的事吗——它们只生活在北极，厚厚的皮毛和鲸脂让它们保暖，它们在冰洞口耐心等待来捕猎海豹？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极点在哪里？
topics.description: 知道地球有北极和南极——地球上最冷的两个地方——能在球仪上找到它们，理解它们位于地球的最顶端和最底端，离赤道尽可能远
evidence: Point to the North Pole and South Pole on a globe or world map
Explain that the poles are the coldest places on Earth because they are farthest from the Equator
State that the North Pole is at the top and the South Pole is at the bottom of the Earth
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果给 {{name}} 一个地球仪，他们能指出北极和南极，并告诉你它们是地球上最冷的地方吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 寒冷天气的适应
topics.description: 理解极地动物如何适应在极寒中生存——鲸脂（厚厚的脂肪层）为海豹和鲸鱼保温，北极熊的中空毛发锁住空气保暖，企鹅鳍状肢中的逆流热交换防止热量流失，北极狐长出厚厚的白色冬季皮毛用于伪装和保暖，有些动物迁徙以避开最严酷的月份
evidence: Describe at least three cold-weather adaptations: blubber, hollow fur, counter-current heat exchange, white winter coats, or migration
Explain the purpose of each adaptation (e.g. blubber insulates against cold water, white fur provides camouflage in snow)
Use the word adaptation correctly to mean a feature that helps an animal survive in its environment
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释极地动物在严寒中生存的几种方式吗——比如北极熊的中空毛发锁住暖空气、海豹厚厚的鲸脂，或者北极狐在冬天变色？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 比较北极与南极
topics.description: 详细比较北极和南极——北极是被漂浮海冰覆盖的海洋，周围有陆地（加拿大、俄罗斯、格陵兰、斯堪的纳维亚），而南极是被厚达 4 公里的冰层覆盖的、比欧洲还大的大陆；北极熊、北极狐和海象只生活在北极，而企鹅、豹海豹和信天翁只出现在南极
evidence: State that the Arctic is a frozen ocean surrounded by land (name at least two bordering countries), while Antarctica is a continent covered by ice sheet up to 4 km thick
Correctly assign at least three animals to the Arctic and three to the Antarctic
Name at least two differences in human presence: indigenous peoples in the Arctic vs research stations only in Antarctica
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能详细解释北极和南极有什么不同吗——哪些动物住在哪里、一个是冰冻的海洋另一个是冰冻的大陆，以及哪些国家与北极接壤？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 冰与物质状态
topics.description: 理解不同形式的冰和物质状态——海水结冰时形成海冰（含盐且相对较薄），冰川冰由数百年压缩的雪形成（淡水，非常厚），冰山从冰川断裂后漂浮在海上；知道水以固体（冰）、液体（水）和气体（水蒸气）的形式存在，盐会降低水的冰点
evidence: Distinguish between sea ice (frozen ocean, salty, thin) and glacial ice (compacted snow, fresh water, thick)
Explain that icebergs break off from glaciers and float because ice is less dense than liquid water
Describe the three states of water (solid, liquid, gas) and explain that salt lowers the freezing point
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释海冰和冰川冰的区别，并描述水如何在固体、液体和气体之间变化吗——也许可以用盐水和淡水做一个简单的冷冻实验？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 因纽特人与萨米人
topics.description: 知道原住民已经在北极生活了数千年——因纽特人分布在加拿大、阿拉斯加和格陵兰，萨米人住在斯堪的纳维亚北部——他们对环境有着非凡的了解，用狗拉雪橇和皮划艇出行，穿兽皮衣物保暖，建造冰屋作为临时住所，对他们赖以生存的动物和土地怀有深深的敬意
evidence: Name the Inuit (Canada, Alaska, Greenland) and Sami (northern Scandinavia) as Arctic indigenous peoples
Describe at least three aspects of traditional Arctic life: dog sleds, kayaks, animal-skin clothing, igloos, or hunting practices
Explain that indigenous Arctic peoples have deep knowledge of their environment developed over thousands of years
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讲一讲在北极生活了数千年的因纽特人和萨米人吗——他们如何乘狗拉雪橇出行、穿兽皮衣物，以及对冰和动物的了解有多深？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地食物链
topics.description: 理解极地食物链——在南极，浮游植物被磷虾吃，磷虾被鱼和企鹅吃，企鹅被豹海豹和虎鲸吃；在北极，冰下的藻类喂养浮游动物，浮游动物喂养鱼，鱼喂养海豹，海豹喂养北极熊——像磷虾和浮游生物这样微小的生物是所有极地生命的基础
evidence: Construct an Antarctic food chain: phytoplankton → krill → penguin → leopard seal or orca
Construct an Arctic food chain: algae → zooplankton → fish → seal → polar bear
Explain why krill and plankton are critical — without them, the entire food chain collapses
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释一条极地食物链吗——从微小的浮游生物开始，经过磷虾和鱼，一直到海豹和北极熊或虎鲸——并解释为什么最底层的微小生物如此重要？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 北极苔原
topics.description: 知道什么是北极苔原——一片广阔、没有树木的景观，地表下是永久冻土（永远冻结的土地），夏季生长季非常短，苔藓、地衣和耐寒的草类蓬勃生长，是驯鹿、麝牛、旅鼠和雪鸮的家园
evidence: Describe the tundra as a treeless landscape with permafrost (permanently frozen ground) beneath the surface
Explain that the tundra has a very short summer growing season when mosses, lichens, and grasses grow quickly
Name at least three tundra animals: caribou/reindeer, musk oxen, lemmings, or snowy owls
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道什么是苔原吗——北极附近那片巨大平坦、没有树木的景观，地下是冻土，夏天很短但万物蓬勃生长？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 南极点的竞赛
topics.description: 详细了解南极点竞赛的故事——挪威人罗尔德·阿蒙森和英国人罗伯特·法尔肯·斯科特都在 1911 年出发，阿蒙森使用狗拉雪橇和周密计划于 12 月 14 日率先到达，斯科特晚 34 天到达，使用人力拖拽的雪橇，不幸在返程中与队友遇难；还要了解欧内斯特·沙克尔顿 1914 年的“坚忍号”探险，船只被冰困住并压碎，以及沙克尔顿乘小船前往南乔治亚岛营救船员的非凡旅程
evidence: Describe the Scott vs Amundsen race: Amundsen arrived 14 December 1911 using dog sleds; Scott arrived 34 days later and died on the return
Explain at least two reasons Amundsen succeeded: better planning, dog sleds, polar experience, and lighter supplies
Narrate the key events of the Endurance expedition: ship crushed, camps on ice, boat journey to South Georgia, all crew rescued
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能详细讲述阿蒙森和斯科特竞逐南极点的故事吗——谁赢了、为什么，斯科特出了什么问题，以及沙克尔顿“坚忍号”不可思议的求生故事？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 为什么极地季节如此极端
topics.description: 理解为什么两极的季节如此极端——地球自转轴倾斜约 23.5°，所以当地球绕太阳公转时，每个极地有半年时间朝向太阳倾斜（持续白昼，夏季更暖），半年时间背离太阳倾斜（持续黑暗，冬季严寒）；这种倾斜也驱动着海冰冬季扩张、夏季退缩的年度循环，并触发迁徙和繁殖等动物行为
evidence: Explain that Earth's axis is tilted at about 23.5° and this tilt causes the extreme polar seasons
Describe how the tilt means each pole faces toward the Sun for half the year (summer/daylight) and away for the other half (winter/darkness)
Connect the seasonal cycle to at least one animal behaviour, such as migration or sea ice retreat affecting hunting
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释为什么两极夏季有连续几个月的白昼、冬季有连续几个月的黑暗吗——这是因为地球绕太阳公转时自转轴是倾斜的？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 南极条约与研究
topics.description: 了解南极洲受《南极条约》管辖（1959 年签署，1961 年生效）——该条约将南极洲保留用于和平目的和科学研究，禁止军事活动和采矿，已有 50 多个国家签署；理解国际科考站研究气候、天文、生物和地质，南极洲是地球上最接近“为科学而非政治而存在”的大陆
evidence: State that the Antarctic Treaty (1959) sets Antarctica aside for peace and science, banning military activity and mining
Know that over 50 countries have signed the treaty and that many operate research stations
Name at least two areas of scientific research conducted in Antarctica: climate, astronomy, biology, or geology
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 了解《南极条约》吗——50 多个国家同意南极洲只用于科学和和平，不用于战争或采矿——以及那里的科考站研究从冰层到恒星的一切？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地气候变化
topics.description: 理解气候变化如何影响极地地区——北极海冰正在急剧缩小（自 1979 年以来每十年约减少 13%），格陵兰和南极冰盖正在失去质量并导致海平面上升，永久冻土正在融化并释放甲烷（一种强效温室气体），这些变化形成正反馈循环：融化导致更多变暖，更多变暖又导致更多融化
evidence: State that Arctic sea ice has been declining at roughly 13% per decade since 1979
Explain the positive feedback loop: warming → ice melts → dark ocean absorbs more heat → more warming → more melting
Describe at least two consequences of polar ice loss: sea level rise and permafrost thawing releasing methane
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释气候变化如何融化极地冰层吗——北极海冰在缩小，冰盖在失去质量，而融化实际上会引发更多融化，形成恶性循环？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 地球的冰冻水
topics.description: 理解冰冻圈及其在地球水系统中的作用——冰冻圈是地球上所有冰冻的水（冰盖、冰川、海冰、永久冻土、积雪）；极地冰盖储存了地球约 69% 的淡水；如果所有极地冰都融化，海平面将上升超过 65 米；水循环通过蒸发、降水和融水流入海洋，将极地冰与全球系统连接起来
evidence: Define the cryosphere as all frozen water on Earth and name its components: ice sheets, glaciers, sea ice, permafrost, snow
State that polar ice sheets hold approximately 69% of Earth's fresh water
Explain how polar ice connects to the global water cycle and what would happen if it all melted (65m+ sea level rise)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道地球大部分淡水其实以冰的形式锁在两极吗——而且如果全部融化，海平面将上升超过 65 米，淹没全球沿海城市？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 冰川与冰盖
topics.description: 理解冰川和冰盖如何形成和运动——积雪经过数百年堆积并压缩成致密的冰，冰川在自身重量下缓慢向下流动，刻出 U 形谷并沉积冰碛；格陵兰和南极冰盖加在一起所存的冰足以让海平面上升超过 65 米；从这些冰盖钻取的冰芯中含有被困住的气泡，揭示了地球过去 80 万年的气候历史
evidence: Describe how glaciers form: snow accumulates, compresses, and becomes dense ice that flows slowly under its own weight
Explain that the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets hold enough water to raise sea levels dramatically if melted
Describe how ice cores reveal climate history through trapped air bubbles from hundreds of thousands of years ago
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释冰川如何由层层积雪压成冰、如何缓慢刻出山谷，以及科学家如何钻入冰盖了解数千年前地球的气候吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地气候带
topics.description: 理解极地地区属于极地气候带——地球五大主要气候带之一（热带、干旱带、温带、大陆性气候带、极地气候带）——其特征是即使夏季气温也很少超过 10°C，降水稀少（极地沙漠的降雨量比撒哈拉还少），风力强劲；了解纬度是决定气候带的关键因素，极地地区位于北纬/南纬 60° 以上
evidence: Name the five main climate zones and place polar regions correctly within them
State that polar regions are above approximately 60° latitude and explain that distance from the Equator is the main reason they are cold
Describe polar climate characteristics: rarely above 10°C in summer, very low precipitation, strong winds
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释极地气候带在地球五大气候带中的位置，以及两极为什么这么冷——把它与两极位于高纬度、远离赤道的位置联系起来吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地保护与未来
topics.description: 理解极地地区面临的保护挑战——南大洋的海洋保护区旨在保护南极生态系统，随着冰层退缩，北极国家就北方航线和资源的主权产生争议，原住民争取土地权利和在环境决策中的发言权，国际合作（《巴黎协定》《南极条约》）至关重要，但随着经济压力增大，维持合作变得困难
evidence: Describe at least two conservation measures: marine protected areas in the Southern Ocean and the Antarctic Treaty
Explain why Arctic sovereignty is contested as ice retreats and shipping routes open
Describe the role of indigenous peoples in Arctic environmental decisions and why their knowledge matters
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能讨论两极面临的重大挑战吗——比如随着冰层融化，各国争夺北极资源，推动在南极建立海洋保护区，以及为什么原住民的声音在这些决策中很重要？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地生态系统比较
topics.description: 比较北极和南极生态系统——北极既有陆地（苔原）生态系统也有海洋生态系统，支撑着大型陆地哺乳动物和原住民人类社区，而南极几乎完全以海洋为基础，几乎没有陆地植物或哺乳动物；两个地区的食物链都短而集中，以浮游植物和磷虾为基础，而且都受到气候变化和人类活动的格外严重的影响
evidence: Compare Arctic (terrestrial + marine, land mammals, human communities) with Antarctic (almost entirely marine, no land mammals)
Explain that both polar food chains depend on phytoplankton and krill at the base
Describe why polar ecosystems are particularly vulnerable to climate change (short food chains, specialised organisms)
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能比较北极和南极生态系统吗——解释北极有陆地动物和人类，而南极的生命几乎全在海洋中，并且两者都依赖磷虾这样的小生物？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地探索的过去与现在
topics.description: 比较历史上的极地探索与现代极地科学——英雄时代（1897–1922）依靠船只、雪橇犬和人的耐力，许多人因此丧生；而今天的极地科学家使用 GPS、卫星、破冰船、带暖气的研究站和飞机；了解现代挑战包括研究气候变化数据，以及极地科学现在有来自不同国家的多元化团队，包括冰川学家 Liz Thomas 和海洋生物学家 Sylvia Earle 等女性科学家
evidence: Compare Heroic Age exploration (dog sleds, man-hauling, many deaths) with modern science (GPS, satellites, icebreakers, heated stations)
Name at least two technologies that make modern polar science possible
Name a modern polar scientist and explain that today's polar teams are diverse and international
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能比较过去的极地探索——狗拉雪橇、冰冷的营地、真实的死亡危险——与现代极地科学使用卫星、带暖气的研究站和多元化国际团队吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 极地海洋与世界气候
topics.description: 了解极地海洋如何与全球气候系统相连——寒冷、高密度的极地海水下沉，驱动温盐环流（全球洋流传送带）；海冰将阳光反射回太空（反照率效应），帮助调节地球温度；南极洲周围的南大洋因上升流带来的营养物质，是地球上生产力最高的海洋生态系统之一
evidence: Explain that cold, dense polar water sinks and drives global ocean circulation (thermohaline circulation)
Describe the albedo effect: white ice reflects sunlight back to space, while dark ocean absorbs heat
State that the Southern Ocean is extremely productive because upwelling brings nutrients to the surface
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释寒冷的极地海水如何下沉并驱动全球洋流传送带，以及白色的海冰如何反射阳光帮助地球保持凉爽吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 来自雨林的日常食物
topics.description: 知道许多日常食物来自雨林——巧克力由可可豆制成，香蕉生长在热带森林中，咖啡果在森林树荫下成熟，巴西坚果从巨树上掉落——把我们的日常生活与遥远的森林联系起来
evidence: Name at least three foods that come from rainforests, such as chocolate (cacao), bananas, and Brazil nuts
Explain that cacao beans grow on trees in the rainforest and are made into chocolate
Connect their own food choices to rainforest origins by identifying a product they eat that comes from the forest
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 正在吃巧克力棒或香蕉，他们能告诉你这些食物最初来自雨林吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林原住民
topics.description: 知道亚诺马米人等原住民已在雨林中生活了数千年，用森林材料建造房屋，通过打猎、捕鱼和采集寻找食物，并深入了解森林及其动植物
evidence: Explain that indigenous peoples like the Yanomami have lived in rainforests for thousands of years
Describe how they use the forest for shelter, food, and medicine
Show respect for indigenous knowledge by explaining that these communities understand the forest very deeply
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道有些人已在雨林中生活了数千年——用树木建造房屋，知道哪些植物是食物、哪些是药物吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林内部
topics.description: 描述身处雨林中的感受——又热又黏（潮湿），因为树冠遮挡光线而地面昏暗，动物叫声和昆虫嗡嗡声很响，雨水和凝结水不断滴落
evidence: Describe the air inside a rainforest as hot and sticky (humid)
Explain that the forest floor is dark because tall trees block most of the sunlight
Name at least two sounds you would hear in a rainforest, such as bird calls, insect buzzing, or rain dripping
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 观看一段雨林视频，他们能描述站在里面会是什么感觉、什么声音、什么样子——炎热、嘈杂、地面昏暗吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林动物
topics.description: 说出并认识标志性的雨林动物——美洲豹、巨嘴鸟、树懒、箭毒蛙、吼猴、金刚鹦鹉和蝴蝶——并知道它们各自生活在雨林的哪一层
evidence: Name at least five iconic rainforest animals such as jaguars, toucans, sloths, poison dart frogs, and howler monkeys
Match at least three animals to the rainforest layer where they live (e.g. monkeys in the canopy, jaguars on the forest floor)
Describe one distinctive feature of each named animal
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出至少五种生活在雨林中的动物，并各说出一点特征——比如巨嘴鸟色彩鲜艳的大嘴，或树懒倒挂在树上吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林昆虫
topics.description: 知道雨林是数百万昆虫的家园——种植真菌的切叶蚁、巨型甲虫、宝石色蝴蝶、巨大的蜘蛛和竹节虫——昆虫是雨林中数量最多的动物
evidence: Name at least three types of insect or minibeast found in the rainforest, such as leaf-cutter ants, morpho butterflies, and giant beetles
Explain that insects are the most numerous animals in the rainforest
Describe one interesting behaviour, such as leaf-cutter ants carrying leaf pieces back to grow fungus
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 知道雨林里到处都是昆虫——比如排成长队搬运叶片碎片的切叶蚁，或像餐盘一样大的蝴蝶吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林分层
topics.description: 知道雨林从地面到天空有四层——森林地面层（昏暗、潮湿、满是分解的落叶）、林下层（树荫下的小树和灌木）、树冠层（大多数动物生活的浓密树顶）、露生层（高出树冠、伸向明亮阳光的最高树木）
evidence: Name the four rainforest layers in order from ground to sky: forest floor, understory, canopy, emergent
Describe one key feature of each layer, such as the canopy being a thick roof of leaves or the forest floor being dark and damp
Explain that most rainforest animals live in the canopy because that is where there is food and light
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 画一片雨林，他们能画出四个层次——昏暗的森林地面层、阴凉的林下层、枝叶茂密的树冠层，以及伸向天空的最高露生层树木吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林植物
topics.description: 知道雨林里有种类极其丰富的植物——高耸的吉贝树和巴西坚果树、被称为藤本的攀缘藤蔓、长在树枝上的彩色兰花、巨大的睡莲，还有能把雨水汇聚起来的大叶子
evidence: Name at least three types of rainforest plant, such as kapok trees, lianas (climbing vines), and orchids
Explain that rainforest plants grow very tall because they compete for sunlight
Describe one unusual feature, such as orchids growing on tree branches or lianas climbing up trunks
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能说出一些生长在雨林里的植物吗——比如参天大树、攀缘藤蔓，或者长在树枝上的兰花——并能解释它们为什么长得这么大、这么高？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 什么是雨林？
topics.description: 知道雨林是生长在赤道附近炎热潮湿地区的高大茂密森林，那里几乎天天下雨，形成温暖潮湿的环境，植物和动物都能茁壮生长
evidence: Describe a rainforest as a forest that is hot and wet, located near the Equator
Explain that it rains very often in a rainforest, which is why the plants grow so tall and thick
Point to the Equator on a globe and say that rainforests are found in the hot belt near it
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张图片，上面是茂密的绿色丛林、巨大的树木和垂挂的藤蔓，他们能告诉你这是雨林，并解释那里几乎每天都很热、经常下雨吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林分布在哪里
topics.description: 知道雨林分布在地球中部的一条带状区域——南美洲（亚马孙）、中非（刚果）和东南亚——并且除南极洲和欧洲外，每个大洲都有雨林
evidence: Point to the Amazon, Congo, and Southeast Asian rainforest regions on a world map
Explain that rainforests grow near the Equator where it is hot and wet all year
Name at least two continents that have large rainforests
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一张世界地图，他们能指出雨林生长的地方吗——在地球中部附近，比如南美洲、非洲和亚洲？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林生物的分类
topics.description: 把雨林生物归入主要类别——哺乳动物（美洲豹、猴子、蝙蝠）、鸟类（巨嘴鸟、金刚鹦鹉、蜂鸟）、爬行动物（蛇、蜥蜴、凯门鳄）、两栖动物（树蛙、箭毒蛙）、昆虫（蝴蝶、蚂蚁、甲虫）和植物（树木、附生植物、蕨类）——并利用可观察的特征对它们进行分类
evidence: Sort at least eight rainforest organisms into correct groups: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, insects, or plants
State the key feature that defines each group (e.g. mammals have fur and feed milk to their young)
Explain why classification helps scientists understand and study the huge variety of life in rainforests
topics.assessmentPrompt: 如果 {{name}} 看不同雨林动物的图片，他们能把它们分到哺乳动物、鸟类、爬行动物和昆虫等类别里，并解释每一种为什么属于它所在的类别吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 原住民的生态知识
topics.description: 理解雨林原住民在数千年间积累了深厚的生态知识——用植物做药、做食物和建筑材料，采用轮耕等可持续的耕作方式，并以现代科学才刚刚开始重视的方式理解动物行为和森林生态
evidence: Give at least two examples of indigenous knowledge, such as using specific plants as medicine or practising sustainable farming
Explain what shifting cultivation is and why it is less harmful to the forest than permanent clearing
Describe how indigenous knowledge and modern science can work together to protect rainforests
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释雨林原住民对森林里的植物和动物了解得非常多——比如哪些植物能治病——而且科学家正在从这些知识中学习吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林动物的生存妙招
topics.description: 知道雨林动物如何适应环境——伪装帮助叶虫和树蛙藏身，鲜艳的警告色（警戒色）表明箭毒蛙有毒，卷尾能让猴子抓住树枝，巨嘴鸟的大嘴帮助它够到远处的果实，许多动物在夜间活动以避开白天的酷热
evidence: Describe at least three animal adaptations such as camouflage, warning colours, and prehensile tails
Explain how each adaptation helps the animal survive (e.g. camouflage hides prey from predators)
Give a specific example for each adaptation, linking the animal to its rainforest layer
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释箭毒蛙为什么颜色那么鲜艳——那是在警告捕食者它很危险——或者树懒为什么动得那么慢，慢到毛上长出藻类，帮它更好地融入环境吗？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林食物网
topics.description: 理解能量和养分如何在雨林食物网中流动——从植物（生产者）到食草动物（初级消费者）再到捕食者（次级消费者）——以及真菌和昆虫等分解者会分解森林地面上的死亡物质，把养分循环回土壤，供植物再次利用
evidence: Construct a simple rainforest food chain with at least three levels: producer → herbivore → predator
Explain the role of decomposers in breaking down dead material and returning nutrients to the soil
Use the terms producer, consumer, and decomposer correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: {{name}} 能解释一条雨林食物链吗——比如一棵果树喂养猴子，猴子可能被美洲豹捕食，而当生物死亡后，微小的生物会把它们分解，再次滋养树木？

topics.subject: Science
topics.name: 雨林植物的适应
topics.description: 知道雨林植物如何适应环境——滴水尖叶子能迅速把水排走以防腐烂，板根向四周伸展，在贫瘠土壤中支撑高大的树木，附生植物（如兰花和凤梨科植物）长在树枝上，无需土壤就能获得阳光，藤本植物攀爬树干以到达林冠层
evidence: Describe at least three plant adaptations: drip-tip leaves, buttress roots, and epiphytes
Explain the purpose of each adaptation (e.g. drip-tips shed water to prevent rot)
Use the word adaptation to mean a feature that helps an organism survive in its environment
